+function GS2TT_Append takes player p, integer abilId, integer maxLevel, string talentName, string effectText, boolean showEffect returns nothing
+    local integer i = 0
+    local string oldText
+    local string addText
+    if GetLocalPlayer() == p then
+        if showEffect and StringLength(effectText) > 0 then
+            set addText = "|n|n|cff80ff80[특성 적용] " + talentName + "|r|n" + effectText
+        else
+            set addText = "|n|n|cff80ff80[특성 적용] " + talentName + "|r"
+        endif
+        loop
+            exitwhen i >= maxLevel
+            set oldText = BlzGetAbilityExtendedTooltip(abilId, i)
+            call BlzSetAbilityExtendedTooltip(abilId, oldText + addText, i)
+            set i = i + 1
+        endloop
+    endif
+endfunction
+function SP172_Alive takes unit u returns boolean
+    return u != null and GetUnitTypeId(u) != 0 and GetWidgetLife(u) > 0.405 and not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_DEAD)
+endfunction
+function SP172_Distance takes unit a, unit b returns real
+    local real x=GetUnitX(a)-GetUnitX(b)
+    local real y=GetUnitY(a)-GetUnitY(b)
+    return SquareRoot(x*x+y*y)
+endfunction
+function SP172_Trait takes unit h, integer id returns boolean
+    return GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),id,true)>0
+endfunction
+function SP174_Number takes real amount returns string
+    if RAbsBJ(amount-I2R(R2I(amount)))<0.05 then
+        return I2S(R2I(amount))
+    endif
+    return R2SW(amount,1,1)
+endfunction
+function SP174_Expire takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local effect fx=LoadEffectHandle(SP174_FX,k,0)
+    if fx!=null then
+        call DestroyEffect(fx)
+    endif
+    call FlushChildHashtable(SP174_FX,k)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    set fx=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function SP172_QLabel takes unit h returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    local texttag tag=LoadTextTagHandle(SP172_Data,k,6)
+    local integer count=LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,3)
+    if tag!=null then

+        call SetTextTagPosUnit(tag,h,85.0)
+    endif
+    set tag=null
+endfunction

+function SP172_RUpdate takes unit h returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    local integer lv=GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpR')
+    local boolean pending=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,20)!=null and not LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,24)
+    local boolean changed=pending!=LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,30) or lv!=LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,31)
+    local ability a=BlzGetUnitAbility(h,'ASpR')
+    local integer i=0
+    local integer cost
+    local real range=1000.0
+    local real remaining
+    if lv<=0 or a==null then
+        set a=null
+        return
+    endif
+    if pending then
+        set range=99999.0
+    endif
+    if changed then
+        loop
+            exitwhen i>=3
+            set cost=120+30*i
+            if pending then
+                set cost=0
+            endif
+            call BlzSetUnitAbilityManaCost(h,'ASpR',i,cost)
+            call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ABILITY_RLF_CAST_RANGE,i,range)
+            set i=i+1
+        endloop
+        if lv==1 then
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpR',2)
+        else
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpR',1)
+        endif
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpR',lv)
+        call SaveBoolean(SP172_Data,k,30,pending)
+        call SaveInteger(SP172_Data,k,31,lv)
+    endif
+    if pending then
+        call BlzEndUnitAbilityCooldown(h,'ASpR')
+        call SaveBoolean(SP172_Data,k,28,false)
+    elseif LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,28) then
+        set remaining=LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,27)-SP172_Time
+        if remaining>0.0 and not IsTriggerEnabled(gg_trg_Single_WTFEffect) then
+            call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(h,'ASpR',remaining)
+        else
+            call BlzEndUnitAbilityCooldown(h,'ASpR')
+        endif
+        call SaveBoolean(SP172_Data,k,28,false)
+    endif
+    set a=null
+endfunction
+function SP172_RStop takes unit h returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    local boolean wasPending=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,20)!=null and not LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,24)
+    local lightning wire=LoadLightningHandle(SP172_Data,k,25)
+    call SaveInteger(SP172_Data,k,32,LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,32)+1)
+    call RemoveSavedHandle(SP172_Data,k,20)
+    call RemoveSavedHandle(SP172_Data,k,21)
+    call SaveBoolean(SP172_Data,k,24,false)
+    if wire!=null then
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(SP172_Data,k,25)
+        call DestroyLightning(wire)
+    endif
+    if wasPending then
+        call SaveBoolean(SP172_Data,k,28,true)
+    endif
+    set wire=null
+endfunction

+function GS296_PandoraClap takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit target
+    local group targets
+    local integer level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster, 'A0O3')
+    if GetSpellAbilityId() != 'A0O3' or level < 1 or level > 3 then
+        set caster = null
+        return
+    endif
+    set targets = CreateGroup()
+    call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(targets, GetUnitX(caster), GetUnitY(caster), 542.00, null)
+    loop
+        set target = FirstOfGroup(targets)
+        exitwhen target == null
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(targets, target)
+        if IsUnitInRange(target, caster, 350.00) and IsUnitEnemy(target, GetOwningPlayer(caster)) and GetWidgetLife(target) > 0.405 and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_FLYING) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(target) then
+            call UnitDamageTarget(caster, target, 150.00, false, false, ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC, WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+        endif
+    endloop
+    call DestroyGroup(targets)
+    set targets = null
+    set target = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction

+endfunction

+function GS151_BloodApply takes unit h returns nothing
+    local integer key=GetHandleId(h)
+    local real life=GetWidgetLife(h)
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)!='HDr1' then
+        return
+    endif
+    if not LoadBoolean(GS2DW_Data,key,'BL51') then
+        call BlzSetUnitMaxHP(h,BlzGetUnitMaxHP(h)+200)
+        if life>0.405 then
+            call SetWidgetLife(h,life+200.0)
+        endif
+        call SaveBoolean(GS2DW_Data,key,'BL51',true)
+    endif
+    if GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'DM51')==0 then
+        call UnitAddAbility(h,'DM51')
+        call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(h,true,'DM51')
+        call BlzUnitHideAbility(h,'DM51',true)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GS120_BreathVisualTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer key=GetHandleId(t)
+    local effect e=LoadEffectHandle(GS2DW_Data,key,11)
+    local effect frost
+    local integer i=0
+    local real offset
+    local real trail
+    local real forward
+    local real sx=LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,13)
+    local real sy=LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,14)
+    local real previous=LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,12)
+    local real distance=previous+LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,15)*0.03125
+    local real angle=LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,16)
+    if previous>=1000.0 then
+        call BlzSetSpecialEffectScale(e,0.0)
+        call DestroyEffect(e)
+        loop
+            exitwhen i>=3
+            set frost=LoadEffectHandle(GS2DW_Data,key,17+i)
+            call BlzSetSpecialEffectAlpha(frost,0)
+            call BlzSetSpecialEffectScale(frost,0.0)
+            call DestroyEffect(frost)
+            set i=i+1
+        endloop
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS2DW_Data,key)
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    else
+        if distance>1000.0 then
+            set distance=1000.0
+        endif
+        call BlzSetSpecialEffectX(e,LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,13)+distance*Cos(angle))
+        call BlzSetSpecialEffectY(e,LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,14)+distance*Sin(angle))
+        call BlzSetSpecialEffectScale(e,0.80)
+        set trail=distance
+        loop
+            exitwhen i>=3
+            set frost=LoadEffectHandle(GS2DW_Data,key,17+i)
+            set offset=I2R(i-1)*(37.5+112.5*trail/1000.0)
+            set forward=trail
+            if forward*forward+offset*offset>1000000.0 then
+                set forward=SquareRoot(1000000.0-offset*offset)
+            endif
+            call BlzSetSpecialEffectX(frost,sx+forward*Cos(angle)-offset*Sin(angle))
+            call BlzSetSpecialEffectY(frost,sy+forward*Sin(angle)+offset*Cos(angle))
+            call BlzSetSpecialEffectAlpha(frost,130)
+            set i=i+1
+        endloop
+        call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,key,12,distance)
+    endif
+    set frost=null
+    set e=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GS120_BreathLimit takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit source = GetEventDamageSource()
+    local unit target = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local real dx
+    local real dy
+    if GetUnitTypeId(source) == 'dDr1' then
+        set dx = GetUnitX(target)-GetUnitX(source)
+        set dy = GetUnitY(target)-GetUnitY(source)
+        if dx*dx+dy*dy > 1000000.0 then
+            call BlzSetEventDamage(0.0)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set source = null
+    set target = null
+endfunction

+    set t=null
+endfunction

+function GS107_Spell takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer sid = GetHandleId(caster)
+    local integer level
+    local group g
+    local unit u
+    if GetSpellAbilityId() == 'ADq2' and GetUnitTypeId(caster) == 'HDr1' then
+        set level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster, 'ADq2')
+        if level > 4 then
+            set level = level - 4
+        endif
+        call SaveReal(GS107_Data, sid, 10, TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime) + 2.0)
+        call SaveInteger(GS107_Data, sid, 11, level)
+        call SaveInteger(GS107_Data, sid, 12, LoadInteger(GS107_Data, sid, 12) + 1)
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS107_Hits, sid)
+    elseif GetSpellAbilityId() == 'A0PT' then
+        set g = CreateGroup()
+        call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(g, GetSpellTargetX(), GetSpellTargetY(), 400.0, null)
+        loop
+            set u = FirstOfGroup(g)
+            exitwhen u == null
+            call GroupRemoveUnit(g, u)
+            if GetWidgetLife(u) > 0.405 and IsUnitEnemy(u, GetOwningPlayer(caster)) and not IsUnitType(u, UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(u) then
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'Bams')
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'Bam2')
+            endif
+        endloop
+        call DestroyGroup(g)
+    endif
+    set g = null
+    set u = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction

+        if LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,5) then
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'SW44')
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'BW45')
+        endif
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS144_Data,uid)
+    endif
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS144_Data,key)
+    call PauseTimer(t)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+endfunction
+function GS144_BootAttack takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetAttacker()
+    local integer uid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local real now = TimerGetElapsed(GS144_Clock)
+    if LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,0) and now <= LoadReal(GS144_Data,uid,1) and not LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,7) then
+        call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,0,false)
+        call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,7,true)
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GS144_Data,uid,3,GetTriggerUnit())
+        call SaveReal(GS144_Data,uid,4,now+3.00)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function GS144_BootDamage takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetEventDamageSource()
+    local integer uid = GetHandleId(u)
+    if BlzGetEventIsAttack() and GetEventDamage() > 0.00 and LoadUnitHandle(GS144_Data,uid,3) == GetTriggerUnit() and TimerGetElapsed(GS144_Clock) <= LoadReal(GS144_Data,uid,4) then
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS144_Data,uid,3)
+        call BlzSetEventDamage(GetEventDamage()+100.00)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function GS114S_Band takes unit h returns integer
+    if GetHeroLevel(h) >= 15 then
+        return 3
+    elseif GetHeroLevel(h) >= 8 then
+        return 2
+    endif
+    return 1
+endfunction
+function GS114S_Enemy takes unit v, unit h returns boolean
+    return v != null and GetWidgetLife(v) > 0.405 and IsUnitEnemy(v, GetOwningPlayer(h)) and not IsUnitType(v, UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not IsUnitType(v, UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(v)
+endfunction
+function GS114S_StopSiege takes unit h returns nothing
+    local integer k = GetHandleId(h)
+    local unit a = LoadUnitHandle(GS114S_Data, k, 21)
+    local unit b = LoadUnitHandle(GS114S_Data, k, 22)
+    local timer duration = LoadTimerHandle(GS114S_Data,k,40)
+    local real remaining
+    call SaveBoolean(GS114S_Data, k, 23, false)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS114S_Data,k,42,false)
+    if duration != null then
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS114S_Data,k,40)
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(duration))
+        call PauseTimer(duration)
+        call DestroyTimer(duration)
+    endif
+    if HaveSavedReal(GS114S_Data,k,44) then
+        set remaining=RMaxBJ(0.0,LoadReal(GS114S_Data,k,44)-TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime))
+        if remaining>0.0 then
+            call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(h,'ASg1',remaining)
+        else
+            call BlzEndUnitAbilityCooldown(h,'ASg1')
+        endif
+    endif
+    call BlzUnitHideAbility(h,'ASf1',true)
+    if GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASs1') > 0 then
+        call BlzUnitHideAbility(h,'ASs1',false)
+    endif
+    set duration = null
+    call RemoveSavedHandle(GS114S_Data, k, 21)
+    call RemoveSavedHandle(GS114S_Data, k, 22)
+    if a != null then
+        call RemoveUnit(a)
+    endif
+    if b != null then
+        call RemoveUnit(b)
+    endif
+    call BlzUnitHideAbility(h, 'ASx1', true)
+    set a = null
+    set b = null
+endfunction
+function GS121_Fire takes unit h, real x, real y returns nothing
+    local unit a = LoadUnitHandle(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(h),21)
+    local unit b = LoadUnitHandle(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(h),22)
+    if a != null then
+        call IssuePointOrder(a,"attackground",x,y)
+    endif
+    if b != null then
+        call IssuePointOrder(b,"attackground",x,y)
+    endif
+    set a = null
+    set b = null
+endfunction
+function GS114S_ItemOrder takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer order=GetIssuedOrderId()
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(h)
+    local item it
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)=='USa1' and order>=852008 and order<=852013 then
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS114S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItem"))
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS114S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItemTarget"))
+        call RemoveSavedInteger(GS114S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItemType"))
+        if GetTriggerEventId()==EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_TARGET_ORDER and GetOrderTargetUnit()!=null then
+            set it=UnitItemInSlot(h,order-852008)
+            if it!=null then
+                call SaveItemHandle(GS114S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItem"),it)
+                call SaveInteger(GS114S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItemType"),GetItemTypeId(it))
+                call SaveUnitHandle(GS114S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItemTarget"),GetOrderTargetUnit())
+                call SaveBoolean(GS114S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemBonusPaid"),false)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set it=null
+    set h=null
+endfunction
+function GS116S_SiegeBegin takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GetUnitTypeId(GetTriggerUnit()) == 'USa1' and GetSpellAbilityId() == 'ASg1' then
+        call SaveBoolean(GS114S_Data, GetHandleId(GetTriggerUnit()), 23, true)
+        call BlzUnitHideAbility(GetTriggerUnit(), 'ASx1', false)
+    endif

+function GS138_SiegeCooldownSync takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()

+    local real remaining=RMaxBJ(0.0,LoadReal(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(h),44)-TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime))

+function GSRI_ProbeShape takes integer front, integer payload, integer ranks, integer lengthField, integer endField returns nothing
+    local unit probe = CreateUnit(Player(PLAYER_NEUTRAL_PASSIVE),'e002',0.0,0.0,0.0)
+    local ability a
+    local integer lv = 0
+    call ShowUnit(probe,false)
+    call UnitAddAbility(probe,payload)
+    set a = BlzGetUnitAbility(probe,payload)
+    if a != null then
+        call SaveInteger(GSRI_Data,front,2,5)
+        loop
+            exitwhen lv >= ranks
+            call SaveReal(GSRI_Data,front,200+lv*3,BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ABILITY_RLF_AREA_OF_EFFECT,lv))
+            call SaveReal(GSRI_Data,front,201+lv*3,BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ConvertAbilityRealLevelField(lengthField),lv))
+            call SaveReal(GSRI_Data,front,202+lv*3,BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ConvertAbilityRealLevelField(endField),lv))
+            set lv = lv+1
+        endloop
+    endif
+    call RemoveUnit(probe)
+    set probe = null
+    set a = null
+endfunction
+function GSRI_HideSegment takes integer i returns nothing
+    if i>=0 and i<GSRI_POOL_SIZE then
+        if GSRI_SegmentShown[i] and GSRI_Effect[i]!=null then
+            call SetLightningColor(GSRI_Effect[i],0,0,0,0)
+        endif
+        set GSRI_SegmentShown[i]=false
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GSRI_SmoothYaw takes real target returns real
+    local real delta
+    if not GSRI_YawValid then
+        set GSRI_Yaw = target
+        set GSRI_YawValid = true
+    else
+        set delta = Atan2(Sin(target-GSRI_Yaw), Cos(target-GSRI_Yaw))
+        if RAbsBJ(delta) < 0.001 then
+            set GSRI_Yaw = target
+        else
+            set GSRI_Yaw = GSRI_Yaw + delta*GSRI_TURN_BLEND
+            set GSRI_Yaw = Atan2(Sin(GSRI_Yaw), Cos(GSRI_Yaw))
+        endif
+    endif
+    return GSRI_Yaw
+endfunction
+function GSRI_Snapshot takes unit u returns nothing
+    local integer sid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer i = 0
+    local integer count = 0
+    local integer id
+    local integer lv
+    local integer offset
+    local integer profile
+    local integer lengthField
+    local integer endField
+    local ability a
+    local real range
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GSRI_Cache, sid)
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GSRI_CacheIndex, sid)
+    loop
+        set a = BlzGetUnitAbilityByIndex(u, i)
+        exitwhen a == null
+        set id = BlzGetAbilityId(a)
+        if LoadInteger(GSRI_Data, id, 1) != 0 and not HaveSavedInteger(GSRI_CacheIndex, sid, id) then
+            set offset = 1 + count*10
+            set lv = GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, id)-1
+            call SaveInteger(GSRI_CacheIndex, sid, id, offset)
+            call SaveInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset, id)
+            call SaveInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+1, lv)
+            call SaveInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+2, BlzGetAbilityIntegerField(a, ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_X))
+            call SaveInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+3, BlzGetAbilityIntegerField(a, ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_Y))
+            if lv >= 0 then
+                set range = BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a, ABILITY_RLF_CAST_RANGE, lv)
+                set profile = LoadInteger(GSRI_Data, id, 2)
+                if profile == 4 then
+                    set range = BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a, ConvertAbilityRealLevelField('Ebl1'), lv)
+                endif
+                call SaveReal(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+5, range)
+                if LoadInteger(GSRI_Data, id, 1) == 2 then
+                    call SaveInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+4, BlzGetAbilityIntegerLevelField(a, ConvertAbilityIntegerLevelField('Ncl2'), lv))
+                endif
+                call SaveReal(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+6, BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a, ABILITY_RLF_AREA_OF_EFFECT, lv))
+                if profile == 3 then
+                    set lengthField = LoadInteger(GSRI_Data, id, 3)
+                    set endField = LoadInteger(GSRI_Data, id, 4)
+                    if lengthField != 0 and endField != 0 then
+                        call SaveReal(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+7, BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a, ConvertAbilityRealLevelField(lengthField), lv))
+                        call SaveReal(GSRI_Cache, sid, offset+8, BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a, ConvertAbilityRealLevelField(endField), lv))
+                    endif
+                endif
+            endif
+            set count = count+1
+        endif
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+    call SaveInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, 0, count)
+    set a = null
+endfunction
+function GSRI_Level takes unit u, integer id returns integer
+    local integer offset
+    if id == 'ASpR' and GetUnitTypeId(u) == 'OSp1' and GSRI_Item == null then
+        return GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'ASpR')-1
+    endif
+    if GSRI_Item != null then
+        return 0
+    endif
+    set offset = LoadInteger(GSRI_CacheIndex, GetHandleId(u), id)
+    if offset == 0 then
+        return -1
+    endif
+    return LoadInteger(GSRI_Cache, GetHandleId(u), offset+1)
+endfunction
+function GSRI_Range takes unit u, integer id, integer lv returns real
+    local integer offset
+    if id == 'ASpR' and GetUnitTypeId(u) == 'OSp1' and GSRI_Item == null then
+        if LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,GetHandleId(u),20)!=null and not LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,GetHandleId(u),24) then
+            return 2000.0
+        endif
+        return 1000.0
+    endif
+    if id == 'ASp2' or (id == 'ASpR' and LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,GetHandleId(u),20)!=null and not LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,GetHandleId(u),24)) then
+        return 2000.0
+    endif
+    if GSRI_Item != null then
+        return LoadReal(GSRI_Data, id, 10)
+    endif
+    set offset = LoadInteger(GSRI_CacheIndex, GetHandleId(u), id)
+    if offset == 0 then
+        return 0.0
+    endif
+    return LoadReal(GSRI_Cache, GetHandleId(u), offset+5)
+endfunction
+function GSRI_ItemSlot takes integer key returns integer
+    if key == 103 or key == 36 then
+        return 0
+    elseif key == 104 or key == 38 then
+        return 1
+    elseif key == 100 or key == 37 then
+        return 2
+    elseif key == 101 or key == 12 then
+        return 3
+    elseif key == 97 or key == 35 then
+        return 4
+    elseif key == 98 or key == 40 then
+        return 5
+    endif
+    return -1
+endfunction
+function GSRI_FindItem takes unit u, integer slot returns integer
+    local item it=UnitItemInSlot(u,slot)
+    local integer found=0
+    if it!=null then
+        set found=LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,GetItemTypeId(it),100)
+    endif
+    if found!=0 then
+        set GSRI_Item=it
+    else
+        set GSRI_Item=null
+    endif
+    set it=null
+    return found
+endfunction
+function GSRI_OnInventory takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GetTriggerPlayer() == GetLocalPlayer() and GSRI_Enabled then
+        set GSRI_PendingSlot = LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,GetHandleId(BlzGetTriggerFrame()),101)-1
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GSRI_OnItemCommand takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u
+    local item it
+    local integer aid = LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,GetHandleId(GetTriggeringTrigger()),102)
+    local integer slot = 0
+    if GetTriggerPlayer() != GetLocalPlayer() or not GSRI_Enabled then
+        return
+    endif
+    set u = udg_HeroPlayer[GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer())+1]
+    if u == null or not IsUnitSelected(u,GetLocalPlayer()) then
+        set u = null
+        return
+    endif
+    loop
+        exitwhen slot >= 6
+        set it = UnitItemInSlot(u,slot)
+        if it != null and LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,GetItemTypeId(it),100) == aid then
+            set GSRI_PendingSlot = slot
+            exitwhen true
+        endif
+        set slot = slot+1
+    endloop
+    set it = null
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function GSRI_ItemProbeTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer aid
+    local ability a
+    local real range=0.0
+    if GSRI_ItemProbeIndex>=GSRI_ItemProbeCount then
+        call RemoveUnit(GSRI_ItemProbeUnit)
+        set GSRI_ItemProbeUnit=null
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+        set t=null
+        return
+    endif
+    set aid=GSRI_ItemProbeIds[GSRI_ItemProbeIndex]
+    call UnitAddAbility(GSRI_ItemProbeUnit,aid)
+    set a=BlzGetUnitAbility(GSRI_ItemProbeUnit,aid)
+    if a!=null then
+        if LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,aid,2)==4 then
+            set range=BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ConvertAbilityRealLevelField('Ebl1'),0)
+        else
+            set range=BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ABILITY_RLF_CAST_RANGE,0)
+        endif
+        if LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,aid,2)==3 then
+            call SaveReal(GSRI_Data,aid,20,BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ABILITY_RLF_AREA_OF_EFFECT,0))
+            call SaveReal(GSRI_Data,aid,21,BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ConvertAbilityRealLevelField(LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,aid,3)),0))
+            call SaveReal(GSRI_Data,aid,22,BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ConvertAbilityRealLevelField(LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,aid,4)),0))
+        endif
+        if range>0.0 and range<9999.0 then
+            call SaveReal(GSRI_Data,aid,10,range)
+        endif
+    endif
+    call UnitRemoveAbility(GSRI_ItemProbeUnit,aid)
+    set GSRI_ItemProbeIndex=GSRI_ItemProbeIndex+1
+    set a=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GS129_TabBoard takes nothing returns nothing
+    local player p = GetTriggerPlayer()
+    local integer pid = GetPlayerId(p)
+    if GetLocalPlayer() == p then
+        if BlzGetTriggerPlayerIsKeyDown() then
+            if not GS129_TabHeld[pid] then
+                set GS129_TabHeld[pid] = true
+                if udg_MB != null and IsMultiboardDisplayed(udg_MB) then
+                    call MultiboardMinimize(udg_MB,not IsMultiboardMinimized(udg_MB))
+                endif
+            endif
+        else
+            set GS129_TabHeld[pid] = false
+        endif
+    endif
+    set p = null
+endfunction

+function GS177RV_Expected takes nothing returns real
+    local real hour=GetFloatGameState(GAME_STATE_TIME_OF_DAY)
+    if hour>=6.0 and hour<18.0 then
+        return 1500.0
+    endif
+    return 800.0
+endfunction
+function GS177RV_Samples takes unit hero, player p, real distance returns string
+    local real x=GetUnitX(hero)
+    local real y=GetUnitY(hero)
+    local string result=""
+    if IsVisibleToPlayer(x+distance,y,p) then
+        set result=result+"동1 "
+    else
+        set result=result+"동0 "
+    endif
+    if IsVisibleToPlayer(x-distance,y,p) then
+        set result=result+"서1 "
+    else
+        set result=result+"서0 "
+    endif
+    if IsVisibleToPlayer(x,y-distance,p) then
+        set result=result+"남1 "
+    else
+        set result=result+"남0 "
+    endif
+    if IsVisibleToPlayer(x,y+distance,p) then
+        set result=result+"북1"
+    else
+        set result=result+"북0"
+    endif
+    return result
+endfunction
+function GS169_Diagnostic takes nothing returns nothing
+    local player p=GetTriggerPlayer()
+    local unit u=udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(p)]
+    local integer rank=GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A169')
+    local real chance=0.0
+    local real mult=0.0
+    if GetUnitTypeId(u)=='Eevm' then
+        if rank>0 then
+            set chance=BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(BlzGetUnitAbility(u,'A169'),ABILITY_RLF_CHANCE_TO_CRITICAL_STRIKE,rank-1)
+            set mult=BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(BlzGetUnitAbility(u,'A169'),ABILITY_RLF_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER_OCR2,rank-1)
+        endif
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,30,"[엘타 진단] E="+I2S(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A08S'))+" / 크리특="+I2S(GetPlayerTechCount(p,'R09X',true))+" / 크리 능력="+I2S(rank)+" / 확률="+R2S(chance)+"% / 배율="+R2S(mult))
+    else
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,10,"엘타닌을 선택한 플레이어만 사용할 수 있습니다.")
+    endif
+    set p=null
+    set u=null
+endfunction

+    return TimerGetElapsed(GS191_Clock)

+function GS191_Emblem takes unit u returns item
+    local integer i=0
+    local item it=null
+    loop
+        exitwhen i>=6
+        set it=UnitItemInSlot(u,i)
+        if GetItemTypeId(it)=='I08E' then
+            return it
+        endif
+        set i=i+1
+    endloop
+    set it=null
+    return null
+endfunction

+function GS191_ShieldStep takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer i=0
+    local integer n=GS192_ShieldCount
+    local integer keep=0
+    local integer uid
+    local unit u=null
+    local effect e=null
+    loop
+        exitwhen i>=n
+        set u=GS192_ShieldUnits[i]
+        set uid=GetHandleId(u)
+        set e=LoadEffectHandle(GS146_Data,uid,2)
+        if GetUnitTypeId(u)!=0 and GetWidgetLife(u)>0.405 and e!=null and LoadInteger(GS146_Data,uid,1)>0 then
+            if IsUnitHidden(u) or not IsUnitVisible(u,GetLocalPlayer()) then
+                call BlzSetSpecialEffectAlpha(e,0)
+            else
+                call BlzSetSpecialEffectAlpha(e,255)
+            endif
+            set GS192_ShieldUnits[keep]=u
+            set keep=keep+1
+        else
+            if e!=null then
+                call BlzSetSpecialEffectAlpha(e,0)
+                call DestroyEffect(e)
+                call RemoveSavedHandle(GS146_Data,uid,2)
+            endif
+            call SaveBoolean(GS191_Data,uid,1920,false)
+        endif
+        set i=i+1
+    endloop
+    set i=keep
+    loop
+        exitwhen i>=n
+        set GS192_ShieldUnits[i]=null
+        set i=i+1
+    endloop
+    set GS192_ShieldCount=keep
+    if keep==0 then
+        call PauseTimer(GS191_ShieldTimer)
+    endif
+    set e=null
+    set u=null
+endfunction

+function GSTI_RestrictionCheck takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local unit u=LoadUnitHandle(GSTI_Data,GetHandleId(t),0)
+    local item it=LoadItemHandle(GSTI_Data,GetHandleId(t),1)
+    local integer i=0
+    if GetUnitTypeId(u)=='Odrt' and GetItemTypeId(it)=='IT31' then
+        loop
+            exitwhen i>=6
+            if UnitItemInSlot(u,i)==it then
+                call UnitRemoveItem(u,it)
+                call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(u),0,0,5,"플레임 블레이더는 레지스턴스 아뮬렛을 사용할 수 없습니다.")
+            endif
+            set i=i+1
+        endloop
+    endif
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GSTI_Data,GetHandleId(t))
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    set t=null
+    set u=null
+    set it=null
+endfunction
+function GSTI_Has takes unit u, integer kind returns boolean
+    local integer i=0
+    loop
+        exitwhen i>=6
+        if GetItemTypeId(UnitItemInSlot(u,i))==kind then
+            return true
+        endif
+        set i=i+1
+    endloop
+    return false
+endfunction
+function GSTI_Find takes unit u, integer kind returns item
+    local integer i=0
+    local item it=null
+    loop
+        exitwhen i>=6
+        set it=UnitItemInSlot(u,i)
+        if GetItemTypeId(it)==kind then
+            return it
+        endif
+        set i=i+1
+    endloop
+    set it=null
+    return null
+endfunction
+function GSTI_Enemy takes unit source, unit target returns boolean
+    return source!=null and GetUnitTypeId(source)!=0 and target!=null and GetUnitTypeId(target)!=0 and GetWidgetLife(target)>0.405 and IsUnitEnemy(target,GetOwningPlayer(source)) and not IsUnitType(target,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not IsUnitType(target,UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(target)
+endfunction

+function GSTI_Chat takes nothing returns nothing
+    local player p=GetTriggerPlayer()
+    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(p)
+    local integer page=0
+    local unit shop=null
+    if GetEventPlayerChatString()=="-특성상점2" then
+        set page=1
+    endif
+    set shop=GSTI_Shops[page]
+    if GetLocalPlayer()==p then
+        call ClearSelection()
+        call SelectUnit(shop,true)
+        call PanCameraToTimed(GetUnitX(shop),GetUnitY(shop),0.2)
+    endif
+    call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,8,"[195-14] 11시 상인 1 / 5시 상인 2 · 상인 1은 8종 / 상인 2는 5종 판매. -특성상점 / -특성상점2")
+    set shop=null
+    set p=null
+endfunction
+function GSTI_RestoreStock takes integer kind returns nothing
+    local integer page=LoadInteger(GSTI_Data,kind,50)-1
+    if page>=0 and page<2 and not LoadBoolean(GSTI_Data,kind,51) and GSTI_Shops[page]!=null then
+        call AddItemToStock(GSTI_Shops[page],kind,1,1)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GSTI_SellOut takes integer kind returns nothing
+    local integer page=LoadInteger(GSTI_Data,kind,50)-1
+    call SaveBoolean(GSTI_Data,kind,51,true)
+    if page>=0 and page<2 and GSTI_Shops[page]!=null then
+        call RemoveItemFromStock(GSTI_Shops[page],kind)
+    endif
+endfunction

+function GS181_FlakMark takes unit source, player owner, real x, real y, integer level returns nothing
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(source)
+    local timer t=CreateTimer()
+    if GS181_Flak==null then
+        set GS181_Flak=InitHashtable()
+    endif
+    call SaveBoolean(GS181_Flak,sid,0,true)
+    call SavePlayerHandle(GS181_Flak,sid,1,owner)
+    call SaveReal(GS181_Flak,sid,2,x)
+    call SaveReal(GS181_Flak,sid,3,y)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS181_Flak,sid,4,GetPlayerTechCount(owner,'R0AM',true)>0)
+    call SaveInteger(GS181_Flak,sid,5,level)
+    call SaveTimerHandle(GS181_Flak,sid,8,t)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS181_Flak,GetHandleId(t),0,source)
+    call TimerStart(t,3.0,false,function GS181_FlakExpire)
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GS181_FlakDamage takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit source=GetEventDamageSource()
+    local unit target=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(source)
+    local player owner
+    local real dx
+    local real dy
+    local real amount=GetEventDamage()
+    local integer pid
+    if GS181_Flak!=null and amount>0.0 and LoadBoolean(GS181_Flak,sid,0) and not BlzGetEventIsAttack() then
+        set owner=LoadPlayerHandle(GS181_Flak,sid,1)
+        set pid=GetPlayerId(owner)
+        if GS181_Live(source) and GS181_Live(target) and IsUnitEnemy(target,owner) then
+            call SaveReal(GS181_Flak,'last',pid,amount)
+            call SaveBoolean(GS181_Flak,'molt',pid,false)
+            set dx=GetUnitX(target)-LoadReal(GS181_Flak,sid,2)
+            set dy=GetUnitY(target)-LoadReal(GS181_Flak,sid,3)
+            if LoadBoolean(GS181_Flak,sid,4) and dx*dx+dy*dy<=10000.0 and not IsUnitType(target,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not IsUnitType(target,UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL) and not IsUnitType(target,UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(target) then
+                call BlzSetEventDamage(amount*2.0)
+                call SaveReal(GS181_Flak,'last',pid,amount*2.0)
+                call SaveBoolean(GS181_Flak,'molt',pid,true)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set source=null
+    set target=null
+    set owner=null
+endfunction
+function GS180_SightApply takes unit u, real previous, boolean initial returns nothing
+    local real wanted=GS180_SightExpected()
+    local real actual
+    if GS180_SightHero(u) and GetWidgetLife(u)>0.405 and not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) and not IsUnitHidden(u) then
+        set actual=BlzGetUnitRealField(u,UNIT_RF_SIGHT_RADIUS)
+        if initial or actual==previous or (GetUnitTypeId(u)=='URa1' and actual<wanted) then
+            if actual!=wanted then
+                call BlzSetUnitRealField(u,UNIT_RF_SIGHT_RADIUS,wanted)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GSCT_Track takes unit h returns nothing
+    call GSCT_Ensure()
+    if h!=null then
+        call GroupAddUnit(GSCT_Sources,h)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GSCT_SyncLine takes hashtable data, integer parent, integer child, string kind, boolean visibility, unit a, unit b, real height, boolean terrain returns nothing
+    local lightning wire=LoadLightningHandle(data,parent,child)
+    local real x1
+    local real y1
+    local real x2
+    local real y2
+    local real z1=height
+    local real z2=height
+    local real dx
+    local real dy
+    local boolean valid=GSCT_Live(a) and GSCT_Live(b) and not GSCT_InTransit(a) and not GSCT_InTransit(b)
+    if valid then
+        set x1=GetUnitX(a)
+        set y1=GetUnitY(a)
+        set x2=GetUnitX(b)
+        set y2=GetUnitY(b)
+        set dx=x1-x2
+        set dy=y1-y2
+        set valid=GSCT_Number(x1) and GSCT_Number(y1) and GSCT_Number(x2) and GSCT_Number(y2) and dx*dx+dy*dy<=4096.0*4096.0
+        if valid and terrain then
+            set z1=z1+BlzGetUnitZ(a)
+            set z2=z2+BlzGetUnitZ(b)
+        endif
+        set valid=valid and GSCT_Number(z1) and GSCT_Number(z2)
+    endif
+    if not valid then
+        call GSCT_ClearLine(data,parent,child)
+    elseif wire==null then
+        set wire=AddLightningEx(kind,visibility,x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2)
+        if wire!=null then
+            call SaveLightningHandle(data,parent,child,wire)
+        endif
+    elseif not MoveLightningEx(wire,visibility,x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2) then
+        call GSCT_ClearLine(data,parent,child)
+    endif
+    set wire=null
+endfunction
+function GSST_Live takes unit u returns boolean
+    return GSST_Exists(u) and GetWidgetLife(u)>0.405 and not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_DEAD)
+endfunction
+function GSST_ReleasePull takes unit u returns nothing
+    local timer t=null
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(u)
+    if GSST_Data!=null and u!=null then
+        set t=LoadTimerHandle(GSST_Data,sid,201)
+        if t!=null then
+            call RemoveSavedHandle(GSST_Data,sid,201)
+            if LoadUnitHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(t),3)==u then
+                call RemoveSavedHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(t),3)
+                if GSST_Exists(u) and (GSCT_State==null or not LoadBoolean(GSCT_State,GetHandleId(u),1)) then
+                    call SetUnitPathing(u,true)
+                endif
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GSST_ReleaseOwnedPull takes timer t returns nothing
+    local unit u=null
+    if GSST_Data!=null and t!=null then
+        set u=LoadUnitHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(t),3)
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(t),3)
+        if u!=null and LoadTimerHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(u),201)==t then
+            call RemoveSavedHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(u),201)
+            if GSST_Exists(u) and (GSCT_State==null or not LoadBoolean(GSCT_State,GetHandleId(u),1)) then
+                call SetUnitPathing(u,true)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set u=null
+endfunction
+function GSCT_DetachUnit takes unit u returns nothing
+    local integer i
+    local integer sid
+    local integer k
+    local unit h
+    local timer t
+    if not GSST_Exists(u) then
+        return
+    endif
+    call GSCT_Ensure()
+    call SaveReal(GSCT_State,GetHandleId(u),0,TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)+0.25)
+    set i=BlzGroupGetSize(GSCT_Sources)-1
+    loop
+        exitwhen i<0
+        set h=BlzGroupUnitAt(GSCT_Sources,i)
+        set sid=GetHandleId(h)
+        if GetUnitTypeId(h)==0 then
+            call GroupRemoveUnit(GSCT_Sources,h)
+            call FlushChildHashtable(GSCT_State,sid)
+        else
+            if SP172_Data!=null then
+                if h==u or LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,sid,1)==u then
+                    call GSCT_ClearLine(SP172_Data,sid,5)
+                endif
+                if LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,sid,20)==u or LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,sid,21)==u then
+                    call GSCT_ClearLine(SP172_Data,sid,25)
+                endif
+            endif
+            if RAIN_Data!=null then
+                set t=LoadTimerHandle(RAIN_Data,sid,22)
+                if t!=null then
+                    set k=GetHandleId(t)
+                    if h==u or LoadUnitHandle(RAIN_Data,k,1)==u then
+                        call GSCT_ClearLine(RAIN_Data,k,4)
+                    endif
+                endif
+                set t=LoadTimerHandle(RAIN_Data,sid,10)
+                if t!=null then
+                    set k=GetHandleId(t)
+                    if h==u or LoadUnitHandle(RAIN_Data,k,1)==u then
+                        call GSCT_ClearLine(RAIN_Data,k,5)
+                    endif
+                endif
+            endif
+        endif
+        set i=i-1
+    endloop
+    set h=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction

+function GS2_AuditWrathTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit caster = LoadUnitHandle(GS2_AuditData, id, 0)
+    local integer ticks = LoadInteger(GS2_AuditData, id, 2) + 1
+    if caster == null or GetWidgetLife(caster) <= 0.405 or GetUnitCurrentOrder(caster) != OrderId("starfall") or ticks >= 45 then
+        call GS2_AuditWrathDispose(t)
+    else
+        call SaveInteger(GS2_AuditData, id, 2, ticks)
+    endif
+    set caster = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS2_AuditRangeDispatch takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger source=GetTriggeringTrigger()
+    local integer id=GetHandleId(source)
+    local trigger target=LoadTriggerHandle(GS2_AuditData,id,2)
+    local unit anchor=LoadUnitHandle(GS2_AuditData,id,3)
+    local unit previous=GSST_RangeAnchor
+    if target!=null and GSST_Exists(anchor) and GetWidgetLife(anchor)>0.405 and IsTriggerEnabled(target) then
+        set GSST_RangeAnchor=anchor
+        if TriggerEvaluate(target) then
+            call TriggerExecute(target)
+        endif
+        set GSST_RangeAnchor=previous
+    endif
+    set source=null
+    set target=null
+    set anchor=null
+    set previous=null
+endfunction
+function GS2_AuditDamageClean takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer id=GS2_AuditDamageCursor
+    local integer following
+    local integer previous
+    local integer work=0
+    local unit u=null
+    if id==0 then
+        set GS2_AuditDamageDelay=GS2_AuditDamageDelay+1
+        if GS2_AuditDamageDelay<10 then
+            return
+        endif
+        set GS2_AuditDamageDelay=0
+        set id=GS2_AuditDamageHead
+    endif
+    loop
+        exitwhen id==0 or work>=64
+        set following=LoadInteger(GS2_AuditDamageData,id,-2)
+        set u=LoadUnitHandle(GS2_AuditDamageData,id,-1)
+        if GetUnitTypeId(u)==0 then
+            set previous=LoadInteger(GS2_AuditDamageData,id,-3)
+            if previous==0 then
+                set GS2_AuditDamageHead=following
+            else
+                call SaveInteger(GS2_AuditDamageData,previous,-2,following)
+            endif
+            if following!=0 then
+                call SaveInteger(GS2_AuditDamageData,following,-3,previous)
+            endif
+            call FlushChildHashtable(GS2_AuditDamageData,id)
+            set GS2_AuditDamageTracked=GS2_AuditDamageTracked-1
+            set GS2_AuditDamageCleaned=GS2_AuditDamageCleaned+1
+        endif
+        set id=following
+        set work=work+1
+    endloop
+    set GS2_AuditDamageCursor=id
+    set GS2_AuditDamageLastChecks=work
+    set u=null
+endfunction
+function GS2_FriendVisualUpdate takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local unit caster = LoadUnitHandle(GS2_AuditData, GetHandleId(t), StringHash("GS2.FriendVisualCaster"))
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(caster)
+    local unit friend = LoadUnitHandle(GS2_AuditData, id, StringHash("GS2.FriendTarget"))
+    if friend == null or not IsUnitAliveBJ(caster) or not IsUnitAliveBJ(friend) then
+        call GS2_FriendVisualClear(caster)
+    endif
+    set caster = null
+    set friend = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS2_FriendExpire takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local unit caster = LoadUnitHandle(GS2_AuditData, GetHandleId(t), StringHash("GS2.FriendCaster"))
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(caster)
+    if LoadTimerHandle(GS2_AuditData, id, StringHash("GS2.FriendTimer")) == t then
+        call GS2_FriendVisualClear(caster)
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS2_AuditData, id, StringHash("GS2.FriendTarget"))
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS2_AuditData, id, StringHash("GS2.FriendTimer"))
+    endif
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS2_AuditData, GetHandleId(t))
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    set t = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction
+function GS2_AuditDamageDispatch takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit damaged = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(damaged)
+    local integer count = LoadInteger(GS2_AuditDamageData, id, 0)
+    local integer i = 1
+    local trigger target
+    call GS2_FriendDamage(damaged)
+    loop
+        exitwhen i > count
+        set target = LoadTriggerHandle(GS2_AuditDamageData, id, i)
+        if target != null and IsTriggerEnabled(target) then
+            if TriggerEvaluate(target) then
+                call TriggerExecute(target)
+            endif
+        endif
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    set damaged = null
+    set target = null
+endfunction

+function d_effect takes effect e, real t returns nothing
+    local timer timerHandle
+    if e == null then
+        return
+    endif
+    if t <= 0.00 then
+        call DestroyEffect(e)
+        return
+    endif
+    if GS2PERF_Effects == null then
+        set GS2PERF_Effects = InitHashtable()
+    endif
+    set timerHandle = CreateTimer()
+    call SaveEffectHandle(GS2PERF_Effects, GetHandleId(timerHandle), 0, e)
+    call TimerStart(timerHandle, t, false, function d_effect_action)
+    set timerHandle = null
+endfunction
+function RemoveMixItem takes integer t, unit u returns nothing
+    local integer pid=GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))+1
+    local integer n=0
+    local item it=udg_ItemTaken[pid]
+    if t<=0 then
+        set it=null
+        return
+    endif
+    if it==null or GS138_MaterialIndex(it)!=t then
+        set it=null
+        loop
+            exitwhen n>5 or it!=null
+            if GS138_MaterialIndex(UnitItemInSlot(u,n))==t then
+                set it=UnitItemInSlot(u,n)
+            endif
+            set n=n+1
+        endloop
+    endif
+    if it!=null then
+        if GetItemType(it)==ITEM_TYPE_CHARGED and GetItemCharges(it)>1 then
+            call SetItemCharges(it,GetItemCharges(it)-1)
+        else
+            if udg_ItemTaken[pid]==it then
+                set udg_ItemTaken[pid]=null
+            endif
+            if udg_GS2_LastMixedItem==it then
+                set udg_GS2_LastMixedItem=null
+            endif
+            call RemoveItem(it)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set it=null
+endfunction
+function CountItem takes integer t, unit u returns integer
+    local integer index = 0
+    local integer a = 0
+    if GS138_MaterialIndex(udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))]) == t then
+        if GetItemType(udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))]) == ITEM_TYPE_CHARGED and GetItemCharges(udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))]) > 1 then
+        set index = index + GetItemCharges(udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))])
+        else
+        set index = index + 1
+        endif
+    endif
+    loop
+    exitwhen a > 5
+    if GS138_MaterialIndex(UnitItemInSlot(u, a)) == t then
+        if GetItemType(UnitItemInSlot(u, a)) == ITEM_TYPE_CHARGED and GetItemCharges(UnitItemInSlot(u, a)) > 1 then
+        set index = index + GetItemCharges(UnitItemInSlot(u, a))
+        else
+        set index = index + 1
+        endif
+    endif 
+    set a = a + 1
+    endloop
+    return index
+endfunction
+function MakeUnitFollow takes unit u, unit target, integer time returns nothing
+    local timer t = CreateTimer()
+    local integer r = time * 25
+    call SaveUnitHandleBJ( u, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("Follow1"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
+    call SaveUnitHandleBJ( target, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("Follow2"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
+    call SaveIntegerBJ( r, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("Follow3"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
+    call TimerStart(t, 0.04, true, function MakeUnitFollow_Sub)
+endfunction
+function Knockback takes unit u, real angle, real distance, real speed returns nothing
+    local timer t = CreateTimer()
+    call SaveUnitHandleBJ( u, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("KnockBack1"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
+    call SaveRealBJ( angle, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("KnockBack2"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
+    call SaveRealBJ( distance, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("KnockBack3"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
+    call SaveRealBJ( speed/25, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("KnockBack4"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
+    call TimerStart(t, 0.04, true, function Knockback_Action)
+endfunction
+function GSTF_Create takes nothing returns nothing
+    local framehandle root = BlzCreateFrameByType("FRAME", "GSTF_Root", BlzGetFrameByName("ConsoleUIBackdrop", 0), "", 0)
+    local framehandle slot
+    local framehandle f
+    local framehandle g
+    local integer i = 0
+    local integer s
+    local integer c
+    call GS1959_ResetUI()
+    call BlzFrameSetSize(root, GSTF_W(), 5 * (GSTF_H() + GSTF_Gap()))
+    loop
+        exitwhen i > 4
+        set slot = BlzCreateFrameByType("BACKDROP", "GSTF_Slot", root, "", i)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(slot,FRAMEPOINT_TOPRIGHT,root,FRAMEPOINT_TOPRIGHT,0.0,-i*(GSTF_H()+GSTF_Gap()))
+        call BlzFrameSetSize(slot, GSTF_W(), GSTF_H())
+        call BlzFrameSetTexture(slot, "Textures\\Black32.blp", 0, true)
+        call BlzFrameSetAlpha(slot, 160)
+        set f = BlzCreateFrameByType("BACKDROP", "GSTF_Icon", slot, "", i)
+        call BlzFrameSetSize(f, 0.036, 0.036)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, slot, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, 0.005, -0.005)
+        set g = BlzCreateFrameByType("BACKDROP", "GSTF_LvlBg", f, "", i)
+        call BlzFrameSetSize(g, 0.015, 0.011)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(g, FRAMEPOINT_BOTTOMRIGHT, f, FRAMEPOINT_BOTTOMRIGHT, 0.0, 0.0)
+        call BlzFrameSetTexture(g, "Textures\\Black32.blp", 0, true)
+        call BlzFrameSetAlpha(g, 200)
+        set g = BlzCreateFrameByType("TEXT", "GSTF_Lvl", f, "", i)
+        call BlzFrameSetAllPoints(g, BlzGetFrameByName("GSTF_LvlBg", i))
+        call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(g, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_CENTER)
+        call BlzFrameSetScale(g, 0.8)
+        call GSTF_PassText(g)
+        set f = BlzCreateFrameByType("BACKDROP", "GSTF_UltGlow", slot, "", i)
+        call BlzFrameSetSize(f, GSTF_UltSize() + 0.005, GSTF_UltSize() + 0.005)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, slot, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, GSTF_UltX() - 0.0025, -0.0015)
+        call BlzFrameSetTexture(f, "UI\\Widgets\\Console\\Human\\CommandButton\\human-activebutton.blp", 0, true)
+        call BlzFrameSetVisible(f, false)
+        set s = 0
+        loop
+            exitwhen s > 3
+            set c = i * 4 + s
+            set f = BlzCreateFrameByType("BACKDROP", "GSTF_Sk", slot, "", c)
+            if s < 3 then
+                call BlzFrameSetSize(f, GSTF_SkSize(), GSTF_SkSize())
+                call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, slot, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, 0.045 + s * (GSTF_SkSize() + GSTF_SkGap()), -0.006)
+            else
+                call BlzFrameSetSize(f, GSTF_UltSize(), GSTF_UltSize())
+                call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, slot, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, GSTF_UltX(), -0.004)
+            endif
+            set g = BlzCreateFrameByType("TEXT", "GSTF_SkCd", f, "", c)
+            call BlzFrameSetAllPoints(g, f)
+            call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(g, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_CENTER)
+            call BlzFrameSetScale(g, 0.85)
+            call GSTF_PassText(g)
+            set s = s + 1
+        endloop
+        set f = BlzCreateFrameByType("BACKDROP", "GSTF_HpBg", slot, "", i)
+        call BlzFrameSetSize(f, GSTF_BarW(), 0.0065)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, slot, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, 0.045, -0.025)
+        call BlzFrameSetTexture(f, "Textures\\Black32.blp", 0, true)
+        set g = BlzCreateFrameByType("BACKDROP", "GSTF_Hp", f, "", i)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(g, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, 0.0, 0.0)
+        call BlzFrameSetSize(g, GSTF_BarW(), 0.0065)
+        call BlzFrameSetTexture(g, "ReplaceableTextures\\TeamColor\\TeamColor06.blp", 0, true)
+        set f = BlzCreateFrameByType("BACKDROP", "GSTF_MpBg", slot, "", i)
+        call BlzFrameSetSize(f, GSTF_BarW(), 0.0055)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, slot, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, 0.045, -0.0345)
+        call BlzFrameSetTexture(f, "Textures\\Black32.blp", 0, true)
+        set g = BlzCreateFrameByType("BACKDROP", "GSTF_Mp", f, "", i)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(g, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, f, FRAMEPOINT_TOPLEFT, 0.0, 0.0)
+        call BlzFrameSetSize(g, GSTF_BarW(), 0.0055)
+        call BlzFrameSetTexture(g, "ReplaceableTextures\\TeamColor\\TeamColor01.blp", 0, true)
+        set f = BlzCreateFrameByType("BACKDROP", "GSTF_Dead", slot, "", i)
+        call BlzFrameSetAllPoints(f, slot)
+        call BlzFrameSetTexture(f, "Textures\\Black32.blp", 0, true)
+        call BlzFrameSetAlpha(f, 150)
+        set g = BlzCreateFrameByType("TEXT", "GSTF_DeadTime", f, "", i)
+        call BlzFrameSetAllPoints(g, BlzGetFrameByName("GSTF_Icon", i))
+        call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(g, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_CENTER)
+        call BlzFrameSetScale(g, 1.5)
+        call GSTF_PassText(g)
+        set g = BlzCreateFrameByType("TEXT", "GSTF_DeadLbl", f, "", i)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(g, FRAMEPOINT_LEFT, f, FRAMEPOINT_LEFT, 0.047, 0.0)
+        call BlzFrameSetSize(g, 0.066, 0.02)
+        call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(g, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_LEFT)
+        call GSTF_PassText(g)
+        call BlzFrameSetText(g, "|cffff8080부활 대기 중|r")
+        call BlzFrameSetVisible(f, false)
+        call BlzFrameSetVisible(slot, false)
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    set root = null
+    set slot = null
+    set f = null
+    set g = null
+endfunction
+function GSTF_SetBar takes string name, integer i, real h, real ratio returns nothing
+    local integer key = i
+    local framehandle f
+    if name == "GSTF_Mp" then
+        set key = 5+i
+    endif
+    if ratio > 1.0 then
+        set ratio = 1.0
+    elseif ratio <= 0.001 then
+        set ratio = 0.0
+    endif
+    if GS1959_BarValid[key] and GS1959_BarRatio[key] == ratio and GS1959_BarHeight[key] == h then
+        return
+    endif
+    set f = BlzGetFrameByName(name,i)
+    if ratio > 0.001 then
+        call BlzFrameSetSize(f,GSTF_BarW()*ratio,h)
+        call BlzFrameSetVisible(f,true)
+    else
+        call BlzFrameSetVisible(f,false)
+    endif
+    set GS1959_BarRatio[key] = ratio
+    set GS1959_BarHeight[key] = h
+    set GS1959_BarValid[key] = true
+    set f = null
+endfunction
+function GSTF_FillSkill takes integer i, integer s, unit u returns nothing
+    local integer c = i * 4 + s
+    local integer a = GSTF_SkillOf(GetUnitTypeId(u), s)
+    local integer lvl
+    local real cd
+    local framehandle f = BlzGetFrameByName("GSTF_Sk", c)
+    local boolean ready = false
+    local string cooldownText = ""
+    local string texture
+    if a == 0 then
+        call BlzFrameSetVisible(f, false)
+        set f = null
+        return
+    endif
+    call BlzFrameSetVisible(f, true)
+    set texture=BlzGetAbilityIcon(a)
+    if GS167_SkillTexture[c]!=texture then
+        call BlzFrameSetTexture(f,texture,0,true)
+        set GS167_SkillTexture[c]=texture
+    endif
+    set lvl = GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, a)
+    if lvl == 0 then
+        call BlzFrameSetAlpha(f, 45)
+    elseif GSTF_IsPassive(a) then
+        call BlzFrameSetAlpha(f, 255)
+    else
+        set cd = BlzGetUnitAbilityCooldownRemaining(u, a)
+        if a == 'ADq1' then
+            set cd = BlzGetUnitAbilityCooldownRemaining(u, 'ADq2')
+        endif
+        if cd > 0.0 then
+            call BlzFrameSetAlpha(f, 110)
+            set cooldownText = I2S(R2I(cd) + 1)
+        elseif GetUnitState(u, UNIT_STATE_MANA) < BlzGetUnitAbilityManaCost(u, a, lvl - 1) then
+            call BlzFrameSetAlpha(f, 150)
+        else
+            call BlzFrameSetAlpha(f, 255)
+            set ready = true
+        endif
+    endif
+    call GSTF_SetText("GSTF_SkCd", c, cooldownText)
+    if s == 3 then
+        set f = BlzGetFrameByName("GSTF_UltGlow", i)
+        call BlzFrameSetVisible(f, ready)
+        if ready then
+            call BlzFrameSetAlpha(f, 120 + R2I(135.0 * RAbsBJ(Sin(TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime) * 3.0))))
+        endif
+    endif
+    set f = null
+endfunction
+function GSTF_IsTeammate takes player p, player lp returns boolean
+    if p == lp then
+        return GSTF_ShowSelf()
+    endif
+    return IsPlayerAlly(p, lp) and IsPlayerAlly(lp, p)
+endfunction
+function GSPF_FindHost takes nothing returns integer
+    local integer i = 1
+    loop
+        exitwhen i > 5
+        if GSPF_IsUser(Player(i)) then
+            return i
+        endif
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    set i = 0
+    loop
+        exitwhen i > 11
+        if GSPF_IsUser(Player(i)) then
+            return i
+        endif
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    return -1
+endfunction
+function GSPF_HostId takes nothing returns integer
+    return S2I(GSPF_GetState("GSPF_Host"))
+endfunction
+function GSPF_Bit takes string name, integer k returns boolean
+    return SubString(GSPF_GetState(name), k, k + 1) == "1"
+endfunction
+function GSPF_SetBit takes string name, integer k, boolean on returns nothing
+    local string s = GSPF_GetState(name)
+    local string c = "0"
+    if on then
+        set c = "1"
+    endif
+    call GSPF_SetState(name, SubString(s, 0, k) + c + SubString(s, k + 1, StringLength(s)))
+endfunction
+function GSPF_ShopsAlive takes nothing returns boolean
+    local integer g = 0
+    loop
+        exitwhen g > 5
+        if GetUnitTypeId(GSPF_Shop(g)) == 0 then
+            return false
+        endif
+        set g = g + 1
+    endloop
+    return TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime) <= 120.0
+endfunction
+function GSPF_OnBoardCmd takes nothing returns nothing
+    local framehandle f = BlzGetTriggerFrame()
+    if GetTriggerPlayer() == GetLocalPlayer() then
+        if GetTriggerEventId() == EVENT_PLAYER_CHAT then
+            call GSPF_SetState("GSPF_Closed", "0")
+        else
+            call BlzFrameSetEnable(f, false)
+            call BlzFrameSetEnable(f, true)
+            call GSPF_SetState("GSPF_Closed", "1")
+        endif
+    endif
+    set f = null
+endfunction
+function GSPF_OnRandomClick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local player p = GetTriggerPlayer()
+    call GSPF_DropFocus(BlzGetTriggerFrame())
+    if GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[GetPlayerId(p) + 1]) != 0 or not GSPF_StockReady() or udg_RandomRuning then
+        set p = null
+        return
+    endif
+    call GSPF_SetState("GSPF_RandPid", I2S(GetPlayerId(p)))
+    call ExecuteFunc("Trig_random_Actions")
+    set p = null
+endfunction

+function GS2R2_BomberSpawn takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer unitId=GetUnitTypeId(u)
+    local integer key=GetHandleId(u)
+    local timer t
+    local real lifetime=10.00
+    if unitId!='n02P' and unitId!='n02O' and unitId!='n02Q' and unitId!='n02N' then
+        set u=null
+        return
+    endif
+    if HaveSavedHandle(GS2PB_Data,key,2) then
+        set u=null
+        return
+    endif
+    call SetUnitVertexColor(u,255,255,255,255)
+    if GetRandomInt(1,100)<=(20-GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R07I',GetOwningPlayer(u))*20) then
+        set lifetime=2.00
+        call TextTag("Made In China",u,10,255,255,150,3)
+    endif
+    set t=CreateTimer()
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS2PB_Data,GetHandleId(t),1,u)
+    call SaveTimerHandle(GS2PB_Data,key,2,t)
+    call TimerStart(t,lifetime-0.50,false,function GS2R2_BomberWindowEnd)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLife(u,'BTLF',lifetime)
+    set u=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GS2_Ver6_WaterReady takes location p returns boolean
+    local group g
+    local boolean found
+    if GetTerrainCliffLevelBJ(p) == 1 or DistanceBetweenPoints(p, udg_Hero_MRG_UltiPoint) <= 600.00 then
+        return true
+    endif
+    set g = CreateGroup()
+    call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(g, GetLocationX(p), GetLocationY(p), 450.00, Filter(function GS2_Ver6_WaterDummy))
+    set found = FirstOfGroup(g) != null
+    call DestroyGroup(g)
+    set g = null
+    return found
+endfunction

+function Trig_Debugging_Setup_Conditions takes nothing returns boolean
+    if ( not ( IsUnitAliveBJ(udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())]) == true ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( UnitHasBuffBJ(udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())], 'B03K') == false ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())]) != 'O005' ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())]) != 'U00I' ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not Trig_Debugging_Setup_Func005C() ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    return true
+endfunction

+function Trig_Debugging_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer pn = GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())
+    local integer skill = 0
+    if ( ( GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[pn]) == 'Npbm' ) ) then //판다 워리어//
+    set skill = ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0H4', udg_HeroPlayer[pn]) * 4 )
+    endif
+    if ( ( GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[pn]) == 'Hart' ) ) then //룬나이트//
+    set skill = ( 2 + ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0GK', udg_HeroPlayer[pn]) * 3 ) )
+    endif
+    if ( ( GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[pn]) == 'Nplh' ) ) then //드레드 나이트//
+    set skill = ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0VC', udg_HeroPlayer[pn]) * 5 )
+    endif
+    if ( ( GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[pn]) == 'Huth' ) ) then //할루시네이터//
+    set skill = ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0JZ', udg_HeroPlayer[pn]) * 3 )
+    endif
+    set udg_Debugging_Vote_PN = pn
+    set udg_Debug_Bool[pn] = true
+    call SetUnitInvulnerable( udg_HeroPlayer[pn], true )
+    call PauseUnitBJ( true, udg_HeroPlayer[pn] )
+    call PolledWait( 10.00 )
+    if ( ( udg_Debugging_Vote_Max == udg_Debugging_Vote_Int ) ) then
+        call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[pn]), ConvertedPlayer(pn), GetUnitLoc(udg_HeroPlayer[pn]), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call SetHeroXP( GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetHeroXP(udg_HeroPlayer[pn]), false )
+        call ModifyHeroStat( bj_HEROSTAT_STR, GetLastCreatedUnit(), bj_MODIFYMETHOD_SET, GetHeroStatBJ(bj_HEROSTAT_STR, udg_HeroPlayer[pn], false) )
+        call ModifyHeroStat( bj_HEROSTAT_AGI, GetLastCreatedUnit(), bj_MODIFYMETHOD_SET, GetHeroStatBJ(bj_HEROSTAT_AGI, udg_HeroPlayer[pn], false) )
+        call ModifyHeroStat( bj_HEROSTAT_INT, GetLastCreatedUnit(), bj_MODIFYMETHOD_SET, GetHeroStatBJ(bj_HEROSTAT_INT, udg_HeroPlayer[pn], false) )
+        call UnitAddItemSwapped( UnitItemInSlotBJ(udg_HeroPlayer[pn], 1), GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddItemSwapped( UnitItemInSlotBJ(udg_HeroPlayer[pn], 2), GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddItemSwapped( UnitItemInSlotBJ(udg_HeroPlayer[pn], 3), GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddItemSwapped( UnitItemInSlotBJ(udg_HeroPlayer[pn], 4), GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddItemSwapped( UnitItemInSlotBJ(udg_HeroPlayer[pn], 5), GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddItemSwapped( UnitItemInSlotBJ(udg_HeroPlayer[pn], 6), GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call RemoveUnit( udg_HeroPlayer[pn] )
+        set udg_HeroPlayer[pn] = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+    if ( ( GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[pn]) == 'Npbm' ) ) then //판다 워리어//
+    call ModifyHeroStat( bj_HEROSTAT_AGI, udg_HeroPlayer[pn], bj_MODIFYMETHOD_SUB, skill )
+    endif
+    if ( ( GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[pn]) == 'Hart' ) ) then //룬나이트//
+    call ModifyHeroStat( bj_HEROSTAT_INT, udg_HeroPlayer[pn], bj_MODIFYMETHOD_SUB, skill )
+    endif
+    if ( ( GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[pn]) == 'Nplh' ) ) then //드레드 나이트//
+    call ModifyHeroStat( bj_HEROSTAT_STR, udg_HeroPlayer[pn], bj_MODIFYMETHOD_SUB, skill )
+    endif
+    if ( ( GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[pn]) == 'Huth' ) ) then //할루시네이터//
+    call ModifyHeroStat( bj_HEROSTAT_AGI, udg_HeroPlayer[pn], bj_MODIFYMETHOD_SUB, skill )
+    endif
+        if ( ( GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R01M', GetTriggerPlayer()) == 1 ) ) then
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A02V', udg_HeroPlayer[pn] )
+        endif
+        if ( ( GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R01P', GetTriggerPlayer()) == 1 ) ) then
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A02X', udg_HeroPlayer[pn] )
+        endif
+        if ( ( GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R08T', GetTriggerPlayer()) == 1 ) ) then
+            call IncUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A13S', udg_HeroPlayer[pn] )
+        endif
+    call DisplayTextToForce( GetPlayersAll(), "상대팀의 만장일치로 디버깅이 되었습니다." )
+        set udg_Debugging_Vote_Bool = false
+        set udg_Debug_Bool[pn] = false
+    else
+    set udg_Debugging_Vote_Bool = false
+    set udg_Debug_Bool[pn] = false
+    call DisplayTextToForce( GetPlayersAll(), "상대팀이 만장일치가 되지 않아 디버깅이 되지 않습니다." )
+    call SetUnitInvulnerable( udg_HeroPlayer[pn], false )
+    call PauseUnitBJ( false, udg_HeroPlayer[pn] )
+    endif
+endfunction

+function Trig_home2_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer pn = GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())
+    local integer A = 1
+    local integer A_end = 40
+    local unit wispkun
+    if ( udg_debug_or_home[pn] == true ) then
+        return
+    endif
+    set udg_debug_or_home[pn] = true
+    call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetTriggerPlayer(), GetUnitLoc(udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())]), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    set wispkun = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 42.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0NT', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'S00D', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    loop
+        exitwhen A > A_end
+        call PolledWait( 1.00 )
+        if ( IsUnitAliveBJ(udg_HeroPlayer[pn]) == false ) then
+        call DisplayTextToForce( GetForceOfPlayer(ConvertedPlayer(pn)), "귀환이 취소되었습니다." )
+        call KillUnit( wispkun )
+        set udg_debug_or_home[pn] = false
+        return
+        endif
+        set A = A + 1
+    endloop
+    if ( IsUnitAlly(udg_HeroPlayer[pn], udg_Force[1]) == true ) then
+        call GS2V84_SetUnitPositionLoc_1(udg_HeroPlayer[pn], GetRectCenter(gg_rct_G_Home))
+    endif
+    if ( IsUnitAlly(udg_HeroPlayer[pn], udg_Force[2]) == true ) then
+        call GS2V84_SetUnitPositionLoc_1(udg_HeroPlayer[pn], GetRectCenter(gg_rct_D_Home))
+    endif
+    set udg_debug_or_home[pn] = false
+endfunction

+function Trig_Ban_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    set bj_forLoopAIndex = 1
+    set bj_forLoopAIndexEnd = udg_HeroMax[3]

+        exitwhen bj_forLoopAIndex > bj_forLoopAIndexEnd

+            set bj_forLoopBIndex = 1
+            set bj_forLoopBIndexEnd = 12
+            loop
+                exitwhen bj_forLoopBIndex > bj_forLoopBIndexEnd
+                call SetPlayerUnitAvailableBJ( udg_Hero[GetForLoopIndexA()], false, ConvertedPlayer(GetForLoopIndexB()) )
+                set bj_forLoopBIndex = bj_forLoopBIndex + 1
+            endloop
+            set udg_Hero[GetForLoopIndexA()] = 0
+            set udg_RandHero[GetForLoopIndexA()] = true
+            call DisplayTimedTextToForce( GetPlayersAll(), 30.00, ( "|cffffcc00" + ( udg_HeroName[GetForLoopIndexA()] + "|r을(를) 밴 하였습니다." ) ) )
+            return
+        else
+        endif
+        set bj_forLoopAIndex = bj_forLoopAIndex + 1
+    endloop
+    call DisplayTextToForce( GetForceOfPlayer(GetTriggerPlayer()), "해당 이름을 가진 영웅이 존재하지 않습니다. 영웅의 이름 앞부분만을 인식하므로 주의해 주세요.\n예) 키아 일루젼시커 -> 키아" )
+endfunction

+    if ( not ( RAbsBJ(( ModuloReal(( ( GS2V84_AngleBetweenPointsUnits(GetEventDamageSource(), GetTriggerUnit()) - GetUnitFacing(GetTriggerUnit()) ) + 540.00 ), 360.00) - 180.00 )) > 90.00 ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    return true
+endfunction
+function Trig_DamageTaken_Func019C takes nothing returns boolean

+    endif

+endfunction

+                if ( Trig_MegaCreep_System_Func002Func012Func001Func002C() ) then
+                    call PlaySoundBJ( gg_snd_GameFound )
+                    call DisplayTextToForce( GetPlayersAll(), "|cffffcc00가디언의 템플|r이 2개 파괴되었습니다. \n\n|cffffcc00다크니스의 헬 게이트|r가 모두 건재하므로 어둠의 군대는 더욱 강력해질 것입니다.\n\n현재 부활중인 가디언 영웅들의 |cffffcc00부활시간|r이 감소합니다." )

+                    call SetPlayerTechResearchedSwap( 'R092', 1, udg_Force[2] )

+function spread takes nothing returns nothing
+    local force humans=CreateForce()
+    local force bots=CreateForce()
+    local force inactive=CreateForce()
+    local force pool=humans
+    local player p=null
+    local integer i=1
+    local integer guardian=0
+    local integer darkness=0
+    local integer side=GetRandomInt(0,1)
+    local integer row=0
+    loop
+        exitwhen i>12
+        set udg_SP_Player[i]=null
+        set udg_SP_Number[i]=0
+        set p=ConvertedPlayer(i)
+        if i==1 or i==7 then
+            set udg_SP_Player[i]=p
+            set udg_SP_Number[i]=i
+        elseif spread_option(p) then
+            if GetPlayerController(p)==MAP_CONTROL_USER then
+                call ForceAddPlayer(humans,p)
+            else
+                call ForceAddPlayer(bots,p)
+            endif
+        else
+            call ForceAddPlayer(inactive,p)
+        endif
+        set i=i+1
+    endloop
+    loop
+        if CountPlayersInForceBJ(pool)==0 then
+            if pool==humans then
+                set pool=bots
+            else
+                exitwhen true
+            endif
+        else
+            set p=ForcePickRandomPlayer(pool)
+            call ForceRemovePlayer(pool,p)
+            if side==0 then
+                set row=2+guardian
+                set guardian=guardian+1
+            else
+                set row=8+darkness
+                set darkness=darkness+1
+            endif
+            set udg_SP_Player[row]=p
+            set udg_SP_Number[GetConvertedPlayerId(p)]=row
+            set side=1-side
+        endif
+    endloop
+    set i=2
+    loop
+        exitwhen i>12
+        if i!=7 and udg_SP_Player[i]==null then
+            set p=ForcePickRandomPlayer(inactive)
+            call ForceRemovePlayer(inactive,p)
+            set udg_SP_Player[i]=p
+            set udg_SP_Number[GetConvertedPlayerId(p)]=i
+        endif
+        set i=i+1
+    endloop
+    call DestroyForce(humans)
+    call DestroyForce(bots)
+    call DestroyForce(inactive)
+    set pool=null
+    set humans=null
+    set bots=null
+    set inactive=null
+    set p=null
+endfunction

+    endif
+    return true
+endfunction

+function Trig_Single_AllianceManekin_Conditions takes nothing returns boolean
+    if ( not Trig_Single_AllianceManekin_Func001C() ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( SubStringBJ(GetEventPlayerChatString(), 1, 8) == "-아군 " ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    return true
+endfunction
+function Trig_Single_Alliance_Func002C takes nothing returns boolean
+    if ( ( udg_ModeSingle == true ) ) then
+        return true
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_Single_Alliance_Func002Func002C() ) then
+        return true
+    endif
+    return false
+endfunction
+function Trig_Single_Alliance_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local player p=GetTriggerPlayer()
+    if udg_ModeSingle or GS163_TestMode then
+        call GS180_GrantDummyControl(p,12)
+        call GS180_GrantDummyControl(p,13)
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,8,"아군·적 마네킹 제어권과 시야 공유를 활성화했습니다. 기존 마네킹과 이후 생성하는 마네킹에 모두 적용됩니다.")
+    endif
+    set p=null
+endfunction
+function Trig_Test_Lock_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    set bj_wantDestroyGroup=true
+    call GS2V84_ForGroupBJOwned(GetUnitsInRectMatching(GetPlayableMapRect(), Condition(function Trig_Test_Lock_Func002001002)), function Trig_Test_Lock_Func002A)
+endfunction
+function Trig_Test_Unlock_Conditions takes nothing returns boolean
+    if ( not Trig_Test_Unlock_Func002C() ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( udg_ModeSingle == false ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    return true
+endfunction

+endfunction

+function Trig_AcidBomb_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    if ( Trig_AcidBomb_Func001C() ) then
+        call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B057', GetSpellTargetUnit() )
+    else
+        call DoNothing(  )
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_AcidBomb_Func002C() ) then
+        call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B04T', GetSpellTargetUnit() )
+    else
+        call DoNothing(  )
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_AcidBomb_Func003C() ) then
+        call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B00H', GetSpellTargetUnit() )
+    else
+        call DoNothing(  )
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_AcidBomb_Func004C() ) then
+        call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B016', GetSpellTargetUnit() )
+    else
+        call DoNothing(  )
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_AcidBomb_Func005C() ) then
+        call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B027', GetSpellTargetUnit() )
+    else
+        call DoNothing(  )
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_AcidBomb_Func006C() ) then
+        call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B04P', GetSpellTargetUnit() )
+    else
+        call DoNothing(  )
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_AcidBomb_Func007C() ) then
+        call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B0AM', GetSpellTargetUnit() )
+    else
+        call DoNothing(  )
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_AcidBomb_Func008C() ) then
+        call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B07E', GetSpellTargetUnit() )
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_AcidBomb_Func009C() ) then
+        call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B090', GetSpellTargetUnit() )
+    else
+    endif
+endfunction

+function GS157_BasherTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer i = 1
+    local unit u
+    local boolean ranged
+    loop
+        exitwhen i > 12
+        set u = udg_HeroPlayer[i]
+        if u != null then
+            set ranged = IsUnitType(u, UNIT_TYPE_RANGED_ATTACKER)
+            if GS157_BasherUnit[i] != u or GS157_BasherRanged[i] != ranged then
+                set GS157_BasherUnit[i] = u
+                set GS157_BasherRanged[i] = ranged
+                call GS157_BasherSync(u)
+            endif
+        endif
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    set u = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_Pack_Horse_Give_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit horse = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit hero = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local integer a = 0
+    loop
+    exitwhen a > 6
+    if ( UnitInventoryCount(hero) == 6 ) then
+        set udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(hero))] = UnitItemInSlotBJ(horse, a)
+        call SetItemLifeBJ( udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(hero))], 500.00 )
+        call SetItemUserData( udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(hero))], R2I(GetItemLifeBJ(udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(hero))])) )
+        set udg_PackHorseT = hero
+    call TriggerExecute( gg_trg_Pack_Horse_Give_Mix )
+    else
+        call UnitAddItemSwapped( UnitItemInSlotBJ(horse, a), hero )
+    endif
+    set a = a+1
+    endloop
+    if IsUnitAlly(horse, udg_Force[1]) then
+        call GS2V84_IssuePointOrderLocBJ_2(horse, "move", GetRectCenter(gg_rct_G_Home))
+    else
+        call GS2V84_IssuePointOrderLocBJ_2(horse, "move", GetRectCenter(gg_rct_D_Home))
+    endif
+endfunction

+function GS115_DeferItem takes unit caster, unit target, integer aid returns nothing
+    local timer t = CreateTimer()
+    local integer k = GetHandleId(t)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS115_ItemData, k, 0, caster)
+    if target != null then
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GS115_ItemData, k, 1, target)
+    endif
+    call SaveInteger(GS115_ItemData, k, 2, aid)
+    call TimerStart(t, 0.00, false, function GS115_ItemCommit)
+    set t = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_Belginus_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit d=null
+    if h!=null and GetUnitTypeId(h)!=0 and GetWidgetLife(h)>0.405 then
+        set d=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'ewsp',GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        if d!=null then
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(d,'BTLF',1.00)
+            call UnitAddAbility(d,'A0B1')
+            call IssueTargetOrder(d,"rejuvination",h)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set d=null
+    set h=null
+endfunction

+function Trig_AnT_Skill_Learn_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    if ( Trig_AnT_Skill_Learn_Func001C() ) then
+        call SetPlayerTechResearchedSwap( 'R04T', ( GetLearnedSkillLevel() + 1 ), GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()) )
+        call SetPlayerTechResearchedSwap( 'R0BN', ( GetLearnedSkillLevel() + 1 ), GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()) )
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0W0', GetTriggerUnit(), ( GetLearnedSkillLevel() + 1 ) )
+        if ( Trig_AnT_Skill_Learn_Func001Func004C() ) then
+            if ( Trig_AnT_Skill_Learn_Func001Func004Func003C() ) then
+                call SetPlayerAbilityAvailableBJ( false, 'A0L4', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()) )
+                call SetPlayerAbilityAvailableBJ( true, 'A14Q', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()) )
+            else
+            endif
+        else
+            if ( Trig_AnT_Skill_Learn_Func001Func004Func004C() ) then
+                call SetPlayerAbilityAvailableBJ( true, 'A0L4', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()) )
+            else
+            endif
+        endif
+        if ( Trig_AnT_Skill_Learn_Func001Func005C() ) then
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A14Q', GetTriggerUnit(), GetLearnedSkillLevel() )
+            call SetPlayerAbilityAvailableBJ( true, 'A14Q', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()) )
+            call SetPlayerAbilityAvailableBJ( false, 'A0L4', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()) )
+        else

+function Trig_AnT_Special_1_Conditions takes nothing returns boolean
+    local location center = null
+    local location dl = null
+    local rect r = null
+    local destructable d = null
+    local boolean nearTree = false
+    if ( not ( GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R06T', GetOwningPlayer(GetAttacker())) >= 1 ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( GetUnitTypeId(GetAttacker()) == 'Nsjs' ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( IsUnitType(GetAttackedUnitBJ(), UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) != true ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( IsUnitType(GetAttackedUnitBJ(), UNIT_TYPE_HERO) == true ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( IsUnitType(GetAttackedUnitBJ(), UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) != true ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( IsUnitEnemy(GetAttackedUnitBJ(), GetOwningPlayer(GetAttacker())) == true ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    set center = GetUnitLoc(GetAttackedUnitBJ())
+    set r = RectFromCenterSizeBJ(center, 400.00, 400.00)
+    set d = RandomDestructableInRectBJ(r, Condition(function Trig_AnT_Special_1_Func017001002001002))
+    if d != null then
+        set dl = GetDestructableLoc(d)
+        set nearTree = DistanceBetweenPoints(center, dl) <= 400.00
+        call RemoveLocation(dl)
+    endif
+    call RemoveRect(r)
+    call RemoveLocation(center)
+    set d = null
+    set r = null
+    set dl = null
+    set center = null
+    if not nearTree then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( UnitHasBuffBJ(GetAttackedUnitBJ(), 'BEer') != true ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    return true
+endfunction
