+endfunction
+function Trig_Grand_Cross_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit dummy = null
+    local location center = GetUnitLoc(caster)
+    local location spawnLoc = null
+    local location aimLoc = null
+    local integer i = 1
+    if GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE, caster) >= 51.00 + 50.00 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0AD', caster)) then
+        call SetUnitLifeBJ(caster, GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE, caster) - (50.00 + 50.00 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0AD', caster))))
+    else
+        call RemoveLocation(center)
+        set center = null
+        set caster = null
+        return
+    endif
+    call GS2_GrandCrossFixedDamage(caster, GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster, 'A0AD'))
+    loop
+        exitwhen i > 6
+        set spawnLoc = PolarProjectionBJ(center, -100.00, 60.00 * I2R(i))
+        call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1, 'e03M', GetOwningPlayer(caster), spawnLoc, bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        set dummy = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+        call RemoveLocation(spawnLoc)
+        set spawnLoc = null
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(3.00, 'BTLF', dummy)
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ('A0C8', dummy)
+        set aimLoc = PolarProjectionBJ(center, 100.00, 60.00 * I2R(i))
+        call IssuePointOrderLocBJ(dummy, "breathoffrost", aimLoc)
+        call RemoveLocation(aimLoc)
+        set aimLoc = null
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    if GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R037', GetOwningPlayer(caster)) == 1 then
+        call SetUnitInvulnerable(caster, true)
+        call TriggerSleepAction(1.50)
+        call SetUnitInvulnerable(caster, false)
+    endif
+    call RemoveLocation(center)
+    set center = null
+    set dummy = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_DrA_Special_3_Conditions takes nothing returns boolean

+    endif

+function Trig_Backstab_Atk_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit source = GetEventDamageSource()
+    local unit target = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit dummy = null
+    local location p = null
+    call UnitRemoveBuffBJ('B02O', source)
+    set udg_Hero_DrA_BackstabTarget = target
+    set udg_Hero_DrA_Backstab = false
+    set udg_Hero_DrA_BackstabDmg = 30 + GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0AK', source) * 30
+    if GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R03B', GetOwningPlayer(source)) != 0 then
+        set udg_Hero_DrA_BackstabDmg = R2I(2.00 * I2R(udg_Hero_DrA_BackstabDmg))
+    endif
+    if Trig_Backstab_Atk_Func005C() then
+        set p = GetUnitLoc(target)
+        call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_DrA), p, bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        set dummy = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+        call RemoveLocation(p)
+        set p = null
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(1.00, 'BTLF', dummy)
+        if GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE, target) > I2R(udg_Hero_DrA_BackstabDmg) then
+            call UnitDamageTargetBJ(dummy, target, I2R(udg_Hero_DrA_BackstabDmg), ATTACK_TYPE_HERO, DAMAGE_TYPE_DIVINE)
+        else
+            call SetUnitLifeBJ(target, RMaxBJ(1.00, GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE, target) - I2R(udg_Hero_DrA_BackstabDmg)))
+            call UnitDamageTargetBJ(dummy, target, I2R(udg_Hero_DrA_BackstabDmg), ATTACK_TYPE_HERO, DAMAGE_TYPE_DIVINE)
+        endif
+        call TextTagForce("백스탭!", target, 10, 250, 128, 114, 3, GetPlayersAll())
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ("origin", target, "Objects\\Spawnmodels\\Human\\HumanBlood\\BloodElfSpellThiefBlood.mdl")
+        call DestroyEffectBJ(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ())
+    endif
+    call PolledWait(0.10)
+    if udg_Hero_DrA_BackstabTarget == target then
+        set udg_Hero_DrA_BackstabTarget = null
+    endif
+    set dummy = null
+    set target = null
+    set source = null
+endfunction

+function GSAMB_AmbushEnd takes boolean cancelHit returns nothing
+    set GSAMB_AmbushActive=false
+    set udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuStun=0
+    call PauseTimer(udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuLevel)
+    if GSAMB_AmbushWatch!=null then
+        call PauseTimer(GSAMB_AmbushWatch)
+    endif
+    call GSAMB_AmbushClearVisuals()
+    if GSAMB_AmbushCaster!=null then
+        call UnitRemoveBuffBJ('B0AC',GSAMB_AmbushCaster)
+    endif
+    if cancelHit then
+        call GSAMB_AmbushClearHit()
+    endif
+    if GSAMB_AmbushPendingCaster==null then
+        set GSAMB_AmbushCaster=null
+    endif
+endfunction
+function Trig_Ambush_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local player owner = GetOwningPlayer(caster)
+    local location center = GetUnitLoc(caster)
+    local location dest = null
+    local integer i = 1
+    local real duration=BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(BlzGetUnitAbility(caster,'A0G4'),ABILITY_RLF_DURATION_NORMAL,GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster,'A0G4')-1)
+    call GSAMB_AmbushClearHit()
+    call PauseTimer(udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuLevel)
+    call PauseTimer(GSAMB_AmbushWatch)
+    set GSAMB_AmbushActive=false
+    if udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuLoc != null then
+        call RemoveLocation(udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuLoc)
+        set udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuLoc = null
+    endif
+    loop
+        exitwhen i > 18
+        if udg_Hero_DrR_Ambush_SFX[i] != null then
+            call RemoveUnit(udg_Hero_DrR_Ambush_SFX[i])
+            set udg_Hero_DrR_Ambush_SFX[i] = null
+        endif
+        set dest = PolarProjectionBJ(center, 1300.00, 20.00 * I2R(i))
+        call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1, 'e03P', owner, dest, bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call RemoveLocation(dest)
+        set dest = null
+        call SetUnitVertexColorBJ(GetLastCreatedUnit(), 100, 100, 100, 100.00)
+        set udg_Hero_DrR_Ambush_SFX[i] = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+        if GetLocalPlayer() == owner then
+            call SetUnitVertexColorBJ(udg_Hero_DrR_Ambush_SFX[i], 100, 100, 100, 0.00)
+        endif
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    set udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuStun = 0
+    set udg_Hero_DrR = caster
+    set GSAMB_AmbushCaster=caster
+    set GSAMB_AmbushActive=true
+    if duration<=0.0 then
+        set duration=15.0
+    endif
+    set GSAMB_AmbushDeadline=TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)+duration
+    set udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuLoc = center
+    set center = null
+    set udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuAttacker = null
+    call StartTimerBJ(udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuLevel, false, 4.50 - 0.50 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0G4', caster)))
+    call TriggerExecute(gg_trg_Ambush_Check)
+    set owner = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction
+function Trig_Ambush_Buff_Conditions takes nothing returns boolean
+    return GSAMB_AmbushValid()
+endfunction
+function Trig_Ambush_Check_Func002C takes nothing returns boolean
+    return GSAMB_AmbushValid()
+endfunction

+endfunction

+        else

+    endif

+function Trig_DCB_Atk_Conditions takes nothing returns boolean

+function Trig_Chakra_Magic_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit target = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local integer level = GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A06X', GetTriggerUnit())
+    local real mana = ( 50.00 + ( 25.00 * level ) )
+    local real mana2 = ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA, target) * ( 0.06 + ( 0.04 * level ) ) )
+    if (IsUnitAlly(target, GetTriggerPlayer()) == true) then
+    call SetUnitManaBJ( target, ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MANA, target) + mana ) )
+    call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetUnitLoc(GetSpellTargetUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 2.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0UP', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0UP', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped(GetSpellAbilityId(), GetTriggerUnit()) )
+    call IssueImmediateOrderById( GetLastCreatedUnit(), 852277 )
+    else
+    if ( Trig_Chakra_Magic_Func013C() ) then
+        call SetUnitManaBJ( GetTriggerUnit(), ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MANA, GetTriggerUnit()) + (mana2* 0.5) ) )
+        call UnitDamageTargetBJ( GetTriggerUnit(), target, ( 60.00 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A06X', GetTriggerUnit())) ), ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC )
+        call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetSpellAbilityUnit()), GetUnitLoc(GetSpellTargetUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0WB', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "entanglingroots", GetSpellTargetUnit() )
+    else
+        call SetUnitManaBJ( GetTriggerUnit(), ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MANA, GetTriggerUnit()) + mana2 ) )
+    endif
+    call SetUnitManaBJ( target, ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MANA, target) - mana2 ) )
+    endif
+endfunction

+function Trig_Tidal_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit dummy = null
+    local rect r = null
+    local real cx = GetUnitX(caster)
+    local real cy = GetUnitY(caster)
+    local real ang = 0.00
+    local real x = 0.00
+    local real y = 0.00
+    local integer i = 1
+    set udg_Hero_Ele = caster
+    call PlaySoundBJ( gg_snd_PandarenBrewmasterStormWarcry1 )
+    set r = Rect(cx-375.00, cy-375.00, cx+375.00, cy+375.00)
+    call EnumDestructablesInRectAll( r, function Trig_Tidal_Func004A )
+    call RemoveRect(r)
+    set r = null
+    set i = 1
+    loop
+        exitwhen i > 4
+        set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'e01Q', cx+GetRandomReal(-50.00,50.00), cy+GetRandomReal(-50.00,50.00), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', dummy )
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'e01Q', cx, cy, bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    if ( Trig_Tidal_Func007C() ) then
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A13Q', dummy, ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A12D', caster) + 3 ) )
+    else
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A13Q', dummy, GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A12D', caster) )
+    endif
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', dummy )
+    call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( dummy, "thunderclap" )
+    set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'ewsp', cx, cy, bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0H3', dummy )
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 1.00, 'BTLF', dummy )
+    call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( dummy, "stomp" )
+    set i = 1
+    loop
+        exitwhen i > 12
+        set ang = (30.00*I2R(i))*bj_DEGTORAD
+        set x = cx + 10.00*Cos(ang)
+        set y = cy + 10.00*Sin(ang)
+        set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'e01R', x, y, 30.00*I2R(i))
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 0.50, 'BTLF', dummy )
+        call IssuePointOrder(dummy, "move", cx+500.00*Cos(ang), cy+500.00*Sin(ang))
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    set udg_Hero_Ele_Int = ( udg_Hero_Ele_Int - 4 )
+    call TextTagForce( I2S(udg_Hero_Ele_Int), udg_Hero_Ele, 10, 45, 143, 38, 3, GetForceOfPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_Ele)) )
+    set dummy = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_Shadow_Jail_Cast_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit target = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local unit dummy = null
+    local player owner = GetOwningPlayer(caster)
+    local timer gs2JailTimer = CreateTimer()
+    local location targetLoc = null
+    local location homeLoc = null
+    call PolledWait(0.05)
+    call UnitRemoveBuffBJ('BNsq', target)
+    set targetLoc = GetUnitLoc(target)
+    call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(target), targetLoc, bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    set dummy = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(1.00, 'BTLF', dummy)
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ('A0L0', dummy)
+    if GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R06X', owner) > 0 then
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0L0', dummy, 2)
+    else
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0L0', dummy, 1)
+    endif
+    call IssueTargetOrderBJ(dummy, "sleep", target)
+    if IsUnitAlly(target, owner) == true then
+        call AddSpecialEffectLocBJ(targetLoc, "Objects\\Spawnmodels\\Undead\\UCancelDeath\\UCancelDeath.mdl")
+        call DestroyEffectBJ(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ())
+        if IsUnitAlly(target, udg_Force[1]) == true then
+            set homeLoc = GetRectCenter(gg_rct_G_Home_Revive)
+        else
+            set homeLoc = GetRectCenter(gg_rct_D_Home_Revive)
+        endif
+        call SetUnitPositionLoc(target, homeLoc)
+        call RemoveLocation(homeLoc)
+        set homeLoc = null
+    endif
+    call RemoveLocation(targetLoc)
+    set targetLoc = null
+    call SaveUnitHandleBJ(target, GetHandleIdBJ(gs2JailTimer), StringHashBJ("Jail_target"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+    call SaveIntegerBJ(7 + GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R06X', owner) * 4, GetHandleIdBJ(gs2JailTimer), StringHashBJ("Jail_sec"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+    call SaveRealBJ(GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE, target), GetHandleIdBJ(gs2JailTimer), StringHashBJ("Jail_hp"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+    call SaveRealBJ(GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MANA, target), GetHandleIdBJ(gs2JailTimer), StringHashBJ("Jail_mp"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+    call TimerStart(gs2JailTimer, 1.00, true, function Trig_Shadow_Jail_Loop_Actions)
+    set dummy = null
+    set owner = null
+    set target = null
+    set caster = null
+    set gs2JailTimer = null
+endfunction

+function GSST_BomberDeath takes unit u returns nothing
+    local timer t=null
+    local unit d=null
+    local integer k
+    local boolean stun=false
+    if GSST_Data!=null and u!=null then
+        set t=LoadTimerHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(u),301)
+        if t!=null then
+            set k=GetHandleId(t)
+            set stun=LoadBoolean(GSST_Data,k,310) and TimerGetRemaining(t)>0.0
+            call RemoveSavedHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(u),301)
+            call FlushChildHashtable(GSST_Data,k)
+            call PauseTimer(t)
+            call DestroyTimer(t)
+            if stun and GSST_Exists(u) and GSCT_Number(GetUnitX(u)) and GSCT_Number(GetUnitY(u)) then
+                set d=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(u),'e002',GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u),bj_UNIT_FACING)
+                if d!=null then
+                    call UnitApplyTimedLife(d,'BTLF',1.0)
+                    call UnitAddAbility(d,'A0NI')
+                    call IssueImmediateOrder(d,"stomp")
+                endif
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set t=null
+    set d=null
+endfunction

+function GS146_Expire takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer key=GetHandleId(t)
+    local integer n
+    local integer i=0
+    local integer uid
+    local integer count
+    local unit u
+    local group remainingScan
+    local effect e
+    local sound audio
+    if t==null or GS146_Data==null or not LoadBoolean(GS146_Data,key,4) then
+        set t=null
+        return
+    endif
+    call SaveBoolean(GS146_Data,key,4,false)
+    call PauseTimer(t)
+    set n=LoadInteger(GS146_Data,key,6)
+    set remainingScan=LoadGroupHandle(GS146_Data,key,5)
+    set audio=LoadSoundHandle(GS146_Data,key,3)
+    loop
+        exitwhen i>=n
+        set u=LoadUnitHandle(GS146_Data,key,100+i)
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS146_Data,key,100+i)
+        if u!=null then
+            set uid=GetHandleId(u)
+            set count=LoadInteger(GS146_Data,uid,1)
+            if count>0 then
+                if count==1 then
+                    set e=LoadEffectHandle(GS146_Data,uid,2)
+                    call RemoveSavedHandle(GS146_Data,uid,2)
+                    call RemoveSavedInteger(GS146_Data,uid,1)
+                    if e!=null then
+                        call SaveEffectHandle(GS146_Data,key,10000+i,e)
+                    endif
+                else
+                    call SaveInteger(GS146_Data,uid,1,count-1)
+                endif
+                call GS190_InvulnerabilityEnd(u)
+            endif
+        endif
+        set i=i+1
+    endloop
+    if remainingScan!=null then
+        call DestroyGroup(remainingScan)
+    endif
+    set i=0
+    loop
+        exitwhen i>=n
+        set e=LoadEffectHandle(GS146_Data,key,10000+i)
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS146_Data,key,10000+i)
+        if e!=null then
+            call DestroyEffect(e)
+        endif
+        set i=i+1
+    endloop
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS146_Data,key)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    if audio!=null then
+        call StopSound(audio,true,false)
+    endif
+    set audio=null
+    set e=null
+    set remainingScan=null
+    set u=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction

+function GS184_AsuraEnd takes timer t returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit h=null
+    local unit bonus=null
+    local item gem=null
+    local effect fx=null
+    local boolean owns=false
+    local boolean paused=false
+    local real started=0.0
+    if t==null or GS184_MonkData==null or not LoadBoolean(GS184_MonkData,k,0) then
+        return
+    endif
+    set h=LoadUnitHandle(GS184_MonkData,k,1)
+    set owns=h!=null and LoadTimerHandle(GS184_MonkData,GetHandleId(h),100)==t
+    set paused=LoadBoolean(GS184_MonkData,k,7)
+    set started=LoadReal(GS184_MonkData,k,5)
+    set bonus=LoadUnitHandle(GS184_MonkData,k,8)
+    set fx=LoadEffectHandle(GS184_MonkData,k,9)
+    set gem=LoadItemHandle(GS184_MonkData,k,15)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS184_MonkData,k,0,false)
+    if owns then
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS184_MonkData,GetHandleId(h),100)
+    endif
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS184_MonkData,k)
+    call PauseTimer(t)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    if fx!=null then
+        call DestroyEffect(fx)
+    endif
+    if gem!=null then
+        call RemoveItem(gem)
+    endif
+    if GSST_Exists(bonus) then
+        call RemoveUnit(bonus)
+    endif
+    if owns and paused and GSST_Exists(h) then
+        call PauseUnit(h,false)
+        if GSST_Exists(h) and GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'A0EY')>0 and not GS184_AsuraBusy(h) and not IsTriggerEnabled(gg_trg_Single_WTFEffect) then
+            call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(h,'A0EY',RMaxBJ(0.0,90.0-(TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)-started)))
+        endif
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set bonus=null
+    set gem=null
+    set fx=null
+endfunction
+function Trig_Gungsin_Func005Func005C takes nothing returns boolean
+    if ( not ( RAbsBJ(( ModuloReal(( ( GS2V84_AngleBetweenPointsUnits(GetTriggerUnit(), udg_Hero_Mon_GungTarget) - GetUnitFacing(udg_Hero_Mon_GungTarget) ) + 540.00 ), 360.00) - 180.00 )) <= 90.00 ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    return true
+endfunction

+        return false
+    endif
+    return true
+endfunction

+function Trig_Moon_Protection_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    set udg_Hero_MoW_MPOn = true
+    set udg_Hero_MoW_Loc[2] = GetUnitLoc(GetSpellAbilityUnit())
+    call StartTimerBJ( udg_Hero_MoW_MP_Timer, true, 0.03 )
+    set bj_forLoopAIndex = 1
+    set bj_forLoopAIndexEnd = 3
+    loop
+        exitwhen bj_forLoopAIndex > bj_forLoopAIndexEnd
+        call CreateNUnitsAtLoc( 1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetSpellAbilityUnit()), udg_Hero_MoW_Loc[2], bj_UNIT_FACING )
+        set udg_Hero_MoW_MPCaster2[GetForLoopIndexA()] = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 1.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0TX', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0TX', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0GA', GetSpellAbilityUnit()) )
+        call IssueTargetOrderBJ( udg_Hero_MoW_MPCaster2[GetForLoopIndexA()], "rejuvination", udg_Hero_MoW[GetForLoopIndexA()] )
+        call CreateNUnitsAtLoc( 1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetSpellAbilityUnit()), udg_Hero_MoW_Loc[2], bj_UNIT_FACING )
+        set udg_Hero_MoW_MPCaster[GetForLoopIndexA()] = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 1.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0FP', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0FP', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0GA', GetSpellAbilityUnit()) )
+        call IssueTargetOrderBJ( udg_Hero_MoW_MPCaster[GetForLoopIndexA()], "sleep", udg_Hero_MoW[GetForLoopIndexA()] )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'Avul', udg_Hero_MoW[GetForLoopIndexA()] )
+        set bj_forLoopAIndex = bj_forLoopAIndex + 1
+    endloop
+    if ( Trig_Moon_Protection_Func005C() ) then
+        call CreateNUnitsAtLoc( 1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetSpellAbilityUnit()), udg_Hero_MoW_Loc[2], bj_UNIT_FACING )
+        set udg_Hero_MoW_StarfallCaster = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 2.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0G9', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( udg_Hero_MoW_StarfallCaster, "starfall" )
+    else
+    endif
+    call EnableTrigger( gg_trg_Moon_Protection_Timer )
+    call PolledWait( ( 1 + ( 1 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0GA', GetTriggerUnit())) ) ) )
+    call PauseTimerBJ( true, udg_Hero_MoW_MP_Timer )
+    call RemoveLocation( udg_Hero_MoW_Loc[2] )

+function Trig_Hunting_Net_Explode_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local group g = GetUnitsInRectMatching(GetPlayableMapRect(), Condition(function Net_Con))
+    local unit u = FirstOfGroup(g)
+    local unit v = u
+    call GroupRemoveUnitSimple( u, g )
+    loop
+    if ( GS2V84_DistanceBetweenPointsUnits(GetSpellAbilityUnit(), u) < GS2V84_DistanceBetweenPointsUnits(GetSpellAbilityUnit(), v) ) then
+        set v = u
+    else
+    endif
+    exitwhen ( CountUnitsInGroup(g) <= 0 )
+    set u = FirstOfGroup(g)
+    call GroupRemoveUnitSimple( u, g )
+    endloop
+    call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( v, "roar" )
+    call DestroyGroup(g)
+    set g = null
+    set u = null
+    set v = null
+endfunction
+function Trig_Poison_Sniping_Move_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local location sourceLoc

+    if ( Trig_Poison_Sniping_Move_Func001C() ) then

+function Trig_Poison_Sniping_Poison_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h=udg_Hero_Ran
+    local unit target=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit dummy=null
+    local ability poison=null
+    local integer rank=GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'A0O8')
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)==0 or not GSST_Live(target) or rank<1 or rank>4 then
+        set h=null
+        set target=null
+        return
+    endif
+    if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'R00F',true)>0 then
+        set rank=rank+4
+    endif
+    set dummy=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'ewsp',GetUnitX(target),GetUnitY(target),bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    if dummy!=null then
+        call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy,'BTLF',8.00)
+        call UnitAddAbility(dummy,'A00Q')
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy,'A00Q',rank)
+        set poison=BlzGetUnitAbility(dummy,'A00Q')
+        if poison!=null then
+            call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(poison,ConvertAbilityRealLevelField('Esh5'),rank-1,0.00)
+            call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(poison,ConvertAbilityRealLevelField('Esh1'),rank-1,0.00)
+        endif
+        call IssueTargetOrder(dummy,"shadowstrike",target)
+    endif
+    set poison=null
+    set dummy=null
+    set target=null
+    set h=null
+endfunction
+function GS195_RangerPoisonStop takes timer clock returns nothing
+    local integer key=GetHandleId(clock)
+    local unit target=LoadUnitHandle(GS195_RangerPoisonData,key,2)
+    if LoadTimerHandle(GS195_RangerPoisonData,GetHandleId(target),0)==clock then
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS195_RangerPoisonData,GetHandleId(target),0)
+    endif
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS195_RangerPoisonData,key)
+    call PauseTimer(clock)
+    call DestroyTimer(clock)
+    set target=null
+endfunction
+function GS195_RangerPoisonTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer clock=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer key=GetHandleId(clock)
+    local unit source=LoadUnitHandle(GS195_RangerPoisonData,key,1)
+    local unit target=LoadUnitHandle(GS195_RangerPoisonData,key,2)
+    local integer remaining=LoadInteger(GS195_RangerPoisonData,key,4)
+    if not GSST_Live(source) or not GSST_Live(target) or GetUnitAbilityLevel(target,'B00D')==0 or not IsUnitEnemy(target,GetOwningPlayer(source)) then
+        call GS195_RangerPoisonStop(clock)
+    else
+        call SaveInteger(GS195_RangerPoisonData,key,4,remaining-1)
+        call UnitDamageTarget(source,target,LoadReal(GS195_RangerPoisonData,key,3),false,false,ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL,DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+        if remaining<=1 or not GSST_Live(target) then
+            call GS195_RangerPoisonStop(clock)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set source=null
+    set target=null
+    set clock=null
+endfunction
+function GS195_RangerPoisonStart takes unit source, unit target returns nothing
+    local timer clock=null
+    local timer previous=null
+    local integer key=0
+    local integer rank=GetUnitAbilityLevel(source,'A00Q')
+    local real amount=25.0
+    if not GSST_Live(source) or not GSST_Live(target) or rank<1 or rank>8 then
+        return
+    endif
+    if GS195_RangerPoisonData==null then
+        set GS195_RangerPoisonData=InitHashtable()
+    endif
+    set previous=LoadTimerHandle(GS195_RangerPoisonData,GetHandleId(target),0)
+    if previous!=null then
+        call GS195_RangerPoisonStop(previous)
+    endif
+    if rank>4 then
+        set rank=rank-4
+        set amount=amount+15.0
+    endif
+    set amount=amount+15.0*I2R(rank-1)
+    set clock=CreateTimer()
+    set key=GetHandleId(clock)
+    call SaveTimerHandle(GS195_RangerPoisonData,GetHandleId(target),0,clock)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS195_RangerPoisonData,key,1,source)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS195_RangerPoisonData,key,2,target)
+    call SaveReal(GS195_RangerPoisonData,key,3,amount)
+    call SaveInteger(GS195_RangerPoisonData,key,4,4)
+    call TimerStart(clock,1.0,true,function GS195_RangerPoisonTick)
+    set previous=null
+    set clock=null
+endfunction
+function Trig_Poison_Sniping_Stun_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    call GS195_RangerPoisonStart(GetTriggerUnit(),u)
+    call PolledWait( 3.9 )
+    if ( UnitHasBuffBJ(u, 'B00D') ) then
+        call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(u), GetUnitLoc(u), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 1.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A11R', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A11R', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0O8', udg_Hero_Ran) )
+        call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "thunderbolt", u )
+    else
+    endif
+endfunction

+function Trig_Knight_Charge_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = CreateTimer()
+    local unit u = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local real ux = GetUnitX(u)
+    local real uy = GetUnitY(u)
+    local real tx = GetSpellTargetX()
+    local real ty = GetSpellTargetY()
+    local real dx = tx - ux
+    local real dy = ty - uy
+    set udg_Hero_RoC_ChargeStop = false
+    set udg_Hero_RoC = u
+    set udg_Hero_RoC_ChargeAngle = Atan2(dy, dx) * bj_RADTODEG
+    set udg_Hero_RoC_ChargeLoopCount = R2I(SquareRoot(dx*dx + dy*dy) / 40.00)
+    call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ("origin", u, "Abilities\\Spells\\Orc\\Shockwave\\ShockwaveMissile.mdl")
+    set udg_Hero_RoC_ChargeEff = GetLastCreatedEffectBJ()
+    call TimerStart(t, 0.04, true, function Charge_Sub)
+    set u = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_Horseback_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local location currentLoc = GetUnitLoc(udg_Hero_RoC)
+    local real moved = 0.00
+    if udg_Hero_RoC_loc == null then
+        set udg_Hero_RoC_loc = currentLoc
+        set currentLoc = null
+        return
+    endif
+    set moved = DistanceBetweenPoints(udg_Hero_RoC_loc, currentLoc)
+    if moved < 500.00 then
+        set udg_Hero_RoC_real = ( udg_Hero_RoC_real + moved )
+    endif
+    call RemoveLocation(udg_Hero_RoC_loc)
+    set udg_Hero_RoC_loc = currentLoc
+    set currentLoc = null
+    if ( Trig_Horseback_Func003C() ) then
+        if ( Trig_Horseback_Func003Func001C() ) then
+            call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "chest", udg_Hero_RoC, "Abilities\\Spells\\Orc\\WarDrums\\DrumsCasterHeal.mdl" )
+            call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+        else
+        endif
+        set udg_Hero_RoC_real = 0.00
+        set udg_Hero_RoC_Int = IMinBJ(( udg_Hero_RoC_Int + 1 ), 6)
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0KP', udg_Hero_RoC, ( ( ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0GV', udg_Hero_RoC) - 1 ) * 6 ) + ( udg_Hero_RoC_Int + 1 ) ) )
+    else
+    endif
+endfunction

+function Trig_Swash_Slide_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local effect eff1
+    local effect eff2
+    local effect eff3
+    local unit target = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local unit slideunit
+    local unit casterunit
+    local unit targetunit
+    local unit dmgunit
+    local unit wisp
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local location cLoc = null
+    local location tLoc = null
+    local location dest = null
+    local location slideLoc = null
+    local real dist = 0.0
+    local real angle = 0.0
+    call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(caster), caster, bj_UNIT_FACING )
+    set wisp = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+    if ( UnitHasItemOfTypeBJ(caster, 'I011') == true ) then
+        call UnitAddItemByIdSwapped( 'I011', wisp )
+    endif
+    call PauseUnitBJ( true, caster )
+    call SetUnitVertexColorBJ( caster, 100, 100, 100, 100.00 )
+    call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'h000', GetTriggerPlayer(), caster, GetUnitFacing(caster) )
+    set slideunit = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+    call SetUnitFlyHeightBJ( slideunit, 400.00, 2000.00 )
+    call GS2_AddSpecialEffectAtUnitBJ( caster, "Abilities\\Spells\\NightElf\\Blink\\BlinkCaster.mdl" )
+    set eff1 = GetLastCreatedEffectBJ()
+    call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'h001', GetTriggerPlayer(), caster, GetUnitFacing(caster) )
+    set casterunit = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A01D', casterunit )
+    call PolledWait( 0.15 )
+    if IsUnitAliveBJ(target) then
+        set cLoc = GetUnitLoc(caster)
+        set tLoc = GetUnitLoc(target)
+        set dist = DistanceBetweenPoints(cLoc, tLoc)
+        if dist < 1400 then
+            set angle = AngleBetweenPoints(cLoc, tLoc)
+            set dest = PolarProjectionBJ(cLoc, (dist - 100.00), angle)
+            call SetUnitPositionLoc(slideunit, dest)
+            set slideLoc = GetUnitLoc(slideunit)
+            call SetUnitPositionLoc(caster, slideLoc)
+            call RemoveLocation(slideLoc)
+            call RemoveLocation(dest)
+            set slideLoc = null
+            set dest = null
+        endif
+        call RemoveLocation(tLoc)
+        call RemoveLocation(cLoc)
+        set tLoc = null
+        set cLoc = null
+    endif
+    call SetUnitAnimation( slideunit, "attack" )
+    call SetUnitTimeScalePercent( slideunit, 300.00 )
+    call SetUnitFlyHeightBJ( slideunit, 0.00, 2000.00 )
+    call GS2_AddSpecialEffectAtUnitBJ( caster, "Abilities\\Spells\\NightElf\\Blink\\BlinkTarget.mdl" )
+    set eff2 = GetLastCreatedEffectBJ()
+    call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'h001', GetTriggerPlayer(), caster, GetUnitFacing(caster) )
+    set targetunit = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+    call PolledWait( 0.15 )
+    call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(caster), target, bj_UNIT_FACING )
+    set dmgunit = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 1.00, 'BTLF', dmgunit )
+    if ( Trig_Swash_Slide_Func041C() ) then
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A01N', dmgunit )
+        call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( dmgunit, "stomp" )
+    else
+    endif
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A01O', dmgunit )
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A01O', dmgunit, ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A01X', caster) + ( 4 * GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R00Q', GetOwningPlayer(caster)) ) ) )
+    call IssueTargetOrderBJ( dmgunit, "thunderbolt", target )
+    call GS2_AddSpecialEffectAtUnitBJ( target, "Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\ThunderClap\\ThunderClapCaster.mdl" )
+    set eff3 = GetLastCreatedEffectBJ()
+    call PauseUnitBJ( false, caster )
+    call SetUnitVertexColorBJ( caster, 100, 100, 100, 0.00 )
+    call IssueTargetOrderBJ( caster, "attack", target )
+    call RemoveUnit( slideunit )
+    call PolledWait( 0.50 )
+    if ( UnitHasItemOfTypeBJ(wisp, 'I011') == true ) then
+        call RemoveItem( GetItemOfTypeFromUnitBJ(wisp, 'I011') )
+    endif
+    call RemoveUnit( wisp )
+    call RemoveUnit( casterunit )
+    call RemoveUnit( targetunit )
+    call DestroyEffectBJ( eff1 )
+    call DestroyEffectBJ( eff2 )
+    call DestroyEffectBJ( eff3 )
+    set eff1 = null
+    set eff2 = null
+    set eff3 = null
+    set caster = null
+    set target = null
+    set slideunit = null
+    set casterunit = null
+    set targetunit = null
+    set dmgunit = null
+    set wisp = null
+endfunction

+function Thunder_Lizard_Charge_Sub takes nothing returns nothing
+    local real x = 40 * CosBJ(udg_Hero_ThL_ChargeAngle) 
+    local real y = 40 * SinBJ(udg_Hero_ThL_ChargeAngle) 
+    local unit u = udg_Hero_ThL
+    local item i = GS2V84_CreateItemLoc_1('texp', Location(GetUnitX(u)+x, GetUnitY(u)+y))
+    if GS2V84_DistanceBetweenPoints_01(Location(GetUnitX(u)+x, GetUnitY(u)+y), GetItemLoc(i)) < 20 then
+    call SetUnitX(u,GetItemX(i))
+    call SetUnitY(u,GetItemY(i))
+    call SetUnitAnimation( u, "walk fast" )
+    call SetUnitFacing( u, udg_Hero_ThL_ChargeAngle )
+    set udg_Hero_ThL_ChargeLoopCount = udg_Hero_ThL_ChargeLoopCount - 1
+    else
+    set udg_Hero_ThL_ChargeLoopCount = 0
+    endif
+    call RemoveItem( i )    
+    if (udg_Hero_ThL_ChargeLoopCount <= 0 ) or udg_Hero_ThL_ChargeStop then
+        set udg_Hero_ThL_ChargeStop = true
+        set udg_Hero_ThL_ChargeLoopCount = 0
+        call DestroyTimer(GetExpiredTimer())
+        call ResetUnitAnimation( u )
+        call DestroyEffectBJ( udg_Hero_ThL_ChargeEff )
+        call SetUnitAnimation( u, "Spell" )
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", u, "Abilities\\Spells\\Orc\\WarStomp\\WarStompCaster.mdl" )
+        call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+        call DisableTrigger( gg_trg_Thunder_Lizard_Chargeunit )
+    endif
+endfunction

+        call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_ThL), GetUnitLoc(udg_Hero_ThL), bj_UNIT_FACING)

+function Trig_Reincarnation_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local effect e
+    local unit tk = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer i = GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0ZH', tk)
+    local integer m = GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0T8', tk)
+    if ( Trig_Reincarnation_Func006C() ) then
+        set udg_Hero_ToW_ReinDmg[1] = GetEventDamage()
+        set udg_Hero_ToW_ReinDmg[2] = GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE, GetTriggerUnit())
+    else
+        set udg_Hero_ToW_ReinDmg[1] = ( udg_Hero_ToW_ReinDmg[1] + GetEventDamage() )
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_Reincarnation_Func007C() ) then
+        call TriggerExecute( gg_trg_Wraith_of_Blood_Earth_Spirit_Die )
+        call DisableTrigger( gg_trg_Reincarnation )
+        call TriggerSleepAction( 2.00 )
+        loop
+            exitwhen ( udg_Hero_ToW_Dies )
+            if ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE, tk) > 0.00 ) then
+                set udg_Hero_ToW_Dies = true
+                call PolledWait( 0.15 )
+                call SetUnitLifePercentBJ( tk, ( I2R(( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0IN', tk) * 20 ))) )
+                call SetUnitManaPercentBJ( tk, ( I2R(( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0IN', tk) * 20 ))) )
+                if ( GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R08P', GetOwningPlayer( tk )) == 1 ) and (udg_Hero_ToW_Invulnerable == false) then
+                    set udg_Hero_ToW_Invulnerable = true
+                    call SetUnitInvulnerable( tk, true )
+                    call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", tk, "Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\DivineShield\\DivineShieldTarget.mdl" )
+                    set e = GetLastCreatedEffectBJ()
+                    call PolledWait( 4 )
+                    call DestroyEffectBJ( e )
+                    call SetUnitInvulnerable( tk, false )
+                    set udg_Hero_ToW_Invulnerable = false
+                endif
+            endif
+            call PolledWait( 0.1 )
+        endloop
+        call PolledWait( 6 )
+        set udg_Hero_ToW_Dies = false
+        call EnableTrigger( gg_trg_Reincarnation )
+    else
+    endif
+endfunction
+function Trig_Reincarnaion_Portal_Conditions takes nothing returns boolean
+    if ( not ( GetUnitTypeId(GetTriggerUnit()) == 'Hhkl' ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( udg_Hero_ToW_Invulnerable == true ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not Trig_Reincarnaion_Portal_Func003C() ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    return true
+endfunction

+function Trig_Vendetta_Actions takes nothing returns nothing

+    call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'e02I', GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_AbW), GetUnitLoc(udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetKillingUnitBJ()))]), bj_UNIT_FACING)

+endfunction

+function Trig_Black_Shaker_Night_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    set bj_forLoopAIndex = 1

+        exitwhen bj_forLoopAIndex > bj_forLoopAIndexEnd

+            call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3( 1, 'e01F', ConvertedPlayer(GetForLoopIndexA()), GetPlayerStartLocationLoc(ConvertedPlayer(GetForLoopIndexA())), bj_UNIT_FACING )

+                call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'S004', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+                call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'S004', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A04U', udg_HeroPlayer[GetForLoopIndexA()]) )
+            else
+            endif
+            call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3( 1, 'e037', ConvertedPlayer(GetForLoopIndexA()), GetPlayerStartLocationLoc(ConvertedPlayer(GetForLoopIndexA())), bj_UNIT_FACING )
+            if ( Trig_Black_Shaker_Night_Func001Func001Func006C() ) then
+                call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0K7', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            else
+            endif
+        else
+        endif
+        set bj_forLoopAIndex = bj_forLoopAIndex + 1
+    endloop
+endfunction

+function Trig_Shadow_Break_IllDead_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit illusion = GetDyingUnit()
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(illusion)
+    local unit target = LoadUnitHandleBJ(id, StringHashBJ("GS2_SBTarget"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+    local real storedDamage = LoadRealBJ(id, StringHashBJ("GS2_SBDamage"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+    call SaveBooleanBJ(true, id, StringHashBJ("GS2_SBResolved"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+    if target != null then
+        if Trig_Shadow_Break_IllDead_Func001C() then
+            call UnitDamageTargetBJ(udg_Hero_BlS, target, GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE, target) * 0.10, ATTACK_TYPE_HERO, DAMAGE_TYPE_DIVINE)
+            call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ("origin", target, "Objects\\Spawnmodels\\Demon\\DemonLargeDeathExplode\\DemonLargeDeathExplode.mdl")
+            call DestroyEffectBJ(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ())
+        endif
+        if Trig_Shadow_Break_IllDead_Func002C() then
+            call UnitDamageTargetBJ(udg_Hero_BlS, target, 20.00 + 60.00 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A09F', udg_Hero_BlS)), ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC)
+            call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ("chest", target, "Abilities\\Spells\\Undead\\DeathCoil\\DeathCoilSpecialArt.mdl")
+            call DestroyEffectBJ(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ())
+        endif
+        call UnitDamageTargetBJ(udg_Hero_BlS, target, storedDamage * (0.33 + 0.07 * I2R(GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R08X', GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_BlS)))), ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC)
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ("origin", target, "Objects\\Spawnmodels\\NightElf\\NightElfLargeDeathExplode\\NightElfLargeDeathExplode.mdl")
+        call DestroyEffectBJ(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ())
+    endif
+    if udg_Hero_BlS_SBIllusion == illusion then
+        set udg_Hero_BlS_SBIllusion = null
+    endif
+    set target = null
+    set illusion = null
+endfunction

+function GS166_Sync takes unit u returns nothing
+    local integer id=GetUnitTypeId(u)
+    local integer lv
+    local integer target
+    local boolean active=false
+    call GS168_EnsureState()
+    if id=='Eevm' then
+        set lv=GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A08S')
+        set target=1
+        if lv>0 then
+            if lv>4 then
+                set lv=4
+            endif
+            set active=LoadReal(GS166_Data,GetHandleId(u),0)>TimerGetElapsed(GS166_Clock)
+            set target=lv+1
+            if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(u),'R09X',true)>0 then
+                set target=target+8
+            endif
+            if active then
+                set target=target+4
+            endif
+        endif
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A10Y')==0 then
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A08F')
+            call UnitAddAbility(u,'A10Y')
+            call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(u,true,'A10Y')
+        endif
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A08F')!=target then
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A08F',target)
+        endif
+        if lv>0 and GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(u),'R09X',true)>0 and not IsUnitIllusion(u) then
+            if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A169')==0 then
+                call UnitAddAbility(u,'A169')
+                call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(u,true,'A169')
+                call BlzUnitHideAbility(u,'A169',true)
+            endif
+            set target=lv
+            if active then
+                set target=target+4
+            endif
+            if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A169')!=target then
+                call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A169',target)
+            endif
+        elseif GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A169')>0 then
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A169')
+        endif
+        if not active and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0A4')>0 then
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A0A4')
+        endif
+    elseif id=='Hmgd' or id=='H00I' or id=='H00O' or id=='H00P' or id=='H00Q' then
+        if id!='Hmgd' and GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(u),'R04W',true)>0 then
+            if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0FH')==0 then
+                call UnitAddAbility(u,'A0FH')
+                call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(u,true,'A0FH')
+            endif
+        elseif GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0FH')>0 then
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A0FH')
+        endif
+    endif
+endfunction
+function Trig_Vulture_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit v=GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local unit bird=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'u00D',GetUnitX(v),GetUnitY(v),GetUnitFacing(v))
+    local timer t=CreateTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local integer uid=GetHandleId(h)
+    local real duration=10.0+2.0*I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'A12L'))
+    call GS168_EnsureState()
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS166_Data,k,20,h)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS166_Data,k,21,v)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS166_Data,k,22,bird)
+    call SaveReal(GS166_Data,k,23,TimerGetElapsed(GS166_Clock)+duration)
+    call SaveTimerHandle(GS166_Data,uid,20,t)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS166_Data,uid,21,v)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS166_Data,uid,22,bird)
+    call SetUnitPathing(bird,false)
+    call IssueTargetOrder(bird,"attack",v)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLife(bird,'BTLF',duration)
+    call TimerStart(t,0.03125,true,function GS167_VultureTick)
+    set h=null
+    set v=null
+    set bird=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction

+function Trig_Sword_Explode_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer a = 0
+    local effect b
+    local effect c
+    set udg_DT_Boolean = true
+    call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "weapon", GetTriggerUnit(), "Abilities\\Weapons\\GreenDragonMissile\\GreenDragonMissile.mdl" )
+    set c = GetLastCreatedEffectBJ()
+    call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "weapon", GetTriggerUnit(), "Abilities\\Weapons\\GreenDragonMissile\\GreenDragonMissile.mdl" )
+    set b = GetLastCreatedEffectBJ()
+    call PolledWait( 0.30 )
+    call DestroyEffectBJ( b )
+    set a = 1
+    if ( Trig_Sword_Explode_Func012C() ) then
+        set udg_Hero_DaT_ExploLvl = a
+        if ( Trig_Sword_Explode_Func012Func003C() ) then
+            call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B01T', GetTriggerUnit() )
+            call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'e030', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( ( 2.50 + I2R(( 10 * a )) ), 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0OZ', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0OZ', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0QE', GetTriggerUnit()) )
+        else
+            call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A081', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A081', GetLastCreatedUnit(), ( udg_Hero_DaT_ExploLvl + ( 4 * ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0QE', GetTriggerUnit()) - 1 ) ) ) )
+            call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "innerfire", GetTriggerUnit() )
+        endif
+    else
+        call DoNothing(  )
+    endif
+    loop
+    if ( Trig_Sword_Explode_Func014C() ) then
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "weapon", GetTriggerUnit(), "Abilities\\Weapons\\GreenDragonMissile\\GreenDragonMissile.mdl" )
+        set b = GetLastCreatedEffectBJ()
+        if ( Trig_Sword_Explode_Func014Func004C() ) then
+            call PolledWait( 0.80 )
+            set a = a + 1
+        else
+            call DoNothing(  )
+        endif
+        call DestroyEffectBJ( b )
+    else
+        call DoNothing(  )
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_Sword_Explode_Func015C() ) then
+        set udg_Hero_DaT_ExploLvl = a
+        if ( Trig_Sword_Explode_Func015Func003C() ) then
+            call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B01T', GetTriggerUnit() )
+            call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'e030', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( ( 2.50 + I2R(( 10 * a )) ), 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0OZ', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0OZ', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0QE', GetTriggerUnit()) )
+        else
+            call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A081', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A081', GetLastCreatedUnit(), ( udg_Hero_DaT_ExploLvl + ( 4 * ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0QE', GetTriggerUnit()) - 1 ) ) ) )
+            call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "innerfire", GetTriggerUnit() )
+        endif
+    else
+        call DoNothing(  )
+    endif
+    exitwhen ( ( udg_DT_Boolean == false ) or ( a >= 4 ) )
+    endloop
+    call DestroyEffectBJ( c )
+    set b = null
+    set c = null
+endfunction

+    call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )

+function Trig_Soul_Control_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit target = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local unit dummy = null
+    local boolean soul = false
+    local integer skillLevel = GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster, 'A0SP')
+    local integer effectLevel = 0
+    local integer soulLevel = GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster, 'A00K')
+    if caster == null or target == null or GetUnitTypeId(target) == 0 or GetWidgetLife(target) <= 0.405 then
+        set caster = null
+        set target = null
+        return
+    endif
+    set soul = udg_Hero_DeM_Soul >= 5
+    set effectLevel = (skillLevel - 1) * 6 + 1
+    if soul then
+        set effectLevel = (skillLevel - 1) * 6 + soulLevel + 2
+    endif
+    set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'ewsp', GetUnitX(caster), GetUnitY(caster), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 1.00)
+    call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'A0ST')
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, 'A0ST', effectLevel)
+    if soul then
+        set udg_Hero_DeM_Soul = udg_Hero_DeM_Soul - 5
+        call TextTagForce(I2S(udg_Hero_DeM_Soul), caster, 10,255,50,150,3,GetForceOfPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(caster)))
+    endif
+    call IssuePointOrder(dummy, "silence", GetUnitX(target), GetUnitY(target))
+    if skillLevel >= 2 then
+        set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'ewsp', GetUnitX(target), GetUnitY(target), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 2.00)
+        call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'ASc1')
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, 'ASc1', effectLevel)
+        call IssueTargetOrder(dummy, "slow", target)
+    endif
+    if skillLevel == 4 then
+        set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'ewsp', GetUnitX(caster), GetUnitY(caster), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 1.00)
+        call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'A0SU')
+        if soul then
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, 'A0SU', 2 + soulLevel)
+        endif
+        call IssueTargetOrder(dummy, "doom", target)
+    endif
+    set dummy = null
+    set target = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_Venom_Blast_Timer_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local group g = null
+    local unit u = null
+    call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'e030', GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_DeC), udg_Hero_DeC, bj_UNIT_FACING )
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 2.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0IE', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0IE', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0ID', udg_Hero_DeC) )
+    call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "thunderclap" )
+    call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'e032', GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_DeC), udg_Hero_DeC, GetUnitFacing(udg_Hero_DeC) )
+    call KillUnit( GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    call PauseTimerBJ( true, udg_Hero_DeC_VenomEffTimer )
+    set bj_forLoopAIndex = 1
+    set bj_forLoopAIndexEnd = 10
+    loop
+        exitwhen bj_forLoopAIndex > bj_forLoopAIndexEnd
+        call DestroyEffectBJ( udg_Hero_DeC_VenomEff[GetForLoopIndexA()] )
+        set bj_forLoopAIndex = bj_forLoopAIndex + 1
+    endloop
+    call PlaySoundBJ( gg_snd_DeC_Ulti )
+    if ( Trig_Venom_Blast_Timer_Func011C() ) then
+        set g = CreateGroup()
+        call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(g, GetUnitX(udg_Hero_DeC), GetUnitY(udg_Hero_DeC), 200.00, null)
+        loop
+            set u = FirstOfGroup(g)
+            exitwhen u == null
+            call GroupRemoveUnit(g, u)
+            if IsUnitEnemy(u, GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_DeC)) and GetWidgetLife(u) > 0.405 then
+                call UnitDamageTargetBJ( udg_Hero_DeC, u, ( 66.00 + ( 66.00 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0ID', udg_Hero_DeC)) ) ), ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_POISON )
+            endif
+        endloop
+        call DestroyGroup(g)
+    else
+    endif
+    set u = null
+    set g = null
+endfunction

+function GS2_ZaeQCollect takes nothing returns nothing
+    local group candidates = CreateGroup()
+    local unit target
+    local unit caster = udg_Hero_DrK
+    call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(candidates, GetUnitX(caster), GetUnitY(caster), 200.00, null)
+    loop
+        set target = FirstOfGroup(candidates)
+        exitwhen target == null
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(candidates, target)
+        if target != caster and GetWidgetLife(target) > 0.405 and IsUnitEnemy(target, GetOwningPlayer(caster)) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(target) and GetUnitAbilityLevel(target, 'Aloc') == 0 and not IsUnitInGroup(target, udg_Hero_DrK_group) and GS2_ZaeQInFront(target) then
+            call GroupAddUnit(udg_Hero_DrK_group, target)
+            call SetUnitPathing(target, false)
+        endif
+    endloop
+    call DestroyGroup(candidates)
+    set candidates = null
+    set target = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction
+function Trig_Charge_Unit_Conditions takes nothing returns boolean
+    if ( not ( IsUnitAliveBJ(GetTriggerUnit()) == true ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( IsUnitType(GetTriggerUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) == false ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( IsUnitType(GetTriggerUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL) == false ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( IsUnitType(GetTriggerUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) == false ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( GetTriggerUnit() != udg_Hero_DrK ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( IsUnitEnemy(GetTriggerUnit(), GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_DrK)) == true ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( IsUnitInGroup(GetTriggerUnit(), udg_Hero_DrK_group) == false ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    return GS2_ZaeQInFront(GetTriggerUnit())
+endfunction
+function Trig_Charge_Unit_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit target = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local timer t
+    if target != null and not IsUnitInvulnerable(target) and IsUnitAliveBJ(udg_Hero_DrK) then
+        call GroupAddUnit(udg_Hero_DrK_group, target)
+        call SetUnitPathing(target, false)
+        set t = CreateTimer()
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GS2_AuditData, GetHandleId(t), 0, target)
+        call SaveTimerHandle(GS2_AuditData, GetHandleId(target), 204, t)
+        call TimerStart(t, 2.00, false, function GS2_AuditPathRestore)
+        set t = null
+    endif
+    set target = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_FaM_Special_2_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer rand = GetRandomInt( 1 , 100 )
+    local integer chance = 60 // 발동 확률
+    local real mana = ( 15.00 + ( I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A01I', GetTriggerUnit())) * 15.00 ) )
+    local unit target = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    call PolledWait( 0.15 )
+    if ( rand > chance ) then
+    return
+    endif
+    if ( IsUnitAliveBJ(target) == false ) then
+    return
+    endif
+    if ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MANA, GetTriggerUnit()) >= mana ) then
+    call SetUnitManaBJ( GetTriggerUnit(), ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MANA, GetTriggerUnit()) - mana ) )
+    call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 5.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A01T', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A01T', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A01I', GetTriggerUnit()) )
+    call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "chainlightning", target )
+    call TextTag( "멀티 캐스트!!" , GetTriggerUnit() , 10 , 255 , 255 , 150, 3 )
+    else
+    endif
+endfunction
+function Trig_Ice_Wall_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit center = null
+    local unit left = null
+    local unit left2 = null
+    local unit right = null
+    local unit right2 = null
+    local real time = 3.00
+    local integer rand = GetRandomInt(1,100)
+    local integer chance = 100
+    local real px = GetSpellTargetX()
+    local real py = GetSpellTargetY()
+    local real baseAng = Atan2(GetUnitY(caster)-py, GetUnitX(caster)-px)*bj_RADTODEG
+    local real a = 0.00
+    set center = CreateUnit(GetTriggerPlayer(), 'h002', px, py, bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    set a = (baseAng+90.00)*bj_DEGTORAD
+    set left = CreateUnit(GetTriggerPlayer(), 'h002', px+200.00*Cos(a), py+200.00*Sin(a), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    set left2 = CreateUnit(GetTriggerPlayer(), 'h002', px+400.00*Cos(a), py+400.00*Sin(a), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    set a = (baseAng-90.00)*bj_DEGTORAD
+    set right = CreateUnit(GetTriggerPlayer(), 'h002', px+200.00*Cos(a), py+200.00*Sin(a), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    set right2 = CreateUnit(GetTriggerPlayer(), 'h002', px+400.00*Cos(a), py+400.00*Sin(a), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( time, 'BTLF', center )
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( time, 'BTLF', right )
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( time, 'BTLF', left )
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( time, 'BTLF', right2 )
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( time, 'BTLF', left2 )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A01Z', center )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A01Z', left )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A01Z', right )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A01Z', left2 )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A01Z', right2 )
+    if ( Trig_Ice_Wall_Func031C() ) then
+        if ( rand <= chance ) then
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A01Z', center, 2 )
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A01Z', left, 2 )
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A01Z', right, 2 )
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A01Z', left2, 2 )
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A01Z', right2, 2 )
+        else
+        endif
+    else
+    endif
+    call IssuePointOrder(center, "cloudoffog", GetUnitX(center), GetUnitY(center))
+    call IssuePointOrder(left, "cloudoffog", GetUnitX(left), GetUnitY(left))
+    call IssuePointOrder(right, "cloudoffog", GetUnitX(right), GetUnitY(right))
+    call IssuePointOrder(left2, "cloudoffog", GetUnitX(left2), GetUnitY(left2))
+    call IssuePointOrder(right2, "cloudoffog", GetUnitX(right2), GetUnitY(right2))
+    set center = null
+    set left = null
+    set left2 = null
+    set right = null
+    set right2 = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction

+function GS19513_FlameBurstAction takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local player owner = GetOwningPlayer(caster)
+    local integer pid = GetPlayerId(owner)
+    local integer level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster,'A0CP')
+    local integer trait = GetPlayerTechCount(owner,'R048',true)
+    local integer rank = level
+    local integer actual = 0
+    local real x = GetUnitX(caster)
+    local real y = GetUnitY(caster)
+    local real damage = 0.0
+    local real radius = 0.0
+    local real slow = 0.0
+    local unit dummy = null
+    local ability payload = null
+    local boolean added = false
+    local boolean ordered = false
+    if level >= 1 and level <= 4 then
+        if trait > 0 then
+            set rank = level+4
+        endif
+        // Preserve the existing explosion visual, without asking its model to cast.
+        call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1,'h00W',owner,Location(x,y),bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call UnitApplyTimedLife(GetLastCreatedUnit(),'BTLF',3.00)
+        // 1.07/1.5005 used ewsp as the actual A0CV caster as well.
+        set dummy = CreateUnit(owner,'ewsp',x,y,bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        if dummy != null then
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy,'BTLF',3.00)
+            call UnitAddAbility(dummy,'Aloc')
+            call BlzSetUnitRealField(dummy,UNIT_RF_CAST_POINT,0.0)
+            call BlzSetUnitRealField(dummy,UNIT_RF_CAST_BACK_SWING,0.0)
+            call SetUnitState(dummy,UNIT_STATE_MANA,GetUnitState(dummy,UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA))
+            set added = UnitAddAbility(dummy,'A0CV')
+            if added then
+                call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy,'A0CV',rank)
+                set actual = GetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy,'A0CV')
+                set payload = BlzGetUnitAbility(dummy,'A0CV')
+                if actual == rank and payload != null then
+                    set damage = BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(payload,ABILITY_RLF_AOE_DAMAGE,actual-1)
+                    set radius = BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(payload,ABILITY_RLF_AREA_OF_EFFECT,actual-1)
+                    set slow = BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(payload,ABILITY_RLF_MOVEMENT_SPEED_REDUCTION_PERCENT_HTC3,actual-1)
+                    call BlzEndUnitAbilityCooldown(dummy,'A0CV')
+                    set ordered = IssueImmediateOrderById(dummy,852096)
+                endif
+            endif
+        endif
+        set GS19513_FlameBurstStatus[pid] = "[투마 W 진단] 스킬="+I2S(level)+" 특성="+I2S(trait)+" 내부="+I2S(actual)+"/"+I2S(rank)+" 부여="+GS19513_Flag(added)+" 명령접수="+GS19513_Flag(ordered)+" 피해설정="+R2S(damage)+" 범위="+R2S(radius)+" 감속설정="+R2S(slow)
+    else
+        set GS19513_FlameBurstStatus[pid] = "[투마 W 진단] 잘못된 시전자/스킬 레벨: "+I2S(level)
+    endif
+    set payload = null
+    set dummy = null
+    set caster = null
+    set owner = null
+endfunction
+
+function GS19513_FlameBurstChat takes nothing returns nothing
+    local player p = GetTriggerPlayer()
+    local string status = GS19513_FlameBurstStatus[GetPlayerId(p)]
+    if not GS19513_FlameBurstInstalled then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,20,"[투마 W 진단] 발동 처리 설치가 확인되지 않았습니다.")
+    elseif status == null or status == "" then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,15,"[투마 W 진단] 아직 시전 기록이 없습니다.")
+    else
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,20,status)
+    endif
+    set p = null
+endfunction
+function GS19513_FlameBurstInstall takes nothing returns nothing
+    call DestroyTimer(GetExpiredTimer())
+    if gg_trg_Flame_Burst != null then
+        call TriggerClearActions(gg_trg_Flame_Burst)
+        call TriggerAddAction(gg_trg_Flame_Burst,function GS19513_FlameBurstAction)
+        set GS19513_FlameBurstInstalled = true
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GS19513_FlameBurstInit takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger t
+    local integer i = 0
+    if GS19513_FlameBurstStarted then
+        return
+    endif
+    set GS19513_FlameBurstStarted = true
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= 12
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerChatEvent(t,Player(i),"-투마진단",true)
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS19513_FlameBurstChat)
+    call TimerStart(CreateTimer(),0.0,false,function GS19513_FlameBurstInstall)
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function Trig_Flame_Burst_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    call GS19513_FlameBurstAction()
+endfunction

+function GS2_ZigManaPay takes unit caster, integer level returns nothing
+    local timer t
+    if GS2_ZigRainData != null and HaveSavedReal(GS2_ZigRainData, GetHandleId(caster), 200) then
+        set t = CreateTimer()
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GS2_ZigRainData, GetHandleId(t), 0, caster)
+        call SaveReal(GS2_ZigRainData, GetHandleId(t), 1, LoadReal(GS2_ZigRainData, GetHandleId(caster), 200))
+        call SaveReal(GS2_ZigRainData, GetHandleId(t), 2, 80.00 + 20.00 * I2R(level - 5))
+        call RemoveSavedReal(GS2_ZigRainData, GetHandleId(caster), 200)
+        call TimerStart(t, 0.00, false, function GS2_ZigManaAfter)
+        set t = null
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GS2_ZigApplyBurn takes unit source, unit target, real damage returns nothing
+    local unit buffDummy = null
+    local timer t = LoadTimerHandle(GS2_ZigRainData, GetHandleId(target), 100)
+    local integer id
+    if GetUnitTypeId(target) == 0 or GetWidgetLife(target) <= 0.405 or BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(target) then
+        set t = null
+        return
+    endif
+    if t == null then
+        set t = CreateTimer()
+        call SaveTimerHandle(GS2_ZigRainData, GetHandleId(target), 100, t)
+    endif
+    set id = GetHandleId(t)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS2_ZigRainData, id, 4, source)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS2_ZigRainData, id, 7, target)
+    call SaveReal(GS2_ZigRainData, id, 5, damage)
+    call SaveInteger(GS2_ZigRainData, id, 6, 5)
+    set buffDummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(source), 'ewsp', GetUnitX(target), GetUnitY(target), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    call UnitAddAbility(buffDummy, 'Aloc')
+    call UnitApplyTimedLife(buffDummy, 'BTLF', 2.00)
+    call UnitAddAbility(buffDummy, 'AZg1')
+    call IssueTargetOrder(buffDummy, "slow", target)
+    set buffDummy = null
+    call TimerStart(t, 1.00, true, function GS2_ZigBurnTick)
+    set t = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_ChainBoom_Start_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit target = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local integer i = 0
+    loop
+    set i = i + 1
+    if ( ( IsUnitAliveBJ(target) == true ) ) then
+    call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_LOI_Hero), GetUnitLoc(target), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    call GS2V84_AddSpecialEffectLocBJ_0(GetUnitLoc(target), "Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\Doom\\DoomDeath.mdl")
+    call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 1.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0Z5', GetLastCreatedUnit() )

+    call TriggerSleepAction( 1.00 )
+    endif
+    if ( IsUnitEnemy( target, GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_LOI_Hero)) == true ) then

+    set i = 3

+    set i = 3
+    endif
+    endif

+function Trig_FireM_Damage_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit gs2EvtTarget = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local real gs2EvtDamage = GetEventDamage()
+    local integer i = 0
+    local effect e
+    call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "chest", gs2EvtTarget, "Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\BreathOfFire\\BreathOfFireDamage.mdl" )
+    set e = GetLastCreatedEffectBJ()
+    loop
+    set i = i + 1
+    call TriggerSleepAction( 0.90 )
+    if ( IsUnitAliveBJ(gs2EvtTarget) == true ) then
+        if ( IsUnitType(gs2EvtTarget, UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) == true ) then
+            set i = 5
+        else
+            if IsUnitInvulnerable(gs2EvtTarget) then
+            set i = 5
+            endif
+            if ( not ( IsUnitInvulnerable(gs2EvtTarget) ) ) then
+            call UnitDamageTargetBJ( udg_Hero_LOI_FireMastery, gs2EvtTarget, ( gs2EvtDamage * ( 0.03 + ( 0.01 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0WM', udg_Hero_LOI_Hero)) ) ) ), ATTACK_TYPE_HERO, DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL )
+            endif
+        endif
+    else
+        set i = 5
+    endif
+    exitwhen i >= 5
+    endloop
+    call DestroyEffectBJ( e )
+    set e = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_OgL_Skill_Effect_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer PlayerId = GetConvertedPlayerId( GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()) )
+    local integer PowerCnt = 0
+    local real UsingMana = 8.00 + I2R(( 4 * GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A07A', GetTriggerUnit()) )) 
+    if ( Trig_OgL_Skill_Effect_Func005C() ) then
+        set udg_Hero_OgL_PowerBool = true
+        loop
+        exitwhen PowerCnt >= 5 + I2R(( 1 * GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R01C', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit())) ))
+        call PolledWait( ( 0.50 - ( I2R(GS2V84_CountUnitsInGroupOwned(GetUnitsInRectMatching(GetPlayableMapRect(), Condition(function Trig_OgL_Skill_Effect_Func005Func004001003001001001002)))) * 0.25 ) ) )
+        if ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MANA, GetTriggerUnit()) < ( UsingMana ) )  then
+        call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( udg_HeroPlayer[PlayerId], "stop" )
+        return
+        endif
+        if ( udg_Hero_OgL_PowerBool == false) then
+        return
+        endif
+        set PowerCnt = PowerCnt + 1
+        call SetUnitManaBJ( udg_HeroPlayer[PlayerId], ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MANA, udg_HeroPlayer[PlayerId]) - UsingMana ) )
+        if ( Trig_OgL_Skill_Effect_Func005Func016C() ) then
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0AA', GetTriggerUnit() )
+            call TextTagForce( "파워 스트라이크 +1", GetTriggerUnit(), 9, 255, 255, 255, 2, GetForceOfPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit())) )
+        else
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0AA', GetTriggerUnit(), PowerCnt )
+            call TextTagForce( "파워 스트라이크 +1", GetTriggerUnit(), 9, 255, 255, 255, 2, GetForceOfPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit())) )
+        endif
+        endloop
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_OgL_Skill_Effect_Func006C() ) then
+        call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 2.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A041', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A041', GetLastCreatedUnit(), ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A04Y', GetTriggerUnit()) + ( GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R01H', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit())) * 4 ) ) )
+        call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "thunderclap" )

+    endif
+endfunction

+function Trig_ShT_Learn_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit d=udg_Hero_ShT_PassiveWisp
+    local integer rank=GetLearnedSkillLevel()
+    local player owner=GetOwningPlayer(h)
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)=='Oshd' and not IsUnitIllusion(h) and rank>=1 and rank<=4 then
+        if d==null or GetUnitTypeId(d)==0 or GetWidgetLife(d)<=0.405 or GetOwningPlayer(d)!=owner then
+            set d=CreateUnit(owner,'e03H',GetRectCenterX(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea),GetRectCenterY(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea),bj_UNIT_FACING)
+            set udg_Hero_ShT_PassiveWisp=d
+        endif
+        if d!=null then
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(d,'A0TE',rank+1)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set owner=null
+    set d=null
+    set h=null
+endfunction

+function Trig_Curruption_Arrow_Skel_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit gs2EvtTarget = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local real gs2EvtDamage = GetEventDamage()
+    if ( Trig_Curruption_Arrow_Skel_Func001C() ) then
+        set udg_Hero_SoH_ExtraDmg[1] = gs2EvtDamage
+        set udg_Hero_SoH_ExtraDmg[2] = GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE, gs2EvtTarget)
+    else
+        set udg_Hero_SoH_ExtraDmg[1] = ( gs2EvtDamage + udg_Hero_SoH_ExtraDmg[1] )
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_Curruption_Arrow_Skel_Func002C() ) then
+        call PolledWait( 0.10 )
+        if ( (gs2EvtTarget != null and IsUnitDeadBJ(gs2EvtTarget) == true) ) then
+            if GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A149', udg_Hero_SoH) == 1 then
+            call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'u00C', GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_SoH), GetUnitLoc(gs2EvtTarget), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 80.00, 'Brai', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddTypeBJ( UNIT_TYPE_SUMMONED, GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call SetUnitAnimation( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "birth" )
+            elseif GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A149', udg_Hero_SoH) == 2 then
+            call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'u00T', GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_SoH), GetUnitLoc(gs2EvtTarget), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 80.00, 'Brai', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddTypeBJ( UNIT_TYPE_SUMMONED, GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call SetUnitAnimation( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "birth" )
+            elseif GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A149', udg_Hero_SoH) == 3 then
+            call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'u00R', GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_SoH), GetUnitLoc(gs2EvtTarget), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 80.00, 'Brai', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddTypeBJ( UNIT_TYPE_SUMMONED, GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call SetUnitAnimation( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "birth" )
+            elseif GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A149', udg_Hero_SoH) == 4 then
+            call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'u00S', GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_SoH), GetUnitLoc(gs2EvtTarget), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 80.00, 'Brai', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddTypeBJ( UNIT_TYPE_SUMMONED, GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call SetUnitAnimation( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "birth" )
+            call RemoveUnit( gs2EvtTarget )
+            endif
+        else
+        endif
+    else
+    endif
+endfunction

+function Trig_TrB_Skil_Effect_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local player cast_player = GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit())
+    local real cast_life = 1.00
+    local real bloodTime = ( 3.00 + ( 2.00 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A02L', GetTriggerUnit())) ) )
+    if ( Trig_TrB_Skil_Effect_Func005C() ) then
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'S001', udg_Hero_TrB_Caster )
+        set udg_Hero_TrB_DamageTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))] = 0.00
+        call PolledWait( bloodTime )
+        call UnitRemoveAbilityBJ( 'S001', udg_Hero_TrB_Caster )
+        loop
+        call PolledWait( 0.1 )
+        exitwhen UnitHasBuffBJ(udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(cast_player)], 'B07T') == false
+        endloop
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(cast_player)], "Objects\\Spawnmodels\\Human\\HumanLargeDeathExplode\\HumanLargeDeathExplode.mdl" )
+        call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+        if ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE, udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(cast_player)]) <= udg_Hero_TrB_DamageTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(cast_player)] ) then
+        call UnitRemoveBuffsBJ( bj_REMOVEBUFFS_ALL, udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(cast_player)] )
+        call SetUnitInvulnerable( udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(cast_player)], false )
+        if ( IsUnitAlly(GetTriggerUnit(), udg_Force[1]) == true ) then
+        call UnitDamageTargetBJ( GS1959_PickRandomOwned(GetUnitsOfPlayerAll(udg_Force[2])), udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(cast_player)], 1000000000.00, ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS, DAMAGE_TYPE_DIVINE )
+        else
+        call UnitDamageTargetBJ( GS1959_PickRandomOwned(GetUnitsOfPlayerAll(udg_Force[1])), udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(cast_player)], 1000000000.00, ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS, DAMAGE_TYPE_DIVINE )
+        endif
+        else
+        call SetUnitLifeBJ( udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(cast_player)], ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE, udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(cast_player)]) - udg_Hero_TrB_DamageTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(cast_player)] ) )
+        endif
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_TrB_Skil_Effect_Func006C() ) then
+        call PauseTimerBJ( true, udg_Hero_TrB_InrageTimer )
+        if ( Trig_TrB_Skil_Effect_Func006Func003C() ) then
+            call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", GetTriggerUnit(), "Abilities\\Spells\\Undead\\AnimateDead\\AnimateDeadTarget.mdl" )
+            call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+            call UnitRemoveBuffsBJ( bj_REMOVEBUFFS_NEGATIVE, GetTriggerUnit() )
+            call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B01X', GetTriggerUnit() )
+            call SetUnitLifeBJ( GetTriggerUnit(), ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE, GetTriggerUnit()) + ( 1.00 * ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE, GetTriggerUnit()) * 0.20 ) ) ) )
+        else
+            call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B01X', GetTriggerUnit() )
+            call SetUnitLifeBJ( GetTriggerUnit(), ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE, GetTriggerUnit()) + ( 1.00 * ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE, GetTriggerUnit()) * 0.12 ) ) ) )
+        endif
+        set udg_Hero_TrB_Inrageint = ( udg_Hero_TrB_Inrageint - 4 )
+        call TextTagForce( I2S(udg_Hero_TrB_Inrageint), GetTriggerUnit(), 10, 200, 0, 0, 2, GetForceOfPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit())) )
+        if ( Trig_TrB_Skil_Effect_Func006Func006C() ) then
+            call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 1.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0IP', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0IP', GetLastCreatedUnit(), udg_Hero_TrB_Inrageint )
+            call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "battleroar" )
+            call TriggerSleepAction( 0.10 )
+            call StartTimerBJ( udg_Hero_TrB_InrageTimer, false, 19.90 )
+        else
+        endif
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_TrB_Skil_Effect_Func007C() ) then
+        call StartTimerBJ( udg_Hero_TrB_Berserk_Timer, true, 0.03 )
+        call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'e03O', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetRectCenter(GetPlayableMapRect()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( ( 2.00 + ( 2.00 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0RD', GetTriggerUnit())) ) ), 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    else
+    endif
+endfunction

+function InitTrig_League takes nothing returns nothing
+    set gg_trg_League = CreateTrigger(  )
