+function GS2S_HeroUpdate takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetEnumUnit()
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer form = GetUnitTypeId(u)
+    local integer previous = LoadInteger(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("form"))
+    local integer ultimateLevel
+    local integer researchLevel
+    local ability passiveButton
+    local real remainingCooldown
+    if form == 0 then
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS2S_Data, id)
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(GS2S_Heroes, u)
+        set u = null
+        return
+    endif
+    call GS2S_RestoreLevels(u)
+    set ultimateLevel = GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A0PK')
+    if form == 'N03C' then
+        set ultimateLevel = LoadInteger(GS2S_Data, id, 'A0PK')
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A0PK') > 0 then
+            if not LoadBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateRemoved")) then
+                call SaveReal(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateReadyAt"), TimerGetElapsed(GS2S_Clock) + BlzGetUnitAbilityCooldownRemaining(u, 'A0PK'))
+            endif
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'A0PK')
+            call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateRemoved"), true)
+        endif
+    elseif LoadBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateRemoved")) then
+        set remainingCooldown = LoadReal(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateReadyAt")) - TimerGetElapsed(GS2S_Clock)
+        if remainingCooldown > 0.00 and ultimateLevel > 0 then
+            call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u, 'A0PK', remainingCooldown)
+        endif
+        call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateRemoved"), false)
+    endif
+    if previous != form then
+        call BlzSetAbilityResearchTooltip('A0PK', "오버 클록 배우기|cffffcc00(R)|r - [|cffffcc00레벨 %d|r]", 0)
+        call BlzSetAbilityTooltip('A0PK', "오버 클록|cffffcc00(R)|r - [|cffffcc00레벨 1|r]", 0)
+        call BlzSetAbilityTooltip('A0PK', "오버 클록|cffffcc00(R)|r - [|cffffcc00레벨 2|r]", 1)
+        call BlzSetAbilityTooltip('A0PK', "오버 클록|cffffcc00(R)|r - [|cffffcc00레벨 3|r]", 2)
+    endif
+    if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A0QM') == 0 then
+        call UnitAddAbility(u, 'A0QM')
+    endif
+    call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(u, true, 'A0QM')
+    if not LoadBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("rageVisible")) then
+        call BlzUnitHideAbility(u, 'A0QM', false)
+        call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("rageVisible"), true)
+    endif
+    if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(u), 'R07W', true) > 0 or LoadBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("rageUnlocked")) then
+        if not LoadBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("rageEnabled")) then
+            call BlzUnitDisableAbility(u, 'A0QM', false, false)
+            call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("rageEnabled"), true)
+        endif
+    elseif not LoadBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("rageLocked")) then
+        call BlzUnitDisableAbility(u, 'A0QM', true, false)
+        call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("rageLocked"), true)
+    endif
+    if previous != form or ultimateLevel != LoadInteger(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateLevel")) then
+        call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(u, true, 'A0PK')
+        if form == 'Nalc' then
+            call BlzUnitDisableAbility(u, 'A0PK', false, false)
+        endif
+        call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("ultimateLevel"), ultimateLevel)
+    endif
+    if form == 'N03C' then
+        if ultimateLevel > 0 then
+            call UnitAddAbility(u, 'S008')
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'S008', ultimateLevel)
+            call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(u, true, 'S008')
+            if previous != 'N03C' then
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'A15G')
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'A15H')
+                if GetRandomInt(0, 1) == 0 then
+                    call UnitAddAbility(u, 'A15G')
+                    call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A15G', ultimateLevel)
+                else
+                    call UnitAddAbility(u, 'A15H')
+                    call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A15H', ultimateLevel)
+                endif
+            endif
+        endif
+    else
+        call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'S008')
+        call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'A15G')
+        call UnitRemoveAbility(u, 'A15H')
+    endif
+    set passiveButton = BlzGetUnitAbility(u, 'S008')
+    if passiveButton != null then
+        if BlzGetAbilityIntegerField(passiveButton, ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_X) != 3 or BlzGetAbilityIntegerField(passiveButton, ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_Y) != 2 then
+            call BlzSetAbilityIntegerField(passiveButton, ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_X, 3)
+            call BlzSetAbilityIntegerField(passiveButton, ABILITY_IF_BUTTON_POSITION_NORMAL_Y, 2)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set passiveButton = null
+    call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("form"), form)
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_PotionLaunch takes unit caster, real x, real y returns nothing
+    local timer t = CreateTimer()
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(t)
+    local integer level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster, 'A052')
+    local integer effectLevel = level
+    local real dx = x - GetUnitX(caster)
+    local real dy = y - GetUnitY(caster)
+    local integer ticks = R2I(SquareRoot(dx*dx + dy*dy) / 30.00) + 1
+    if ticks > 25 then
+        set ticks = 25
+    endif
+    if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'R08Y', true) > 0 and GetRandomInt(1, 100) <= 50 then
+        set effectLevel = level + 8
+    elseif GetRandomInt(0, 1) == 0 then
+        set effectLevel = level + 4
+    endif
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS2S_Data, id, 2, caster)
+    call SaveEffectHandle(GS2S_Data, id, 3, AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\AcidBomb\\BottleMissile.mdl", GetUnitX(caster), GetUnitY(caster)))
+    call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, 5, ticks)
+    call SaveReal(GS2S_Data, id, 6, GetUnitX(caster))
+    call SaveReal(GS2S_Data, id, 7, GetUnitY(caster))
+    call SaveReal(GS2S_Data, id, 8, x)
+    call SaveReal(GS2S_Data, id, 9, y)
+    call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, 10, effectLevel)
+    call TimerStart(t, 0.03, true, function GS2S_PotionImpact)
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_Enter takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit caster
+    local timer t
+    if GS2S_IsHero(u) then
+        call GroupAddUnit(GS2S_Heroes, u)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+    set caster = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_ItemBonus takes unit u, unit target, boolean tracked returns nothing
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer level=GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0P7')
+    local timer pending
+    local integer key
+    if target==null or not IsUnitEnemy(target,GetOwningPlayer(u)) or level<=0 then
+        return
+    endif
+    if tracked then
+        if LoadBoolean(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemBonusPaid")) then
+            return
+        endif
+        call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemBonusPaid"),true)
+    endif
+    set pending=CreateTimer()
+    set key=GetHandleId(pending)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS2S_ItemDamageData,key,0,u)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS2S_ItemDamageData,key,1,target)
+    call SaveReal(GS2S_ItemDamageData,key,2,10.00+20.00*I2R(level))
+    call TimerStart(pending,0.00,false,function GS2S_ItemDamageApply)
+    set pending=null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_ItemOrder takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer order=GetIssuedOrderId()
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(u)
+    local item it
+    if GS2S_IsHero(u) and order>=852008 and order<=852013 then
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItem"))
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItemTarget"))
+        if GetTriggerEventId()==EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_TARGET_ORDER and GetOrderTargetUnit()!=null then
+            set it=UnitItemInSlot(u,order-852008)
+            if it!=null then
+                call SaveItemHandle(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItem"),it)
+                call SaveUnitHandle(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItemTarget"),GetOrderTargetUnit())
+                call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemBonusPaid"),false)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set it=null
+    set u=null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_PreCast takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer aid=GetSpellAbilityId()
+    if GS2S_IsHero(u) then
+        call RemoveSavedInteger(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemCastAbility"))
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemCastTarget"))
+        if GetSpellTargetUnit()!=null and GS2S_ItemSpell(u,aid) then
+            call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemCastAbility"),aid)
+            call SaveUnitHandle(GS2S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemCastTarget"),GetSpellTargetUnit())
+        endif
+        if GetSpellAbilityId() == 'A052' then
+            call SaveUnitHandle(GS2S_Data, GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u)), StringHash("potionCaster"), u)
+        elseif GetSpellAbilityId() == 'A0QM' then
+            call GS2S_RestoreLevels(u)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_Learn takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer level
+    local integer before
+    local integer learned = GetLearnedSkill()
+    if GetUnitTypeId(u) == 'N03C' then
+        set before = GetLearnedSkillLevel() - 1
+        if before > 0 then
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u, learned, before)
+        else
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(u, learned)
+        endif
+        call UnitModifySkillPoints(u, 1)
+        set u = null
+        return
+    endif
+    if GS2S_IsHero(u) then
+        call GroupAddUnit(GS2S_Heroes, u)
+        if GetLearnedSkill() == 'S008' then
+            call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, 'A0PK', GetLearnedSkillLevel())
+        elseif GetLearnedSkill() == 'A0PK' then
+            call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, 'A0PK', GetLearnedSkillLevel())
+        endif
+        if GetLearnedSkill() == 'A0P7' then
+            set level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A0P7')
+            set before = LoadInteger(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("researchLearn"))
+            if level > before then
+                call SetHeroInt(u, GetHeroInt(u, false) + 3 * (level - before), true)
+                if before < 3 and level >= 3 then
+                    call AdjustPlayerStateBJ(300, GetOwningPlayer(u), PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD)
+                endif
+                if before < 4 and level >= 4 then
+                    call AdjustPlayerStateBJ(1, GetOwningPlayer(u), PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER)
+                endif
+                call SaveInteger(GS2S_Data, id, StringHash("researchLearn"), level)
+            endif
+        endif
+        call GS2S_RestoreLevels(u)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function GS2S_Research takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit shop = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local player p = GetOwningPlayer(shop)
+    local integer tech = GetResearched()
+    local unit hero = udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(p)]
+    if GetUnitTypeId(shop) != 'n02U' or not GS2S_IsHero(hero) then
+        set shop = null
+        set hero = null
+        set p = null
+        return
+    endif
+    if tech == 'R07T' then
+        call AdjustPlayerStateBJ(1200, p, PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD)
+    elseif tech == 'R07U' then
+        call UnitAddItemById(hero, 'I06T')
+    elseif tech == 'R07V' then
+        call UnitAddItemById(hero, 'I00P')
+    elseif tech == 'R07W' then
+        call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data, GetHandleId(hero), StringHash("rageUnlocked"), true)
+        call SaveBoolean(GS2S_Data, GetHandleId(hero), StringHash("rageEnabled"), true)
+        call UnitAddAbility(hero, 'A0QM')
+        call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(hero, true, 'A0QM')
+        call BlzUnitDisableAbility(hero, 'A0QM', false, false)
+        call BlzUnitHideAbility(hero, 'A0QM', false)
+    endif
+    set shop = null
+    set hero = null
+    set p = null
+endfunction

+function SP172_Enemy takes unit h, unit u returns boolean
+    return SP172_Alive(u) and IsUnitEnemy(u,GetOwningPlayer(h)) and not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL) and not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(u)
+endfunction
+function SP174_Float takes unit v, real amount, boolean burst returns nothing
+    local texttag tag=null
+    local string label="독 -"+SP174_Number(amount)
+    if burst then
+        set label="맹독! +"+SP174_Number(amount)
+    endif
+    if IsUnitVisible(v,GetLocalPlayer()) then
+        set tag=CreateTextTag()
+        if tag!=null then
+            if burst then
+                call SetTextTagText(tag,label,0.028)
+                call SetTextTagColor(tag,200,255,70,255)
+                call SetTextTagPosUnit(tag,v,110.0)
+                call SetTextTagVelocity(tag,0.0,0.05)
+                call SetTextTagLifespan(tag,1.10)
+                call SetTextTagFadepoint(tag,0.65)
+            else
+                call SetTextTagText(tag,label,0.023)
+                call SetTextTagColor(tag,80,255,110,255)
+                call SetTextTagPosUnit(tag,v,55.0)
+                call SetTextTagVelocity(tag,0.0,0.035)
+                call SetTextTagLifespan(tag,0.75)
+                call SetTextTagFadepoint(tag,0.40)
+            endif
+            call SetTextTagPermanent(tag,false)
+            call SetTextTagVisibility(tag,true)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set tag=null
+endfunction
+function SP174_Burst takes unit v returns nothing
+    local effect fx=AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\AcidBomb\\BottleImpact.mdl",GetUnitX(v),GetUnitY(v))
+    local timer t=CreateTimer()
+    if SP174_FX==null then
+        set SP174_FX=InitHashtable()
+    endif
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectScale(fx,1.50)
+    if not IsUnitVisible(v,GetLocalPlayer()) then
+        call BlzSetSpecialEffectAlpha(fx,0)
+    endif
+    call SaveEffectHandle(SP174_FX,GetHandleId(t),0,fx)
+    call TimerStart(t,0.65,false,function SP174_Expire)
+    set fx=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function SP172_ApplyTrait takes unit h returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    local boolean extra=SP172_Trait(h,'RSpS')
+    local integer w=GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpW')
+    local ability a=BlzGetUnitAbility(h,'ASpW')
+    local real range=300.0
+    local real life=GetWidgetLife(h)
+    if extra and GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'AShP')==0 then
+        call UnitAddAbility(h,'AShP')
+        call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(h,true,'AShP')
+        call BlzUnitHideAbility(h,'AShP',true)
+        if life>0.405 then
+            call SetWidgetLife(h,RMinBJ(life,I2R(BlzGetUnitMaxHP(h))))
+        endif
+    elseif not extra and GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'AShP')>0 then
+        call UnitRemoveAbility(h,'AShP')
+        if life>0.405 then
+            call SetWidgetLife(h,RMinBJ(life,I2R(BlzGetUnitMaxHP(h))))
+        endif
+    endif
+    call SaveBoolean(SP172_Data,k,90,extra)
+    if SP172_Trait(h,'RSpW') then
+        set range=600.0
+    endif
+    if a!=null then
+        call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ABILITY_RLF_CAST_RANGE,0,range)
+        call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ABILITY_RLF_CAST_RANGE,1,range)
+        call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ABILITY_RLF_CAST_RANGE,2,range)
+        call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(a,ABILITY_RLF_CAST_RANGE,3,range)
+        if w>0 then
+            if w==1 then
+                call SetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpW',2)
+            else
+                call SetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpW',1)
+            endif
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpW',w)
+        endif
+    endif
+    call SaveInteger(SP172_Data,k,92,w)
+    call SaveBoolean(SP172_Data,k,93,SP172_Trait(h,'RSpW'))
+    set a=null
+endfunction
+function SP172_WStart takes unit h, real x, real y returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    local integer lv=GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpW')
+    local integer id='nSw1'
+    local unit nest
+    call SP172_WStop(h)
+    if lv==2 then
+        set id='nSw2'
+    elseif lv==3 then
+        set id='nSw3'
+    elseif lv==4 then
+        set id='nSw4'
+    endif
+    set nest=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),id,x,y,0.0)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,40,nest)
+    call SaveInteger(SP172_Data,k,41,lv)
+    call SaveReal(SP172_Data,k,42,SP172_Time+0.5)
+    call SaveInteger(SP172_Data,k,43,12)
+    set nest=null
+endfunction
+function SP172_EndCast takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h=GetTriggerUnit()
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)=='OSp1' and GetSpellAbilityId()=='ASpR' then
+        call SaveBoolean(SP172_Data,GetHandleId(h),28,true)
+        call SP172_RUpdate(h)
+    endif
+    set h=null
+endfunction
+function SP173_Mark takes unit u, integer aid returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(u)
+    if SP172_Alive(u) then
+        call SaveInteger(SP173_Status,k,aid,SP173_Epoch)
+        call GroupAddUnit(SP173_Marked,u)
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,aid)==0 then
+            call UnitAddAbility(u,aid)
+            call BlzUnitHideAbility(u,aid,true)
+        endif
+    endif
+endfunction
+function SP173_StatusFinish takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer i=BlzGroupGetSize(SP173_Marked)-1
+    local integer n
+    local integer aid
+    local integer bid
+    local integer k
+    local boolean present
+    local unit u
+    loop
+        exitwhen i<0
+        set u=BlzGroupUnitAt(SP173_Marked,i)
+        set k=GetHandleId(u)
+        set n=0
+        set present=false
+        loop
+            exitwhen n>=6
+            if n==0 then
+                set aid='ASbQ'
+                set bid='BSpQ'
+            elseif n==1 then
+                set aid='ASbR'
+                set bid='BSpR'
+            elseif n==2 then
+                set aid='ASbE'
+                set bid='BSpE'
+            elseif n==3 then
+                set aid='AScQ'
+                set bid='BScQ'
+            elseif n==4 then
+                set aid='AScR'
+                set bid='BScR'
+            else
+                set aid='AScE'
+                set bid='BScE'
+            endif
+            if LoadInteger(SP173_Status,k,aid)!=SP173_Epoch or not SP172_Alive(u) then
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u,aid)
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u,bid)
+                call RemoveSavedInteger(SP173_Status,k,aid)
+            else
+                set present=true
+            endif
+            set n=n+1
+        endloop
+        if not present then
+            call GroupRemoveUnit(SP173_Marked,u)
+            call FlushChildHashtable(SP173_Status,k)
+        endif
+        set i=i-1
+    endloop
+    set u=null
+endfunction

+function DW160_Tick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit h=LoadUnitHandle(DW160_Data,k,0)
+    local unit v=LoadUnitHandle(DW160_Data,k,1)
+    local real now=TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)
+    if LoadReal(DW160_Data,k,3)>0.0 and now>=LoadReal(DW160_Data,k,3) then
+        call DW160_ClearMark(k)
+    endif
+    if h==null or v==null or GetUnitTypeId(h)==0 or GetUnitTypeId(v)==0 or now>=LoadReal(DW160_Data,k,6) then
+        call DW160_ClearMark(k)
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(DW160_Data,GetHandleId(h),GetHandleId(v))
+        call FlushChildHashtable(DW160_Data,k)
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set v=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function DW160_Bonus takes unit h, unit v, integer k returns nothing
+    local real amount=30.0

+        call SaveReal(DW160_Data,k,4,TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)+6.0)

+    set DW160_Busy=false

+endfunction

+function GS120_BreathVisual takes unit source, real x, real y returns nothing
+    local timer t=CreateTimer()
+    local integer key=GetHandleId(t)
+    local real sx=GetUnitX(source)
+    local real sy=GetUnitY(source)
+    local real angle=Atan2(y-sy,x-sx)
+    local effect e=AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\CrushingWave\\CrushingWaveMissile.mdl",sx,sy)
+    local effect frost
+    local integer i=0
+    local integer speed=BlzGetAbilityIntegerField(BlzGetUnitAbility(source,'ADr2'),ABILITY_IF_MISSILE_SPEED)
+    if speed<=0 then
+        set speed=1100
+    endif
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectYaw(e,angle)
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectScale(e,0.80)
+    call BlzSetSpecialEffectTimeScale(e,0.65)
+    call SaveEffectHandle(GS2DW_Data,key,11,e)
+    loop
+        exitwhen i>=3
+        set frost=AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\BreathOfFrost\\BreathOfFrostMissile.mdl",sx,sy)
+        call BlzSetSpecialEffectYaw(frost,angle)
+        call BlzSetSpecialEffectScale(frost,0.45)
+        call BlzSetSpecialEffectTimeScale(frost,0.65)
+        call BlzSetSpecialEffectAlpha(frost,130)
+        call SaveEffectHandle(GS2DW_Data,key,17+i,frost)
+        set i=i+1
+    endloop
+    call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,key,12,0.0)
+    call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,key,13,sx)
+    call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,key,14,sy)
+    call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,key,15,I2R(speed))
+    call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,key,16,angle)
+    call TimerStart(t,0.03125,true,function GS120_BreathVisualTick)
+    set frost=null
+    set e=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function DWT_Slow takes unit h, unit v, integer lv, real strength, real duration returns nothing
+    local integer k = GetHandleId(v)
+    local real now = TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)
+    local unit d
+    local integer skill='DXsl'
+    local integer buff='DXsb'
+    local integer rank=lv
+    local timer t
+    local integer key
+    if not GS2DW_Valid(v,h,false) then
+        return
+    endif
+    if LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,81)>now and LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,80)>strength then
+        return
+    endif
+    if LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,81)>now and LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,80)==strength and LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,81)>=now+duration then
+        return
+    endif
+    call SaveReal(DWT_Data,k,80,strength)
+    call SaveReal(DWT_Data,k,81,now+duration)
+    if lv==9 or lv==11 then
+        set skill='DXls'
+        set buff='DXlb'
+    elseif lv==12 then
+        set skill='DR50'
+        set buff='BR50'
+        set rank=1
+    elseif lv>=1 and lv<=8 then
+        set skill='DQ50'+lv-1
+        set rank=1
+    endif
+    set d=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'ewsp',GetUnitX(v),GetUnitY(v),0.0)
+    call UnitAddAbility(d,skill)
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevel(d,skill,rank)
+    call SetUnitState(d,UNIT_STATE_MANA,1000.0)
+    call IssueTargetOrder(d,"slow",v)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLife(d,'BTLF',1.0)
+    set t=LoadTimerHandle(DWT_Data,k,buff)
+    if t!=null then
+        call FlushChildHashtable(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(t))
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    endif
+    set t=CreateTimer()
+    set key=GetHandleId(t)
+    call SaveInteger(DWT_Data,k,82,LoadInteger(DWT_Data,k,82)+1)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(DWT_Data,key,0,v)
+    call SaveInteger(DWT_Data,key,1,buff)
+    call SaveInteger(DWT_Data,key,2,LoadInteger(DWT_Data,k,82))
+    call SaveTimerHandle(DWT_Data,k,buff,t)
+    call TimerStart(t,duration,false,function GS150_SlowEnd)
+    set t=null
+    set d=null
+endfunction

+function GS107_DotTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit source = LoadUnitHandle(GS107_Data, id, 0)
+    local unit target = LoadUnitHandle(GS107_Data, id, 1)
+    local integer count = LoadInteger(GS107_Data, id, 3)
+    local boolean seen = LoadBoolean(GS107_Data, id, 4)
+    local boolean stop = GetUnitTypeId(source) == 0 or GetWidgetLife(target) <= 0.405 or IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE)
+    if GetUnitAbilityLevel(target, 'BDq1') > 0 then
+        set seen = true
+        call SaveBoolean(GS107_Data, id, 4, true)
+    elseif seen and count < 4 then
+        set stop = true
+    endif
+    if not stop then
+        call UnitDamageTarget(source, target, 5.0 + 5.0 * I2R(LoadInteger(GS107_Data, id, 2)), false, false, ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC, WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+        call GS108_FrostText(target)
+        set count = count + 1
+        call SaveInteger(GS107_Data, id, 3, count)
+    endif
+    if stop or count >= 5 then
+        if LoadReal(GS107_Data, GetHandleId(target), 101) == LoadReal(GS107_Data, id, 6) then
+            call RemoveSavedReal(GS107_Data, GetHandleId(target), 101)
+        endif
+        call DestroyEffect(LoadEffectHandle(GS107_Data, id, 5))
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(GS107_Timers, GetHandleId(target), GetHandleId(source))
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS107_Data, id)
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    endif
+    set source = null
+    set target = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS2FB_Area takes unit caster, real radius, real damage returns nothing
+    local group targets = CreateGroup()
+    local unit target
+    call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(targets, GetUnitX(caster), GetUnitY(caster), radius + 192.0, null)
+    loop
+        set target = FirstOfGroup(targets)
+        exitwhen target == null
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(targets, target)
+        if IsUnitInRange(target, caster, radius) and GS2DW_Valid(target, caster, true) then
+            call UnitDamageTarget(caster, target, damage, false, false, ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC, WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+        endif
+    endloop
+    call DestroyGroup(targets)
+    set targets = null
+    set target = null
+endfunction

+function GS117_WindTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k = GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit u = LoadUnitHandle(GS117_Data, k, 0)
+    local integer aid = LoadInteger(GS117_Data, k, 1)
+    local integer buff = GS117_WindBuff(aid)
+    local integer proxy = GS125_WindProxy(aid)
+    local real now = TimerGetElapsed(GS117_Clock)
+    local real elapsed = now - LoadReal(GS117_Data, k, 3)
+    local real remaining = RMaxBJ(0.0, LoadReal(GS117_Data, k, 2) - now)
+    local real actual
+    local integer ended = LoadInteger(GS117_Data, k, 5)
+    local boolean first = not LoadBoolean(GS117_Data, k, 7)
+    local boolean done = false
+    if u == null or GetUnitTypeId(u) == 0 or LoadTimerHandle(GS117_Data, GetHandleId(u), aid) != t then
+        set done = true
+    else
+        set actual = BlzGetUnitAbilityCooldownRemaining(u, aid)
+        if first then
+            call SaveBoolean(GS117_Data, k, 7, true)
+            if proxy != 0 then
+                call BlzUnitDisableAbility(u,aid,true,true)
+                call SaveBoolean(GS117_Data,k,10,true)
+                call UnitAddAbility(u,proxy)
+                call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u,proxy,GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,aid))
+                call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u,proxy,remaining)
+            endif
+            call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u, aid, remaining)
+            call TimerStart(t, 0.10, true, function GS117_WindTick)
+        elseif RAbsBJ(actual - remaining) > 0.25 then
+            if remaining > 0.0 then
+                call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u, aid, remaining)
+            else
+                call BlzEndUnitAbilityCooldown(u, aid)
+            endif
+        endif
+        if proxy != 0 and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,proxy) > 0 then
+            if remaining <= 0.0 and not LoadBoolean(GS117_Data,k,11) then
+                call BlzUnitDisableAbility(u,proxy,true,false)
+                call SaveBoolean(GS117_Data,k,11,true)
+            endif
+        endif
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, buff) > 0 then
+            call SaveBoolean(GS117_Data, k, 4, true)
+            set ended = 0
+        elseif LoadBoolean(GS117_Data, k, 4) or elapsed >= 2.0 then
+            set ended = ended + 1
+            if ended >= 2 and remaining <= 0.0 then
+                set done = true
+            endif
+        endif
+        call SaveInteger(GS117_Data, k, 5, ended)
+        if elapsed > LoadReal(GS117_Data, k, 6) and remaining <= 0.0 then
+            set done = true
+        endif
+    endif
+    if done then
+        if u != null and LoadTimerHandle(GS117_Data, GetHandleId(u), aid) == t then
+            if proxy != 0 then
+                call BlzEndUnitAbilityCooldown(u,aid)
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u,proxy)
+                if LoadBoolean(GS117_Data,k,10) then
+                    call BlzUnitDisableAbility(u,aid,false,false)
+                endif
+            endif
+            call RemoveSavedHandle(GS117_Data, GetHandleId(u), aid)
+        endif
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS117_Data, k)
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS123_WindUI takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k = GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit u = LoadUnitHandle(GS117_Data,k,0)
+    local integer aid = LoadInteger(GS117_Data,k,1)
+    if u != null and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,aid) > 0 and GS125_WindProxy(aid) == 0 then
+        call BlzUnitHideAbility(u,aid,false)
+    endif
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS117_Data,k)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    set u = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS144_BootTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local unit u = LoadUnitHandle(GS144_Data,GetHandleId(t),0)
+    local integer uid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local real now = TimerGetElapsed(GS144_Clock)
+    local boolean ended = false
+    local real remaining
+    if u == null or GetUnitTypeId(u) == 0 or GetWidgetLife(u) <= 0.405 or LoadTimerHandle(GS144_Data,uid,2) != t then
+        call GS144_BootFinish(t,u)
+    else
+        if not LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,9) then
+            set remaining = BlzGetUnitAbilityCooldownRemaining(u,'A056')
+            if remaining < 59.0 then
+                call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u,'A056',60.0)
+            endif
+            call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,9,true)
+        endif
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'BW44') > 0 then
+            call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,6,true)
+        endif
+        set ended = now >= LoadReal(GS144_Data,uid,1) or LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,7)
+        if LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,6) and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'BW44') == 0 then
+            set ended = true
+        endif
+        if now >= LoadReal(GS144_Data,uid,8)+0.50 and not LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,6) then
+            set ended = true
+        endif
+        if ended then
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'BW44')
+            call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,7,true)
+            call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,0,false)
+            if LoadBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,5) then
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'SW44')
+                call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'BW45')
+                call SaveBoolean(GS144_Data,uid,5,false)
+            endif
+            if not HaveSavedHandle(GS144_Data,uid,3) or now > LoadReal(GS144_Data,uid,4) then
+                call GS144_BootFinish(t,u)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set u = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS121_SiegeExpire takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local unit h = LoadUnitHandle(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(t),41)
+    call GS114S_StopSiege(h)
+    set h = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS121_SiegeOrders takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer order = GetIssuedOrderId()
+    local integer key = GetHandleId(h)
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h) == 'USa1' and LoadBoolean(GS114S_Data,key,23) then
+        if order == OrderId("clusterrockets") and LoadUnitHandle(GS114S_Data,key,21) != null then
+            call SaveBoolean(GS114S_Data,key,42,true)
+        elseif order != OrderId("berserk") and order != OrderId("channel") then
+            call GS114S_StopSiege(h)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set h = null
+endfunction
+function GS121_SiegeAction takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer aid = GetSpellAbilityId()
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h) == 'USa1' and LoadBoolean(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(h),23) and aid != 'ASg1' and aid != 'ASf1' and aid != 'ASx1' then
+        call GS114S_StopSiege(h)
+    endif
+    set h = null
+endfunction
+function GS114S_Update takes unit h returns nothing
+    local player p = GetOwningPlayer(h)
+    local integer k = GetHandleId(h)
+    local integer q = GetUnitAbilityLevel(h, 'ASq1')
+    local integer w = GetUnitAbilityLevel(h, 'ASw1')
+    local integer r = GetUnitAbilityLevel(h, 'ASr1')
+    local integer prev = LoadInteger(GS114S_Data, k, 1)
+    local integer id
+    local integer threshold
+    local integer i = 1
+    local real move = 0.0
+    local ability battle = BlzGetUnitAbility(h,'ASq1')
+    local integer rank = 0
+    if battle != null then
+        loop
+            exitwhen rank >= 4
+            call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(battle,ABILITY_RLF_CHANCE_TO_CRITICAL_STRIKE,rank,5.0*I2R(rank+1))
+            call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(battle,ABILITY_RLF_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER_OCR2,rank,2.0)
+            call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(battle,ABILITY_RLF_DAMAGE_BONUS_OCR3,rank,0.0)
+            call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(battle,ABILITY_RLF_CHANCE_TO_EVADE_OCR4,rank,0.05*I2R(rank))
+            set rank = rank + 1
+        endloop
+    endif
+    set battle = null
+    if q != prev then
+        if prev > 0 then
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(h, 'ASb1' + prev - 1)
+        endif
+        if q > 0 then
+            set id = 'ASb1' + q - 1
+            call UnitAddAbility(h, id)
+            call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(h, true, id)
+            call BlzUnitHideAbility(h, id, true)
+        endif
+        call SaveInteger(GS114S_Data, k, 1, q)
+    endif
+    set prev = LoadInteger(GS114S_Data, k, 2)
+    if w != prev then
+        if prev > 0 then
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(h, 'ASa1' + prev - 1)
+        endif
+        if w > 0 then
+            set id = 'ASa1' + w - 1
+            call UnitAddAbility(h, id)
+            call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(h, true, id)
+            call BlzUnitHideAbility(h, id, true)
+        endif
+        call SaveInteger(GS114S_Data, k, 2, w)
+    endif
+    if r != LoadInteger(GS114S_Data, k, 3) then
+        if r > 0 then
+            set move = I2R(4 * r - 2)
+        endif
+        call SetUnitMoveSpeed(h, GetUnitDefaultMoveSpeed(h) + move)
+        call SaveInteger(GS114S_Data, k, 3, r)
+    endif
+    if GetPlayerTechCount(p, 'RS01', true) > 0 and GetUnitAbilityLevel(h, 'ASg1') == 0 then
+        call UnitAddAbility(h, 'ASg1')
+        call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(h, true, 'ASg1')
+        call UnitAddAbility(h, 'ASx1')
+        call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(h, true, 'ASx1')
+        call BlzUnitHideAbility(h, 'ASx1', true)
+        call UnitAddAbility(h,'ASf1')
+        call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(h,true,'ASf1')
+        call BlzUnitHideAbility(h,'ASf1',true)
+    endif
+    if GetPlayerTechCount(p, 'RS05', true) > 0 then
+        call UnitAddAbility(h, 'ASs1')
+        call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(h, true, 'ASs1')
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(h, 'ASs1', GS114S_Band(h))
+        call BlzUnitHideAbility(h,'ASs1',LoadBoolean(GS114S_Data,k,23))
+    endif
+    if GetPlayerTechCount(p, 'RS04', true) > 0 then
+        loop
+            exitwhen i > 3
+            if i == 1 then
+                set threshold = 3
+            elseif i == 2 then
+                set threshold = 8
+            else
+                set threshold = 15
+            endif
+            if GetHeroLevel(h) >= threshold and not LoadBoolean(GS114S_Data, k, 30 + i) then
+                call SaveBoolean(GS114S_Data, k, 30 + i, true)
+                call UnitModifySkillPoints(h, 1)
+            endif
+            set i = i + 1
+        endloop
+    endif
+    set p = null
+endfunction
+function GS114S_ItemSkill takes unit h, integer aid returns boolean
+    return GS2S_ItemSpell(h,aid)
+endfunction
+function GS114S_ItemBonus takes unit h, unit target, boolean tracked returns nothing
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(h)
+    local integer band=GS114S_Band(h)
+    if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RS02',true)<=0 or not GS114S_Enemy(target,h) then
+        return
+    endif
+    if tracked then
+        if LoadBoolean(GS114S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemBonusPaid")) then
+            return
+        endif
+        call SaveBoolean(GS114S_Data,sid,StringHash("itemBonusPaid"),true)
+    endif
+    call UnitDamageTarget(h,target,65.0+45.0*I2R(band),false,false,ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL,DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+endfunction
+function GS116S_Escape takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h = udg_HeroPlayer[GetPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer()) + 1]
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h) == 'USa1' and LoadBoolean(GS114S_Data, GetHandleId(h), 23) then
+        call GS114S_StopSiege(h)
+        call IssueImmediateOrder(h, "stop")
+    endif
+    set h = null
+endfunction
+function GS114S_EndCast takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer sync
+    if GetUnitTypeId(GetTriggerUnit()) == 'USa1' and GetSpellAbilityId() == 'ASg1' and not LoadBoolean(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(GetTriggerUnit()),42) then
+        call GS114S_StopSiege(GetTriggerUnit())
+    endif
+    if GetUnitTypeId(GetTriggerUnit())=='USa1' and GetSpellAbilityId()=='ASg1' then
+        set sync=CreateTimer()
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GS114S_Data,GetHandleId(sync),45,GetTriggerUnit())
+        call TimerStart(sync,0.0,false,function GS138_SiegeCooldownSync)
+        set sync=null
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GS114S_Death takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GetUnitTypeId(GetTriggerUnit()) == 'USa1' then
+        call GS114S_StopSiege(GetTriggerUnit())
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GS114S_Hit takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h = GetEventDamageSource()
+    local unit v = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit d
+    local integer k
+    local real now
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h) == 'USa1' and not IsUnitIllusion(h) and BlzGetEventIsAttack() and GetEventDamage() > 0.0 and GS114S_Enemy(v, h) and GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h), 'RS03', true) > 0 then
+        set k = GetHandleId(h)
+        set now = TimerGetElapsed(GS114S_Clock)
+        if now >= LoadReal(GS114S_Data, k, 20) and GetRandomInt(1, 100) <= 20 then
+            call SaveReal(GS114S_Data, k, 20, now + 4.0)
+            call TextTagForce("강타!", h, 10, 255, 220, 80, 1.50, GetPlayersAll())
+            set d = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h), 'dSa1', GetUnitX(v), GetUnitY(v), 0.0)
+            call IssueTargetOrder(d, "thunderbolt", v)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(d, 'BTLF', 2.0)
+            call UnitDamageTarget(h, v, 30.0, false, false, ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC, WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set h = null
+    set v = null
+    set d = null
+endfunction

+function GSRI_Hide takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer i = 0
+    if GSRI_Visible then
+        loop
+            exitwhen i >= GSRI_POOL_SIZE
+            call GSRI_HideSegment(i)
+            set GSRI_SegmentValid[i] = false
+            set i = i+1
+        endloop
+        set GSRI_Visible = false
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GSRI_Z takes real x, real y returns real
+    if GSRI_Ground==null or not GSCT_Number(x) or not GSCT_Number(y) then
+        return 0.0
+    endif
+    call MoveLocation(GSRI_Ground, x, y)
+    return GetLocationZ(GSRI_Ground) + 12.00
+endfunction
+function GSRI_SnapshotTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer i = 1
+    local integer sid
+    local unit u
+    loop
+        exitwhen i > 12
+        set u = udg_HeroPlayer[i]
+        set sid = GetHandleId(u)
+        if GSRI_CacheOwner[i] != sid then
+            call FlushChildHashtable(GSRI_Cache, GSRI_CacheOwner[i])
+            call FlushChildHashtable(GSRI_CacheIndex, GSRI_CacheOwner[i])
+            set GSRI_CacheOwner[i] = sid
+        endif
+        if u != null and GetUnitTypeId(u) != 0 then
+            call GSRI_Snapshot(u)
+        endif
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function GSRI_Allowed takes unit u, integer id returns boolean
+    local integer kind = LoadInteger(GSRI_Data, id, 1)
+    local integer level = GSRI_Level(u, id)
+    local integer sid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer offset = LoadInteger(GSRI_CacheIndex, sid, id)
+    local real range
+    if id == 'ASpR' and GetUnitTypeId(u) == 'OSp1' and GSRI_Item == null then
+        return GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'ASpR')>0
+    endif
+    if kind == 0 or level < 0 then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if GSRI_Item == null then
+        if offset == 0 then
+            return false
+        endif
+        if LoadInteger(GSRI_Cache,sid,offset+2) < 0 or LoadInteger(GSRI_Cache,sid,offset+3) < 0 then
+            return false
+        endif
+        if kind == 2 and LoadInteger(GSRI_Cache,sid,offset+4) == 0 then
+            return false
+        endif
+    endif
+    set range = GSRI_Range(u,id,level)
+    return range > 0.00 and range < 9999.00
+endfunction
+function GSRI_Trim takes integer oldEnd returns nothing
+    local integer i = GSRI_DrawIndex
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= oldEnd
+        call GSRI_HideSegment(i)
+        set GSRI_SegmentValid[i] = false
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+endfunction
+function GSRI_RegisterItemCommand takes integer aid, string order returns nothing
+    local trigger t = CreateTrigger()
+    call SaveInteger(GSRI_Data,GetHandleId(t),102,aid)
+    call TriggerRegisterCommandEvent(t,aid,order)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GSRI_OnItemCommand)
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS129_Init takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger t = CreateTrigger()
+    local integer i = 0
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= bj_MAX_PLAYER_SLOTS
+        call BlzTriggerRegisterPlayerKeyEvent(t,Player(i),OSKEY_CAPSLOCK,0,true)
+        call BlzTriggerRegisterPlayerKeyEvent(t,Player(i),OSKEY_CAPSLOCK,0,false)
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS129_TabBoard)
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS177RF_Target takes unit source returns unit
+    local unit hero=null
+    local integer slot
+    if source==null then
+        return null
+    endif
+    if not IsUnitType(source,UNIT_TYPE_HERO) and (BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(source) or GetUnitAbilityLevel(source,'Aloc')>0) then
+        set slot=GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(source))+1
+        if slot>=1 and slot<=12 then
+            set hero=udg_HeroPlayer[slot]
+        endif
+        if hero!=null and GetOwningPlayer(hero)==GetOwningPlayer(source) and RAIN_Alive(hero) and not IsUnitIllusion(hero) then
+            return hero
+        endif
+        set hero=null
+        return null
+    endif
+    return source
+endfunction
+function RAIN_Enemy takes unit h, unit v returns boolean
+    return RAIN_Alive(v) and IsUnitEnemy(v,GetOwningPlayer(h)) and not IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE)
+endfunction
+function RAIN_REnemy takes unit h, unit v returns boolean
+    return RAIN_Alive(v) and IsUnitEnemy(v,GetOwningPlayer(h)) and not IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(v)
+endfunction
+function RAIN_Dummy takes unit h, unit v, integer aid, integer lv, string order returns nothing
+    local unit d=null
+    if GS181_Live(h) and GS181_Live(v) and aid!=0 and lv>0 then
+        set d=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'nRad',GetUnitX(v),GetUnitY(v),0.0)
+        if d!=null then
+            call UnitAddAbility(d,aid)
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(d,aid,lv)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(d,'BTLF',1.5)
+            call IssueTargetOrder(d,order,v)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set d=null
+endfunction
+function RAIN_Mark takes unit h, unit v, integer lv returns nothing
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(v)
+    local timer t=LoadTimerHandle(RAIN_Data,sid,1)
+    local integer k
+    local real duration=2.0+I2R(lv)
+    local real ratio=0.20
+    if t!=null then
+        set k=GetHandleId(t)
+        call DestroyEffect(LoadEffectHandle(RAIN_Data,k,2))
+        call FlushChildHashtable(RAIN_Data,k)
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    endif
+    if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RR01',true)>0 then
+        set duration=duration+2.0
+        set ratio=0.25
+    endif
+    set t=CreateTimer()
+    set k=GetHandleId(t)
+    call SaveTimerHandle(RAIN_Data,sid,1,t)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(RAIN_Data,k,0,v)
+    call SaveReal(RAIN_Data,k,1,ratio)
+    call SaveEffectHandle(RAIN_Data,k,2,AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Undead\\Curse\\CurseTarget.mdl",v,"overhead"))
+    call TimerStart(t,duration,false,function RAIN_QExpire)
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function RAIN_RStop takes unit h returns nothing
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(h)
+    local timer t=LoadTimerHandle(RAIN_Data,sid,10)
+    if t!=null then
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(RAIN_Data,sid,10)
+        call GSCT_ClearLine(RAIN_Data,GetHandleId(t),5)
+        call FlushChildHashtable(RAIN_Data,GetHandleId(t))
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    endif
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function RAIN_Research takes nothing returns nothing
+    local player p=GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit())
+    local integer tech=GetResearched()
+    if GetUnitTypeId(GetTriggerUnit())=='nRat' then
+        if tech=='RR01' then
+            call GS2TT_Append(p,'ARq1',4,"낙인","지속시간 +2초, 추가 피해 25%",false)
+        elseif tech=='RR02' then
+            call GS2TT_Append(p,'ARw1',4,"영혼 고문","흡수 중 10% 감속, 완료 후 25% 감속",false)
+        elseif tech=='RR03' then
+            call GS2TT_Append(p,'ARr1',3,"환각","회당 소모/피해 +10/15/20, 기절 0.5초",false)
+        elseif tech=='RR04' then
+            call GS2TT_Append(p,'ARe1',4,"마법 충격","적 스킬 사용 시 20/30/40/50 피해",false)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set p=null
+endfunction
+function GS177_SpawnRoro takes player p returns nothing
+    local integer slot=GetPlayerId(p)
+    local unit h=udg_HeroPlayer[slot+1]
+    local unit r=null
+    local real angle=0.0
+    local real x=0.0
+    local real y=0.0
+    if not (udg_ModeSingle or GS163_TestMode) then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,5,"싱글 또는 -테스트 모드에서 사용할 수 있습니다.")
+        set h=null
+        return
+    endif
+    if h==null or GetUnitTypeId(h)==0 or IsUnitType(h,UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) or GetWidgetLife(h)<=0.405 then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,5,"영웅을 선택하고 부활한 뒤 -로오로를 입력하세요.")
+        set h=null
+        return
+    endif
+    set r=GS177_TestRoro[slot]
+    if r!=null and GetUnitTypeId(r)!=0 then
+        call RemoveUnit(r)
+    endif
+    set angle=GetUnitFacing(h)*bj_DEGTORAD
+    set x=RMaxBJ(GetRectMinX(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)+64.0,RMinBJ(GetRectMaxX(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)-64.0,GetUnitX(h)+350.0*Cos(angle)))
+    set y=RMaxBJ(GetRectMinY(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)+64.0,RMinBJ(GetRectMaxY(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)-64.0,GetUnitY(h)+350.0*Sin(angle)))
+    set r=CreateUnit(Player(PLAYER_NEUTRAL_AGGRESSIVE),'nfgb',x,y,GetUnitFacing(h)+180.0)
+    call SetUnitPosition(r,x,y)
+    call BlzUnitDisableAbility(r,'A0EH',true,true)
+    call SetUnitCreepGuard(r,false)
+    call GS2_AuditDamageSubscribe(gg_trg_DamageTaken,r)
+    set GS177_TestRoro[slot]=r
+    call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,8,"테스트용 로오로(변신형)를 소환했습니다. 직접 처치하면 90초 시야 보상이 발동합니다. 적 마네킹은 처치 전에 만들어 두세요.")
+    set h=null
+    set r=null
+endfunction
+function GS177RV_Show takes player p returns nothing
+    local unit hero=udg_HeroPlayer[GetPlayerId(p)+1]
+    local real actual
+    local real expected=GS177RV_Expected()
+    if hero==null or GetUnitTypeId(hero)!='URa1' then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,12,"레인딜라를 선택한 플레이어가 -레인시야를 입력해 주세요.")
+    else
+        set actual=BlzGetUnitRealField(hero,UNIT_RF_SIGHT_RADIUS)

+function GS191_EmperorRemaining takes unit u returns real
+    local item it=GS191_Emblem(u)
+    local real ends=LoadReal(GS191_Data,GetHandleId(u),1)
+    if it!=null then
+        set ends=RMaxBJ(ends,LoadReal(GS191_Data,GetHandleId(it),1))
+    endif
+    set it=null
+    return RMaxBJ(0.0,ends-GS191_Time())
+endfunction

+    local item it=GS191_Emblem(u)

+        call RemoveSavedReal(GS191_Data,GetHandleId(u),1)
+        if it!=null then
+            call RemoveSavedReal(GS191_Data,GetHandleId(it),1)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set it=null
+endfunction

+function GS192_PromiseStop takes timer t returns nothing
+    local integer key=GetHandleId(t)
+    if t!=null and LoadBoolean(GS192_Data,key,99) then
+        call GS192_PromiseHide(t)
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS192_Data,key)
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GS192_PromiseMove takes timer t returns nothing
+    local integer key=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit caster=LoadUnitHandle(GS192_Data,key,1)
+    local unit target=LoadUnitHandle(GS192_Data,key,2)
+    local unit eye=LoadUnitHandle(GS192_Data,key,3)
+    local integer i=0
+    local boolean share=false
+    if GetUnitTypeId(caster)==0 or GetUnitTypeId(target)==0 or GetWidgetLife(target)<=0.405 then
+        call GS192_PromiseHide(t)
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+    elseif eye!=null and GetUnitTypeId(eye)!=0 then
+        call SetUnitPosition(eye,GetUnitX(target),GetUnitY(target))
+        loop
+            exitwhen i>=12
+            set share=IsPlayerAlly(Player(i),GetOwningPlayer(caster))
+            if share!=LoadBoolean(GS192_Data,key,200+i) then
+                call UnitShareVision(eye,Player(i),share)
+                call SaveBoolean(GS192_Data,key,200+i,share)
+            endif
+            set i=i+1
+        endloop
+    endif
+    set eye=null
+    set target=null
+    set caster=null
+endfunction

+function GSTI_OnSale takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u=GetBuyingUnit()
+    local item it=GetSoldItem()
+    local integer kind=GetItemTypeId(it)
+    local player p=GetOwningPlayer(u)
+    if u!=null and kind!=0 and LoadInteger(GSTI_Data,kind,50)>0 and LoadInteger(GSTI_Data,kind,2)==0 then
+        if GetUnitTypeId(u)=='Odrt' and kind=='IT31' then
+            call RemoveItem(it)
+            call SetPlayerState(p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD,GetPlayerState(p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD)+LoadInteger(GSTI_Data,kind,52))
+            call SetPlayerState(p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER,GetPlayerState(p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER)+LoadInteger(GSTI_Data,kind,53))
+            call GSTI_RestoreStock(kind)
+            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,5,"플레임 블레이더는 레지스턴스 아뮬렛을 사용할 수 없습니다. 비용을 돌려받았습니다.")
+        elseif LoadBoolean(GSTI_Data,kind,51) then
+            call RemoveItem(it)
+            call SetPlayerState(p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD,GetPlayerState(p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD)+LoadInteger(GSTI_Data,kind,52))
+            call SetPlayerState(p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER,GetPlayerState(p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER)+LoadInteger(GSTI_Data,kind,53))
+            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,5,"이미 다른 구매자가 선점한 특성 아이템입니다. 비용을 돌려받았습니다.")
+        else
+            call GSTI_SellOut(kind)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set u=null
+    set it=null
+    set p=null
+endfunction

+endfunction

+function GS180_SightRegister takes unit u returns nothing
+    if GS180_SightHero(u) and not IsUnitInGroup(u,GS180_SightUnits) then
+        call GroupAddUnit(GS180_SightUnits,u)
+        call GS180_SightApply(u,0.0,true)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GS180_SightRevive takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
+    if GS180_SightHero(u) then
+        if not IsUnitInGroup(u,GS180_SightUnits) then
+            call GroupAddUnit(GS180_SightUnits,u)
+        endif
+        call GS180_SightApply(u,0.0,true)
+    endif
+    set u=null
+endfunction
+function GS180_SightTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local real wanted=GS180_SightExpected()
+    local integer i=BlzGroupGetSize(GS180_SightUnits)-1
+    local unit u=null
+    loop
+        exitwhen i<0
+        set u=BlzGroupUnitAt(GS180_SightUnits,i)
+        if not GS180_SightHero(u) then
+            call GroupRemoveUnit(GS180_SightUnits,u)
+        elseif wanted!=GS180_SightBaseline or GetUnitTypeId(u)=='URa1' then
+            call GS180_SightApply(u,GS180_SightBaseline,false)
+        endif
+        set i=i-1
+    endloop
+    set GS180_SightBaseline=wanted
+    set u=null
+endfunction

+endfunction
+function GSCT_Blink takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer aid=GetSpellAbilityId()
+    local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
+    if aid=='A0OB' or aid=='A09M' or aid=='A0LA' or (GetTriggerEventId()==EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT and (aid=='A003' or aid=='A04B' or aid=='A08M' or aid=='A0BU' or aid=='A0FM' or aid=='A0NL' or aid=='A0OU' or aid=='A0PU' or aid=='A0YR' or aid=='A12I' or aid=='AEbl')) then
+        call GSCT_DetachUnit(u)
+        if GSST_Data!=null and GetTriggerEventId()==EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT then
+            call GSST_ReleasePull(u)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set u=null
+endfunction

+function GS181_RainProc takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit caster=LoadUnitHandle(GS181_Rain,k,0)
+    local unit aura=LoadUnitHandle(GS181_Rain,k,1)
+    local player casterOwner=LoadPlayerHandle(GS181_Rain,k,2)
+    local player auraOwner=LoadPlayerHandle(GS181_Rain,k,3)
+    local integer rank=LoadInteger(GS181_Rain,k,4)
+    local boolean allied=LoadBoolean(GS181_Rain,k,5)
+    local boolean shock=LoadBoolean(GS181_Rain,k,6)
+    local real x
+    local real y
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS181_Rain,k)
+    call PauseTimer(t)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    if caster==null then
+        set aura=null
+        set casterOwner=null
+        set auraOwner=null
+        set t=null
+        return
+    endif
+    if GS181_Live(caster) and GetOwningPlayer(caster)==casterOwner then
+        set x=GetUnitX(caster)
+        set y=GetUnitY(caster)
+        if allied then
+            call SetUnitState(caster,UNIT_STATE_MANA,RMinBJ(GetUnitState(caster,UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA),GetUnitState(caster,UNIT_STATE_MANA)+40.0+40.0*I2R(rank)))
+            call GS181_WorldFx("Abilities\\Spells\\Undead\\ReplenishMana\\ReplenishManaCasterOverhead.mdl",x,y,0.75)
+        elseif not IsUnitType(caster,UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) then
+            call SetUnitState(caster,UNIT_STATE_MANA,RMaxBJ(0.0,GetUnitState(caster,UNIT_STATE_MANA)-5.0-5.0*I2R(rank)))
+            if shock and GS181_Live(aura) and GetOwningPlayer(aura)==auraOwner then
+                call GS181_WorldFx("Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\Feedback\\SpellBreakerAttack.mdl",x,y,0.50)
+                call UnitDamageTarget(aura,caster,10.0+10.0*I2R(rank),false,false,ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL,DAMAGE_TYPE_NORMAL,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set caster=null
+    set aura=null
+    set casterOwner=null
+    set auraOwner=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GS181_LeapImpact takes unit h, integer rank, real x, real y returns nothing
+    local player owner=GetOwningPlayer(h)
+    local unit d
+    local rect area=Rect(x-200.0,y-200.0,x+200.0,y+200.0)
+    call EnumDestructablesInRect(area,null,function GS181_LeapKillTree)
+    call RemoveRect(area)
+    if GetPlayerTechCount(owner,'R096',true)>0 then
+        set d=CreateUnit(owner,'ewsp',x,y,0.0)
+        if d!=null then
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(d,'BTLF',4.0)
+            call UnitAddAbility(d,'A0CE')
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(d,'A0CE',rank)
+            call IssueImmediateOrder(d,"stomp")
+        endif
+    endif
+    set d=CreateUnit(owner,'ewsp',x,y,0.0)
+    if d!=null then
+        call UnitApplyTimedLife(d,'BTLF',4.0)
+        call UnitAddAbility(d,'A0BH')
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(d,'A0BH',rank)
+        call IssueImmediateOrder(d,"creepthunderclap")
+    endif
+    call GS181_WorldFx("Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\ThunderClap\\ThunderClapCaster.mdl",x,y,0.75)
+    call GS181_WorldFx("Abilities\\Spells\\Orc\\WarStomp\\WarStompCaster.mdl",x,y,0.75)
+    if GS181_Live(h) and GetPlayerTechCount(owner,'R097',true)>0 and GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'A0AR')>=1 then
+        set udg_Hero_Gla=h
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'B086')==0 then
+            set udg_Hero_Gla_BFLevel=3
+        else
+            set udg_Hero_Gla_BFLevel=IMinBJ(2+2*GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'A0AR'),udg_Hero_Gla_BFLevel+3)
+        endif
+        call TimerStart(udg_Hero_Gla_BFTimer,0.10,false,null)
+    endif
+    set owner=null
+    set d=null
+    set area=null
+endfunction
+function GS2_AuditRangeRegister takes trigger target, real radius, unit anchor returns nothing
+    local integer id = GS2_AuditRangeHead
+    local trigger bridge
+    if anchor == null or target == null then
+        return
+    endif
+    loop
+        exitwhen id == 0
+        if LoadTriggerHandle(GS2_AuditData, id, 2) == target and LoadUnitHandle(GS2_AuditData, id, 3) == anchor and LoadReal(GS2_AuditData, id, 4) == radius then
+            return
+        endif
+        set id = LoadInteger(GS2_AuditData, id, 0)
+    endloop
+    set bridge = CreateTrigger()
+    set id = GetHandleId(bridge)
+    call SaveInteger(GS2_AuditData, id, 0, GS2_AuditRangeHead)
+    call SaveTriggerHandle(GS2_AuditData, id, 1, bridge)
+    call SaveTriggerHandle(GS2_AuditData, id, 2, target)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS2_AuditData, id, 3, anchor)
+    call SaveReal(GS2_AuditData, id, 4, radius)
+    set GS2_AuditRangeHead = id
+    call TriggerRegisterUnitInRange(bridge, anchor, radius, null)
+    call TriggerAddAction(bridge, function GS2_AuditRangeDispatch)
+    set bridge = null
+endfunction
+function GS2_FriendVisualStart takes unit caster, unit friend returns nothing
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(caster)
+    local timer t = CreateTimer()
+    call SaveEffectHandle(GS2_AuditData, id, StringHash("GS2.FriendCasterFX"), AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Orc\\SpiritLink\\SpiritLinkTarget.mdl", caster, "origin"))
+    call SaveEffectHandle(GS2_AuditData, id, StringHash("GS2.FriendTargetFX"), AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Orc\\SpiritLink\\SpiritLinkTarget.mdl", friend, "origin"))
+    call SaveTimerHandle(GS2_AuditData, id, StringHash("GS2.FriendVisualTimer"), t)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS2_AuditData, GetHandleId(t), StringHash("GS2.FriendVisualCaster"), caster)
+    call TimerStart(t, 0.10, true, function GS2_FriendVisualUpdate)
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS2_AuditInit takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = CreateTimer()
+    local timer cleanup = CreateTimer()
+    local trigger damage = CreateTrigger()
+    local integer i = 0
+    set GS2_AuditData = InitHashtable()
+    set GS2_AuditDamageData = InitHashtable()
+    call TimerStart(t, 0.25, true, function GS2_AuditRangeClean)
+    call TimerStart(cleanup, 0.10, true, function GS2_AuditDamageClean)
+    loop
+        exitwhen i > PLAYER_NEUTRAL_PASSIVE
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(damage, Player(i), EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DAMAGED, null)
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(damage, function GS2_AuditDamageDispatch)
+    set t = null
+    set cleanup = null
+    set damage = null
+endfunction

+function GS163_ItemMixCore takes integer index, unit u returns nothing
+    local string DB = udg_ItemMix_DB[index]
+    local string array m
+    local integer x = 1
+    local integer a = 1
+    local boolean MixFail = false
+    local item resultItem = null
+    set m[1] = ""
+    set m[2] = ""
+    set m[3] = ""
+    set m[4] = ""
+    loop
+    exitwhen StringLength(DB) < 4
+    set m[x] = SubStringBJ(DB, 1, 4)
+    set DB = SubStringBJ(DB, 5, StringLength(DB))
+    set x = x + 1
+    endloop
+    loop

+        if CountItem(S2I(SubStringBJ(m[a], 1, 3)),u) > 0 then
+        else
+        set MixFail = true
+        endif
+    else
+        if CountItem(S2I(SubStringBJ(m[a], 1, 3)),u) >= S2I(SubStringBJ(m[a], 4, 4)) then
+        else
+        set MixFail = true
+        endif
+    endif
+    set a = a + 1
+    endloop

+    set a = 1
+    call RemoveMixItem(index,u)
+    loop

+    call RemoveMixItem(S2I(SubStringBJ(m[a], 1, 3)),u)

+function GSTF_FillSlot takes integer i, player p, unit u returns nothing
+    local integer revive = udg_RevivalTimer[udg_SP_Number[GetPlayerId(p) + 1]]
+    local boolean dead = IsUnitType(u, UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) or GetWidgetLife(u) < 0.405 or revive >= 1
+    local integer s = 0
+    local real maxv
+    local string texture=BlzGetAbilityIcon(GetUnitTypeId(u))
+    if GS167_HeroTexture[i]!=texture then
+        call BlzFrameSetTexture(BlzGetFrameByName("GSTF_Icon",i),texture,0,true)
+        set GS167_HeroTexture[i]=texture
+    endif
+    call GSTF_SetText("GSTF_Lvl", i, I2S(GetHeroLevel(u)))
+    loop
+        exitwhen s > 3
+        call GSTF_FillSkill(i, s, u)
+        set s = s + 1
+    endloop
+    call BlzFrameSetVisible(BlzGetFrameByName("GSTF_Dead", i), dead)
+    if dead then
+        call BlzFrameSetVisible(BlzGetFrameByName("GSTF_UltGlow", i), false)
+        if revive >= 1 then
+            call BlzFrameSetText(BlzGetFrameByName("GSTF_DeadTime", i), "|cffff6060" + I2S(revive) + "|r")
+        else
+            call BlzFrameSetText(BlzGetFrameByName("GSTF_DeadTime", i), "")
+        endif
+        call GSTF_SetBar("GSTF_Hp", i, 0.0065, 0)
+        call GSTF_SetBar("GSTF_Mp", i, 0.0055, 0)
+        return
+    endif
+    set maxv = GetUnitState(u, UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE)
+    if maxv > 0 then
+        call GSTF_SetBar("GSTF_Hp", i, 0.0065, GetUnitState(u, UNIT_STATE_LIFE) / maxv)
+    else
+        call GSTF_SetBar("GSTF_Hp", i, 0.0065, 0)
+    endif
+    set maxv = GetUnitState(u, UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA)
+    if maxv > 0 then
+        call GSTF_SetBar("GSTF_Mp", i, 0.0055, GetUnitState(u, UNIT_STATE_MANA) / maxv)
+    else
+        call GSTF_SetBar("GSTF_Mp", i, 0.0055, 0)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GSPF_ModeBlocked takes integer k returns boolean
+    local integer r = GSPF_ModeRival(k)
+    if GSPF_ModeActive(k) then
+        return true
+    endif
+    return r >= 0 and (GSPF_Bit("GSPF_Sel", r) or GSPF_ModeActive(r))
+endfunction
+function GSPF_TryBuy takes player p, integer n returns boolean
+    local integer hid = GSPF_HeroAt(n)
+    local unit shop = GSPF_Shop(GSPF_GroupOf(n))
+    local unit buyer
+    if GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[GetPlayerId(p) + 1]) != 0 or not GSPF_ShopsAlive() then
+        set shop = null
+        return false
+    endif
+    if not GSPF_SideAllowed(GSPF_GroupOf(n), p) or GetPlayerTechMaxAllowed(p, hid) == 0 then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, 6, "|cffff8080" + GetObjectName(hid) + " 은(는) 선택할 수 없습니다|r (이미 선택됨/밴/모드 제한). 다른 영웅을 골라 주세요.")
+        set shop = null
+        return false
+    endif
+    set buyer = CreateUnit(p, 'e003', GetUnitX(shop), GetUnitY(shop) - 64.0, 270.0)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLife(buyer, 'BTLF', 2.0)
+    call IssueNeutralImmediateOrderById(p, shop, hid)
+    set shop = null
+    set buyer = null
+    return true
+endfunction
+function GSPF_BoardTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local player lp = GetLocalPlayer()
+    local integer lpid = GetPlayerId(lp)
+    local framehandle board = BlzGetFrameByName("GSPF_Board", 0)
+    local framehandle b
+    local framehandle cd
+    local integer i = 0
+    local integer k = 0
+    local integer hid
+    local boolean ok
+    local real rem
+    local string s = ""
+    if not GSPF_ShopsAlive() then
+        call BlzFrameSetVisible(board, false)
+        call DestroyTimer(GetExpiredTimer())
+        set board = null
+        set lp = null
+        return
+    endif
+    call BlzFrameSetVisible(board, GSPF_IsUser(lp) and GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[lpid + 1]) == 0 and GSPF_GetState("GSPF_Closed") != "1")
+    if not BlzFrameIsVisible(board) then
+        set board = null
+        set lp = null
+        return
+    endif
+    set rem = 15.5 - TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)
+    set b = BlzGetFrameByName("ScriptDialogButton", 7310)
+    call BlzFrameSetEnable(b, rem <= 0.0 and not udg_RandomRuning)
+    if rem <= 0.0 then
+        call BlzFrameSetText(BlzGetFrameByName("GSPF_BoardTitle", 0), "|cffffcc00영웅 선택|r   |cff999999클릭 = 구매 (200골드)|r")
+        if udg_ModeAllpick then
+            call BlzFrameSetText(b, "|cffffcc00랜덤|r  |cff999999(무료, 양 진영)|r")
+        else
+            call BlzFrameSetText(b, "|cffffcc00랜덤|r  |cff999999(무료)|r")
+        endif
+    else
+        call BlzFrameSetText(BlzGetFrameByName("GSPF_BoardTitle", 0), "|cffffcc00영웅 선택|r   영웅 판매 준비 중 |cffffcc00" + I2S(R2I(rem) + 1) + "초|r")
+        call BlzFrameSetText(b, "|cff808080랜덤  (" + I2S(R2I(rem) + 1) + "초)|r")
+    endif
+    loop
+        exitwhen k > 1
+        if GSPF_SideAllowed(k * 3, lp) then
+            call BlzFrameSetText(BlzGetFrameByName("GSPF_SideLbl", k), GSPF_SideName(k))
+        else
+            call BlzFrameSetText(BlzGetFrameByName("GSPF_SideLbl", k), GSPF_SideName(k) + "  |cff808080(상대 진영 - 올픽일 때만 선택)|r")
+        endif
+        set k = k + 1
+    endloop
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= GSPF_HeroCount()
+        set hid = GSPF_HeroAt(i)
+        set ok = GSPF_SideAllowed(GSPF_GroupOf(i), lp) and GetPlayerTechMaxAllowed(lp, hid) != 0
+        set b = BlzGetFrameByName("ScoreScreenBottomButtonTemplate", 7400 + i)
+        call BlzFrameSetEnable(b, ok and rem <= 0.0)
+        if ok then
+            call BlzFrameSetAlpha(BlzGetFrameByName("ScoreScreenButtonBackdrop", 7400 + i), 255)
+        else
+            call BlzFrameSetAlpha(BlzGetFrameByName("ScoreScreenButtonBackdrop", 7400 + i), 55)
+        endif
+        set cd = BlzGetFrameByName("GSPF_Cd", 7400 + i)
+        if ok and rem > 0.05 then
+            call BlzFrameSetSize(cd, 0.046, 0.046 * RMinBJ(rem / 15.5, 1.0))
+            call BlzFrameSetVisible(cd, true)
+            call BlzFrameSetText(BlzGetFrameByName("GSPF_CdText", 7400 + i), "|cffffffff" + I2S(R2I(rem) + 1) + "|r")
+        else
+            call BlzFrameSetVisible(cd, false)
+            call BlzFrameSetText(BlzGetFrameByName("GSPF_CdText", 7400 + i), "")
+        endif
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    set k = 0
+    loop
+        exitwhen k > 6
+        if GSPF_ModeActive(k) then
+            if s != "" then
+                set s = s + ", "
+            endif
+            set s = s + GSPF_ModeShort(k)
+        endif
+        set k = k + 1
+    endloop
+    if s == "" then
+        set s = "기본"
+    endif
+    set s = "모드: |cffffcc00" + s + "|r     "
+    if udg_ModeRandom then
+        set s = s + "|cffffcc00-랜덤|r 으로만 선택 가능     "
+    elseif udg_Mode3P2R then
+        set s = s + "팀당 3명까지 직접 선택, 나머지는 |cffffcc00-랜덤|r     "
+    else
+        set s = s + "|cffffcc00-랜덤|r 무작위     "
+    endif
+    set s = s + "|cffffcc00-보드|r 다시 열기     상점 마감까지 |cffffcc00" + I2S(R2I(120.0 - TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime))) + "초|r"
+    call BlzFrameSetText(BlzGetFrameByName("GSPF_Hint", 0), s)
+    set b = null
+    set cd = null
+    set board = null
+    set lp = null
+endfunction
+function GS2FB_Transform takes unit oldHero, item essence returns nothing
+    local integer pid = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(oldHero)) + 1
+    local player owner = GetOwningPlayer(oldHero)
+    local integer q = GetUnitAbilityLevel(oldHero, 'A0QN')
+    local integer w = GetUnitAbilityLevel(oldHero, 'A091')
+    local integer e = GetUnitAbilityLevel(oldHero, 'A092')
+    local integer r = GetUnitAbilityLevel(oldHero, 'A0NE')
+    local integer stats = GetUnitAbilityLevel(oldHero, 'A04T')
+    local integer points = GetHeroSkillPoints(oldHero)
+    local unit hero
+    local unit oldTraits
+    local unit controller
+    local group controllers
+    local integer i = 0
+    local integer oldTech
+    local integer newTech
+    local integer refunded = 0
+    local real x = GetUnitX(oldHero)
+    local real y = GetUnitY(oldHero)
+    local real lifeRatio = GetWidgetLife(oldHero) / GetUnitState(oldHero, UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE)
+    local real manaRatio = GetUnitState(oldHero, UNIT_STATE_MANA) / GetUnitState(oldHero, UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA)
+    if r > 3 then
+        set points = points + r - 3
+        set r = 3
+    endif
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= 5
+        if i == 0 then
+            set oldTech = 'R02T'
+            set newTech = 0
+        elseif i == 1 then
+            set oldTech = 'R02S'
+            set newTech = 'RF04'
+        elseif i == 2 then
+            set oldTech = 'R02R'
+            set newTech = 0
+        elseif i == 3 then
+            set oldTech = 'R02Q'
+            set newTech = 'RF02'
+        else
+            set oldTech = 'R02P'
+            set newTech = 0
+        endif
+        if GetPlayerTechCount(owner, oldTech, true) > 0 then
+            if newTech != 0 then
+                call SetPlayerTechResearched(owner, newTech, 1)
+            else
+                set refunded = refunded + 1
+            endif
+            call SetPlayerTechResearched(owner, oldTech, 0)
+        endif
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    if essence != null then
+        call RemoveItem(essence)
+    endif
+    call GSCT_DetachUnit(oldHero)
+    set hero = ReplaceUnitBJ(oldHero, 'OFl1', bj_UNIT_STATE_METHOD_RELATIVE)
+    call GSCT_DetachUnit(hero)
+    if q > 0 then
+        call UnitAddAbility(hero, 'AFq1')
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(hero, 'AFq1', q)
+    endif
+    if w > 0 then
+        call UnitAddAbility(hero, 'AFw1')
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(hero, 'AFw1', w)
+    endif
+    if e > 0 then
+        call UnitAddAbility(hero, 'AFe1')
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(hero, 'AFe1', e)
+    endif
+    if r > 0 then
+        call UnitAddAbility(hero, 'AFr1')
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(hero, 'AFr1', r)
+    endif
+    if stats > 0 then
+        call UnitAddAbility(hero, 'A04T')
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(hero, 'A04T', stats)
+    endif
+    call UnitModifySkillPoints(hero, points - GetHeroSkillPoints(hero))
+    call SetUnitState(hero, UNIT_STATE_LIFE, lifeRatio * GetUnitState(hero, UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE))
+    call SetUnitState(hero, UNIT_STATE_MANA, manaRatio * GetUnitState(hero, UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA))
+    set udg_HeroPlayer[pid] = hero
+    set udg_Hero_ThL = hero
+    call ExecuteFunc("GS2FB_SyncTransferTooltips")
+    set controllers = GetUnitsOfPlayerAndTypeId(owner, 'n00W')
+    set oldTraits = FirstOfGroup(controllers)
+    if oldTraits != null then
+        set controller = ReplaceUnitBJ(oldTraits, 'nFl1', bj_UNIT_STATE_METHOD_MAXIMUM)
+    else
+        set controller = CreateUnit(owner, 'nFl1', x, y, 270.0)
+    endif
+    call DestroyGroup(controllers)
+    if refunded > 0 then
+        call SetPlayerState(owner, PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER, GetPlayerState(owner, PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER) + refunded)
+        call SetPlayerState(owner, PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD, GetPlayerState(owner, PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD) + 300 * refunded)
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(owner, 0, 0, 10, "|cffffcc00불리자드에 없는 기존 특성의 연구 비용과 포인트를 반환했습니다.|r")
+    endif
+    call MultiboardSetItemIconBJ(udg_MB, 1, udg_SP_Number[pid] + 1, "ReplaceableTextures\\CommandButtons\\BTNThunderLizardSalamander.blp")
+    call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\Awaken\\Awaken.mdl", hero, "origin"))
+    call SelectUnitForPlayerSingle(hero, owner)
+    call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(owner, 0, 0, 10, "|cffff8000플레임 비스트로 변신했습니다. Q/W/E/R과 F8 특성을 확인하세요.|r")
+    set owner = null
+    set hero = null
+    set oldTraits = null
+    set controller = null
+    set controllers = null
+endfunction
+function GS2_Ver6_WaterOrder takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit hero = GetOrderedUnit()
+    local location source
+    local location target
+    if hero != udg_Hero_MRG or GetIssuedOrderId() != OrderId("blink") or GetUnitAbilityLevel(hero, 'A0NL') == 0 then
+        set hero = null
+        return
+    endif
+    set source = GetUnitLoc(hero)
+    set target = GetOrderPointLoc()
+    if not GS2_Ver6_WaterReady(source) or not GS2_Ver6_WaterReady(target) then
+        call IssueImmediateOrder(hero, "stop")
+        call DisplayTextToForce(GetForceOfPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(hero)), "|cffffcc00조건이 맞지 않습니다.|r")
+    endif
+    call RemoveLocation(source)
+    call RemoveLocation(target)
+    set source = null
+    set target = null
+    set hero = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_Swap_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    set udg_Sys_SwapHero = udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())]
+    call GS2V84_ForGroupBJOwned(GetUnitsOfPlayerMatching(GetTriggerPlayer(), Condition(function Trig_Swap_Func002001002)), function Trig_Swap_Func002A)
+    set bj_forLoopAIndex = 1
+    set bj_forLoopAIndexEnd = 12
+    loop
+        exitwhen bj_forLoopAIndex > bj_forLoopAIndexEnd
+        if ( Trig_Swap_Func015Func001C() ) then
+            if ( Trig_Swap_Func015Func001Func001C() ) then
+                if ( Trig_Swap_Func015Func001Func001Func001C() ) then
+                    call GS2V84_ForGroupBJOwned(GetUnitsOfPlayerMatching(ConvertedPlayer(GetForLoopIndexA()), Condition(function Trig_Swap_Func015Func001Func001Func001Func005001002)), function Trig_Swap_Func015Func001Func001Func001Func005A)
+                    call SetUnitOwner( udg_Sys_SwapSpecial, ConvertedPlayer(GetForLoopIndexA()), true )
+                    call SetUnitOwner( udg_Sys_SwapHero, ConvertedPlayer(GetForLoopIndexA()), true )
+                    call SetUnitOwner( udg_HeroPlayer[GetForLoopIndexA()], GetTriggerPlayer(), true )
+                    set udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())] = udg_HeroPlayer[GetForLoopIndexA()]
+                    set udg_HeroPlayer[GetForLoopIndexA()] = udg_Sys_SwapHero
+                    if ( Trig_Swap_Func015Func001Func001Func001Func011C() ) then
+                        call SetPlayerName( ConvertedPlayer(GetForLoopIndexA()), GetHeroProperName(udg_HeroPlayer[GetForLoopIndexA()]) )
+                        call SetPlayerName( GetTriggerPlayer(), GetHeroProperName(udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())]) )
+                        call MultiboardSetItemValueBJ( udg_MB, 1, ( udg_SP_Number[GetForLoopIndexA()] + 1 ), ( ( udg_Colors[udg_SP_Number[GetForLoopIndexA()]] + GetPlayerName(ConvertedPlayer(GetForLoopIndexA())) ) + "|r" ) )
+                        call MultiboardSetItemValueBJ( udg_MB, 1, ( udg_SP_Number[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())] + 1 ), ( ( udg_Colors[udg_SP_Number[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())]] + GetPlayerName(GetTriggerPlayer()) ) + "|r" ) )
+                    else
+                    endif
+                    set udg_Sys_SwapNumber[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())] = 0
+                    set udg_Sys_SwapNumber[GetForLoopIndexA()] = 0
+                    call GS2V84_ForGroupBJOwned(GetUnitsOfTypeIdAll('e01B'), function Trig_Swap_Func015Func001Func001Func001Func015A)
+                    call GS2V84_ForGroupBJOwned(GetUnitsOfTypeIdAll('e01S'), function Trig_Swap_Func015Func001Func001Func001Func016A)
+                    call GS2V84_ForGroupBJOwned(GetUnitsOfTypeIdAll('e02A'), function Trig_Swap_Func015Func001Func001Func001Func017A)
+                    call GS2V84_ForGroupBJOwned(GetUnitsOfTypeIdAll('e02K'), function Trig_Swap_Func015Func001Func001Func001Func018A)
+                    set bj_forLoopBIndex = 1
+                    set bj_forLoopBIndexEnd = udg_HeroMax[3]
+                    loop
+                        exitwhen bj_forLoopBIndex > bj_forLoopBIndexEnd
+                        if ( Trig_Swap_Func015Func001Func001Func001Func020Func001C() ) then
+                            call MultiboardSetItemIconBJ( GetLastCreatedMultiboard(), 1, ( udg_SP_Number[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())] + 1 ), udg_HeroIcon[GetForLoopIndexB()] )
+                        else
+                        endif
+                        if ( Trig_Swap_Func015Func001Func001Func001Func020Func002C() ) then
+                            call MultiboardSetItemIconBJ( GetLastCreatedMultiboard(), 1, ( udg_SP_Number[GetForLoopIndexA()] + 1 ), udg_HeroIcon[GetForLoopIndexB()] )
+                        else
+                        endif
+                        set bj_forLoopBIndex = bj_forLoopBIndex + 1
+                    endloop
+                else
+                    call DisplayTimedTextToForce( GetForceOfPlayer(ConvertedPlayer(GetForLoopIndexA())), 8.00, "조건이 맞지 않아 교환이 취소되었습니다." )
+                    call DisplayTimedTextToForce( GetForceOfPlayer(GetTriggerPlayer()), 8.00, "조건이 맞지 않아 교환이 취소되었습니다." )
+                endif
+            else
+                set udg_Sys_SwapNumber[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())] = GetForLoopIndexA()
+                call DisplayTimedTextToForce( GetForceOfPlayer(ConvertedPlayer(GetForLoopIndexA())), 8.00, ( ( ( GetPlayerName(GetTriggerPlayer()) + "(" ) + GetUnitName(udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())]) ) + ")님께서 당신에게 영웅 교환을 신청하셨습니다." ) )
+            endif
+        else
+        endif
+        set bj_forLoopAIndex = bj_forLoopAIndex + 1
+    endloop
+endfunction

+function GS117_ResetUnitCooldowns takes unit u returns nothing
+    local integer i = 1
+    local integer aid
+    local timer t
+    call GS191_EmperorExternalReset(u)
+    call UnitResetCooldown(u)
+    if GS117_Data != null then
+        loop
+            exitwhen i > 7
+            if i == 1 then
+                set aid = 'A0G4'
+            elseif i == 2 then
+                set aid = 'A09P'
+            elseif i == 3 then
+                set aid = 'A0AK'
+            elseif i == 4 then
+                set aid = 'A02B'
+            elseif i == 5 then
+                set aid = 'A0HX'
+            elseif i == 6 then
+                set aid = 'A0BW'
+            else
+                set aid = 'A0EA'
+            endif
+            set t = LoadTimerHandle(GS117_Data, GetHandleId(u), aid)
+            if t != null then
+                call SaveReal(GS117_Data, GetHandleId(t), 2, TimerGetElapsed(GS117_Clock))
+            endif
+            set i = i + 1
+        endloop
+    endif
+    set t = null
+endfunction
