+function GS163_SpawnDummy takes player p, string name, boolean allied, boolean maxed returns nothing
+    local integer n=1
+    local integer side=13
+    local integer k=0
+    local boolean same=false
+    local unit u=null
+    if name=="" then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,5,"영웅 이름을 입력하세요. 예: -만렙 마네킹 켈후")
+        return
+    endif
+    if IsPlayerAlly(p,udg_Force[1])==allied then
+        set side=12
+    endif
+    loop
+        exitwhen k>=12
+        if side==12 then
+            set same=IsPlayerAlly(Player(k),udg_Force[1])
+        else
+            set same=IsPlayerAlly(Player(k),udg_Force[2])
+        endif
+        call SetPlayerAlliance(Player(side),Player(k),ALLIANCE_PASSIVE,same)
+        call SetPlayerAlliance(Player(k),Player(side),ALLIANCE_PASSIVE,same)
+        set k=k+1
+    endloop
+    loop
+        exitwhen n>udg_HeroMax[3]
+        if SubString(udg_HeroName[n],0,StringLength(name))==name then
+            set u=CreateUnit(Player(side),udg_Hero[n],GetRectCenterX(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea),GetRectCenterY(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea),270)
+            if allied then
+                call GS180_GrantDummyControl(p,side)
+            endif
+            if GS177_RoroTargets==null then
+                set GS177_RoroTargets=CreateGroup()
+            endif
+            call GroupAddUnit(GS177_RoroTargets,u)
+            call GS2_AuditDamageSubscribe(gg_trg_DamageTaken,u)
+            if maxed then
+                call SetHeroLevel(u,20,false)
+                call GS163_MaxSkills(u)
+            else
+                call AddHeroXP(u,3000,false)
+            endif
+            call SetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_LIFE,GetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE))
+            call SetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_MANA,GetUnitState(u,UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA))
+            set u=null
+            return
+        endif
+        set n=n+1
+    endloop
+    call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,5,"일치하는 영웅이 없습니다. 영웅 이름의 앞부분을 입력하세요.")
+endfunction

+    local integer rand = GetRandomInt( 1 , 100 )
+    local integer chance = 15 // 발동 확률
+    call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B03V', GetTriggerUnit() )
+    if IsUnitType(GetTriggerUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_SUMMONED) then
+    call d_effect(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ(),0.5)
+    elseif ( rand <= chance ) then
+    call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetEventDamageSource()), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A08A', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "purge", GetTriggerUnit() )
+    endif
+endfunction

+        call d_effect(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ(),0.5)

+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A06F', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "chainlightning", GetTriggerUnit() )
+        endif
+        return
+    else
+        if ( Trig_Battle_Fury_AtkDmg_Func004Func001C() ) then
+            if IsUnitType(GetTriggerUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_SUMMONED) then
+            call d_effect(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ(),0.5)
+            elseif ( rand <= chance ) then
+            call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetEventDamageSource()), GetUnitLoc(GetEventDamageSource()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0XL', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "chainlightning", GetTriggerUnit() )

+        else
+        endif
+    endif

+function Trig_Hisasin_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit target = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit dummy = null
+    if target != null then
+        call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("war3mapImported\\BlinkTarget.mdx", GetUnitX(target), GetUnitY(target)))
+        set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'ewsp', GetUnitX(caster), GetUnitY(caster), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 3.00)
+        call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'A0WK')
+        call UnitDamageTargetBJ(dummy, target, 200.00, ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_DISEASE)
+        call IssueTargetOrder(dummy, "faeriefire", target)
+        call GS115_DeferItem(caster, target, 'A0A0')
+    endif
+    set dummy = null
+    set caster = null
+    set target = null
+endfunction

+    endif

+        call GS2V84_ForGroupBJOwned(GetUnitsInRectMatching(GetPlayableMapRect(), Condition(function Trig_AnT_Skill_Effect_Func003Func003001002)), function Trig_AnT_Skill_Effect_Func003Func003A)
+    else
+    endif

+        set udg_Hero_AnT_Loc = GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit())
+        call CreateNUnitsAtLoc( 1, 'e03B', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), udg_Hero_AnT_Loc, bj_UNIT_FACING )

+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_AnT_Skill_Effect_Func005C() ) then
+        call TriggerSleepAction( 1.50 )
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0W0', a, ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0RW', a) + 1 ) )
+    else
+    endif
+endfunction

+function Trig_Holy_Smash_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit target=GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local unit dummy=null
+    local player owner=null
+    local integer rand=GetRandomInt(1,100)
+    local integer chance=50
+    local real x=0.0
+    local real y=0.0
+    if GSST_Exists(caster) then
+        set owner=GetOwningPlayer(caster)
+        set chance=IMaxBJ(50,GetPlayerTechCount(owner,'R036',true)*200)
+    endif
+    if chance>rand and GSST_Exists(caster) and GSST_Exists(target) then
+        set x=GetUnitX(target)
+        set y=GetUnitY(target)
+        if GSCT_Number(x) and GSCT_Number(y) then
+            set dummy=CreateUnit(owner,'ewsp',x,y,270.0)
+            if GSST_Live(dummy) then
+                call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy,'BTLF',1.0)
+                if GSST_Live(dummy) then
+                    call UnitAddAbility(dummy,'A108')
+                    if GSST_Live(dummy) and GetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy,'A108')>0 then
+                        call IssueImmediateOrder(dummy,"stomp")
+                    endif
+                endif
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set owner=null
+    set dummy=null
+    set target=null
+    set caster=null
+endfunction

+function Trig_Divine_Strike_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local real angle = GetUnitFacing(GetSpellTargetUnit())
+    local timer t = CreateTimer()
+    local unit u = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local integer LoopX = 1
+    call PlaySoundBJ( gg_snd_HeroPaladinYesAttack3 )
+    call PolledWait( 0.15 )
+    call PauseUnitBJ( true, GetTriggerUnit() )
+    call PolledWait( 0.15 )
+    call PauseUnitBJ( false, GetTriggerUnit() )
+    if GS2V84_DistanceBetweenPointsUnits(GetTriggerUnit(), u) < 1600.00 then
+    call GS2V84_SetUnitPositionLocFacingBJ_1(GetTriggerUnit(), GS2V84_PolarProjectionBJ_0(GetUnitLoc(u), 100.00, GetUnitFacing(u)), ( GetUnitFacing(u) + 180.00 ))
+    endif
+    call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetTriggerUnit(), "attack", u )
+    call UnitDamageTargetBJ( GetTriggerUnit(), u, ( 125.00 + ( I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0DQ', GetTriggerUnit())) * 125.00 ) ), ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC )
+    call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", u, "LightStrikeArray.mdx" )
+    call d_effect(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ(),1.5)
+    call SaveUnitHandleBJ( u, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("CruTgt"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
+    call SaveIntegerBJ( 0, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("CruIndex"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
+    call SaveRealBJ( angle, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("CruAngle"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
+    if ( Trig_Divine_Strike_Func001C() ) then
+        call UnitDamageTargetBJ( GetTriggerUnit(), u, ( 31.25 + ( I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0DQ', GetTriggerUnit())) * 31.25 ) ), ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC )
+        call SetUnitLifeBJ( GetTriggerUnit(), ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE, GetTriggerUnit()) - 100.00 ) )
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", u, "Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\Resurrect\\ResurrectCaster.mdl" )
+        call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+    endif
+    call TimerStart(t, 0.05, true, function Trig_Divine_Strike_Sub)
+endfunction

+            call SetUnitAnimation( udg_Hero_DaW_UltiCaster, "attack slam" )
+            call SetUnitTimeScalePercent( udg_Hero_DaW_UltiCaster, 170.00 )
+            call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitFacingUnitBJ( 1, 'o00J', GetOwningPlayer(GetSpellAbilityUnit()), udg_Hero_DaW_UltiCaster, udg_Hero_DaW_UltiTarget )
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 0.20, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call SetUnitTimeScalePercent( GetLastCreatedUnit(), 250.00 )
+            call SetUnitVertexColorBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), 100, 0.00, 0.00, 75.00 )
+            call SetUnitAnimation( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "attack slam" )
+        else
+        endif
+        call GS2_PlaySoundAtUnitBJ( gg_snd_BuildingDeathLargeHuman, 100, udg_Hero_DaW_UltiCaster, 500.00 )
+        call TriggerSleepAction( 0.00 )
+        if ( Trig_Moon_Strike_Execute_Func003Func004C() ) then

+function Trig_Mass_Teleport_Func005Func001C takes nothing returns boolean
+    if ( not ( UnitHasBuffBJ(GetEnumUnit(), 'B03K') == false ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( IsUnitType(GetEnumUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_HERO) == true ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( GetEnumUnit() != GetTriggerUnit() ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( GS178_Participant(GetOwningPlayer(GetEnumUnit())) ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( IsUnitAlly(GetEnumUnit(), GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit())) == true ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if ( not ( GS2V84_DistanceBetweenPointsUnits(GetTriggerUnit(), GetEnumUnit()) <= 800.00 ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    return true
+endfunction

+    call d_effect(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ(),1)

+function GSAMB_AmbushTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GSAMB_AmbushActive and not GSAMB_AmbushValid() then
+        call GSAMB_AmbushEnd(false)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GSAMB_AmbushDeath takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GetDyingUnit()==GSAMB_AmbushCaster or GetDyingUnit()==GSAMB_AmbushPendingCaster then
+        call GSAMB_AmbushEnd(true)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function InitTrig_Ambush takes nothing returns nothing
+    set gg_trg_Ambush = CreateTrigger(  )
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ( gg_trg_Ambush, EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT )
+    call TriggerAddCondition( gg_trg_Ambush, Condition( function Trig_Ambush_Conditions ) )

+function Trig_Ambush_Buff_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    if not GSAMB_AmbushValid() then
+        call GSAMB_AmbushEnd(false)
+        return
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_Ambush_Buff_Func002C() ) then
+        set udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuStun = IMinBJ(3, ( udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuStun + 1 ))
+        call TextTagForce( ( "매복 보너스 + " + I2S(udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuStun) ), udg_Hero_DrR , 10 , 255 , 255 , 150, 3, GetForceOfPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_DrR)) )
+    else
+    endif
+    if GSAMB_AmbushPendingCaster==GSAMB_AmbushCaster and TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)<GSAMB_AmbushHitDeadline then
+        set GSAMB_AmbushPendingStacks=udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuStun
+    endif
+    call StartTimerBJ( udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuLevel, false, ( 4.50 - ( 0.50 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0G4', udg_Hero_DrR)) ) ) )
+endfunction
+function Trig_Ambush_Skill_Remove_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    call GSAMB_AmbushEnd(true)
+endfunction
+function Trig_Ambush_Atk_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    if Trig_Ambush_Atk_Func001C() then
+        set GSAMB_AmbushPendingCaster=GetAttacker()
+        set GSAMB_AmbushPendingStacks=udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuStun
+        set udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuAttacker=GetAttackedUnitBJ()
+        set GSAMB_AmbushHitDeadline=TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)+2.0
+        call StartTimerBJ(udg_Hero_DrR_AmbuAtk,false,2.0)
+    else
+        call GSAMB_AmbushEnd(true)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function Trig_Ambush_AtkTimer_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    call GSAMB_AmbushClearHit()
+    if not GSAMB_AmbushValid() then
+        call GSAMB_AmbushEnd(true)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function Trig_Ambush_Dmg_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetEventDamageSource()
+    local unit target = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer stacks = GSAMB_AmbushPendingStacks
+    local integer level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster, 'A0G4')
+    local boolean talent = GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R099', GetOwningPlayer(caster)) == 1
+    local unit dummy=null
+    if not Trig_Ambush_Dmg_Conditions() then
+        set caster=null
+        set target=null
+        return
+    endif
+    call DisableTrigger(gg_trg_Ambush_Dmg)
+    call GSAMB_AmbushEnd(true)
+    set dummy=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'ewsp', GetUnitX(target), GetUnitY(target), 0.00)
+    call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'A0LI')
+    if not talent then
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, 'A0LI', stacks)
+    endif
+    call IssueTargetOrder(dummy, "thunderbolt", target)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 1.00)
+    if talent then
+        call UnitDamageTargetBJ(caster, target, I2R(stacks) * (25.00 + 15.00 * I2R(level)), ATTACK_TYPE_HERO, DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL)
+        call TextTagForce("앰버쉬 : " + I2S(R2I(I2R(stacks) * (25.00 + 15.00 * I2R(level)))) + "!!", target, 10, 255, 255, 150, 3, GetPlayersAll())
+    else
+        call TextTagForce("앰버쉬 : " + I2S(stacks) + "초 스턴", target, 10, 255, 255, 150, 3, GetPlayersAll())
+    endif
+    call EnableTrigger(gg_trg_Ambush_Dmg)
+    set caster = null
+    set target = null
+    set dummy = null
+endfunction
+function Trig_Call_Hippo_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", GetTriggerUnit(), "Abilities\\Spells\\Orc\\FeralSpirit\\feralspirittarget.mdl" )
+    call d_effect(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ(),1)
+    call PlaySoundBJ( gg_snd_ArcherWarcry1 )
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A050', GetTriggerUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0HT', GetTriggerUnit()) )
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A14G', GetTriggerUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0HT', GetTriggerUnit()) )
+    if ( Trig_Call_Hippo_Func006C() ) then
+        call DisableTrigger( gg_trg_Battle_Reflex_Lost )
+        set udg_Hero_DrR_ReflexCount = 4
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A14A', udg_Hero_DrR, ( ( ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0FR', udg_Hero_DrR) - 1 ) * 4 ) + ( udg_Hero_DrR_ReflexCount + 1 ) ) )
+        if ( Trig_Call_Hippo_Func006Func005C() ) then
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A12J', GetTriggerUnit(), ( udg_Hero_DrR_ReflexCount + 1 ) )
+        else
+        endif
+    else
+    endif
+    call PolledWait( ( 12.00 + ( 6.00 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0HT', GetTriggerUnit())) ) ) )
+    if ( Trig_Call_Hippo_Func008C() ) then
+        call EnableTrigger( gg_trg_Battle_Reflex_Lost )
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_Call_Hippo_Func009C() ) then
+        call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B06O', GetTriggerUnit() )
+        call GS2V84_AddSpecialEffectLocBJ_0(GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), "Abilities\\Spells\\Orc\\FeralSpirit\\feralspirittarget.mdl")
+        call d_effect(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ(),1)
+    else
+    endif
+endfunction
+function Trig_Blow_Bomb_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit dummy = null
+    local real face = GetUnitFacing(caster)
+    local real sx = GetUnitX(caster) + 5.00*Cos(face*bj_DEGTORAD)
+    local real sy = GetUnitY(caster) + 5.00*Sin(face*bj_DEGTORAD)
+    local real backAng = Atan2(GetUnitY(caster)-sy, GetUnitX(caster)-sx)*bj_RADTODEG
+    set dummy = CreateUnit(GetTriggerPlayer(), 'ewsp', sx, sy, backAng)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', dummy )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0LT', dummy )
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0LT', dummy, ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A00N', caster) + ( 4 * GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R0AR', GetOwningPlayer(caster)) ) ) )
+    call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( dummy, "thunderclap" )
+    set dummy = CreateUnit(GetTriggerPlayer(), 'ewsp', sx, sy, backAng)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', dummy )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0EQ', dummy )
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0EQ', dummy, ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A00N', caster) + ( 4 * GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R0AR', GetOwningPlayer(caster)) ) ) )
+    call IssuePointOrder(dummy, "silence", GetUnitX(caster), GetUnitY(caster))
+    call Knockback(caster, backAng, 300, 700)
+    if ( GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R0AR', GetOwningPlayer(caster)) == 1 ) then
+       set dummy = CreateUnit(GetTriggerPlayer(), 'ewsp', sx, sy, backAng)
+       call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', dummy )
+       call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0P2', dummy )
+       call IssueTargetOrderBJ( dummy, "bloodlust", caster )
+    endif
+    set dummy = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction

+    endif

+function Trig_Avartar_Active_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "chest", GetTriggerUnit(), "Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\Avatar\\AvatarCaster.mdl" )
+    call d_effect(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ(),1)
+    if ( Trig_Avartar_Active_Func003C() ) then
+        call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3( 1, 'e016', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetPlayerStartLocationLoc(GetTriggerPlayer()), bj_UNIT_FACING )
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( ( 5.00 + ( 2.00 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A11H', GetSpellAbilityUnit())) ) ), 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'S00C', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    else
+    endif
+    set bj_forLoopAIndex = 1
+    set bj_forLoopAIndexEnd = 8
+    loop
+        exitwhen bj_forLoopAIndex > bj_forLoopAIndexEnd
+        call SetUnitScalePercent( GetTriggerUnit(), ( 110.00 + ( 5.00 * I2R(GetForLoopIndexA()) ) ), ( 110.00 + ( 5.00 * I2R(GetForLoopIndexA()) ) ), ( 110.00 + ( 5.00 * I2R(GetForLoopIndexA()) ) ) )
+        call PolledWait( 0.03 )
+        set bj_forLoopAIndex = bj_forLoopAIndex + 1
+    endloop
+endfunction

+function Trig_Fire_Wave_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    set udg_Hero_ElD_FireWaveOn = true
+    set udg_Hero_ElD_FireWaveHeroLoc = GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit())
+    if ( Trig_Fire_Wave_Func003C() ) then
+        set udg_Hero_ElD_FireWaveLoc = GetUnitLoc(GetSpellTargetUnit())
+    else
+        set udg_Hero_ElD_FireWaveLoc = GetSpellTargetLoc()
+    endif
+    call PolledWait( 0.10 )
+    if ( Trig_Fire_Wave_Func005C() ) then
+        call CreateNUnitsAtLoc( 1, 'e00F', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), udg_Hero_ElD_FireWaveHeroLoc, bj_UNIT_FACING )
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A06W', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A06W', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A06V', GetTriggerUnit()) )
+        call IssuePointOrderLocBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "shockwave", udg_Hero_ElD_FireWaveLoc )
+    else
+        return
+    endif
+    call PolledWait( ( 0.80 - ( 0.20 * I2R(GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R01Y', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))) ) ) )
+    if ( Trig_Fire_Wave_Func007C() ) then
+        call CreateNUnitsAtLoc( 1, 'e00F', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), udg_Hero_ElD_FireWaveHeroLoc, bj_UNIT_FACING )
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A06W', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A06W', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A06V', GetTriggerUnit()) )
+        call IssuePointOrderLocBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "shockwave", udg_Hero_ElD_FireWaveLoc )
+    else
+        return
+    endif
+    call PolledWait( ( 0.80 - ( 0.20 * I2R(GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R01Y', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))) ) ) )
+    if ( Trig_Fire_Wave_Func009C() ) then
+        call CreateNUnitsAtLoc( 1, 'e00F', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), udg_Hero_ElD_FireWaveHeroLoc, bj_UNIT_FACING )
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A06W', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A06W', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A06V', GetTriggerUnit()) )
+        call IssuePointOrderLocBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "shockwave", udg_Hero_ElD_FireWaveLoc )
+    else
+        return
+    endif
+    call PolledWait( ( 0.80 - ( 0.20 * I2R(GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R01Y', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))) ) ) )
+    if ( Trig_Fire_Wave_Func011C() ) then
+        call CreateNUnitsAtLoc( 1, 'e00F', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), udg_Hero_ElD_FireWaveHeroLoc, bj_UNIT_FACING )
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A06W', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A06W', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A06V', GetTriggerUnit()) )
+        call IssuePointOrderLocBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "shockwave", udg_Hero_ElD_FireWaveLoc )
+    else
+        return
+    endif
+endfunction

+function GSST_TornadoEnd takes timer t returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit d=null
+    local group busy=null
+    if GSST_TornadoActive(t) then
+        call SaveBoolean(GSST_Data,k,0,false)
+        set d=LoadUnitHandle(GSST_Data,k,2)
+        set busy=LoadGroupHandle(GSST_Data,k,4)
+        if d!=null and LoadTimerHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(d),200)==t then
+            call RemoveSavedHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(d),200)
+        endif
+        call GSST_ReleaseOwnedPull(t)
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GSST_Data,k)
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+        if busy!=null then
+            call DestroyGroup(busy)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set d=null
+    set busy=null
+endfunction
+function GSST_TornadoEligible takes timer t, unit v returns boolean
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit h=null
+    local unit d=null
+    local group busy=null
+    local boolean valid=false
+    if GSST_TornadoActive(t) and GSST_Live(v) then
+        set h=LoadUnitHandle(GSST_Data,k,1)
+        set d=LoadUnitHandle(GSST_Data,k,2)
+        set busy=LoadGroupHandle(GSST_Data,k,4)
+        set valid=GSST_Live(h) and GSST_Live(d) and v!=h and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(v) and not IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) and not IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL) and not IsUnitInGroup(v,busy)
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set d=null
+    set busy=null
+    return valid
+endfunction

+    call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )

+        call PolledWait( 1.00 )

+        call UnitRemoveAbilityBJ( 'Arav', gs2EvtTarget )
+        call SetUnitFlyHeightBJ( gs2EvtTarget, 2000.00, 4000.00 )
+        call SetUnitFlyHeightBJ( gs2EvtTarget, 2000.00, 4000.00 )
+        call PolledWait( 1.00 )
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "chest", gs2EvtTarget, "Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\CrushingWave\\CrushingWaveDamage.mdl" )
+        call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+        call SetUnitFlyHeightBJ( gs2EvtTarget, 0.00, 4000.00 )
+        call SetUnitFlyHeightBJ( gs2EvtTarget, 0.00, 4000.00 )
+    endif
+    call SetUnitPathing( gs2EvtTarget, true )
+    call PolledWait( 0.20 )
+    call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", gs2EvtTarget, "Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\CrushingWave\\CrushingWaveDamage.mdl" )
+    call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+    call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "chest", gs2EvtTarget, "Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\CrushingWave\\CrushingWaveDamage.mdl" )
+    call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+    call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "head", gs2EvtTarget, "Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\CrushingWave\\CrushingWaveDamage.mdl" )
+    call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+endfunction

+function Trig_Shock_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit d=null
+    local integer level=GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'A0VQ')
+    local real x=GetSpellTargetX()
+    local real y=GetSpellTargetY()
+    set udg_Hero_Ele=h
+    if GSST_Live(h) and level>=1 and level<=4 and GSCT_Number(x) and GSCT_Number(y) then
+        set d=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'e023',x,y,bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        if d!=null then
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(d,'BTLF',2.0)
+            if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'R08D',true)==1 then
+                set level=level+4
+            endif
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(d,'A13R',level)
+            call IssueImmediateOrder(d,"stomp")
+        endif
+    endif
+    set udg_Hero_Ele_Int=udg_Hero_Ele_Int-3
+    call TextTagForce(I2S(udg_Hero_Ele_Int),h,10,45,143,38,3,GetForceOfPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(h)))
+    set h=null
+    set d=null
+endfunction

+function GSST_RocketExtra takes unit h, unit v, integer aid, integer level returns nothing
+    local unit d=null
+    if GSST_Live(h) and GSST_Live(v) and level>=1 and level<=4 and GSCT_Number(GetUnitX(h)) and GSCT_Number(GetUnitY(h)) then
+        set d=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'ewsp',GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        if d!=null then
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(d,'BTLF',3.0)
+            call UnitAddAbility(d,aid)
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(d,aid,level)
+            if GSST_Live(h) and GSST_Live(v) and GSST_Exists(d) then
+                call IssueTargetOrder(d,"thunderbolt",v)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set d=null
+endfunction

+function Trig_Pocket_Bomber_Actions takes nothing returns nothing

+    if GSST_Live(u) and LoadTimerHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(u),301)==null then
+        call SetUnitVertexColorBJ(u,100,100,100,50.0)
+        if Trig_Pocket_Bomber_Func004C() then
+            call TextTag("Made In China",u,10,255,255,150,3)

+            set duration=1.50
+        endif
+        set t=CreateTimer()

+        call SaveTimerHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(u),301,t)
+        call SaveBoolean(GSST_Data,k,310,true)
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GSST_Data,k,311,u)
+        call TimerStart(t,duration,false,function GSST_BomberExpire)
+    endif
+    set t=null
+    set u=null
+endfunction

+function Trig_GoT_Special_1_Conditions takes nothing returns boolean
+    if ( not ( GetSpellAbilityId() == 'A0NB' ) ) then
+        return false
+    endif

+        return false
+    endif

+        return false
+    endif
+    return GSST_Live(GetTriggerUnit()) and GSST_Live(GetSpellTargetUnit()) and GSST_RocketTraitReady(GetTriggerUnit())
+endfunction

+function Trig_GoT_Special_3_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer rand = GetRandomInt(1, 100)
+    local integer chance

+    if ( rand > chance ) then
+    call AbsoluteDamage(GetTriggerUnit(),t, 99999)

+    call DestroyLightning(l)
+    else
+    call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'e00Q', GetOwningPlayer(GetSpellTargetUnit()), GetUnitLoc(GetSpellTargetUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )

+function GS146_Protect takes unit caster, integer level returns nothing
+    local group scan
+    local timer t
+    local unit u
+    local sound audio
+    local effect e
+    local integer uid
+    local integer key
+    local integer n=0
+    if caster==null or GetUnitTypeId(caster)==0 or level<1 or level>3 then
+        return
+    endif
+    if GS146_Data==null then
+        set GS146_Data=InitHashtable()
+    endif
+    set scan=CreateGroup()
+    set t=CreateTimer()
+    if scan==null or t==null then
+        if scan!=null then
+            call DestroyGroup(scan)
+        endif
+        if t!=null then
+            call DestroyTimer(t)
+        endif
+        set scan=null
+        set t=null
+        return
+    endif
+    set key=GetHandleId(t)
+    call SaveGroupHandle(GS146_Data,key,5,scan)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS146_Data,key,4,true)
+    call TimerStart(t,I2R(level+1),false,function GS146_Expire)
+    call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(scan,GetUnitX(caster),GetUnitY(caster),800.0,null)
+    set u=FirstOfGroup(scan)
+    loop
+        exitwhen u==null
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(scan,u)
+        if GetUnitTypeId(u)!=0 and IsUnitAlly(u,GetOwningPlayer(caster)) and GetWidgetLife(u)>0.405 and not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL) and not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and GetUnitTypeId(u)!='ewsp' and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'Aloc')==0 then
+            set uid=GetHandleId(u)
+            call SaveUnitHandle(GS146_Data,key,100+n,u)
+            set n=n+1
+            call SaveInteger(GS146_Data,key,6,n)
+            call SaveInteger(GS146_Data,uid,1,LoadInteger(GS146_Data,uid,1)+1)
+            call GS190_InvulnerabilityBegin(u)
+            if not LoadBoolean(GS146_Data,uid,1901) then
+                call UnitMakeAbilityPermanent(u,true,'Avul')
+            endif
+            if LoadInteger(GS146_Data,uid,1)==1 then
+                set e=GS191_ShieldVisual(u)
+                if e!=null then
+                    call SaveEffectHandle(GS146_Data,uid,2,e)
+                endif
+            endif
+        endif
+        set u=FirstOfGroup(scan)
+    endloop
+    call RemoveSavedHandle(GS146_Data,key,5)
+    call DestroyGroup(scan)
+    set audio=CreateSound("Abilities\\Spells\\Orc\\Voodoo\\BigBadVoodooSpellBirth1.wav",true,true,true,10,10,"SpellsEAX")
+    if audio!=null then
+        call SaveSoundHandle(GS146_Data,key,3,audio)
+        call SetSoundVolume(audio,70)
+        call SetSoundChannel(audio,0)
+        call SetSoundDistances(audio,600.0,2000.0)
+        call SetSoundDistanceCutoff(audio,2500.0)
+        call SetSoundPosition(audio,GetUnitX(caster),GetUnitY(caster),50.0)
+        call StartSound(audio)
+    endif
+    set e=null
+    set audio=null
+    set u=null
+    set scan=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction

+function GS184_MonkMove takes unit h, real x, real y, timer cast returns boolean
+    if not GSST_Live(h) or not GSCT_Number(x) or not GSCT_Number(y) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if cast!=null and not GS184_AsuraCurrent(cast) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    if GSCT_State!=null and LoadBoolean(GSCT_State,GetHandleId(h),1) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    set x=RMaxBJ(GetRectMinX(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)+16.0,RMinBJ(GetRectMaxX(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)-16.0,x))
+    set y=RMaxBJ(GetRectMinY(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)+16.0,RMinBJ(GetRectMaxY(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)-16.0,y))
+    call GSCT_DetachUnit(h)
+    if not GSST_Live(h) or (cast!=null and not GS184_AsuraCurrent(cast)) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    call GSST_ReleasePull(h)
+    if not GSST_Live(h) or (cast!=null and not GS184_AsuraCurrent(cast)) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    call SetUnitPosition(h,x,y)
+    return GSST_Live(h) and (cast==null or GS184_AsuraCurrent(cast))
+endfunction
+function GS184_AsuraValid takes timer t returns boolean
+    local unit h=null
+    local unit v=null
+    local boolean valid=false
+    if t==null or GS184_MonkData==null then
+        return false
+    endif
+    set h=LoadUnitHandle(GS184_MonkData,GetHandleId(t),1)
+    set v=LoadUnitHandle(GS184_MonkData,GetHandleId(t),2)
+    set valid=GS184_AsuraCurrent(t) and GSST_Live(h) and GSST_Live(v)
+    if valid then
+        set valid=GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(h))==LoadInteger(GS184_MonkData,GetHandleId(t),3) and IsUnitEnemy(v,GetOwningPlayer(h)) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(v) and not IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE)
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set v=null
+    return valid
+endfunction

+function Trig_PaW_Skill_Effect_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    if ( Trig_PaW_Skill_Effect_Func001C() ) then
+        call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 4.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0H5', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_PaW_Skill_Effect_Func002C() ) then
+        call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 4.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0IM', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0IM', GetLastCreatedUnit(), ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped(GetSpellAbilityId(), GetTriggerUnit()) + ( GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R0AC', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit())) * 4 ) ) )
+        call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "acidbomb", GetSpellTargetUnit() )
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_PaW_Skill_Effect_Func003C() ) then
+        call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'e03L', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), GS2V84_AngleBetweenPointsUnits(GetTriggerUnit(), GetLastCreatedUnit()))
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 0.50, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call GS2V84_IssuePointOrderLocBJ_2(GetLastCreatedUnit(), "breathoffrost", GetSpellTargetLoc())
+        set udg_Hero_PaW_BombInt = ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A138', GetTriggerUnit()) - 1 )
+        if ( Trig_PaW_Skill_Effect_Func003Func006C() ) then
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A138', udg_Hero_PaW, 1 )
+            call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B04O', udg_Hero_PaW )
+            call KillUnit( udg_Hero_PaW_DrunkenUnit )
+            call TextTagForce( I2S(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A138', udg_Hero_PaW) - 1), udg_Hero_PaW, 10, 255, 100, 100, 2, GetForceOfPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_PaW)) )
+            call PauseTimerBJ( true, udg_Hero_PaW_AttackTimer )
+        else
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A138', udg_Hero_PaW, GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A138', udg_Hero_PaW)/2 + 1)
+            call TextTagForce( I2S(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A138', udg_Hero_PaW) - 1), udg_Hero_PaW, 10, 255, 100, 100, 2, GetForceOfPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_PaW)) )
+            call StartTimerBJ( udg_Hero_PaW_AttackTimer, false, 6.00 )
+        endif
+    else
+    endif

+        call TextTagForce( I2S(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A138', udg_Hero_PaW) - 1), udg_Hero_PaW, 10, 255, 100, 100, 2, GetForceOfPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_PaW)) )
+        call StartTimerBJ( udg_Hero_PaW_AttackTimer, false, 6.00 )
+    endif
+endfunction

+function Trig_PhM_Skill_Effect_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GetSpellAbilityId() == 'A023' then
+        if GetSpellTargetUnit() != null then
+            call GS2_SenaPointImpact(GetTriggerUnit(), GetUnitX(GetSpellTargetUnit()), GetUnitY(GetSpellTargetUnit()))
+        else
+            call GS2_SenaPointImpact(GetTriggerUnit(), GetSpellTargetX(), GetSpellTargetY())
+        endif
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_PhM_Skill_Effect_Func002C() ) then
+        call StartTimerBJ( udg_Hero_PhM_TelTimer, false, ( 2.50 - ( 0.50 * I2R(GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R014', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))) ) ) )
+        if udg_Hero_PhM_TeleLoc != null then
+            call RemoveLocation(udg_Hero_PhM_TeleLoc)
+            set udg_Hero_PhM_TeleLoc = null
+        endif
+        set udg_Hero_PhM_TeleLoc = GetSpellTargetLoc()
+        if ( Trig_PhM_Skill_Effect_Func002Func003C() ) then
+            call AddSpecialEffectLocBJ( udg_Hero_PhM_TeleLoc, "war3mapImported\\FlameStrikeTarget.mdx" )
+            call d_effect( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ(), 3.00 )
+        else
+        endif
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_PhM_Skill_Effect_Func003C() ) then
+        set udg_Hero_PhM = GetTriggerUnit()
+        call RemoveUnit( udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit1 )
+        call RemoveUnit( udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit2 )
+        call RemoveUnit( udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit3 )
+        call GS2_CreateNUnitsPolarAroundUnitFacingUnitBJ( 1, 'hphx', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetTriggerUnit(), 120.00, ( GetUnitFacing(GetTriggerUnit()) - 180.00 ), GetTriggerUnit() )
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 20.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        set udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit1 = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", GetLastCreatedUnit(), "Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\MarkOfChaos\\MarkOfChaosTarget.mdl" )
+        call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+        call GS2_CreateNUnitsPolarAroundUnitFacingUnitBJ( 1, 'hphx', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetTriggerUnit(), 120.00, ( GetUnitFacing(GetTriggerUnit()) - 140.00 ), GetTriggerUnit() )
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 20.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        set udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit2 = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", GetLastCreatedUnit(), "Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\MarkOfChaos\\MarkOfChaosTarget.mdl" )
+        call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+        call GS2_CreateNUnitsPolarAroundUnitFacingUnitBJ( 1, 'hphx', GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()), GetTriggerUnit(), 120.00, ( GetUnitFacing(GetTriggerUnit()) - 220.00 ), GetTriggerUnit() )
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 20.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        set udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit3 = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", GetLastCreatedUnit(), "Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\MarkOfChaos\\MarkOfChaosTarget.mdl" )
+        call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+        call StartTimerBJ( udg_Hero_PhM_SpTimer, true, 0.03 )
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_PhM_Skill_Effect_Func004C() ) then
+        call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetSpellAbilityUnit()), GetSpellTargetUnit(), bj_UNIT_FACING )
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 2.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A026', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "faeriefire", GetSpellTargetUnit() )
+    else
+    endif
+endfunction
+function Trig_Teleportion_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local location teleLoc = null
+    call PolledWait(0.10)
+    if TimerGetRemaining(udg_Hero_PhM_TelTimer) == 0.00 and udg_Hero_PhM_TeleLoc != null then
+        set teleLoc = udg_Hero_PhM_TeleLoc
+        set udg_Hero_PhM_TeleLoc = null
+        call SetUnitPositionLoc(caster, teleLoc)
+        call AddSpecialEffectLocBJ(teleLoc, "Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\MarkOfChaos\\MarkOfChaosTarget.mdl")
+        call d_effect(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ(), 2.00)
+        if GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R0BY', GetOwningPlayer(caster)) >= 1 then
+            call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1, 'e03G', GetOwningPlayer(caster), teleLoc, bj_UNIT_FACING)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(3.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit())
+            call IssueImmediateOrderBJ(GetLastCreatedUnit(), "thunderclap")
+        endif
+        call RemoveLocation(teleLoc)
+        set teleLoc = null
+    endif
+    set caster = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_Free_Annihilation_Orb_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer rand = GetRandomInt( 1 , 100 )
+    local integer chance = 5 * (GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0RG', GetEventDamageSource())) // 발동 확률
+    call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B07X', GetTriggerUnit() )
+    if ( Trig_Free_Annihilation_Orb_Func004C() ) then
+        set udg_Hero_Sil_FADmg = ( I2R(( GetHeroStatBJ(bj_HEROSTAT_INT, GetEventDamageSource(), true) + GetHeroStatBJ(bj_HEROSTAT_AGI, GetEventDamageSource(), true) )) * ( 0.15 + ( 0.05 * I2R(( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0RG', GetEventDamageSource()) + GetPlayerTechCountSimple('R00N', GetOwningPlayer(GetEventDamageSource())) )) ) ) )
+        call UnitDamageTargetBJ( GetEventDamageSource(), GetTriggerUnit(), udg_Hero_Sil_FADmg, ATTACK_TYPE_HERO, DAMAGE_TYPE_DIVINE )
+        call GS2V84_CreateTextTagLocBJ_1(( I2S(R2I(udg_Hero_Sil_FADmg)) + "!" ), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), 0, 10.00, 0.00, 0.00, 100.00, 0)
+        call SetTextTagPermanentBJ( GetLastCreatedTextTag(), false )
+        call SetTextTagLifespanBJ( GetLastCreatedTextTag(), 1.00 )
+        call SetTextTagVelocityBJ( GetLastCreatedTextTag(), 65.00, 90 )
+    else
+        if ( rand <= chance ) then
+        call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetEventDamageSource()), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 1.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A03G', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "soulburn", GetTriggerUnit() )
+        if ( Trig_Free_Annihilation_Orb_Func004Func006C() ) then
+            call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(GetEventDamageSource()), GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 1.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A11C', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "doom", GetTriggerUnit() )
+        else
+        endif
+        endif
+    endif
+endfunction

+function Trig_Wound_Slasher_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B0BE', GetTriggerUnit() )
+    call StartTimerBJ( udg_Hero_SwM_WoundTimer, false, 4.00 )
+    if ( Trig_Wound_Slasher_Func003C() ) then
+        if ( Trig_Wound_Slasher_Func003Func001C() ) then
+            set udg_Hero_SwM_WoundCount = IMinBJ(12, ( udg_Hero_SwM_WoundCount + 1 ))
+        else
+            set udg_Hero_SwM_WoundCount = IMinBJ(4, ( udg_Hero_SwM_WoundCount + 1 ))
+        endif
+    else
+        set udg_Hero_SwM_WoundUnit = GetTriggerUnit()
+        if ( Trig_Wound_Slasher_Func003Func003C() ) then
+            if ( Trig_Wound_Slasher_Func003Func003Func001C() ) then
+                set udg_Hero_SwM_WoundCount = 4
+            else
+                if ( Trig_Wound_Slasher_Func003Func003Func001Func002C() ) then
+                    set udg_Hero_SwM_WoundCount = 4
+                    call TextTag( "상처 찢기!" , GetTriggerUnit() , 13 , 120 , 120 , 120, 3 )
+                else
+                    set udg_Hero_SwM_WoundCount = 1
+                endif
+            endif
+        else
+            set udg_Hero_SwM_WoundCount = 1
+        endif
+    endif
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A15B', GetEventDamageSource(), ( ( ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A11M', GetEventDamageSource()) - 1 ) * 12 ) + ( udg_Hero_SwM_WoundCount + 1 ) ) )
+    call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "chest", GetTriggerUnit(), "Abilities\\Weapons\\HydraliskImpact\\HydraliskImpact.mdl" )
+    call d_effect(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ(),0.2)
+endfunction

+function Trig_Lament_Die_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit gs2EvtTarget = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit gs2EvtSource = GetEventDamageSource()
+    local real gs2EvtDamage = GetEventDamage()
+    local unit u
+    local integer randmsg = GetRandomInt( 1 , 3 )
+    if ( Trig_Lament_Die_Func005C() ) then
+        call SaveRealBJ( gs2EvtDamage, GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer()), StringHashBJ("ExtraDamage"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
+        call SaveRealBJ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE, gs2EvtTarget), GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer()), StringHashBJ("Life"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
+    else
+        call SaveRealBJ( ( LoadRealBJ(GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer()), StringHashBJ("ExtraDamage"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ()) + gs2EvtDamage ), GetConvertedPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer()), StringHashBJ("ExtraDamage"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ() )
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_Lament_Die_Func006C() ) then
+        call DisableTrigger( gg_trg_Lament_Die )
+        call SetUnitLifePercentBJ( gs2EvtTarget, 100 )
+        call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(gs2EvtSource), GetUnitLoc(gs2EvtTarget), bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 8.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        set u = GetLastCreatedUnit()
+        if ( Trig_Lament_Die_Func006Func008C() ) then
+            call SetUnitInvulnerable( gs2EvtTarget, true )
+        else
+        endif
+        if randmsg == 1 then
+        call TextTag( "나의 죽음, 복수하리라..." , gs2EvtTarget , 10 , 131 , 77 , 173, 3 )
+        endif
+        if randmsg == 2 then
+        call TextTag( "이 원한은 잊지 않는다..." , gs2EvtTarget , 10 , 131 , 77 , 173, 3 )
+        endif
+        if randmsg == 3 then
+        call TextTag( "내게 남겨진 건 복수뿐..." , gs2EvtTarget , 10 , 131 , 77 , 173, 3 )
+        endif
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", gs2EvtTarget, "war3mapImported\\RedPillar.mdx" )
+        call d_effect(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ(),5)
+        call TriggerSleepAction( 0.50 )
+        call TriggerSleepAction( ( 1.50 + I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0GI', gs2EvtTarget)) ) )
+        if ( UnitHasBuffBJ(gs2EvtTarget, 'B03K') == false ) then
+            call AbsoluteDamage(u, gs2EvtTarget, 10000)
+        else
+        endif
+        call TriggerSleepAction( 1.00 )
+        call EnableTrigger( gg_trg_Lament_Die )
+    else
+    endif
+endfunction

+function Trig_Silence_of_Curse_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster, 'A02D')
+    local real x = GetSpellTargetX()
+    local real y = GetSpellTargetY()
+    local unit dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'ewsp', x, y, 0.00)
+    local integer abilityId = 'AS51' + level - 1
+    local location target = Location(x, y)
+    local group targets = GetUnitsInRangeOfLocAll(200.00 + I2R(level) * 50.00, target)
+    call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'Aloc')
+    call UnitAddAbility(dummy, abilityId)
+    call IssuePointOrder(dummy, "silence", x, y)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 3.00)
+    call ForGroupBJ(targets, function Trig_Silence_of_Curse_Func001A)
+    call DestroyGroup(targets)
+    call RemoveLocation(target)
+    set targets = null
+    set target = null
+    set dummy = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction

+function GS166_Each takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u=GetEnumUnit()
+    if GetUnitTypeId(u)==0 then
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS166_Data,GetHandleId(u))
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(GS166_Units,u)
+    else
+        call GS166_Sync(u)
+    endif
+    set u=null
+endfunction

+    endif
+endfunction

+function Trig_Parasite_Loop_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local real ux = 0.00
+    local real uy = 0.00
+    local real tx = 0.00
+    local real ty = 0.00
+    local real ang = 0.00
+    local real rx = 0.00
+    local real ry = 0.00
+    if ( Trig_Parasite_Loop_Func001C() ) then
+        if ( Trig_Parasite_Loop_Func001Func006C() ) then
+            set udg_Hero_DeC_ParaSize = 1.00
+            call SetUnitPosition(udg_Hero_DeC, GetUnitX(udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt), GetUnitY(udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt))
+            call SetUnitScalePercent( udg_Hero_DeC, 1.00, 1.00, 1.00 )
+        else
+            if ( Trig_Parasite_Loop_Func001Func006Func001C() ) then
+                if ( Trig_Parasite_Loop_Func001Func006Func001Func002C() ) then
+                    set udg_Hero_DeC_ParaInt = 1
+                    call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "chest", udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt, "Abilities\\Spells\\Undead\\Possession\\PossessionMissile.mdl" )
+                    call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+                    call StartTimerBJ( udg_Hero_DeC_ParaDmgTimer, false, 0.90 )
+                    if ( Trig_Parasite_Loop_Func001Func006Func001Func002Func006C() ) then
+                        call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B079', udg_Hero_DeC )
+                        set udg_Hero_DeC_Sp2Tgt = null
+                        call AbsoluteDamage(udg_Hero_DeC, udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt, 800)
+                        call AbsoluteDamage(udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt, udg_Hero_DeC, 10000)
+                        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt, "war3mapImported\\DemolisherToxicMissile.mdx" )
+                        call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+                    else
+                    endif
+                else
+                endif
+            else
+                if ( Trig_Parasite_Loop_Func001Func006Func001Func003C() ) then
+                    set udg_Hero_DeC_ParaSize = ( udg_Hero_DeC_ParaSize - 3.00 )
+                else
+                    set udg_Hero_DeC_ParaSize = 1.00
+                endif
+                if ( Trig_Parasite_Loop_Func001Func006Func001Func004C() ) then
+                    call SetUnitPosition(udg_Hero_DeC, GetUnitX(udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt), GetUnitY(udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt))
+                else
+                    set ux = GetUnitX(udg_Hero_DeC)
+                    set uy = GetUnitY(udg_Hero_DeC)
+                    set tx = GetUnitX(udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt)
+                    set ty = GetUnitY(udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt)
+                    set ang = Atan2(ty-uy, tx-ux)
+                    call SetUnitPosition(udg_Hero_DeC, ux + 20.00*Cos(ang), uy + 20.00*Sin(ang))
+                    call SetUnitFacing(udg_Hero_DeC, ang*bj_RADTODEG)
+                endif
+                call SetUnitScalePercent( udg_Hero_DeC, udg_Hero_DeC_ParaSize, udg_Hero_DeC_ParaSize, udg_Hero_DeC_ParaSize )
+            endif
+        endif
+        call StartTimerBJ( udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTimer, false, 0.01 )
+    else
+        call PauseTimerBJ( true, udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTimer )
+        call PauseTimerBJ( true, udg_Hero_DeC_ParaDmgTimer )
+        if ( Trig_Parasite_Loop_Func001Func003C() ) then
+            call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_DeC), udg_Hero_DeC, bj_UNIT_FACING )
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 2.50, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0I0', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "drunkenhaze", udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt )
+            call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_DeC), udg_Hero_DeC, bj_UNIT_FACING )
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 2.50, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0II', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "drunkenhaze", udg_Hero_DeC )
+        else
+        endif
+        call SetUnitScalePercent( udg_Hero_DeC, 100.00, 100.00, 100.00 )
+        call SetUnitInvulnerable( udg_Hero_DeC, false )
+        call SetUnitPathing( udg_Hero_DeC, true )
+        call DestroyEffectBJ( udg_Hero_DeC_Eff )
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "chest", udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt, "Abilities\\Spells\\Undead\\Possession\\PossessionMissile.mdl" )
+        call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt, "Objects\\Spawnmodels\\Orc\\OrcLargeDeathExplode\\OrcLargeDeathExplode.mdl" )
+        call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+        set ux = GetUnitX(udg_Hero_DeC)
+        set uy = GetUnitY(udg_Hero_DeC)
+        set rx = ux + GetRandomReal(-50.00, 50.00)
+        set ry = uy + GetRandomReal(-50.00, 50.00)
+        set tx = GetUnitX(udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt)
+        set ty = GetUnitY(udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt)
+        set ang = Atan2(ty-ry, tx-rx)
+        call SetUnitPosition(udg_Hero_DeC, rx, ry)
+        call SetUnitFacing(udg_Hero_DeC, ang*bj_RADTODEG)
+        call SetUnitAnimation( udg_Hero_DeC, "Morph Alternate" )
+        call QueueUnitAnimationBJ( udg_Hero_DeC, "stand" )
+        call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B079', udg_Hero_DeC )
+        set udg_Hero_DeC_ParaTgt = null
+        call RemoveUnit( udg_Hero_DeC_ParaWisp )
+        set udg_Hero_DeC_ParaWisp = null
+    endif
+endfunction
+function InitTrig_Parasite_Dmg takes nothing returns nothing
+    set gg_trg_Parasite_Dmg = CreateTrigger(  )
+    call TriggerRegisterTimerExpireEventBJ( gg_trg_Parasite_Dmg, udg_Hero_DeC_ParaDmgTimer )

+function Trig_Burrow_Drive_Dmg_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = udg_Hero_DeC
+    local unit target = GetOrderTargetUnit()
+    local real lx = GetUnitX(caster)
+    local real ly = GetUnitY(caster)
+    local real ax = GetUnitX(target)
+    local real ay = GetUnitY(target)
+    local real ang = Atan2(ay-ly, ax-lx)
+    local real dist = SquareRoot((ax-lx)*(ax-lx)+(ay-ly)*(ay-ly))
+    local integer i = 0
+    local integer r = R2I(dist) / 100
+    local integer intBonus = 0
+    local effect e = null
+    set intBonus = GetHeroStatBJ(bj_HEROSTAT_INT, caster, true)
+    if IsUnitInvulnerable(target) then
+    else
+        if ( Trig_Burrow_Drive_Dmg_Func008C() ) then
+            call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B09O', caster )
+            call UnitRemoveAbilityBJ( 'A1ZY', caster )
+            call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B076', caster )
+            call SetUnitAnimation( caster, "Attack" )
+            call UnitDamageTargetBJ( caster, target, ( ( 20.00 + I2R(intBonus) ) + ( 80.00 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0I6', caster)) ) ), ATTACK_TYPE_HERO, DAMAGE_TYPE_NORMAL )
+            set e = AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\ThunderClap\\ThunderClapCaster.mdl", ax, ay)
+            call DestroyEffect(e)
+            set e = AddSpecialEffect("Objects\\Spawnmodels\\Undead\\ImpaleTargetDust\\ImpaleTargetDust.mdl", lx, ly)
+            call DestroyEffect(e)
+            call SetUnitPosition(caster, ax - 100.00*Cos(ang), ay - 100.00*Sin(ang))
+            call SetUnitFacing(caster, ang*bj_RADTODEG)
+            call TextTag( I2S(R2I(20.00+(80.00*I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0I6', caster)))))+"!!" , caster , 10 , 200 , 0 , 0, 3 )
+            call TextTag( "+"+I2S(intBonus)+" INT" , target , 9 , 80 , 180 , 255, 3 )
+            call SetTextTagPos( bj_lastCreatedTextTag, ax + 40.00, ay, 70.00 )
+            call IssueTargetOrderBJ( caster, "attack", target )
+            if ( Trig_Burrow_Drive_Dmg_Func008Func012C() ) then
+                call PauseTimerBJ( true, udg_Hero_DeC_Sp1Timer )
+            else
+            endif
+            loop
+                set i = i + 1
+                set e = AddSpecialEffect("Objects\\Spawnmodels\\Undead\\ImpaleTargetDust\\ImpaleTargetDust.mdl", lx + (100.00*I2R(i))*Cos(ang), ly + (100.00*I2R(i))*Sin(ang))
+                call DestroyEffect(e)
+                exitwhen ( i >= r )
+            endloop
+        else
+            call DisplayTextToForce( GetForceOfPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(caster)), "|cffffcc00거리가 닿지 않습니다.|r" )
+        endif
+    endif
+    set e = null
+    set target = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction

+function DragNet_Sub takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local unit u = LoadUnitHandleBJ(GetHandleIdBJ(t),StringHashBJ("DesNet1"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+    local real px = LoadRealBJ(GetHandleIdBJ(t),StringHashBJ("DesNet2"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+    local real py = LoadRealBJ(GetHandleIdBJ(t),StringHashBJ("DesNet3"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+    local real ux = GetUnitX(u)
+    local real uy = GetUnitY(u)
+    local real dx = px - ux
+    local real dy = py - uy
+    local real dist = SquareRoot(dx*dx + dy*dy)
+    local real dmg = LoadRealBJ(GetHandleIdBJ(t),StringHashBJ("DesNetDmg"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+    local effect e
+    if UnitHasBuffBJ(u, 'B06F') then
+        if (dist > 300) and (GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0FU', udg_Hero_Des) >= 2) then
+            call SetUnitPosition(u, px, py)
+            set dx = px - GetUnitX(u)
+            set dy = py - GetUnitY(u)
+            call SaveRealBJ(SquareRoot(dx*dx + dy*dy), GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("DesNetDistance"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+        else
+            call SaveRealBJ(ux, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("DesNet2"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+            call SaveRealBJ(uy, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("DesNet3"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+            call SaveRealBJ(LoadRealBJ(GetHandleIdBJ(t),StringHashBJ("DesNetDistance"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ()) + dist, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("DesNetDistance"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+        endif
+        if LoadRealBJ(GetHandleIdBJ(t),StringHashBJ("DesNetDistance"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ()) >= 100 then
+            call UnitDamageTargetBJ(udg_Hero_Des, u, dmg, ATTACK_TYPE_HERO, DAMAGE_TYPE_DIVINE)
+            set e = AddSpecialEffect("Objects\\Spawnmodels\\Human\\HumanBlood\\BloodElfSpellThiefBlood.mdl", GetUnitX(u), GetUnitY(u))
+            call d_effect(e, 0.1)
+            call SaveRealBJ(0, GetHandleIdBJ(t), StringHashBJ("DesNetDistance"), GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ())
+        endif
+    else
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GetLastCreatedHashtableBJ(), GetHandleId(t))
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    endif
+    set e = null
+    set u = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction

+function Charged_Sub takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = udg_Hero_DrK
+    local real dx = GS2_ZaeQTargetX - GetUnitX(u)
+    local real dy = GS2_ZaeQTargetY - GetUnitY(u)
+    local real remaining = SquareRoot(dx * dx + dy * dy)
+    local real step = RMinBJ(40.00, remaining)
+    local real x = GetUnitX(u) + step * CosBJ(udg_Hero_DrK_ChargeAngle)
+    local real y = GetUnitY(u) + step * SinBJ(udg_Hero_DrK_ChargeAngle)
+    local item probe
+    if GetWidgetLife(u) > 0.405 and not udg_Hero_DrK_ChargeStop then
+        call GS2_ZaeQCollect()
+        set probe = CreateItem('texp', x, y)
+        set dx = x - GetItemX(probe)
+        set dy = y - GetItemY(probe)
+        if dx * dx + dy * dy < 400.00 then
+            call SetUnitX(u, GetItemX(probe))
+            call SetUnitY(u, GetItemY(probe))
+            call SetUnitAnimation(u, "walk fast")
+            call SetUnitFacing(u, udg_Hero_DrK_ChargeAngle)
+            call GS2_ZaeQCollect()
+            call ForGroup(udg_Hero_DrK_group, function GS2_ZaeQCarry)
+            set udg_Hero_DrK_ChargeLoopCount = udg_Hero_DrK_ChargeLoopCount - 1
+        else
+            set udg_Hero_DrK_ChargeLoopCount = 0
+        endif
+        call RemoveItem(probe)
+        set probe = null
+    else
+        set udg_Hero_DrK_ChargeLoopCount = 0
+    endif
+    if udg_Hero_DrK_ChargeLoopCount <= 0 or udg_Hero_DrK_ChargeStop or remaining <= 40.00 then
+        set udg_Hero_DrK_ChargeStop = true
+        set udg_Hero_DrK_ChargeLoopCount = 0
+        call DestroyTimer(GetExpiredTimer())
+        call ResetUnitAnimation(u)
+        call DestroyEffectBJ(udg_Hero_DrK_ChargeEff)
+        set udg_Hero_DrK_ChargeEff = null
+        call SetUnitAnimation(u, "Attack Slam")
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ("origin", u, "Abilities\\Spells\\Orc\\WarStomp\\WarStompCaster.mdl")
+        call DestroyEffectBJ(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ())
+        call DisableTrigger(gg_trg_Charge_Unit)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_Charge_Unit_Move_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local location centerLoc
+    local rect scanRect
+    if ( Trig_Charge_Unit_Move_Func002C() ) then
+        set centerLoc = GetUnitLoc(udg_Hero_DrK)
+        set scanRect = RectFromCenterSizeBJ(centerLoc, 300.00, 300.00)
+        call EnumDestructablesInRectAll( scanRect, function Trig_Charge_Unit_Move_Func002Func002A )
+        call RemoveRect(scanRect)
+        set scanRect = null
+        if ( Trig_Charge_Unit_Move_Func002Func004C() ) then
+            call ForGroupBJ( udg_Hero_DrK_group, function Trig_Charge_Unit_Move_Func002Func004Func002A )
+        else
+            call ForGroupBJ( udg_Hero_DrK_group, function Trig_Charge_Unit_Move_Func002Func004Func001A )
+        endif
+        if ( Trig_Charge_Unit_Move_Func002Func005C() ) then
+            if udg_Hero_DrK_Sp1loc == null then
+                set udg_Hero_DrK_Sp1loc = centerLoc
+                set centerLoc = null
+            else
+                set udg_Hero_DrK_Sp1real = ( udg_Hero_DrK_Sp1real + DistanceBetweenPoints(centerLoc, udg_Hero_DrK_Sp1loc) )
+                call RemoveLocation(udg_Hero_DrK_Sp1loc)
+                set udg_Hero_DrK_Sp1loc = centerLoc
+                set centerLoc = null
+                if ( Trig_Charge_Unit_Move_Func002Func005Func004C() ) then
+                    call ForGroupBJ( udg_Hero_DrK_group, function Trig_Charge_Unit_Move_Func002Func005Func004Func001A )
+                    call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "origin", udg_Hero_DrK, "Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\Thunderclap\\ThunderClapCaster.mdl" )
+                    call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+                    set udg_Hero_DrK_Sp1real = 0.00
+                else
+                endif
+            endif
+        else
+        endif
+        if centerLoc != null then
+            call RemoveLocation(centerLoc)
+            set centerLoc = null
+        endif
+    else
+        call ForGroupBJ( udg_Hero_DrK_group, function Trig_Charge_Unit_Move_Func002Func001A )
+        call ForGroup(udg_Hero_DrK_group, function GS2_AuditChargeReset)
+        call GroupRemoveGroup( udg_Hero_DrK_group, udg_Hero_DrK_group )
+        if udg_Hero_DrK_Sp1loc != null then
+            call RemoveLocation(udg_Hero_DrK_Sp1loc)
+            set udg_Hero_DrK_Sp1loc = null
+        endif
+        set udg_Hero_DrK_Sp1real = 0.00
+        call DisableTrigger( GetTriggeringTrigger() )
+    endif
+endfunction

+function GS2_ZigRainHit takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit source = LoadUnitHandle(GS2_ZigRainData, id, 4)
+    local player owner = Player(LoadInteger(GS2_ZigRainData, id, 0))
+    local real x = LoadReal(GS2_ZigRainData, id, 2)
+    local real y = LoadReal(GS2_ZigRainData, id, 3)
+    local real damage = LoadReal(GS2_ZigRainData, id, 5)
+    local group targets = CreateGroup()
+    local unit target
+    call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(targets, x, y, 300.00, null)
+    loop
+        set target = FirstOfGroup(targets)
+        exitwhen target == null
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(targets, target)
+        if GetWidgetLife(target) > 0.405 and IsUnitEnemy(target, owner) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL) and not IsUnitType(target, UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) then
+            call UnitDamageTarget(source, target, damage, false, false, ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_FIRE, WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+            call GS2_ZigApplyBurn(source, target, damage / 5.00 - 4.00)
+        endif
+    endloop
+    call DestroyGroup(targets)
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS2_ZigRainData, id)
+    call PauseTimer(t)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    set target = null
+    set targets = null
+    set source = null
+    set owner = null
+    set t = null

+            set udg_Hero_MRG_PB_True = null

+        call SetUnitTimeScalePercent( udg_Hero_MRG, 100.00 )

+        if udg_Hero_MRG_PB_True != null then
+            call RemoveUnit(udg_Hero_MRG_PB_True)
+            set udg_Hero_MRG_PB_True = null
+        endif
+        return
+    else
+    endif
+    call SetUnitTimeScalePercent( udg_Hero_MRG, 150.00 )
+    if ( Trig_Punish_Blade_Caster_Func016C() ) then
+        call Knockback(udg_Hero_MRG_UltiTarget,GS2V84_AngleBetweenPointsUnits(udg_Hero_MRG, udg_Hero_MRG_UltiTarget),300,800)

+    call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )

+    call DestroyEffectBJ( GetLastCreatedEffectBJ() )
+    call PlaySoundBJ( gg_snd_MRG_Ulti )

+function Trig_PoD_Skill_Effect_Conditions takes nothing returns boolean
+    if ( not Trig_PoD_Skill_Effect_Func008C() ) then
+        return false
+    endif
+    return true
+endfunction
+function Trig_PoD_Skill_Effect_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit target = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local location point = null
+    local integer lv = 0
+    local real dx = 0.00
+    local real dy = 0.00
+    if ( Trig_PoD_Skill_Effect_Func003C() ) then
+        if ( IsUnitAliveBJ(target) == true ) then
+            set point = Location(GetUnitX(caster), GetUnitY(caster))
+        else
+            set point = Location(GetSpellTargetX(), GetSpellTargetY())
+        endif
+        set dx = GetUnitX(caster)-GetLocationX(point)
+        set dy = GetUnitY(caster)-GetLocationY(point)
+        set lv = (( R2I(SquareRoot(dx*dx+dy*dy)) / 100 ) + 1 )
+        call d_effect(AddSpecialEffect("Objects\\Spawnmodels\\Human\\HCancelDeath\\HCancelDeath.mdl", GetSpellTargetX(), GetSpellTargetY()),1.5)
+        call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'ewsp', GetTriggerPlayer(), caster, bj_UNIT_FACING )
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 3.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A006', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A006', GetLastCreatedUnit(), ( ( ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A003', caster) - 1 ) * 9 ) + lv ) )
+        call IssuePointOrderLocBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "breathoffire", point )
+        if ( Trig_PoD_Skill_Effect_Func003Func014C() ) then
+            call SetUnitVertexColorBJ( caster, 100, 100, 100, 100.00 )
+            call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(caster), caster, bj_UNIT_FACING )
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 2.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'S00J', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call PolledWait( 4.00 )
+            call SetUnitVertexColorBJ( caster, 100, 100, 100, 0.00 )
+        else
+        endif
+        call RemoveLocation(point)
+        set point = null
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_PoD_Skill_Effect_Func004C() ) then
+        call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'ewsp', GetTriggerPlayer(), caster, bj_UNIT_FACING )
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 1.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        if ( Trig_PoD_Skill_Effect_Func004Func004C() ) then
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A032', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A032', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A04P', caster) )
+            call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "holybolt", target )
+        else
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A031', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A031', GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A04P', caster) )
+            call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "faeriefire", target )
+        endif
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_PoD_Skill_Effect_Func005C() ) then
+        call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(caster), caster, bj_UNIT_FACING )
+        call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 1.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0JD', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+        call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "soulburn", target )
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_PoD_Skill_Effect_Func006C() ) then
+        call PlaySoundBJ( gg_snd_EvilArthasYesAttack2 )
+        if ( Trig_PoD_Skill_Effect_Func006Func002C() ) then
+            call GS2_CreateNUnitsAtUnitBJ( 1, 'ewsp', GetOwningPlayer(caster), caster, bj_UNIT_FACING )
+            call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 1.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0JC', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+            call IssueTargetOrderBJ( GetLastCreatedUnit(), "antimagicshell", caster )
+        else
+        endif
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_PoD_Skill_Effect_Func007C() ) then
+        call UnitDamageTargetBJ( caster, target, ( 15.00 * 1.00 ), ATTACK_TYPE_HERO, DAMAGE_TYPE_DIVINE )
+    else
+    endif
+    if point != null then
+        call RemoveLocation(point)
+        set point = null
+    endif
+    set target = null
+    set caster = null
+endfunction

+    call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ( 1.00, 'BTLF', GetLastCreatedUnit() )
+    call UnitDamageTarget(GetLastCreatedUnit(), GetTriggerUnit(),( 10.00 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A149', GetEventDamageSource())) ),false,true,ATTACK_TYPE_HERO,DAMAGE_TYPE_NORMAL,null)
+    if ( Trig_Curruption_Arrow_Func004C() ) then
+        call UnitRemoveBuffBJ( 'B02H', GetTriggerUnit() )
+        call SetUnitManaBJ( GetTriggerUnit(), ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MANA, GetTriggerUnit()) - ( 5.00 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A149', GetEventDamageSource())) ) ) )
+        call SetUnitManaBJ( GetEventDamageSource(), ( GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_MANA, GetEventDamageSource()) + ( 5.00 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A149', GetEventDamageSource())) ) ) )
+        call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ( "chest", GetTriggerUnit(), "Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\Feedback\\ArcaneTowerAttack.mdl" )
+        call d_effect(GetLastCreatedEffectBJ(),1)
+    else
+    endif
+endfunction

+                call TextTag( "헤드샷!" , udg_Hero_SoH , 10 , 255 , 255 , 255, 3 )

+endfunction

+function SP172_Damage takes unit h, unit v, real amount returns nothing
+    if SP172_Alive(h) and SP172_Enemy(h,v) then
+        call UnitDamageTarget(h,v,amount,false,false,ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL,DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function SP172_EStacks takes unit h, unit v returns integer
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    local integer n=0
+    if v==null then
+        return 0
+    endif
+    if not IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_HERO) or not SP172_Enemy(h,v) then
+        return 0
+    endif
+    if LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,1)==v and SP172_Time<LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,4) then
+        set n=n+1
+    endif
+    if LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,24) and SP172_Time<LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,23) and (LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,20)==v or LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,21)==v) then
+        set n=n+1
+    endif
+    return n
+endfunction
+function SP172_Register takes unit h returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)=='OSp1' and not IsUnitIllusion(h) and not IsUnitInGroup(h,SP172_Heroes) then
+        call GroupAddUnit(SP172_Heroes,h)
+        call GSCT_Track(h)
+                call SP172_ApplyTrait(h)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function SP172_RFirst takes unit h, unit v returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    call SP172_RStop(h)
+    if not SP172_Enemy(h,v) or not IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_HERO) then
+        call BlzEndUnitAbilityCooldown(h,'ASpR')
+        call SetUnitState(h,UNIT_STATE_MANA,GetUnitState(h,UNIT_STATE_MANA)+90.0+30.0*I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpR')))
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(h),0,0,3,"베놈 와이어는 적 영웅을 대상으로 사용합니다.")
+        return
+    endif
+    call SaveReal(SP172_Data,k,27,SP172_Time+110.0)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,20,v)
+    call SaveReal(SP172_Data,k,23,SP172_Time+10.0)
+    call SaveInteger(SP172_Data,k,22,GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpR'))
+    call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(h),0,0,5,"같은 R로 두 번째 대상을 선택하세요. 첫 대상 기준 2000 이내, 제한 10초. 궁극기 특성 연구 시 자신 지정 가능.")
+endfunction
+function SP172_RSecond takes unit h, unit v returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    local unit first=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,20)
+    local boolean selfLink=v==h and SP172_Trait(h,'RSpR')
+    if v==null then
+        set first=null
+        return
+    endif
+    if first==null or LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,24) then
+        call SP172_RStop(h)
+    elseif SP172_Enemy(h,first) and v!=first and SP172_Distance(first,v)<=2000.0 and SP172_Time<LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,23) and (selfLink or (SP172_Enemy(h,v) and IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_HERO) and IsUnitAlly(v,GetOwningPlayer(first)))) then
+        call SaveUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,21,v)
+        call SaveBoolean(SP172_Data,k,24,true)
+        call SaveReal(SP172_Data,k,23,SP172_Time+10.0)
+        call SaveReal(SP172_Data,k,26,SP172_Time+0.5)
+        call GSCT_SyncLine(SP172_Data,k,25,"DRAL",true,first,v,40.0,true)
+        call SaveBoolean(SP172_Data,k,28,true)
+    else
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(h),0,0,3,"다른 적 영웅을 선택하세요. 첫 대상의 아군이며 첫 대상과 2000 이내여야 합니다. 특성 연구 시 자신 선택 가능.")
+    endif
+    set first=null
+endfunction
+function SP172_Research takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit shop=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit h=udg_HeroPlayer[GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(shop))+1]
+    local integer tech=GetResearched()
+    if GetUnitTypeId(shop)=='nSp1' then
+        if tech=='RSpQ' then
+            call GS2TT_Append(GetOwningPlayer(shop),'ASpQ',4,"치명적인 거미줄","조작 4회, 소진 또는 해제 시 100/130/160/190 추가 피해(연결당 1회)",false)
+        elseif tech=='RSpW' then
+            call GS2TT_Append(GetOwningPlayer(shop),'ASpW',4,"산란지 사출","시전 사거리 600",false)
+        elseif tech=='RSpR' then
+            call GS2TT_Append(GetOwningPlayer(shop),'ASpR',3,"벗어날 수 없는 속박","자신 연결 가능, 적 R 피해 80%",false)
+        elseif tech=='RSpE' then
+            call GS2TT_Append(GetOwningPlayer(shop),'ASpE',4,"맹독 주입","중독 대상 평타 3회: 40/60/80/100 추가 피해",false)
+        endif
+        if GetUnitTypeId(h)=='OSp1' then
+            call SP172_ApplyTrait(h)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set shop=null
+    set h=null
+endfunction
+function DW160_Hit takes unit h, unit v, integer kind, integer serial returns nothing
+    local timer t
+    local integer k
+    local real now=TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)
+    if DW160_Busy or IsUnitIllusion(h) or GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RD03',true)<1 or not GS2DW_Valid(v,h,false) then
+        return
+    endif
+    set t=LoadTimerHandle(DW160_Data,GetHandleId(h),GetHandleId(v))
+    if t==null then
+        set t=CreateTimer()
+        set k=GetHandleId(t)
+        call SaveTimerHandle(DW160_Data,GetHandleId(h),GetHandleId(v),t)
+        call SaveUnitHandle(DW160_Data,k,0,h)
+        call SaveUnitHandle(DW160_Data,k,1,v)
+        call TimerStart(t,0.10,true,function DW160_Tick)
+    endif
+    set k=GetHandleId(t)
+    call SaveReal(DW160_Data,k,6,now+10.0)
+    if LoadInteger(DW160_Data,k,10+kind)==serial then
+        set t=null
+        return
+    endif
+    call SaveInteger(DW160_Data,k,10+kind,serial)
+    if DW160_Mode==2 and now<LoadReal(DW160_Data,k,4) then
+        set t=null
+        return
+    endif
+    if DW160_Mode==2 and now<LoadReal(DW160_Data,k,3) and LoadInteger(DW160_Data,k,2)!=kind then
+        call DW160_Bonus(h,v,k)
+    else
+        call DW160_ClearMark(k)
+        call SaveInteger(DW160_Data,k,2,kind)
+        call SaveReal(DW160_Data,k,3,now+3.0)
+        call SaveEffectHandle(DW160_Data,k,5,AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\FrostDamage\\FrostDamage.mdl",v,"chest"))
+    endif
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function DW160_Attack takes unit h, unit v returns nothing
+    local timer t=LoadTimerHandle(DW160_Data,GetHandleId(h),GetHandleId(v))
+    if DW160_Mode==1 and not DW160_Busy and not IsUnitIllusion(h) and GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RD03',true)>0 and t!=null and GS2DW_Valid(v,h,false) then
+        if TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)<LoadReal(DW160_Data,GetHandleId(t),3) then
+            call DW160_Bonus(h,v,GetHandleId(t))
+        endif
+    endif
+    set t=null
+endfunction

+function GS150_BreathRelease takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer key=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit h=LoadUnitHandle(GS2DW_Data,key,0)
+    local real x=LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,1)
+    local real y=LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,2)
+    local real sx=LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,3)
+    local real sy=LoadReal(GS2DW_Data,key,4)
+    local integer lv=LoadInteger(GS2DW_Data,key,5)
+    local unit d
+    local sound voice=LoadSoundHandle(GS2DW_Data,key,6)
+    local effect preparation=LoadEffectHandle(GS2DW_Data,key,7)
+    if preparation!=null then
+        call DestroyEffect(preparation)
+    endif
+    set preparation=null
+    if voice!=null then
+        call StopSound(voice,true,false)
+    endif
+    set voice=null
+    if h!=null and GetUnitTypeId(h)!=0 and GetWidgetLife(h)>0.405 then
+        set voice=GS151_DragonSound("Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\BreathOfFrost\\BreathOfFrost1.wav",sx,sy,70)
+        call KillSoundWhenDone(voice)
+        set voice=null
+        set d=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'dDr1',sx,sy,Atan2(y-sy,x-sx)*bj_RADTODEG)
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GS2DW_Data,GetHandleId(d),0,h)
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(d,'ADr2',lv)
+        call SetUnitVertexColor(d,255,255,255,128)
+        call IssuePointOrder(d,"shockwave",x,y)
+        call GS120_BreathVisual(d,x,y)
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS2DW_Data,key)
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GS2DW_Data,key,0,d)
+        call TimerStart(t,0.5,false,function GS150_BreathHide)
+    else
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS2DW_Data,key)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set d=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GS107_QHit takes nothing returns nothing
