+function GS2FB_Spell takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit target = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local unit dummy
+    local integer skill = GetSpellAbilityId()
+    local integer level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster, skill)
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(caster)
+    if GetUnitTypeId(caster) == 'OFl1' then
+        if skill == 'AFq1' then
+            call GS2FB_Area(caster, 350.0, 40.0 + 80.0 * I2R(level))
+        elseif skill == 'AFw1' and target != null then
+            set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'ewsp', GetUnitX(caster), GetUnitY(caster), 0.0)
+            call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'AFw2')
+            if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'RF03', true) > 0 then
+                set level = level + 4
+            endif
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, 'AFw2', level)
+            call IssuePointOrderById(dummy, 852488, GetUnitX(target), GetUnitY(target))
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 8.0)
+        elseif skill == 'AFr1' then
+            call SaveReal(GS2FB_Data, id, 0, TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime) + 2.0 + 0.50 * I2R(level))
+            if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(caster), 'RF04', true) > 0 then
+                call GS2DW_Dummy(caster, caster, 'AFt2', 1, 852186)
+            endif
+            call PlaySoundBJ(gg_snd_ThL_Ulti)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set caster = null
+    set target = null
+    set dummy = null
+endfunction
+function GS2FB_Damaged takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit hero = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit dummy
+    local integer level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(hero, 'AFe1')
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(hero)
+    local real now = TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)
+    if GetUnitTypeId(hero) == 'OFl1' and GetEventDamage() > 0.0 and BlzGetEventIsAttack() and level > 0 and GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(hero), 'RF02', true) > 0 and now >= LoadReal(GS2FB_Data, id, 1) then
+        if GetRandomInt(1,100) <= 12 then
+            call SaveReal(GS2FB_Data, id, 1, now + 4.0)
+            set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(hero), 'ewsp', GetUnitX(hero), GetUnitY(hero), 0.0)
+            call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'AFt1')
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, 'AFt1', level)
+            call IssueImmediateOrder(dummy, "thunderclap")
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 1.0)
+            call GS2FB_Area(hero, 325.0, 80.0 + 20.0 * I2R(level))
+            call TextTag("야수의 분노!", hero, 10, 255, 255, 150, 3)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set hero = null
+    set dummy = null
+endfunction
+function GS117_Spell takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer aid = GetSpellAbilityId()
+    local integer lv = GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, aid)
+    local unit d = null
+    local timer t
+    local integer k
+    local real cd
+    local real duration
+    local real now
+    if aid == 'A03F' then
+        set lv = IMaxBJ(1, IMinBJ(4, lv))
+        set d = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(u), 'e002', GetSpellTargetX(), GetSpellTargetY(), 0.0)
+        call UnitAddAbility(d, 'AZ71' + lv - 1)
+        call SetUnitState(d, UNIT_STATE_MANA, 1000.0)
+        call IssuePointOrder(d, "silence", GetSpellTargetX(), GetSpellTargetY())
+        call UnitApplyTimedLife(d, 'BTLF', 2.0)
+    endif
+    if GS117_WindBuff(aid) != 0 and aid != 'A0G4' and GS125_WindProxy(aid)==0 then
+        set t = CreateTimer()
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GS117_Data,GetHandleId(t),0,u)
+        call SaveInteger(GS117_Data,GetHandleId(t),1,aid)
+        call TimerStart(t,0.0,false,function GS123_WindUI)
+    endif
+    if GS117_WindBuff(aid) != 0 and (IsUnitType(u, UNIT_TYPE_HERO) or (aid == 'A0PE' and GetUnitTypeId(u) == 'n01U')) and not IsUnitIllusion(u) and (not IsTriggerEnabled(gg_trg_Single_WTFEffect) or GS125_WindProxy(aid) != 0) then
+        set cd = BlzGetUnitAbilityCooldown(u, aid, lv - 1)
+        if IsTriggerEnabled(gg_trg_Single_WTFEffect) then
+            set cd = 0.0
+        endif
+        if cd > 0.0 or GS125_WindProxy(aid) != 0 then
+            set now = TimerGetElapsed(GS117_Clock)
+            set duration = BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(BlzGetUnitAbility(u, aid), ABILITY_RLF_DURATION_NORMAL, lv - 1)
+            set t=LoadTimerHandle(GS117_Data,GetHandleId(u),aid)
+            if t!=null then
+                set k=GetHandleId(t)
+                if LoadBoolean(GS117_Data,k,10) then
+                    call BlzUnitDisableAbility(u,aid,false,false)
+                endif
+                if GS125_WindProxy(aid)!=0 then
+                    call UnitRemoveAbility(u,GS125_WindProxy(aid))
+                endif
+                call FlushChildHashtable(GS117_Data,k)
+                call PauseTimer(t)
+                call DestroyTimer(t)
+            endif
+            set t = CreateTimer()
+            set k = GetHandleId(t)
+            call SaveUnitHandle(GS117_Data, k, 0, u)
+            call SaveInteger(GS117_Data, k, 1, aid)
+            call SaveReal(GS117_Data, k, 2, now + cd)
+            call SaveReal(GS117_Data, k, 3, now)
+            call SaveReal(GS117_Data, k, 6, RMaxBJ(cd, duration) + 4.0)
+            call SaveTimerHandle(GS117_Data, GetHandleId(u), aid, t)
+            call TimerStart(t, 0.0, false, function GS117_WindTick)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set t = null
+    set d = null
+    set u = null
+endfunction

+function GS114S_ItemUse takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(h)
+    local item it=GetManipulatedItem()
+    local unit target
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)=='USa1' and it!=null and it==LoadItemHandle(GS114S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItem")) then
+        set target=LoadUnitHandle(GS114S_Data,sid,StringHash("orderedItemTarget"))
+        call GS114S_ItemBonus(h,target,true)
+    endif
+    set target=null
+    set it=null
+    set h=null
+endfunction
+function GSRI_Cancel takes nothing returns nothing
+    set GSRI_Key = 0
+    set GSRI_LastAbility = 0
+    set GSRI_Caster = null
+    set GSRI_Item = null
+    set GSRI_CachedId = 0
+    set GSRI_YawValid = false
+    set GSRI_FindAge = 0.00
+    call GSRI_Hide()
+endfunction
+function GSRI_Find takes unit u, integer key returns integer
+    local integer sid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer i = 0
+    local integer count = LoadInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, 0)
+    local integer id
+    local integer found = 0
+    if key == 82 and GetUnitTypeId(u) == 'OSp1' and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'ASpR')>0 and GSRI_Item == null then
+        return 'ASpR'
+    endif
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= count
+        set id = LoadInteger(GSRI_Cache, sid, 1+i*10)
+        if LoadInteger(GSRI_Data, id, 0) == key and GSRI_Allowed(u, id) then
+            if found != 0 and found != id then
+                return 0
+            endif
+            set found = id
+        endif
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+    return found
+endfunction
+function GSRI_Segment takes real x1, real y1, real x2, real y2 returns nothing
+    local integer i = GSRI_DrawIndex
+    local real dx = x2-x1
+    local real dy = y2-y1
+    local real length = SquareRoot(dx*dx+dy*dy)
+    local real z1
+    local real z2
+    local real zm
+    if i<0 or i >= GSRI_POOL_SIZE then
+        return
+    endif
+    set GSRI_DrawIndex = i+1
+    if GSRI_Effect[i]==null or not GSCT_Number(x1) or not GSCT_Number(y1) or not GSCT_Number(x2) or not GSCT_Number(y2) then
+        set GSRI_SegmentValid[i]=false
+        call GSRI_HideSegment(i)
+        return
+    endif
+    if GSRI_SegmentValid[i] and GSRI_X1[i] == x1 and GSRI_Y1[i] == y1 and GSRI_X2[i] == x2 and GSRI_Y2[i] == y2 then
+        return
+    endif
+    set GSRI_X1[i] = x1
+    set GSRI_Y1[i] = y1
+    set GSRI_X2[i] = x2
+    set GSRI_Y2[i] = y2
+    set GSRI_SegmentValid[i] = true
+    set z1 = GSRI_Z(x1,y1)
+    set z2 = GSRI_Z(x2,y2)
+    set zm = GSRI_Z((x1+x2)*0.5,(y1+y2)*0.5)
+    if not GSCT_Number(z1) or not GSCT_Number(z2) or not GSCT_Number(zm) or length < 0.01 or RAbsBJ(z2-z1) > 64.00 or RAbsBJ(zm-z1) > 64.00 or RAbsBJ(z2-zm) > 64.00 or RAbsBJ(zm-(z1+z2)*0.5) > 12.00 then
+        call GSRI_HideSegment(i)
+        return
+    endif
+    if not MoveLightningEx(GSRI_Effect[i],false,x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2) then
+        set GSRI_SegmentValid[i]=false
+        call GSRI_HideSegment(i)
+        return
+    endif
+    if not GSRI_SegmentShown[i] then
+        if i < GSRI_RING_LIMIT then
+            call SetLightningColor(GSRI_Effect[i],0.294,0.765,1.00,0.78)
+        else
+            call SetLightningColor(GSRI_Effect[i],0.275,1.00,0.745,0.78)
+        endif
+        set GSRI_SegmentShown[i] = true
+    endif
+endfunction

+function RAIN_RTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit h=LoadUnitHandle(RAIN_Data,k,0)
+    local unit v=LoadUnitHandle(RAIN_Data,k,1)
+    local real amount=LoadReal(RAIN_Data,k,2)
+    local integer tick=LoadInteger(RAIN_Data,k,3)
+    local integer stun=LoadInteger(RAIN_Data,k,4)
+    if not GSCT_RainCurrent(h,t,10) then
+        set h=null
+        set v=null
+        set t=null
+        return
+    endif
+    if not RAIN_Alive(h) or not RAIN_REnemy(h,v) or GetUnitState(h,UNIT_STATE_MANA)<amount then
+        call RAIN_RStop(h)
+        if RAIN_Alive(h) then
+            call IssueImmediateOrder(h,"stop")
+        endif
+    else
+        call SetUnitState(h,UNIT_STATE_MANA,GetUnitState(h,UNIT_STATE_MANA)-amount)
+        if not IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) then
+            call UnitDamageTarget(h,v,amount,false,false,ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL,DAMAGE_TYPE_NORMAL,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+        endif
+        if not GSCT_RainCurrent(h,t,10) then
+            set h=null
+            set v=null
+            set t=null
+            return
+        endif
+        if not RAIN_Alive(h) or not RAIN_REnemy(h,v) then
+            call RAIN_RStop(h)
+        else
+            call RAIN_Dummy(h,v,'ARst',stun,"thunderbolt")
+            if GSCT_RainCurrent(h,t,10) then
+                call GSCT_SyncLine(RAIN_Data,k,5,"DRAM",false,h,v,80.0,false)
+                set tick=tick+1
+                if tick>=6 then
+                    call RAIN_RStop(h)
+                else
+                    call SaveInteger(RAIN_Data,k,3,tick)
+                    call TimerStart(t,1.0,false,function RAIN_RTick)
+                endif
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set v=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function RAIN_WStop takes unit h, boolean completed returns nothing
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(h)
+    local timer t=LoadTimerHandle(RAIN_Data,sid,22)
+    local integer k
+    local unit v=null
+    local integer lv
+    if t!=null then
+        set k=GetHandleId(t)
+        set v=LoadUnitHandle(RAIN_Data,k,1)
+        set lv=LoadInteger(RAIN_Data,k,2)
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(RAIN_Data,sid,22)
+        call GSCT_ClearLine(RAIN_Data,k,4)
+        call FlushChildHashtable(RAIN_Data,k)
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+        if v!=null and GetUnitTypeId(v)!=0 then
+            call UnitRemoveAbility(v,'BRap')
+        endif
+        if completed and RAIN_Enemy(h,v) then
+            if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RR02',true)>0 then
+                set lv=lv+5
+            else
+                set lv=lv+1
+            endif
+            call RAIN_Dummy(h,v,'ARsl',lv,"slow")
+        endif
+    endif
+    set v=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function RAIN_End takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GetSpellAbilityId()=='ARr1' then
+        call RAIN_RStop(GetTriggerUnit())
+    endif
+endfunction
+function RAIN_Damage takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit v=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit h=GetEventDamageSource()
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(v)
+    local timer t=LoadTimerHandle(RAIN_Data,sid,1)
+    local real amount=GetEventDamage()
+    local real now=TimerGetElapsed(RAIN_Clock)
+    local real bonus=0.0
+    if amount>0.0 and t!=null then
+        set bonus=amount*LoadReal(RAIN_Data,GetHandleId(t),1)
+        set amount=amount+bonus
+        call BlzSetEventDamage(amount)
+    endif
+    if amount>0.0 and GetUnitTypeId(v)=='URa1' and not IsUnitIllusion(v) and GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(v),'RR05',true)>0 and now>=LoadReal(RAIN_Data,sid,30) and GetWidgetLife(v)-amount<=0.405 then
+        call SaveReal(RAIN_Data,sid,30,now+5.0)
+        call BlzSetEventDamage(0.0)
+        call RAIN_Dummy(v,v,'ARiv',1,"invisibility")
+        set h=GS177RF_Target(h)
+        if h!=v and RAIN_Alive(h) and not RAIN_Reflecting then
+            set RAIN_Reflecting=true
+            call UnitDamageTarget(v,h,amount,false,false,ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL,DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+            set RAIN_Reflecting=false
+        endif
+    endif
+    if bonus>=1.0 and GetEventDamage()>0.0 then
+        call TextTag("+"+I2S(R2I(bonus)),v,10.0,75.0,50.0,75.0,2.5)
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set v=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GS177RV_Restore takes player p returns nothing
+    local unit hero=udg_HeroPlayer[GetPlayerId(p)+1]
+    local real before
+    local real wanted=GS177RV_Expected()
+    local boolean accepted
+    if not (udg_ModeSingle or GS163_TestMode) then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,12,"시야 기본값 재적용은 싱글 또는 테스트 모드에서만 사용할 수 있습니다. -레인시야는 현재 값을 표시합니다.")
+    elseif hero==null or GetUnitTypeId(hero)!='URa1' or GetOwningPlayer(hero)!=p or not RAIN_Alive(hero) or IsUnitIllusion(hero) then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,12,"본인이 소유한 살아 있는 레인딜라가 필요합니다.")
+    else
+        set before=BlzGetUnitRealField(hero,UNIT_RF_SIGHT_RADIUS)
+        set accepted=BlzSetUnitRealField(hero,UNIT_RF_SIGHT_RADIUS,wanted)
+        if accepted then
+            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,30,"|cffffcc00[시야 재적용]|r 이전 "+R2SW(before,1,1)+" → 요청 "+R2SW(wanted,1,0)+" / 엔진 응답: 성공")
+        else
+            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,30,"|cffffcc00[시야 재적용]|r 엔진이 변경 요청을 거부했습니다. 이전 값 "+R2SW(before,1,1))
+        endif
+        call GS177RV_Show(p)
+    endif
+    set hero=null
+endfunction

+function GS191_EmperorRepair takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit u=LoadUnitHandle(GS191_Data,k,10)
+    local real remaining=GS191_EmperorRemaining(u)
+    if GSST_Live(u) and remaining>0.0 and not IsTriggerEnabled(gg_trg_Single_WTFEffect) then
+        call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u,'A0OG',remaining)
+    endif
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS191_Data,k)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    set u=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GS191_EmperorGuard takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local real remaining
+    if GetSpellAbilityId()=='A0OG' and not IsTriggerEnabled(gg_trg_Single_WTFEffect) then
+        set remaining=GS191_EmperorRemaining(u)
+        if remaining>0.05 then
+            call IssueImmediateOrder(u,"stop")
+            call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u,'A0OG',remaining)
+            if GS191_Time()>=LoadReal(GS191_Data,GetHandleId(u),2) then
+                call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(u),0,0,3,"황제의 문장 재사용까지 "+I2S(R2I(remaining)+1)+"초 남았습니다.")
+                call SaveReal(GS191_Data,GetHandleId(u),2,GS191_Time()+2.0)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set u=null
+endfunction

+function GS191_AvengerStep takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer key=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit follower=LoadUnitHandle(GS191_Data,key,400)
+    local unit target=LoadUnitHandle(GS191_Data,key,401)
+    if GSST_Live(follower) and GSST_Live(target) and GS191_Time()<LoadReal(GS191_Data,key,402) then
+        call SetUnitX(follower,GetUnitX(target))
+        call SetUnitY(follower,GetUnitY(target))
+        call SetUnitFacing(follower,GetUnitFacing(target))
+    else
+        if follower!=null and GetUnitTypeId(follower)!=0 then
+            call RemoveUnit(follower)
+        endif
+        call FlushChildHashtable(GS191_Data,key)
+        call PauseTimer(t)
+        call DestroyTimer(t)
+    endif
+    set follower=null
+    set target=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction

+function GS177FC_Tick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local effect missile=LoadEffectHandle(GS177FC_Data,k,1)
+    local player owner=LoadPlayerHandle(GS177FC_Data,k,0)
+    local real x=LoadReal(GS177FC_Data,k,2)
+    local real y=LoadReal(GS177FC_Data,k,3)
+    local real progress=LoadReal(GS177FC_Data,k,7)+LoadReal(GS177FC_Data,k,8)
+    local integer level=LoadInteger(GS177FC_Data,k,9)
+    if LoadBoolean(GS177FC_Data,k,10) then
+        if progress>=1.0 then
+            call FlushChildHashtable(GS177FC_Data,k)
+            call PauseTimer(t)
+            call DestroyTimer(t)
+            if missile!=null then
+                call DestroyEffect(missile)
+            endif
+            call GS177FC_Blast(owner,x,y,level)
+        else
+            call SaveReal(GS177FC_Data,k,7,progress)
+            if missile!=null then
+                call BlzSetSpecialEffectPosition(missile,LoadReal(GS177FC_Data,k,4)+(x-LoadReal(GS177FC_Data,k,4))*progress,LoadReal(GS177FC_Data,k,5)+(y-LoadReal(GS177FC_Data,k,5))*progress,LoadReal(GS177FC_Data,k,6))
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set missile=null
+    set owner=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GSCT_Init takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger t=CreateTrigger()

+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_CAST)

+function GS181_RainQueue takes unit caster, unit aura, integer rank returns nothing
+    local boolean allied=false
+    local timer t
+    local integer k
+    if not GS181_Live(caster) or not GS181_Live(aura) or rank<1 or rank>4 then
+        return
+    endif
+    set allied=IsUnitAlly(caster,GetOwningPlayer(aura))
+    if allied then
+        if GetRandomInt(1,100)>33 then
+            return
+        endif
+    elseif not IsUnitEnemy(caster,GetOwningPlayer(aura)) or IsUnitType(caster,UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) then
+        return
+    endif
+    if GS181_Rain==null then
+        set GS181_Rain=InitHashtable()
+    endif
+    set t=CreateTimer()
+    set k=GetHandleId(t)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS181_Rain,k,0,caster)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS181_Rain,k,1,aura)
+    call SavePlayerHandle(GS181_Rain,k,2,GetOwningPlayer(caster))
+    call SavePlayerHandle(GS181_Rain,k,3,GetOwningPlayer(aura))
+    call SaveInteger(GS181_Rain,k,4,rank)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS181_Rain,k,5,allied)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS181_Rain,k,6,GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(aura),'RR04',true)>0)
+    call TimerStart(t,0.03125,false,function GS181_RainProc)
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GS181_LeapStop takes unit h returns nothing
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(h)
+    local timer t
+    local integer k
+    local effect e
+    local real height
+    local boolean ownedInvulnerability
+    local boolean paused
+    if GS181_Leap==null then
+        return
+    endif
+    set t=LoadTimerHandle(GS181_Leap,sid,0)
+    if t==null then
+        return
+    endif
+    set k=GetHandleId(t)
+    set e=LoadEffectHandle(GS181_Leap,k,10)
+    set height=LoadReal(GS181_Leap,k,11)
+    set ownedInvulnerability=LoadBoolean(GS181_Leap,k,12)
+    set paused=LoadBoolean(GS181_Leap,k,13)
+    call RemoveSavedHandle(GS181_Leap,sid,0)
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS181_Leap,k)
+    call PauseTimer(t)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    if h!=null and GetUnitTypeId(h)!=0 then
+        call SetUnitFlyHeight(h,height,0.0)
+        call SetUnitTimeScale(h,1.0)
+        call PauseUnit(h,paused)
+        call SetUnitPathing(h,true)
+        call ResetUnitAnimation(h)
+    endif
+    if ownedInvulnerability then
+        call GS190_InvulnerabilityEnd(h)
+    endif
+    call GS181_TransitEnd(h)
+    if e!=null then
+        call DestroyEffect(e)
+    endif
+    set e=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function ItemMix takes integer index, unit u returns nothing
+    if index<=0 or u==null or GS163_MixBusy[GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))] then
+        return
+    endif
+    if StringLength(udg_ItemMix_DB[index])<3 then
+        return
+    endif
+    call GS163_ItemMixCore(index,u)
+endfunction
+function GSTF_Update takes nothing returns nothing
+    local player lp = GetLocalPlayer()
+    local player p
+    local integer pid = 0
+    local integer k = 0
+    local unit u
+    local real w = I2R(BlzGetLocalClientWidth())
+    local real h = I2R(BlzGetLocalClientHeight())
+    local real right = 0.8
+    local framehandle root = BlzGetFrameByName("GSTF_Root", 0)
+    local framehandle slot
+    if udg_MB != null and IsMultiboardDisplayed(udg_MB) and not IsMultiboardMinimized(udg_MB) then
+        call BlzFrameSetVisible(root, false)
+        set lp = null
+        set root = null
+        return
+    endif
+    call BlzFrameSetVisible(root, true)
+    if h > 0 then
+        set right = 0.4 + 0.3 * w / h
+    endif
+    if not GS1959_LayoutValid or GS1959_LayoutRight != right then
+        call BlzFrameClearAllPoints(root)
+        call BlzFrameSetAbsPoint(root, FRAMEPOINT_TOPRIGHT, right - 0.004, GSTF_Top())
+        set GS1959_LayoutRight = right
+        set GS1959_LayoutValid = true
+    endif
+    loop
+        exitwhen pid > 11 or k > 4
+        set p = Player(pid)
+        set u = udg_HeroPlayer[pid + 1]
+        if u != null and IsUnitType(u, UNIT_TYPE_HERO) and GSTF_IsTeammate(p, lp) then
+            set slot = BlzGetFrameByName("GSTF_Slot", k)
+            call BlzFrameSetVisible(slot, true)
+            call GSTF_FillSlot(k, p, u)
+            set k = k + 1
+        endif
+        set pid = pid + 1
+    endloop
+    loop
+        exitwhen k > 4
+        call BlzFrameSetVisible(BlzGetFrameByName("GSTF_Slot", k), false)
+        set k = k + 1
+    endloop
+    set lp = null
+    set p = null
+    set u = null
+    set root = null
+    set slot = null
+endfunction
+function GSPF_RefreshModes takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer k = 0
+    local framehandle b
+    local string t
+    loop
+        exitwhen k > 6
+        set b = BlzGetFrameByName("ScriptDialogButton", 7100 + k)
+        if GSPF_ModeActive(k) then
+            set t = "|cff80ff80[켜짐]|r " + GSPF_ModeLabel(k)
+        elseif GSPF_ModeBlocked(k) then
+            set t = "|cff808080[  ] " + GSPF_ModeLabel(k) + "|r |cffff6060(중복 불가)|r"
+        elseif GSPF_Bit("GSPF_Sel", k) then
+            set t = "|cffffcc00[V]|r " + GSPF_ModeLabel(k)
+        else
+            set t = "[  ] " + GSPF_ModeLabel(k)
+        endif
+        call BlzFrameSetText(b, t)
+        call BlzFrameSetEnable(b, not GSPF_ModeBlocked(k))
+        set k = k + 1
+    endloop
+    set b = null
+endfunction
+function GSPF_Confirm takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GSPF_GetState("GSPF_Done") == "1" then
+        return
+    endif
+    call GSPF_SetState("GSPF_Done", "1")
+    call BlzFrameSetVisible(BlzGetFrameByName("GSPF_ModeBox", 0), false)
+    call BlzFrameSetVisible(BlzGetFrameByName("GSPF_WaitBox", 0), false)
+    if GSPF_Bit("GSPF_Sel", 6) and not GS163_TestMode then
+        set GS163_TestMode=true
+        call DisplayTimedTextToForce(GetPlayersAll(),15,"|cffffcc00테스트 모드 활성화.|r 기존 테스트 명령을 사용할 수 있습니다. -로오로 / -만렙 마네킹 영웅명")
+    endif
+    call PauseGame(false)
+    if GSPF_Bit("GSPF_Sel", 2) and not udg_ModeSP then
+        call TriggerExecute(gg_trg_Mode_HS)
+    elseif GSPF_Bit("GSPF_Sel", 1) and not udg_ModeSP then
+        call TriggerExecute(gg_trg_Mode_SP)
+    endif
+    if GSPF_Bit("GSPF_Sel", 0) and not udg_ModeAllpick then
+        call TriggerExecute(gg_trg_Mode_AP)
+    endif
+    if GSPF_Bit("GSPF_Sel", 3) and not udg_ModeRandom and not udg_Mode3P2R then
+        call TriggerExecute(gg_trg_Mode_AR)
+    elseif GSPF_Bit("GSPF_Sel", 4) and not udg_ModeRandom and not udg_Mode3P2R then
+        call TriggerExecute(gg_trg_Mode_PR)
+    endif
+    if GSPF_Bit("GSPF_Sel", 5) and not IsTriggerEnabled(gg_trg_Damage_Test) then
+        call TriggerExecute(gg_trg_Mode_DG)
+    endif
+    call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(), 0, 0, 10, "|cffffcc00게임 모드 확정|r - 게임을 시작합니다.")
+    call GSPF_BoardTick()
+    call TimerStart(CreateTimer(), 0.1, true, function GSPF_BoardTick)
+endfunction
+function GSPF_OnHeroClick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local framehandle f = BlzGetTriggerFrame()
+    local player p = GetTriggerPlayer()
+    local integer pid = GetPlayerId(p)
+    local integer i = 0
+    local integer n = -1
+    call GSPF_DropFocus(f)
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= GSPF_HeroCount() or n >= 0
+        if f == BlzGetFrameByName("ScoreScreenBottomButtonTemplate", 7400 + i) then
+            set n = i
+        endif
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    set f = null
+    if n < 0 or GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[pid + 1]) != 0 then
+        set p = null
+        return
+    endif
+    if not GSPF_StockReady() then
+        set p = null
+        return
+    endif
+    if GSPF_TryBuy(p, n) then
+        call TriggerSleepAction(1.0)
+        if GetUnitTypeId(udg_HeroPlayer[pid + 1]) == 0 then
+            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p, 0, 0, 8, "|cffff8080구매 실패|r - 상점(정령)에서 직접 구매해 주세요.")
+        endif
+    endif
+    set p = null
+endfunction

+function GSST_TornadoTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit h=null
+    local unit d=null
+    local unit v=null
+    local rect scan=null
+    local real x
+    local real y
+    local real vx
+    local real vy
+    local real dx
+    local real dy
+    local real distance
+    local real facing
+    local real age
+    if not GSST_TornadoActive(t) then
+        set t=null
+        return
+    endif
+    set h=LoadUnitHandle(GSST_Data,k,1)
+    set d=LoadUnitHandle(GSST_Data,k,2)
+    set age=LoadReal(GSST_Data,k,6)+0.04
+    call SaveReal(GSST_Data,k,6,age)
+    if not GSST_Live(h) or not GSST_Live(d) or GetOwningPlayer(h)!=LoadPlayerHandle(GSST_Data,k,9) or age>=1.52 then
+        call GSST_TornadoEnd(t)
+    else
+        set x=GetUnitX(d)
+        set y=GetUnitY(d)
+        if not GSCT_Number(x) or not GSCT_Number(y) then
+            call GSST_TornadoEnd(t)
+        else
+            set scan=Rect(x-100.0,y-100.0,x+100.0,y+100.0)
+            call EnumDestructablesInRect(scan,null,function GSST_TornadoTrees)
+            call RemoveRect(scan)
+            set scan=null
+            if GSST_TornadoActive(t) then
+                set v=LoadUnitHandle(GSST_Data,k,3)
+                if v!=null then
+                    if not GSST_Live(v) or BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(v) or IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) or LoadTimerHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(v),201)!=t then
+                        call GSST_ReleaseOwnedPull(t)
+                    elseif GSCT_State!=null and LoadBoolean(GSCT_State,GetHandleId(v),1) then
+                        call GSST_ReleaseOwnedPull(t)
+                    else
+                        set vx=GetUnitX(v)
+                        set vy=GetUnitY(v)
+                        set facing=GetUnitFacing(v)
+                        if not GSCT_Number(vx) or not GSCT_Number(vy) or not GSCT_Number(facing) then
+                            call GSST_ReleaseOwnedPull(t)
+                        else
+                            set dx=vx-x
+                            set dy=vy-y
+                            set distance=SquareRoot(dx*dx+dy*dy)
+                            if distance>=250.0 then
+                                call GSST_ReleaseOwnedPull(t)
+                            else
+                                set distance=RMinBJ(distance,125.0)
+                                set vx=x+distance*Cos(facing*bj_DEGTORAD)
+                                set vy=y+distance*Sin(facing*bj_DEGTORAD)
+                                set vx=RMaxBJ(GetRectMinX(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)+32.0,RMinBJ(GetRectMaxX(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)-32.0,vx))
+                                set vy=RMaxBJ(GetRectMinY(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)+32.0,RMinBJ(GetRectMaxY(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)-32.0,vy))
+                                call SetUnitPosition(v,vx,vy)
+                                if GSST_TornadoActive(t) and LoadTimerHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(v),201)==t and GSST_Exists(v) then
+                                    call SetUnitFacing(v,facing+15.0)
+                                endif
+                            endif
+                        endif
+                    endif
+                endif
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set d=null
+    set v=null
+    set t=null

-
+function GS184_AsuraImpact takes timer t returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit h=LoadUnitHandle(GS184_MonkData,k,1)
+    local unit v=LoadUnitHandle(GS184_MonkData,k,2)
+    local unit bonus=null
+    local unit dummy=null
+    local item gem=null
+    local effect fx=null
+    local real dx=0.0
+    local real dy=0.0
+    local real x=0.0
+    local real y=0.0
+    local real cost=0.0
+    local real damage=0.0
+    local real mana=0.0
+    local real hp=0.0
+    if not GS184_AsuraValid(t) or LoadBoolean(GS184_MonkData,k,10) then
+        set h=null
+        set v=null
+        return
+    endif
+    call SaveBoolean(GS184_MonkData,k,10,true)
+    set dx=GetUnitX(v)-GetUnitX(h)
+    set dy=GetUnitY(v)-GetUnitY(h)
+    set cost=GetUnitState(v,UNIT_STATE_MAX_LIFE)*0.30
+    set mana=GetUnitState(h,UNIT_STATE_MANA)
+    if not GSCT_Number(dx) or not GSCT_Number(dy) or dx*dx+dy*dy>1960000.0 or not GSCT_Number(cost) or not GSCT_Number(mana) or cost<0.0 or mana<0.0 then
+        set h=null
+        set v=null
+        return
+    endif
+    set damage=RMinBJ(mana,cost)*LoadReal(GS184_MonkData,k,4)+20.0
+    set x=GetUnitX(v)+125.0*Cos(Atan2(dy,dx))
+    set y=GetUnitY(v)+125.0*Sin(Atan2(dy,dx))
+    if UnitHasItemOfTypeBJ(h,'I011') then
+        set bonus=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'ewsp',GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),270.0)
+        if GS184_AsuraCurrent(t) then
+            call SaveUnitHandle(GS184_MonkData,k,8,bonus)
+        endif
+        if GSST_Exists(bonus) then
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(bonus,'BTLF',1.0)
+            set gem=UnitAddItemById(bonus,'I011')
+            if GS184_AsuraCurrent(t) then
+                call SaveItemHandle(GS184_MonkData,k,15,gem)
+            elseif gem!=null then
+                call RemoveItem(gem)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    if GS184_AsuraValid(t) and GS184_MonkMove(h,x,y,t) and GS184_AsuraValid(t) then
+        call PlaySoundBJ(gg_snd_Monk_Asura)
+        call SetUnitAnimation(h,"attack")
+        call SetUnitState(h,UNIT_STATE_MANA,RMaxBJ(0.0,mana-cost))
+        if not GS184_AsuraValid(t) then
+            set gem=null
+            set bonus=null
+            set h=null
+            set v=null
+            return
+        endif
+        set x=GetUnitX(v)
+        set y=GetUnitY(v)
+        set hp=GetWidgetLife(v)
+        if hp>damage then
+            call SetWidgetLife(v,hp-damage)
+        else
+            call UnitRemoveBuffs(v,true,true)
+            if GS184_AsuraValid(t) then
+                call SetUnitInvulnerable(v,false)
+                call SetWidgetLife(v,1.0)
+                if GS184_AsuraValid(t) then
+                    call UnitDamageTarget(h,v,99.0,true,false,ATTACK_TYPE_HERO,DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+                endif
+            endif
+        endif
+        if GS184_AsuraCurrent(t) and GSST_Live(h) then
+            set fx=AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\ThunderClap\\ThunderClapCaster.mdl",x,y)
+            if GS184_AsuraCurrent(t) then
+                call SaveEffectHandle(GS184_MonkData,k,9,fx)
+            elseif fx!=null then
+                call DestroyEffect(fx)
+            endif
+            if GS184_AsuraCurrent(t) and GSST_Live(h) and GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'R04V',true)>0 then
+                if GSST_Live(v) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(v) and not IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) then
+                    set dummy=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'ewsp',GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),270.0)
+                    if GSST_Live(dummy) then
+                        call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy,'BTLF',3.0)
+                        if GS184_AsuraValid(t) and GSST_Live(dummy) then
+                            call UnitAddAbility(dummy,'A083')
+                        endif
+                        if GS184_AsuraValid(t) and GSST_Live(dummy) then
+                            call IssueTargetOrder(dummy,"drunkenhaze",v)
+                        endif
+                    endif
+                endif
+                if GS184_AsuraCurrent(t) and GSST_Live(h) then
+                    set dummy=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'ewsp',GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),270.0)
+                    if GSST_Live(dummy) then
+                        call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy,'BTLF',3.0)
+                        if GS184_AsuraCurrent(t) and GSST_Live(h) and GSST_Live(dummy) then
+                            call UnitAddAbility(dummy,'A08Y')
+                        endif
+                        if GS184_AsuraCurrent(t) and GSST_Live(dummy) and GSST_Live(h) then
+                            call IssueTargetOrder(dummy,"bloodlust",h)
+                        endif
+                    endif
+                endif
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set fx=null
+    set gem=null
+    set bonus=null
+    set dummy=null
+    set h=null
+    set v=null
+endfunction

+function GS2_ZigRainQueueHit takes unit dummy, integer level, real x, real y returns nothing
+    local timer t
+    local real delay
+    if GS2_ZigRainData == null then
+        set GS2_ZigRainData = InitHashtable()
+    endif
+    set delay = BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(BlzGetUnitAbility(dummy, 'A0M5'), ConvertAbilityRealLevelField('acas'), level - 1)
+    if delay < 0.01 then
+        set delay = 1.00
+    endif
+    set t = CreateTimer()
+    call SaveInteger(GS2_ZigRainData, GetHandleId(t), 0, GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(dummy)))
+    call SaveReal(GS2_ZigRainData, GetHandleId(t), 2, x)
+    call SaveReal(GS2_ZigRainData, GetHandleId(t), 3, y)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS2_ZigRainData, GetHandleId(t), 4, dummy)
+    call SaveReal(GS2_ZigRainData, GetHandleId(t), 5, 30.00 * I2R(level - 2))
+    call TimerStart(t, delay, false, function GS2_ZigRainHit)
+    set t = null
+endfunction

+    local unit d

+    call ExplodeUnitBJ(udg_Hero_LOI_Unit)

+    call SetTextTagVelocityBJ(GetLastCreatedTextTag(), 65.00, 90)
+    call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("Objects\\Spawnmodels\\Human\\HCancelDeath\\HCancelDeath.mdl", GetUnitX(udg_Hero_LOI_Unit), GetUnitY(udg_Hero_LOI_Unit)))

+    set d = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(udg_Hero_LOI_Hero), 'e01O', GetUnitX(udg_Hero_LOI_Unit), GetUnitY(udg_Hero_LOI_Unit), 0.00)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLife(d, 'BTLF', 3.00)
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevel(d, 'A0LO', udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_2)

+function GS2S_Spell takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit target = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local integer abilityId = GetSpellAbilityId()
+    local integer level
+    local unit dummy
+    local real cooldown
+    if not GS2S_IsHero(u) then
+        set u = null
+        set target = null
+        return
+    endif
+    call GroupAddUnit(GS2S_Heroes, u)
+    if abilityId == 'A052' then
+        call GS2S_PotionLaunch(u, GetSpellTargetX(), GetSpellTargetY())
+    elseif abilityId == 'A0PW' and target != null and IsUnitEnemy(target, GetOwningPlayer(u)) then
+        set level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A0PW')
+        set dummy = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(u), 'ewsp', GetUnitX(target), GetUnitY(target), 0.00)
+        call SetUnitState(dummy, UNIT_STATE_MANA, 1000.00)
+        if GetRandomInt(1, 100) <= 50 then
+            call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'A11D')
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, 'A11D', level)
+            call IssueTargetOrderBJ(dummy, "curse", target)
+        else
+            call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'A12K')
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, 'A12K', level)
+            call IssueTargetOrderBJ(dummy, "soulburn", target)
+        endif
+        call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 2.00)
+    elseif abilityId == 'A0PK' and GetUnitTypeId(u) == 'Nalc' then
+        set level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(u, 'A0PK')
+        if level == 1 then
+            set cooldown = 80.00
+        elseif level == 2 then
+            set cooldown = 55.00
+        else
+            set cooldown = 30.00
+        endif
+        call GS117_ResetUnitCooldowns(u)
+        call BlzStartUnitAbilityCooldown(u, 'A0PK', cooldown)
+    elseif target != null and IsUnitEnemy(target, GetOwningPlayer(u)) and (GS2S_ItemSpell(u, abilityId) or (LoadInteger(GS2S_Data,GetHandleId(u),StringHash("itemCastAbility"))==abilityId and LoadUnitHandle(GS2S_Data,GetHandleId(u),StringHash("itemCastTarget"))==target)) then
+        call GS2S_ItemBonus(u,target,LoadItemHandle(GS2S_Data,GetHandleId(u),StringHash("orderedItem"))!=null and LoadUnitHandle(GS2S_Data,GetHandleId(u),StringHash("orderedItemTarget"))==target)
+    endif
+    call RemoveSavedInteger(GS2S_Data,GetHandleId(u),StringHash("itemCastAbility"))
+    call RemoveSavedHandle(GS2S_Data,GetHandleId(u),StringHash("itemCastTarget"))
+    set dummy = null
+    set target = null
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function SP174_Hit takes unit h, unit v, real amount, boolean burst returns nothing
+    local real before
+    local real applied
+    if not SP172_Alive(h) or not SP172_Enemy(h,v) then
+        return
+    endif
+    set before=GetWidgetLife(v)
+    call SP172_Damage(h,v,amount)
+    set applied=RMaxBJ(0.0,before-RMaxBJ(0.0,GetWidgetLife(v)))
+    if applied>0.005 then
+        call SP174_Float(v,applied,burst)
+    endif
+    if burst then
+        call SP174_Burst(v)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function SP188_QExhaust takes unit h returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    local unit v=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,1)
+    local integer lv=LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,2)
+    if not LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,9) and SP172_Trait(h,'RSpQ') and SP172_Enemy(h,v) then
+        call SaveBoolean(SP172_Data,k,9,true)
+        call SP172_Damage(h,v,70.0+30.0*I2R(lv))
+    endif
+    set v=null
+endfunction
+function SP172_QStop takes unit h, boolean burst returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    local unit v=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,1)
+    local integer lv=LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,2)
+    local lightning wire=LoadLightningHandle(SP172_Data,k,5)
+    local texttag tag=LoadTextTagHandle(SP172_Data,k,6)
+    local boolean proc=burst and SP172_Trait(h,'RSpQ') and not LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,9)
+    call RemoveSavedHandle(SP172_Data,k,1)
+    call RemoveSavedBoolean(SP172_Data,k,9)
+    call RemoveSavedReal(SP172_Data,k,4)
+    call SaveReal(SP172_Data,k,8,0.0)
+    if wire!=null then
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(SP172_Data,k,5)
+        call DestroyLightning(wire)
+    endif
+    if tag!=null then
+        call DestroyTextTag(tag)
+        call RemoveSavedHandle(SP172_Data,k,6)
+    endif
+    if proc then
+        call SP172_Damage(h,v,70.0+30.0*I2R(lv))
+    endif
+    set v=null
+    set wire=null
+    set tag=null
+endfunction

+function SP172_QCommand takes unit h, boolean pull returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    local unit v=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,1)
+    local integer n=LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,3)
+    local integer lv=LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,2)
+    if SP172_Enemy(h,v) and n>0 and LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,8)<=0.0 and SP172_Time<LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,4) and SP172_Distance(h,v)<2000.0 then
+        call SaveBoolean(SP172_Data,k,7,pull)
+        call SaveReal(SP172_Data,k,8,50.0+50.0*I2R(lv))
+        call SaveInteger(SP172_Data,k,3,n-1)
+        call SP172_QLabel(h)
+        call SP172_Damage(h,v,20.0+20.0*I2R(lv))
+    elseif v==null or not SP172_Enemy(h,v) then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(h),0,0,3,"먼저 Q로 적을 연결해야 당기기/따라가기를 사용할 수 있습니다.")
+    endif
+    set v=null
+endfunction
+function SP175_OwnerStatus takes unit h, unit q, unit r1, unit r2 returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    if not SP172_Alive(h) then
+        return
+    endif
+    if SP172_Enemy(h,q) and SP172_Time<LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,4) then
+        call SP173_Mark(h,'AScQ')
+    endif
+    if LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,24) and SP172_Time<LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,23) then
+        if SP172_Enemy(h,r1) or (r2!=h and SP172_Enemy(h,r2)) then
+            call SP173_Mark(h,'AScR')
+        endif
+    endif
+    if GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpE')>0 then
+        if SP172_EStacks(h,q)>0 or SP172_EStacks(h,r1)>0 or SP172_EStacks(h,r2)>0 then
+            call SP173_Mark(h,'AScE')
+        endif
+    endif
+endfunction
+function DWT_Area takes unit h, real x, real y, real radius, real damage, integer sl, real strength, real duration, integer serial returns nothing
+    local group g=CreateGroup()
+    local unit v
+    call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(g,x,y,radius+192.0,null)
+    loop
+        set v=FirstOfGroup(g)
+        exitwhen v==null
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(g,v)
+        if IsUnitInRangeXY(v,x,y,radius) and GS2DW_Valid(v,h,false) then
+            if damage>0.0 then
+                set DWT_Dealt=false
+                call UnitDamageTarget(h,v,damage,false,false,ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL,DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+                if DWT_Dealt then
+                    if sl==9 then
+                        call DW160_Hit(h,v,2,serial)
+                    elseif sl==11 then
+                        call DW160_Hit(h,v,3,serial)
+                    endif
+                endif
+            endif
+            call DWT_Slow(h,v,sl,strength,duration)
+        endif
+    endloop
+    call DestroyGroup(g)
+    set g=null
+    set v=null
+endfunction
+function GS2DW_Damage takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit s=GetEventDamageSource()
+    local unit v=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit h
+    local timer t
+    local integer k
+    if GetEventDamage()>0.0 then
+        set DWT_Dealt=true
+        if GetUnitTypeId(s)=='HDr1' and BlzGetEventIsAttack() then
+            call DW160_Attack(s,v)
+        endif
+        if GetUnitTypeId(s)=='dDr1' then
+            set h=LoadUnitHandle(GS2DW_Data,GetHandleId(s),0)
+            if h!=null and GS2DW_Valid(v,h,true) and not LoadBoolean(GS2DW_Data,GetHandleId(s),GetHandleId(v)) then
+                call SaveBoolean(GS2DW_Data,GetHandleId(s),GetHandleId(v),true)
+                call DW160_Hit(h,v,4,GetHandleId(s))
+                call GS2DW_Dummy(h,v,'ADf1',1,852095)
+                if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RD05',true)>0 then
+                    set t=CreateTimer()
+                    set k=GetHandleId(t)
+                    call SaveUnitHandle(DWT_Data,k,0,h)
+                    call SaveUnitHandle(DWT_Data,k,1,v)
+                    call TimerStart(t,1.0,false,function DWT_BreathSlow)
+                endif
+            endif
+        elseif GetUnitTypeId(s)=='HDr1' and not BlzGetEventIsAttack() and LoadReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(s),GetHandleId(v))>=TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime) then
+            call RemoveSavedReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(s),GetHandleId(v))
+            call DW160_Hit(s,v,1,LoadInteger(GS107_Data,GetHandleId(s),12))
+        endif
+    endif
+    set s=null
+    set v=null
+    set h=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction

+function GS114S_Spell takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer aid = GetSpellAbilityId()
+    local integer k = GetHandleId(h)
+    local integer band
+    local unit v = GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local unit a
+    local unit b
+    local real face
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h) != 'USa1' then
+        set h = null
+        set v = null
+        return
+    endif
+    set band = GS114S_Band(h)
+    if aid == 'ASf1' then
+        call GS121_Fire(h,GetSpellTargetX(),GetSpellTargetY())
+    elseif aid == 'ASx1' then
+        call GS114S_StopSiege(h)
+        call IssueImmediateOrder(h, "stop")
+    elseif aid == 'ASs1' then
+        if v != null and v != h and GetWidgetLife(v) > 0.405 and IsUnitAlly(v, GetOwningPlayer(h)) then
+            call SetUnitState(v, UNIT_STATE_MANA, GetUnitState(v, UNIT_STATE_MANA) + 75.0 + 75.0 * I2R(band))
+            call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Items\\AIma\\AImaTarget.mdl", v, "origin"))
+        endif
+    elseif aid == 'ASg1' then
+        call GS114S_StopSiege(h)
+        set face = GetUnitFacing(h) * bj_DEGTORAD
+        set a = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h), 'uSa1', GetUnitX(h) + 110.0 * Cos(face + 1.57), GetUnitY(h) + 110.0 * Sin(face + 1.57), GetUnitFacing(h))
+        set b = CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h), 'uSa1', GetUnitX(h) + 110.0 * Cos(face - 1.57), GetUnitY(h) + 110.0 * Sin(face - 1.57), GetUnitFacing(h))
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GS114S_Data, k, 21, a)
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GS114S_Data, k, 22, b)
+        call GS121_SiegeReady(h)
+    elseif GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h), 'RS02', true) > 0 and GS114S_Enemy(v, h) and (GS114S_ItemSkill(h,aid) or (LoadUnitHandle(GS114S_Data,k,StringHash("orderedItemTarget"))==v and LoadBoolean(GS2S_ItemData,LoadInteger(GS114S_Data,k,StringHash("orderedItemType")),aid))) then
+        call GS114S_ItemBonus(h,v,LoadItemHandle(GS114S_Data,k,StringHash("orderedItem"))!=null and LoadUnitHandle(GS114S_Data,k,StringHash("orderedItemTarget"))==v)
+    endif
+    set h = null
+    set v = null
+    set a = null
+    set b = null
+endfunction
+function GSRI_Line takes real x1, real y1, real x2, real y2 returns nothing
+    local real dx = x2-x1
+    local real dy = y2-y1
+    local integer n=0
+    local integer j = 0
+    if not GSCT_Number(x1) or not GSCT_Number(y1) or not GSCT_Number(x2) or not GSCT_Number(y2) then
+        return
+    endif
+    set n=R2I(SquareRoot(dx*dx+dy*dy)/48.00)+1
+    if n>512 then
+        return
+    endif
+    loop
+        exitwhen j >= n
+        call GSRI_Segment(x1+dx*j/n,y1+dy*j/n,x1+dx*(j+1)/n,y1+dy*(j+1)/n)
+        set j = j+1
+    endloop
+endfunction
+function GSRI_OnMouse takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GetTriggerPlayer() != GetLocalPlayer() then
+        return
+    endif
+    if GetTriggerEventId() == EVENT_PLAYER_MOUSE_MOVE then
+        set GSRI_MouseX = BlzGetTriggerPlayerMouseX()
+        set GSRI_MouseY = BlzGetTriggerPlayerMouseY()
+        set GSRI_MouseValid = true
+    else
+        set GSRI_Reason = "mouse click"
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+        if BlzGetTriggerPlayerMouseButton() == MOUSE_BUTTON_TYPE_LEFT and GSRI_LastHover >= 0 then
+            set GSRI_PendingSlot = GSRI_LastHover
+        endif
+    endif
+endfunction

+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+    endif
+endfunction

+        endif
+        if GetEventPlayerChatString() == "-range off" then
+            set GSRI_PendingSlot = -1
+            set GSRI_Enabled = false
+            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(),0,0,5,"범위 표시 OFF")
+        elseif GetEventPlayerChatString() == "-range on" then
+            set GSRI_Enabled = true
+            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(),0,0,5,"범위 표시 ON")
+        endif
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+    endif
+endfunction
+function RAIN_WTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit h=LoadUnitHandle(RAIN_Data,k,0)
+    local unit v=LoadUnitHandle(RAIN_Data,k,1)
+    local integer ticks=LoadInteger(RAIN_Data,k,3)+1
+    local real before
+    local real drained
+    if not GSCT_RainCurrent(h,t,22) then
+        set h=null
+        set v=null
+        set t=null
+        return
+    endif
+    if not RAIN_Alive(h) or not RAIN_Enemy(h,v) or not IsUnitInRange(h,v,700.0) or BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(v) then
+        call RAIN_WStop(h,false)
+    else
+        call GSCT_SyncLine(RAIN_Data,k,4,"DRAL",false,h,v,70.0,false)
+        call SaveInteger(RAIN_Data,k,3,ticks)
+        if ModuloInteger(ticks,20)==0 then
+            set before=GetWidgetLife(v)
+            call UnitDamageTarget(h,v,10.0+10.0*I2R(LoadInteger(RAIN_Data,k,2)),false,false,ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL,DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
+            if not GSCT_RainCurrent(h,t,22) then
+                set h=null
+                set v=null
+                set t=null
+                return
+            endif
+            set drained=RMaxBJ(0.0,before-RMaxBJ(0.0,GetWidgetLife(v)))
+            if RAIN_Alive(h) then
+                call SetWidgetLife(h,GetWidgetLife(h)+drained)
+            endif
+        endif
+        if not RAIN_Alive(h) or not RAIN_Enemy(h,v) then
+            call RAIN_WStop(h,false)
+        elseif ticks>=60 then
+            call RAIN_WStop(h,true)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set v=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GS163_TestChat takes nothing returns nothing
+    local player p=GetTriggerPlayer()
+    local string s=GetEventPlayerChatString()
+    local integer leader=0
+    if s=="-테스트" or s=="-테스트모드" then
+        loop
+            exitwhen leader>=12
+            exitwhen GetPlayerController(Player(leader))==MAP_CONTROL_USER and GetPlayerSlotState(Player(leader))==PLAYER_SLOT_STATE_PLAYING
+            set leader=leader+1
+        endloop
+        if GetPlayerId(p)==leader and TimerGetElapsed(GS163_TestClock)<=120.0 then
+            set GS163_TestMode=true
+            call DisplayTimedTextToForce(GetPlayersAll(),15,"|cffffcc00[테스트 모드]|r 싱글 테스트 명령어와 만렙 마네킹을 사용할 수 있습니다. -아군 이름으로 아군 마네킹 생성·제어, -동맹으로 양쪽 마네킹 제어권을 활성화합니다.")
+        else
+            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,8,"시작 120초 이내, 참가자 중 가장 앞 슬롯의 사람이 -테스트로 활성화할 수 있습니다.")
+        endif
+    elseif s=="-다로진단" then
+        call GS181_FlakShow(p)
+    elseif s=="-거미시야" then
+        call GS180_SpiderSightShow(p)
+    elseif s=="-거미시야복구" then
+        call GS180_SpiderSightRestore(p)
+    elseif s=="-레인시야" then
+        call GS177RV_Show(p)
+    elseif s=="-레인시야복구" then
+        call GS177RV_Restore(p)
+    elseif s=="-로오로" then
+        call GS177_SpawnRoro(p)
+    elseif udg_ModeSingle or GS163_TestMode then
+        if SubString(s,0,18)=="-만렙 마네킹 " then
+            call GS163_SpawnDummy(p,SubString(s,18,StringLength(s)),false,true)
+        elseif SubString(s,0,15)=="-만렙 아군 " then
+            call GS163_SpawnDummy(p,SubString(s,15,StringLength(s)),true,true)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set p=null
+endfunction
+function GS166_Event takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer tech=GetResearched()
+    if GetTriggerEventId()==EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_RESEARCH_FINISH then
+        if tech=='R09X' or tech=='R04W' then
+            call GS166_Track(udg_HeroPlayer[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))])
+        endif
+    elseif GetTriggerEventId()==EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SELL then
+        call GS166_Track(GetSoldUnit())
+    else
+        call GS166_Track(u)
+    endif
+    set u=null
 endfunction

+function GS191_EmperorBegin takes unit u returns boolean
+    local item it=null
+    local timer t=null
+    local real ends
+    if IsTriggerEnabled(gg_trg_Single_WTFEffect) then
+        return true
+    endif
+    if GS191_EmperorRemaining(u)>0.05 then
+        return false
+    endif
+    set ends=GS191_Time()+240.0
+    set it=GS191_Emblem(u)
+    call SaveReal(GS191_Data,GetHandleId(u),1,ends)
+    if it!=null then
+        call SaveReal(GS191_Data,GetHandleId(it),1,ends)
+    endif
+    set t=CreateTimer()
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS191_Data,GetHandleId(t),10,u)
+    call TimerStart(t,0.10,false,function GS191_EmperorRepair)
+    set t=null
+    set it=null
+    return true
+endfunction
+function GS191_EmperorPickup takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local item it=GetManipulatedItem()
+    local timer t

+        set t=CreateTimer()
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GS191_Data,GetHandleId(t),10,u)
+        call TimerStart(t,0.10,false,function GS191_EmperorRepair)
+        set t=null
+    endif
+    set u=null
+    set it=null
+endfunction

+endfunction
+function GS177FC_Start takes unit caster, real x, real y, integer level returns nothing
+    local timer t
+    local integer k
+    local real sx=GetUnitX(caster)
+    local real sy=GetUnitY(caster)
+    local real distance=SquareRoot((x-sx)*(x-sx)+(y-sy)*(y-sy))
+    local effect missile
+    if caster==null or level<1 or level>3 then
+        return
+    endif
+    if GS177FC_Data==null then
+        set GS177FC_Data=InitHashtable()
+    endif
+    set t=CreateTimer()
+    set k=GetHandleId(t)
+    set missile=AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Weapons\\GyroCopter\\GyroCopterMissile.mdl",sx,sy)
+    if missile!=null then
+        call BlzSetSpecialEffectYaw(missile,Atan2(y-sy,x-sx))
+        call BlzSetSpecialEffectPosition(missile,sx,sy,BlzGetUnitZ(caster)+60.0)
+    endif
+    call SavePlayerHandle(GS177FC_Data,k,0,GetOwningPlayer(caster))
+    call SaveEffectHandle(GS177FC_Data,k,1,missile)
+    call SaveReal(GS177FC_Data,k,2,x)
+    call SaveReal(GS177FC_Data,k,3,y)
+    call SaveReal(GS177FC_Data,k,4,sx)
+    call SaveReal(GS177FC_Data,k,5,sy)
+    call SaveReal(GS177FC_Data,k,6,BlzGetUnitZ(caster)+60.0)
+    call SaveReal(GS177FC_Data,k,7,0.0)
+    call SaveReal(GS177FC_Data,k,8,2300.0*0.03125/RMaxBJ(1.0,distance))
+    call SaveInteger(GS177FC_Data,k,9,level)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS177FC_Data,k,10,true)
+    call TimerStart(t,0.03125,true,function GS177FC_Tick)
+    set missile=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GS181_LeapTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local unit h=LoadUnitHandle(GS181_Leap,k,0)
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(h)
+    local integer step=LoadInteger(GS181_Leap,k,8)+1
+    local integer phase=LoadInteger(GS181_Leap,k,9)
+    local real distance=LoadReal(GS181_Leap,k,4)
+    local real angle=LoadReal(GS181_Leap,k,5)
+    local real progress
+    local real x
+    local real y
+    local integer rank
+    if h==null or LoadTimerHandle(GS181_Leap,sid,0)!=t then
+        set h=null
+        set t=null
+        return
+    endif
+    if not GS181_Live(h) then
+        call GS181_LeapStop(h)
+    elseif phase==2 then
+        set rank=LoadInteger(GS181_Leap,k,14)
+        set x=GetUnitX(h)+100.0*Cos(LoadReal(GS181_Leap,k,6))
+        set y=GetUnitY(h)+100.0*Sin(LoadReal(GS181_Leap,k,6))
+        call GS181_LeapStop(h)
+        if GS181_Live(h) then
+            call GS181_LeapImpact(h,rank,x,y)
+        endif
+    else
+        if phase==0 then
+            set progress=I2R(step)/21.43
+        else
+            set progress=1.0/1.43+I2R(step)/33.33
+        endif
+        set x=LoadReal(GS181_Leap,k,2)+distance*progress*Cos(angle)
+        set y=LoadReal(GS181_Leap,k,3)+distance*progress*Sin(angle)
+        set x=RMaxBJ(GetRectMinX(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)+32.0,RMinBJ(GetRectMaxX(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)-32.0,x))
+        set y=RMaxBJ(GetRectMinY(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)+32.0,RMinBJ(GetRectMaxY(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)-32.0,y))
+        call SetUnitPosition(h,x,y)
+        if LoadTimerHandle(GS181_Leap,sid,0)==t then
+            if phase==0 and step==2 then
+                call SetUnitTimeScale(h,0.10)
+            endif
+            if phase==0 and step>=15 then
+                call SetUnitFlyHeight(h,LoadReal(GS181_Leap,k,11),distance*1.50)
+                call SaveInteger(GS181_Leap,k,8,0)
+                call SaveInteger(GS181_Leap,k,9,1)
+            elseif phase==1 and step>=10 then
+                call SaveInteger(GS181_Leap,k,9,2)
+                call SetUnitTimeScale(h,1.30)
+                call TimerStart(t,0.05,false,function GS181_LeapTick)
+            else
+                call SaveInteger(GS181_Leap,k,8,step)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GSTF_Start takes nothing returns nothing

+    call TimerStart(CreateTimer(), 0.1, true, function GSTF_Update)

+function GSPF_OnModeClick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local framehandle f = BlzGetTriggerFrame()
+    local integer pid = GetPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer())
+    local integer k = 0
+    call GSPF_DropFocus(f)
+    if GSPF_GetState("GSPF_Done") == "1" then
+        set f = null
+        return
+    endif
+    if pid != GSPF_HostId() then
+        set f = null
+        return
+    endif
+    if f == BlzGetFrameByName("ScriptDialogButton", 7200) then
+        set f = null
+        call GSPF_Confirm()
+        return
+    endif
+    loop
+        exitwhen k > 6
+        if f == BlzGetFrameByName("ScriptDialogButton", 7100 + k) and not GSPF_ModeBlocked(k) then
+            call GSPF_SetBit("GSPF_Sel", k, not GSPF_Bit("GSPF_Sel", k))
+        endif
+        set k = k + 1
+    endloop
+    call GSPF_RefreshModes()
+    set f = null
+endfunction
+function GSPF_OnLeave takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GSPF_GetState("GSPF_Done") == "1" then
+        return
+    endif
+    if GetPlayerId(GetTriggerPlayer()) == GSPF_HostId() then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(), 0, 0, 10, "1픽이 나가서 모드 없이 진행합니다.")
+        call GSPF_SetState("GSPF_Sel", "0000000")
+        call GSPF_Confirm()
+    endif
+endfunction

+function Trig_Named_Creep_Killing_RoRo_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit killer=GetKillingUnit()
+    local player owner=null
+    local player winner=null
+    local player enemy=null
+    if killer==null then
+        return
+    endif
+    set owner=GetOwningPlayer(killer)
+    if IsPlayerAlly(owner,udg_Force[1]) then
+        set winner=udg_Force[1]
+        set enemy=udg_Force[2]
+    elseif IsPlayerAlly(owner,udg_Force[2]) then
+        set winner=udg_Force[2]
+        set enemy=udg_Force[1]
+    else
+        set killer=null
+        set owner=null
+        return
+    endif
+    call PolledWait(0.40)
+    if enemy==udg_Force[2] then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToForce(GetPlayersAll(),3.00,"|cffffcc00다크니스|r 진영의 영웅의 시야가 |cffffcc0090|r 초 간 공유됩니다!")
+    else
+        call DisplayTimedTextToForce(GetPlayersAll(),3.00,"|cffffcc00가디언|r 진영의 영웅의 시야가 |cffffcc0090|r 초 간 공유됩니다!")
+    endif
+    call GS176_RoroStart(winner,enemy)
+    set killer=null
+    set owner=null
+    set winner=null
+    set enemy=null
+endfunction

+function GS163_ScanMix takes unit u returns nothing
+    local integer pass=0
+    local integer before=0
+    local integer slot=0
+    local item it=null
+    loop
+        set before=GS163_MixSerial
+        call ItemMix(188,u)
+        call ItemMix(189,u)
+        set slot=0
+        loop
+            exitwhen slot>=6
+            set it=UnitItemInSlot(u,slot)
+            if it!=null then
+                call ItemMix(GetItemUserData(it),u)
+            endif
+            set slot=slot+1
+        endloop
+        set pass=pass+1
+        exitwhen before==GS163_MixSerial or pass>=32
+    endloop
+    set it=null
+endfunction
+function Trig_ItemMix_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local item it=null
+    local integer n=0
+    local integer pass=0
+    local integer before=0
+    loop
+        exitwhen n>5
+        set it=UnitItemInSlot(u,n)
+        if it!=null then
+            call SetItemLifeBJ(it,500.0)
+            call SetItemUserData(it,R2I(GetItemLifeBJ(it)))
+        endif
+        set n=n+1
+    endloop
+    loop
+        set before=GS163_MixSerial
+        call ItemMix(188,u)
+        call ItemMix(189,u)
+        set n=0
+        loop
+            exitwhen n>5
+            set it=UnitItemInSlot(u,n)
+            if it!=null then
+                call ItemMix(GetItemUserData(it),u)
+            endif
+            set n=n+1
+        endloop
+        set pass=pass+1
+        exitwhen before==GS163_MixSerial or pass>=32
+    endloop
+    set it=null
+    set u=null
+endfunction
+function Trig_Pack_Horse_Give_Mix_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit t = udg_PackHorseT
+    local integer a=0
+    loop
+    exitwhen a>6
+    call SetItemLifeBJ( UnitItemInSlotBJ(t, a), 500.00 )
+    call SetItemUserData( UnitItemInSlotBJ(t, a), R2I(GetItemLifeBJ(UnitItemInSlotBJ(t, a))) )
+    set a = a+1
+    endloop
+    set a = 0
+    call ItemMix(188, t)
+    call ItemMix(189, t)
+    if StringLength(udg_ItemMix_DB[GetItemUserData(udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(t))])]) > 0 then
+    call ItemMix(GetItemUserData(udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(t))]), t)
+    endif
+    loop
+    exitwhen a>6
+    if StringLength(udg_ItemMix_DB[GetItemUserData(UnitItemInSlotBJ(t, a))]) > 0 then
+    call ItemMix(GetItemUserData(UnitItemInSlotBJ(t, a)), t)
+    endif
+    set a = a+1
+    endloop
+endfunction
+function Trig_Emperor_Sign_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    if ( Trig_Emperor_Sign_Func001C() ) then
+        return
+    else
+    endif

+        call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0P0', udg_Hero_DaT )
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped( 'A0P0', udg_Hero_DaT, GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0PC', udg_Hero_DaT) )
+        call PauseTimerBJ( true, udg_Hero_DaT_UltiTimer )
+        set udg_Hero_DaT = null
+    else
+    endif
+    if not GS191_EmperorBegin(GetSpellAbilityUnit()) then
+        return
+    endif
+    call GS117_ResetUnitCooldowns( GetSpellAbilityUnit() )
+    call GS115_DeferItem(GetSpellAbilityUnit(), null, 'A0OG')
+    set bj_forLoopBIndex = 1
+    set bj_forLoopBIndexEnd = 6

+        exitwhen bj_forLoopBIndex > bj_forLoopBIndexEnd

+            call SetItemDroppableBJ( UnitItemInSlotBJ(GetTriggerUnit(), GetForLoopIndexB()), true )
+        else
+        endif
+        set bj_forLoopBIndex = bj_forLoopBIndex + 1
+    endloop
+    call TextTag( "쿨다운 초기화!" , GetTriggerUnit() ,  10 , 255 , 255 , 150 , 3 )
+endfunction

+function GSST_TornadoStart takes unit h, real targetX, real targetY returns nothing
+    local real x=GetUnitX(h)
+    local real y=GetUnitY(h)
+    local real angle
+    local integer level=GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'A0VR')
+    local unit d=null
+    local timer t=null
+    local integer k
+    if not GSST_Live(h) or level<1 or level>4 or not GSCT_Number(x) or not GSCT_Number(y) or not GSCT_Number(targetX) or not GSCT_Number(targetY) then
+        return
+    endif
+    call GSST_Ensure()
+    set angle=Atan2(targetY-y,targetX-x)
+    set targetX=x+700.0*Cos(angle)
+    set targetY=y+700.0*Sin(angle)
+    set targetX=RMaxBJ(GetRectMinX(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)+32.0,RMinBJ(GetRectMaxX(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)-32.0,targetX))
+    set targetY=RMaxBJ(GetRectMinY(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)+32.0,RMinBJ(GetRectMaxY(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)-32.0,targetY))
+    set d=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'e00U',targetX,targetY,bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    if d!=null then
+        call UnitApplyTimedLife(d,'BTLF',1.50)
+        set t=CreateTimer()
+        set k=GetHandleId(t)
+        call SaveBoolean(GSST_Data,k,0,true)
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GSST_Data,k,1,h)
+        call SaveUnitHandle(GSST_Data,k,2,d)
+        call SaveGroupHandle(GSST_Data,k,4,CreateGroup())
+        call SaveInteger(GSST_Data,k,5,level)
+        call SaveReal(GSST_Data,k,6,0.0)
+        call SavePlayerHandle(GSST_Data,k,9,GetOwningPlayer(h))
+        call SaveTimerHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(d),200,t)
+        call IssuePointOrder(d,"move",x,y)
+        call GS2_AuditRangeRegister(gg_trg_Tonado_Unit,125.0,d)
+        if GSST_TornadoActive(t) then
+            call TimerStart(t,0.04,true,function GSST_TornadoTick)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set d=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function Trig_Tonado_Unit_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    if GSST_Data!=null and GSST_RangeAnchor!=null then
+        call GSST_TornadoTouch(LoadTimerHandle(GSST_Data,GetHandleId(GSST_RangeAnchor),200),GetTriggerUnit())
+    endif
+endfunction

+function GS184_AsuraTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t=GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local integer step=0
+    local unit h=null
+    if not GS184_AsuraCurrent(t) then
+        call GS184_AsuraEnd(t)
+        set t=null
+        return
+    endif
+    set h=LoadUnitHandle(GS184_MonkData,k,1)
+    set step=LoadInteger(GS184_MonkData,k,6)+1
+    if not GSST_Live(h) or GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(h))!=LoadInteger(GS184_MonkData,k,3) or (step<=2 and not GS184_AsuraValid(t)) then
+        call GS184_AsuraEnd(t)
+    else
+        call SaveInteger(GS184_MonkData,k,6,step)
+        call GS184_AsuraLetter(t,step)
+        if step==2 then
+            call GS184_AsuraImpact(t)
+        endif
+        if step>=5 and GS184_AsuraCurrent(t) then
+            call GS184_AsuraEnd(t)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction

+function Trig_PhM_Speical_Timer_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit anchor = null
+    local real bx = 0.00
+    local real by = 0.00
+    local real face = 0.00
+    if ( Trig_PhM_Speical_Timer_Func001C() ) then
+        set anchor = udg_Hero_PhM_Ultunit
+    else
+        set anchor = udg_Hero_PhM
+    endif
+    set bx = GetUnitX(anchor)
+    set by = GetUnitY(anchor)
+    set face = GetUnitFacing(anchor)
+    call SetUnitX(udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit1, bx + 120.00 * Cos((face - 180.00) * bj_DEGTORAD))
+    call SetUnitY(udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit1, by + 120.00 * Sin((face - 180.00) * bj_DEGTORAD))
+    call SetUnitX(udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit2, bx + 120.00 * Cos((face - 140.00) * bj_DEGTORAD))
+    call SetUnitY(udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit2, by + 120.00 * Sin((face - 140.00) * bj_DEGTORAD))
+    call SetUnitX(udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit3, bx + 120.00 * Cos((face - 220.00) * bj_DEGTORAD))
+    call SetUnitY(udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit3, by + 120.00 * Sin((face - 220.00) * bj_DEGTORAD))
+    if ( Trig_PhM_Speical_Timer_Func002C() ) then
+        call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit1, "stop" )
+        call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit2, "stop" )
+        call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit3, "stop" )
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_PhM_Speical_Timer_Func003C() ) then
+        call SetUnitFacingToFaceUnitTimed( udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit1, udg_Hero_PhM, 0.20 )
+        call SetUnitFacingToFaceUnitTimed( udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit2, udg_Hero_PhM, 0.20 )
+        call SetUnitFacingToFaceUnitTimed( udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit3, udg_Hero_PhM, 0.20 )
+    else
+    endif
+    if ( Trig_PhM_Speical_Timer_Func004C() ) then
+        call KillUnit( udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit1 )
+        call KillUnit( udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit2 )
+        call KillUnit( udg_Hero_PhM_Spunit3 )
+        call PauseTimerBJ( true, udg_Hero_PhM_SpTimer )
+    else
+    endif
+    set anchor = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_AbW_Ulti_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit follower=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local unit caster=udg_HeroPlayer[GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(follower))+1]
+    if caster==null or GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster,'A0KZ')==0 then
+        set caster=udg_Hero_AbW
+    endif
+    call UnitApplyTimedLife(follower,'BTLF',10.0)
+    if GSST_Live(caster) and GetOwningPlayer(caster)==GetOwningPlayer(follower) then
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(follower,'A12O',GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster,'A0KZ'))
+        call GS191_AvengerBind(follower,caster)
+    endif
+    set caster=null
+    set follower=null
+endfunction

+function GS2_ZigRainSecond takes nothing returns nothing
+    local timer t = GetExpiredTimer()
+    local integer id = GetHandleId(t)
+    local player owner = Player(LoadInteger(GS2_ZigRainData, id, 0))
+    local integer level = LoadInteger(GS2_ZigRainData, id, 1)
+    local real x = LoadReal(GS2_ZigRainData, id, 2)
+    local real y = LoadReal(GS2_ZigRainData, id, 3)
+    local unit dummy = CreateUnit(owner, 'e00Q', x, y, bj_UNIT_FACING)
+    call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'Aloc')
+    call SetUnitMoveSpeed(dummy, 0.00)
+    call SetUnitPathing(dummy, false)
+    call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy, 'BTLF', 15.00)
+    call UnitAddAbility(dummy, 'A0M5')
+    call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy, 'A0M5', level)
+    call IssuePointOrder(dummy, "rainoffire", x, y)
+    call GS2_ZigRainQueueHit(dummy, level, x, y)
+    call FlushChildHashtable(GS2_ZigRainData, id)
+    call PauseTimer(t)
+    call DestroyTimer(t)
+    set dummy = null
+    set owner = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GS2_HellProcessTarget takes unit t returns nothing
+    local integer ty = GetUnitTypeId(t)
+    if not GS2_HellValidTarget(t) then
+        return
+    endif
+    if IsUnitType(t, UNIT_TYPE_HERO) or ty == 'n01U' or ty == 'u000' or ty == 'u001' or ty == 'u002' or ty == 'u005' or ty == 'u006' or ty == 'u007' or ty == 'o00N' or ty == 'o00O' or ty == 'o00P' then
+        call GS2_HellDetonate()
+        return
+    endif
+    if GS2_HellCanPierce(t) then
+        set udg_Hero_LOI_Limit = udg_Hero_LOI_Limit + 1
+        call GS2_AuditMark(t)
+        call UnitDamageTargetBJ(udg_Hero_LOI_Hero, t, -100.00 + 200.00 * I2R(GetUnitAbilityLevel(udg_Hero_LOI_Hero, 'A0ZS')) + I2R(udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_2 * 100), ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL, DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGIC)
+        call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("Abilities\\Weapons\\GyroCopter\\GyroCopterMissile.mdl", GetUnitX(t), GetUnitY(t)))
+    else
+        call GS2_HellDetonate()
+    endif
+endfunction
