+function GS2S_Init takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger t = CreateTrigger()
+    local timer poll = CreateTimer()
+    set GS2S_Clock = CreateTimer()
+    call TimerStart(GS2S_Clock, 10000000.00, false, null)
+    set GS2S_Data = InitHashtable()
+    set GS2S_ItemDamageData = InitHashtable()
+    call GS2S_InitItemData()
+    set GS2S_Heroes = CreateGroup()
+    call TriggerRegisterEnterRectSimple(t, GetPlayableMapRect())
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2S_Enter)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t, EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_CAST)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2S_PreCast)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_TARGET_ORDER)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS2S_ItemOrder)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_POINT_ORDER)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS2S_ItemOrder)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_ORDER)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS2S_ItemOrder)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_USE_ITEM)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS2S_ItemUse)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t, EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2S_Spell)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t, EVENT_PLAYER_HERO_SKILL)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2S_Learn)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t, EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_RESEARCH_FINISH)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2S_Research)
+    call TimerStart(poll, 0.10, true, function GS2S_HeroTick)
+    set t = null
+    set poll = null
+endfunction
+function SP172_QStart takes unit h, unit v returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    local integer lv=GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpQ')
+    local texttag tag
+    call SP172_QStop(h,false)
+    call SaveBoolean(SP172_Data,k,9,false)
+    if not SP172_Enemy(h,v) then
+        return
+    endif
+    call SaveUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,1,v)
+    call SaveInteger(SP172_Data,k,2,lv)
+    if SP172_Trait(h,'RSpQ') then
+        call SaveInteger(SP172_Data,k,3,4)
+    else
+        call SaveInteger(SP172_Data,k,3,3)
+    endif
+    call SaveReal(SP172_Data,k,4,SP172_Time+12.0)
+    call GSCT_SyncLine(SP172_Data,k,5,"LEAS",true,h,v,40.0,true)
+    set tag=CreateTextTag()
+    call SaveTextTagHandle(SP172_Data,k,6,tag)
+    call SetTextTagColor(tag,210,230,190,255)
+    call SetTextTagPermanent(tag,true)
+    call SetTextTagVisibility(tag,GetLocalPlayer()==GetOwningPlayer(h))
+    call SP172_QLabel(h)
+    set tag=null
+endfunction
+function SP172_Attack takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h=GetEventDamageSource()
+    local unit v=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(h)
+    local integer tid=GetHandleId(v)
+    local integer lv
+    local integer n
+    local group victims
+    if not SP172_ProcBusy and GetUnitTypeId(h)=='OSp1' and not IsUnitIllusion(h) and BlzGetEventIsAttack() and GetEventDamage()>0.0 and SP172_Alive(h) and SP172_Enemy(h,v) and IsUnitType(v,UNIT_TYPE_HERO) and SP172_Trait(h,'RSpE') and SP172_EStacks(h,v)>0 then
+        set lv=GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpE')
+        if lv>0 and SP172_Time>=LoadReal(SP172_Cooldowns,sid,tid) then
+            set victims=LoadGroupHandle(SP172_Data,sid,91)
+            if victims==null then
+                set victims=CreateGroup()
+                call SaveGroupHandle(SP172_Data,sid,91,victims)
+            endif
+            call GroupAddUnit(victims,v)
+            if SP172_Time>LoadReal(SP172_Windows,sid,tid) then
+                call SaveInteger(SP172_Hits,sid,tid,0)
+                call SaveReal(SP172_Windows,sid,tid,SP172_Time+5.0)
+            endif
+            set n=LoadInteger(SP172_Hits,sid,tid)+1
+            call SaveInteger(SP172_Hits,sid,tid,n)
+            if n>=3 then
+                call RemoveSavedInteger(SP172_Hits,sid,tid)
+                call RemoveSavedReal(SP172_Windows,sid,tid)
+                call SaveReal(SP172_Cooldowns,sid,tid,SP172_Time+6.0)
+                set SP172_ProcBusy=true
+                call SP174_Hit(h,v,20.0+20.0*I2R(lv),true)
+                set SP172_ProcBusy=false
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set v=null
+    set victims=null
+endfunction
+function SP172_TickHero takes unit h returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    local unit v=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,1)
+    local unit first=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,20)
+    local unit second=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,21)
+    local unit nest=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,40)
+    local unit mover
+    local unit anchor
+    local unit spawn
+    local unit victim
+    local group victims
+    local real dist
+    local real dx
+    local real dy
+    local real step
+    local real left
+    local real amount
+    local integer lv
+    local integer id
+    local integer i
+    local integer count
+    local integer rVersion=LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,32)
+    local lightning wire
+    if not SP172_Alive(h) then
+        call SP172_QStop(h,false)
+        call SP172_RStop(h)
+        call SP172_WStop(h)
+    else
+        if v!=null then
+            if not SP172_Enemy(h,v) then
+                call SP172_QStop(h,false)
+            elseif SP172_Time>=LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,4) or SP172_Distance(h,v)>=2000.0 then
+                call SP172_QStop(h,true)
+            else
+                set left=LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,8)
+                if left>0.0 and not GSCT_InTransit(h) and not GSCT_InTransit(v) then
+                    if LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,7) then
+                        set mover=v
+                        set anchor=h
+                    else
+                        set mover=h
+                        set anchor=v
+                    endif
+                    set dx=GetUnitX(anchor)-GetUnitX(mover)
+                    set dy=GetUnitY(anchor)-GetUnitY(mover)
+                    set dist=SquareRoot(dx*dx+dy*dy)
+                    if dist>90.0 then
+                        set step=RMinBJ(RMinBJ(left,40.0),dist-90.0)
+                        call SetUnitPosition(mover,GetUnitX(mover)+step*dx/dist,GetUnitY(mover)+step*dy/dist)
+                        set left=left-step
+                    else
+                        set left=0.0
+                    endif
+                    call SaveReal(SP172_Data,k,8,left)
+                    if left<=0.0 and LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,3)==0 then
+                        call SP188_QExhaust(h)
+                    endif
+                endif
+                if LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,1)==v then
+                    call GSCT_SyncLine(SP172_Data,k,5,"LEAS",true,h,v,40.0,true)
+                    call SP172_QLabel(h)
+                endif
+            endif
+        endif
+        if first!=null and LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,20)==first and LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,32)==rVersion then
+            if not SP172_Enemy(h,first) or (second!=null and second!=h and not SP172_Enemy(h,second)) then
+                call SP172_RStop(h)
+            elseif LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,24) then
+                if SP172_Time+0.001>=LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,26) then
+                    set lv=LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,22)
+                    set amount=(5.0+5.0*I2R(lv))*SP172_Distance(first,second)/100.0
+                    set amount=RMaxBJ((5.0+5.0*I2R(lv))*3.0,RMinBJ((5.0+5.0*I2R(lv))*10.0,amount))*0.5
+                    call SaveReal(SP172_Data,k,26,LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,26)+0.5)
+                    if second==h then
+                        call SP172_Damage(h,first,amount*0.8)
+                    else
+                        call SP172_Damage(h,first,amount)
+                        if SP172_Alive(first) and LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,20)==first and LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,21)==second and LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,24) and LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,32)==rVersion then
+                            call SP172_Damage(h,second,amount)
+                        endif
+                    endif
+                endif
+                if LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,20)==first and LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,21)==second and LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,24) and LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,32)==rVersion then
+                    if SP172_Time+0.001>=LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,23) or not SP172_Alive(first) or not SP172_Alive(second) or not SP172_Alive(h) then
+                        call SP172_RStop(h)
+                    else
+                        call GSCT_SyncLine(SP172_Data,k,25,"DRAL",true,first,second,40.0,true)
+                    endif
+                endif
+            elseif SP172_Time>=LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,23) then
+                call SP172_RStop(h)
+            endif
+        endif
+        if nest!=null and SP172_Time+0.001>=LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,42) then
+            set count=LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,43)
+            if count>0 then
+                set i=0
+                set victims=LoadGroupHandle(SP172_Data,k,50)
+                if victims==null then
+                    set victims=CreateGroup()
+                    call SaveGroupHandle(SP172_Data,k,50,victims)
+                endif
+                set i=BlzGroupGetSize(victims)-1
+                set count=0
+                loop
+                    exitwhen i<0
+                    set spawn=BlzGroupUnitAt(victims,i)
+                    if not SP172_Alive(spawn) then
+                        call GroupRemoveUnit(victims,spawn)
+                        call FlushChildHashtable(SP172_SpawnTargets,GetHandleId(spawn))
+                    else
+                        set count=count+1
+                    endif
+                    set i=i-1
+                endloop
+                if count<12 then
+                    set lv=LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,41)
+                    set id='nSs1'
+                    if lv==2 then
+                        set id='nSs2'
+                    elseif lv==3 then
+                        set id='nSs3'
+                    elseif lv==4 then
+                        set id='nSs4'
+                    endif
+                    set spawn=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),id,GetUnitX(nest),GetUnitY(nest),GetUnitFacing(h))
+                    call GroupAddUnit(victims,spawn)
+                    call UnitApplyTimedLife(spawn,'BTLF',6.0)
+                    if SP172_Enemy(h,v) then
+                        call IssueTargetOrder(spawn,"attack",v)
+                    else
+                        call IssuePointOrder(spawn,"attack",GetUnitX(nest)+GetRandomReal(-250.0,250.0),GetUnitY(nest)+GetRandomReal(-250.0,250.0))
+                    endif
+                endif
+                call SaveInteger(SP172_Data,k,43,LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,43)-1)
+                call SaveReal(SP172_Data,k,42,LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,42)+0.5)
+            endif
+        endif
+        if SP172_Beat==0 then
+            if GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpW')!=LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,92) or SP172_Trait(h,'RSpW')!=LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,93) or SP172_Trait(h,'RSpS')!=LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,90) then
+                call SP172_ApplyTrait(h)
+            endif
+            set lv=GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpE')
+            if lv>0 then
+                set v=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,1)
+                set first=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,20)
+                set second=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,21)
+                if SP172_EStacks(h,v)>0 then
+                    call SP174_Hit(h,v,(1.0+I2R(lv))*I2R(SP172_EStacks(h,v)),false)
+                endif
+                if first!=v and SP172_EStacks(h,first)>0 then
+                    call SP174_Hit(h,first,(1.0+I2R(lv))*I2R(SP172_EStacks(h,first)),false)
+                endif
+                if second!=v and second!=first and SP172_EStacks(h,second)>0 then
+                    call SP174_Hit(h,second,(1.0+I2R(lv))*I2R(SP172_EStacks(h,second)),false)
+                endif
+            endif
+            if nest!=null and SP172_Trait(h,'RSpS') and SP172_Distance(h,nest)<=400.0 then
+                call SetUnitState(h,UNIT_STATE_LIFE,GetWidgetLife(h)+4.0)
+            endif
+            set victims=LoadGroupHandle(SP172_Data,k,50)
+            if victims!=null then
+                set i=BlzGroupGetSize(victims)-1
+                loop
+                    exitwhen i<0
+                    set spawn=BlzGroupUnitAt(victims,i)
+                    if not SP172_Alive(spawn) then
+                        call GroupRemoveUnit(victims,spawn)
+                        call FlushChildHashtable(SP172_SpawnTargets,GetHandleId(spawn))
+                    elseif SP172_Enemy(h,LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,1)) and LoadUnitHandle(SP172_SpawnTargets,GetHandleId(spawn),1)!=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,1) then
+                        call IssueTargetOrder(spawn,"attack",LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,1))
+                        call SaveUnitHandle(SP172_SpawnTargets,GetHandleId(spawn),1,LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,1))
+                    endif
+                    set i=i-1
+                endloop
+            endif
+            set victims=LoadGroupHandle(SP172_Data,k,91)
+            if victims!=null then
+                set i=BlzGroupGetSize(victims)-1
+                loop
+                    exitwhen i<0
+                    set victim=BlzGroupUnitAt(victims,i)
+                    set id=GetHandleId(victim)
+                    if SP172_Time>LoadReal(SP172_Windows,k,id) and SP172_Time>LoadReal(SP172_Cooldowns,k,id) then
+                        call RemoveSavedInteger(SP172_Hits,k,id)
+                        call RemoveSavedReal(SP172_Windows,k,id)
+                        call RemoveSavedReal(SP172_Cooldowns,k,id)
+                        call GroupRemoveUnit(victims,victim)
+                    endif
+                    set i=i-1
+                endloop
+            endif
+        endif
+        if nest!=null and LoadInteger(SP172_Data,k,43)<=0 then
+            call SP172_WStop(h)
+        endif
+    endif
+    call SP172_RUpdate(h)
+    set v=null
+    set first=null
+    set second=null
+    set nest=null
+    set mover=null
+    set anchor=null
+    set spawn=null
+    set victim=null
+    set victims=null
+    set wire=null
+endfunction
+function SP173_StatusHero takes unit h returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(h)
+    local unit q=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,1)
+    local unit r1=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,20)
+    local unit r2=LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,k,21)
+    if SP172_Alive(h) then
+        if SP172_Enemy(h,q) and SP172_Time<LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,4) then
+            call SP173_Mark(q,'ASbQ')
+        endif
+        if LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,k,24) and SP172_Time<LoadReal(SP172_Data,k,23) then
+            if SP172_Enemy(h,r1) then
+                call SP173_Mark(r1,'ASbR')
+            endif
+            if r2!=h and SP172_Enemy(h,r2) then
+                call SP173_Mark(r2,'ASbR')
+            endif
+        endif
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'ASpE')>0 then
+            if SP172_EStacks(h,q)>0 then
+                call SP173_Mark(q,'ASbE')
+            endif
+            if r1!=q and SP172_EStacks(h,r1)>0 then
+                call SP173_Mark(r1,'ASbE')
+            endif
+            if r2!=q and r2!=r1 and SP172_EStacks(h,r2)>0 then
+                call SP173_Mark(r2,'ASbE')
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    call SP175_OwnerStatus(h,q,r1,r2)
+    set q=null
+    set r1=null
+    set r2=null
+endfunction
+function DWT_ZoneStep takes timer t returns nothing
+    local integer k=GetHandleId(t)
+    local integer tick=LoadInteger(DWT_Data,k,1)+1
+    local unit h=LoadUnitHandle(DWT_Data,k,0)
+    local real damage=0.0
+    if tick<=4 or (tick==5 and LoadBoolean(DWT_Data,k,7)) then
+        set damage=LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,4)
+    endif
+    if damage>0.0 then
+        call DWT_LightBurst(LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,2),LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,3),LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,5))
+    endif
+    call DWT_Area(h,LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,2),LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,3),LoadReal(DWT_Data,k,5),damage,11,0.20,0.65,LoadInteger(DWT_Data,k,22))
+    call SaveInteger(DWT_Data,k,1,tick)
+    if tick>=5 then
+        call TimerStart(t,0.60,false,function DWT_ZoneEnd)
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction

+    local trigger learn = CreateTrigger()
+    local trigger research = CreateTrigger()
+    local trigger spell = CreateTrigger()

+    local trigger escape = CreateTrigger()
+    local trigger death = CreateTrigger()
+    local trigger hit = CreateTrigger()

+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(learn, Player(i), EVENT_PLAYER_HERO_SKILL, null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(learn, Player(i), EVENT_PLAYER_HERO_LEVEL, null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(research, Player(i), EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_RESEARCH_FINISH, null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(spell, Player(i), EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT, null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerEvent(escape, Player(i), EVENT_PLAYER_END_CINEMATIC)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(beginning, Player(i), EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_CHANNEL, null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(ending, Player(i), EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_ENDCAST, null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(death, Player(i), EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DEATH, null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(hit, Player(i), EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DAMAGED, null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(orders,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_TARGET_ORDER,null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(orders,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_POINT_ORDER,null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(orders,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_ORDER,null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(used,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_USE_ITEM,null)
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(learn, function GS114S_Learn)
+    call TriggerAddAction(research, function GS114S_Research)
+    call TriggerAddAction(spell, function GS114S_Spell)
+    call TriggerAddAction(escape, function GS116S_Escape)
+    call TriggerAddAction(beginning, function GS116S_SiegeBegin)
+    call TriggerAddAction(ending, function GS114S_EndCast)
+    call TriggerAddAction(death, function GS114S_Death)
+    call TriggerAddAction(hit, function GS114S_Hit)
+    call TriggerAddAction(orders,function GS114S_ItemOrder)
+    call TriggerAddAction(used,function GS114S_ItemUse)
+    set orders=null
+    set used=null
+    set learn = null
+    set research = null
+    set spell = null
+    set ending = null
+    set beginning = null
+    set escape = null
+    set death = null
+    set hit = null
+endfunction
+function GSRI_PathLine takes real x1, real y1, real x2, real y2 returns nothing
+    call GSRI_Line(GSRI_OriginX+x1*GSRI_Cos-y1*GSRI_Sin,GSRI_OriginY+x1*GSRI_Sin+y1*GSRI_Cos,GSRI_OriginX+x2*GSRI_Cos-y2*GSRI_Sin,GSRI_OriginY+x2*GSRI_Sin+y2*GSRI_Cos)
+endfunction
+function RAIN_WStart takes unit h, unit v, integer lv returns nothing
+    local timer t
+    local integer k
+    call GSCT_Track(h)
+    call RAIN_WStop(h,false)
+    set t=CreateTimer()
+    set k=GetHandleId(t)
+    call SaveTimerHandle(RAIN_Data,GetHandleId(h),22,t)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(RAIN_Data,k,0,h)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(RAIN_Data,k,1,v)
+    call SaveInteger(RAIN_Data,k,2,lv)
+    call SaveInteger(RAIN_Data,k,3,0)
+    call GSCT_SyncLine(RAIN_Data,k,4,"DRAL",false,h,v,70.0,false)
+    if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RR02',true)>0 then
+        call RAIN_Dummy(h,v,'ARsl',1,"slow")
+    endif
+    call TimerStart(t,0.05,true,function RAIN_WTick)
+    set t=null
+endfunction

+function GS192_PromiseStart takes unit caster, unit target, real duration returns timer
+    local timer t=CreateTimer()
+    local real delay=RMaxBJ(0.0,duration-10.0)
+    local integer key=GetHandleId(t)
+    if GS192_Data==null then
+        set GS192_Data=InitHashtable()
+    endif
+    call SaveBoolean(GS192_Data,key,99,true)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS192_Data,key,1,caster)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS192_Data,key,2,target)
+    if delay<=0.0 then
+        call GS192_PromiseCreate(t)
+    else
+        call TimerStart(t,delay,false,function GS192_PromiseReveal)
+    endif
+    return t
+endfunction

+function GS181_LeapStart takes unit h, real targetX, real targetY returns nothing
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(h)
+    local timer t
+    local integer k
+    local real facing
+    local real x
+    local real y
+    local real sx
+    local real sy
+    local real distance
+    local integer rank=GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'A0AV')
+    if not GS181_Live(h) or rank<1 or rank>3 then
+        return
+    endif
+    if not GSCT_Number(targetX) or not GSCT_Number(targetY) or not GSCT_Number(GetUnitX(h)) or not GSCT_Number(GetUnitY(h)) then
+        return
+    endif
+    call GS181_LeapStop(h)
+    if GS181_Leap==null then
+        set GS181_Leap=InitHashtable()
+    endif
+    set facing=GetUnitFacing(h)*bj_DEGTORAD
+    set x=targetX-100.0*Cos(facing)
+    set y=targetY-100.0*Sin(facing)
+    set sx=GetUnitX(h)
+    set sy=GetUnitY(h)
+    set distance=SquareRoot((x-sx)*(x-sx)+(y-sy)*(y-sy))
+    set t=CreateTimer()
+    set k=GetHandleId(t)
+    call SaveTimerHandle(GS181_Leap,sid,0,t)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS181_Leap,k,0,h)
+    call SaveReal(GS181_Leap,k,2,sx)
+    call SaveReal(GS181_Leap,k,3,sy)
+    call SaveReal(GS181_Leap,k,4,distance)
+    call SaveReal(GS181_Leap,k,5,Atan2(y-sy,x-sx))
+    call SaveReal(GS181_Leap,k,6,facing)
+    call SaveInteger(GS181_Leap,k,8,0)
+    call SaveInteger(GS181_Leap,k,9,0)
+    call SaveReal(GS181_Leap,k,11,GetUnitFlyHeight(h))
+    call SaveBoolean(GS181_Leap,k,12,false)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS181_Leap,k,13,IsUnitPaused(h))
+    call SaveInteger(GS181_Leap,k,14,rank)
+    call GSCT_Ensure()
+    call SaveBoolean(GSCT_State,sid,1,true)
+    call GSCT_DetachUnit(h)
+    if LoadTimerHandle(GS181_Leap,sid,0)!=t then
+        set t=null
+        return
+    endif
+    if not GS181_Live(h) then
+        call GS181_LeapStop(h)
+        set t=null
+        return
+    endif
+    call UnitAddAbility(h,'Arav')
+    call UnitRemoveAbility(h,'Arav')
+    call SetUnitPathing(h,false)
+    call PauseUnit(h,true)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS181_Leap,k,12,true)
+    call GS190_InvulnerabilityBegin(h)
+    call SetUnitTimeScale(h,0.70)
+    call SetUnitAnimation(h,"slam")
+    call SetUnitFlyHeight(h,GetUnitFlyHeight(h)+distance/2.0,distance*1.30)
+    call GS181_WorldFx("Abilities\\Weapons\\PhoenixMissile\\Phoenix_Missile_mini.mdl",sx,sy,0.80)
+    call PlaySoundBJ(gg_snd_GromYesAttack4)
+    call TimerStart(t,0.03,true,function GS181_LeapTick)
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GSTF_Init takes nothing returns nothing

+function GSPF_CreateModeBox takes integer host returns nothing
+    local framehandle box = GSPF_Panel("GSPF_ModeBox", 7001, 0.36, 0.39)
+    local framehandle f

+    call BlzFrameSetAbsPoint(box, FRAMEPOINT_CENTER, 0.4, 0.36)

+    call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(f, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_CENTER)
+    call BlzFrameSetText(f, "|cffffcc00게임 모드 선택|r  |cff999999(게임 일시정지 중)|r")
+    set f = GSPF_Text("GSPF_ModeSub", 0, box, 0.32, 0.014)
+    call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOP, box, FRAMEPOINT_TOP, 0.0, -0.046)
+    call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(f, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_CENTER)
+    call BlzFrameSetText(f, "|cff999999여러 개 선택 가능 / 같이 켤 수 없는 모드는 자동 잠금|r")
+    loop
+        exitwhen k > 6
+        set f = BlzCreateFrame("ScriptDialogButton", box, 0, 7100 + k)
+        call BlzFrameSetSize(f, 0.31, 0.032)
+        call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_TOP, box, FRAMEPOINT_TOP, 0.0, -0.068 - k * 0.035)
+        call BlzTriggerRegisterFrameEvent(t, f, FRAMEEVENT_CONTROL_CLICK)
+        set k = k + 1
+    endloop
+    set f = BlzCreateFrame("ScriptDialogButton", box, 0, 7200)
+    call BlzFrameSetSize(f, 0.16, 0.036)
+    call BlzFrameSetPoint(f, FRAMEPOINT_BOTTOM, box, FRAMEPOINT_BOTTOM, 0.0, 0.022)
+    call BlzFrameSetText(f, "|cffffcc00확정하고 게임 시작|r")
+    call BlzTriggerRegisterFrameEvent(t, f, FRAMEEVENT_CONTROL_CLICK)
+    call BlzFrameSetVisible(box, GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer()) == host)
+    set box = GSPF_Panel("GSPF_WaitBox", 7003, 0.42, 0.06)
+    call BlzFrameSetAbsPoint(box, FRAMEPOINT_CENTER, 0.4, 0.4)
+    set f = GSPF_Text("GSPF_Wait", 0, box, 0.38, 0.02)

+    call BlzFrameSetTextAlignment(f, TEXT_JUSTIFY_MIDDLE, TEXT_JUSTIFY_CENTER)
+    call BlzFrameSetText(f, "|cffffcc00" + GetPlayerName(Player(host)) + "|r 님이 게임 모드를 선택하고 있습니다  |cff999999(일시정지)|r")
+    call BlzFrameSetVisible(box, GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer()) != host)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GSPF_OnModeClick)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    set k = 0
+    loop
+        exitwhen k > 11

+        set k = k + 1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GSPF_OnLeave)
+    set box = null
+    set f = null
+    set t = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_Item_Buy_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit hero = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local item createdItem = null
+    local item slotItem = null
+    local integer a = 1
+    local integer b = R2I(GetItemLifeBJ(GetManipulatedItem()))
+    if b == 40 and UnitHasItemOfTypeBJ(hero, 'crys') then
+        call AdjustPlayerStateBJ(1100, GetOwningPlayer(hero), PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD)
+        call RemoveItem(GetManipulatedItem())
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(hero), 0.00, 0.00, 3.00, "쉐도우 오브는 한 개만 보유할 수 있습니다. 중복 구매 비용을 돌려받았습니다.")
+        set hero = null
+        return
+    endif
+    if Trig_Item_Buy_Func006C() then
+        call SetItemCharges(GetItemOfTypeFromUnitBJ(hero, udg_ItemType[b]), GetItemCharges(GetItemOfTypeFromUnitBJ(hero, udg_ItemType[b])) + 3)
+        set hero = null
+        return
+    endif
+    if Trig_Item_Buy_Func007C() then
+        call SetItemCharges(GetItemOfTypeFromUnitBJ(hero, udg_ItemType[b]), GetItemCharges(GetItemOfTypeFromUnitBJ(hero, udg_ItemType[b])) + 1)
+        set hero = null
+        return
+    endif
+    set createdItem = CreateItem(udg_ItemType[b], GetUnitX(hero), GetUnitY(hero))
+    call SetItemUserData(createdItem, b)
+    if UnitInventoryCount(hero) == 6 then
+        set udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(hero))] = createdItem
+        call SetItemLifeBJ(createdItem, 500.00)
+        call SetItemUserData(createdItem, R2I(GetItemLifeBJ(createdItem)))
+        loop
+            exitwhen a > 6
+            set slotItem = UnitItemInSlotBJ(hero, a)
+            if slotItem != null then
+                call SetItemLifeBJ(slotItem, 500.00)
+                call SetItemUserData(slotItem, R2I(GetItemLifeBJ(slotItem)))
+            endif
+            set a = a + 1
+        endloop
+        set udg_GS2_LastMixedItem = null
+        call ItemMix(188, hero)
+        call ItemMix(189, hero)
+        if StringLength(udg_ItemMix_DB[b]) > 0 then
+            call ItemMix(b, hero)
+        endif
+        if udg_GS2_LastMixedItem != null and StringLength(udg_ItemMix_DB[GetItemUserData(udg_GS2_LastMixedItem)]) > 0 then
+            call ItemMix(GetItemUserData(udg_GS2_LastMixedItem), hero)
+        endif
+        set a = 1
+        loop
+            exitwhen a > 6
+            set slotItem = UnitItemInSlotBJ(hero, a)
+            if slotItem != null and StringLength(udg_ItemMix_DB[GetItemUserData(slotItem)]) > 0 then
+                call ItemMix(GetItemUserData(slotItem), hero)
+            endif
+            set a = a + 1
+        endloop
+        call GS163_ScanMix(hero)
+        set udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(hero))] = null
+        set udg_GS2_LastMixedItem = null
+    else
+        call UnitAddItem(hero, createdItem)
+    endif
+    set slotItem = null
+    set createdItem = null
+    set hero = null
+endfunction

+function Trig_Full_Inv_Get_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local item i = GetOrderTargetItem()
+    local integer a=1
+    if ( Trig_Full_Inv_Get_Func003C() ) then
+        call IssueTargetItemOrder( GetTriggerUnit(), "move", GetOrderTargetItem() )
+    else
+        call SetUnitFacingTimed( GetTriggerUnit(), GS2V84_AngleBetweenPoints_01(GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), GetItemLoc(GetOrderTargetItem())), 0.01 )
+    endif
+    call PolledWait( 0.01 )
+    call UnitAddAbilityBJ( 'A0W3', GetTriggerUnit() )
+    loop
+    exitwhen i==null or GetItemTypeId(i)==0 or IsItemOwned(i)
+    if ( Trig_Full_Inv_Get_Func010C() ) then
+        if ( GS2V84_DistanceBetweenPoints_01(GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()), GetItemLoc( i )) <= 170.00 ) then
+        set udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))] = i
+        call SetItemLifeBJ( udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))], 500.00 )
+        call SetItemUserData( udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))], R2I(GetItemLifeBJ(udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))])) )
+        set bj_forLoopAIndex = 1
+        set bj_forLoopAIndexEnd = 6
+        loop
+            exitwhen bj_forLoopAIndex > bj_forLoopAIndexEnd
+            call SetItemLifeBJ( UnitItemInSlotBJ(GetTriggerUnit(), GetForLoopIndexA()), 500.00 )
+            call SetItemUserData( UnitItemInSlotBJ(GetTriggerUnit(), GetForLoopIndexA()), R2I(GetItemLifeBJ(UnitItemInSlotBJ(GetTriggerUnit(), GetForLoopIndexA()))) )
+            set bj_forLoopAIndex = bj_forLoopAIndex + 1
+        endloop
+        call IssueImmediateOrderBJ( GetTriggerUnit(), "stop" )
+        call UnitRemoveAbilityBJ( 'A0W3', GetTriggerUnit() )
+        if ( Trig_Full_Inv_Get_Func010Func009C() ) then
+            call SetItemCharges( GetItemOfTypeFromUnitBJ(GetTriggerUnit(), GetItemTypeId(udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))])), ( GetItemCharges(GetItemOfTypeFromUnitBJ(GetTriggerUnit(), GetItemTypeId(udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))]))) + GetItemCharges(udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))]) ) )
+            set udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))] = null
+            call RemoveItem(i)
+            set i=null
+        else
+        endif
+        call ItemMix(188, GetTriggerUnit())
+        call ItemMix(189, GetTriggerUnit())
+        if udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))]!=null and StringLength(udg_ItemMix_DB[GetItemUserData(udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))])]) > 0 then
+        call ItemMix(GetItemUserData(udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))]), GetTriggerUnit())
+        endif
+        set a = 1
+        loop
+        exitwhen a>6
+        if StringLength(udg_ItemMix_DB[GetItemUserData(UnitItemInSlotBJ(GetTriggerUnit(), a))]) > 0 then
+        call ItemMix(GetItemUserData(UnitItemInSlotBJ(GetTriggerUnit(), a)), GetTriggerUnit())
+        endif
+        set a = a+1
+        endloop
+        call GS163_ScanMix(GetTriggerUnit())
+        set udg_ItemTaken[GetConvertedPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))] = null
+        endif
+    else
+    endif
+    call PolledWait( 0.10 )
+    exitwhen ( GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A0W3', GetTriggerUnit()) == 0 )
+    endloop
+    call UnitRemoveAbility(GetTriggerUnit(),'A0W3')
+    set i=null
+endfunction

+function GS184_AsuraStart takes unit h, unit v returns nothing
+    local timer t=null
+    local integer k=0
+    local integer rank=GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'A0EY')
+    if not GSST_Live(h) or not GSST_Live(v) or h==v or rank<1 or rank>3 or IsUnitPaused(h) or GS184_AsuraBusy(h) then
+        return
+    endif
+    if not IsUnitEnemy(v,GetOwningPlayer(h)) or not GSCT_Number(GetUnitX(v)) or not GSCT_Number(GetUnitY(v)) then
+        return
+    endif
+    if GS184_MonkData==null then
+        set GS184_MonkData=InitHashtable()
+    endif
+    set t=CreateTimer()
+    if t==null then
+        return
+    endif
+    set k=GetHandleId(t)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS184_MonkData,k,0,true)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS184_MonkData,k,1,h)
+    call SaveUnitHandle(GS184_MonkData,k,2,v)
+    call SaveInteger(GS184_MonkData,k,3,GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(h)))
+    call SaveReal(GS184_MonkData,k,4,0.50+I2R(rank)*0.25)
+    call SaveReal(GS184_MonkData,k,5,TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime))
+    call SaveInteger(GS184_MonkData,k,6,0)
+    call SaveBoolean(GS184_MonkData,k,7,true)
+    call SaveReal(GS184_MonkData,k,12,GetUnitX(v))
+    call SaveReal(GS184_MonkData,k,13,GetUnitY(v)-250.0)
+    call SaveTimerHandle(GS184_MonkData,GetHandleId(h),100,t)
+    call PauseUnit(h,true)
+    if GS184_AsuraCurrent(t) and GSST_Live(h) then
+        call GS184_AsuraLetter(t,0)
+        call TimerStart(t,0.10,true,function GS184_AsuraTick)
+    else
+        call GS184_AsuraEnd(t)
+    endif
+    set t=null
+endfunction

+function GS2_HellScan takes real radius returns nothing
+    local group g = CreateGroup()
+    local unit u
+    if udg_Hero_LOI_Unit == null or GetWidgetLife(udg_Hero_LOI_Unit) <= 0.405 then
+        call DestroyGroup(g)
+        set g = null
+        return
+    endif
+    call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(g, GetUnitX(udg_Hero_LOI_Unit), GetUnitY(udg_Hero_LOI_Unit), radius, null)
+    loop
+        set u = FirstOfGroup(g)
+        exitwhen u == null or GetWidgetLife(udg_Hero_LOI_Unit) <= 0.405
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(g, u)
+        call GS2_HellProcessTarget(u)
+    endloop
+    call DestroyGroup(g)
+    set u = null
+    set g = null
+endfunction
+function SP172_Spell takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer id=GetSpellAbilityId()
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)=='OSp1' and not IsUnitIllusion(h) and SP172_Alive(h) then
+        call SP172_Register(h)
+        if id=='ASpQ' then
+            call SP172_QStart(h,GetSpellTargetUnit())
+        elseif id=='ASpD' then
+            call SP172_QCommand(h,true)
+        elseif id=='ASpF' then
+            call SP172_QCommand(h,false)
+        elseif id=='ASpW' then
+            call SP172_WStart(h,GetSpellTargetX(),GetSpellTargetY())
+        elseif id=='ASpR' then
+            if LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,GetHandleId(h),20)!=null and not LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,GetHandleId(h),24) then
+                call SP172_RSecond(h,GetSpellTargetUnit())
+            else
+                call SP172_RFirst(h,GetSpellTargetUnit())
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    set h=null
+endfunction
+function SP172_Tick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer i=BlzGroupGetSize(SP172_Heroes)-1
+    local integer k
+    local unit h
+    local group g
+    local unit spawn
+    set SP172_Time=SP172_Time+0.05
+    set SP172_Beat=ModuloInteger(SP172_Beat+1,10)
+    if SP172_Beat==0 then
+        set SP173_Epoch=SP173_Epoch+1
+    endif
+    loop
+        exitwhen i<0
+        set h=BlzGroupUnitAt(SP172_Heroes,i)
+        if GetUnitTypeId(h)==0 then
+            set k=GetHandleId(h)
+            call SP172_QStop(h,false)
+            call SP172_RStop(h)
+            call SP172_WStop(h)
+            set g=LoadGroupHandle(SP172_Data,k,50)
+            if g!=null then
+                loop
+                    set spawn=FirstOfGroup(g)
+                    exitwhen spawn==null
+                    call GroupRemoveUnit(g,spawn)
+                    call FlushChildHashtable(SP172_SpawnTargets,GetHandleId(spawn))
+                    call RemoveUnit(spawn)
+                endloop
+                call DestroyGroup(g)
+            endif
+            set g=LoadGroupHandle(SP172_Data,k,91)
+            if g!=null then
+                call DestroyGroup(g)
+            endif
+            call FlushChildHashtable(SP172_Data,k)
+            call FlushChildHashtable(SP172_Hits,k)
+            call FlushChildHashtable(SP172_Windows,k)
+            call FlushChildHashtable(SP172_Cooldowns,k)
+            call GroupRemoveUnit(SP172_Heroes,h)
+        else
+            call SP172_TickHero(h)
+            if SP172_Beat==0 then
+                call SP173_StatusHero(h)
+            endif
+        endif
+        set i=i-1
+    endloop
+    if SP172_Beat==0 then
+        call SP173_StatusFinish()
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set g=null
+    set spawn=null
+endfunction
+function DWT_ZoneTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    call DWT_ZoneStep(GetExpiredTimer())
+endfunction
+function GSRI_Draw takes unit u, integer id returns nothing
+    local integer sid = GetHandleId(u)
+    local integer offset = LoadInteger(GSRI_CacheIndex,sid,id)
+    local integer lv = GSRI_Level(u,id)
+    local real radius = GSRI_Range(u,id,lv)
+    local real x = GetUnitX(u)
+    local real y = GetUnitY(u)
+    local real dx = GSRI_MouseX-x
+    local real dy = GSRI_MouseY-y
+    local real yaw
+    local real angle1
+    local real angle2
+    local real startWidth = 125.00
+    local integer n = R2I(2.00*bj_PI*radius/48.00)+1
+    local integer j = 0
+    local integer profile = LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,id,2)
+    local real reach = 0.0
+    local real endWidth = 0.0
+    local real pointX
+    local real pointY
+    local real distance
+    local unit spiderFirst = null
+    if id == 'ASp2' or (id == 'ASpR' and LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,GetHandleId(u),20)!=null and not LoadBoolean(SP172_Data,GetHandleId(u),24)) then
+        set spiderFirst = LoadUnitHandle(SP172_Data,GetHandleId(u),20)
+        if spiderFirst != null then
+            set x = GetUnitX(spiderFirst)
+            set y = GetUnitY(spiderFirst)
+            set dx = GSRI_MouseX-x
+            set dy = GSRI_MouseY-y
+        endif
+    endif
+    set spiderFirst = null
+    if GSRI_MouseValid and dx*dx+dy*dy > 0.01 then
+        set yaw = GSRI_SmoothYaw(Atan2(dy,dx))
+    else
+        set yaw = 0.0
+    endif
+    set GSRI_CacheAge = GSRI_CacheAge + GSRI_PERIOD
+    if GSRI_CachedId == id and GSRI_CachedLevel == lv and GSRI_CachedX == x and GSRI_CachedY == y and GSRI_CachedRadius == radius and (profile == 0 or profile == 4 or GSRI_CachedYaw == yaw) and GSRI_CacheAge < 0.25 then
+        return
+    endif
+    set GSRI_RingDirty = GSRI_CachedId != id or GSRI_CachedLevel != lv or GSRI_CachedX != x or GSRI_CachedY != y or GSRI_CachedRadius != radius or GSRI_CacheAge >= 0.25
+    if GSRI_CacheAge >= 0.25 then
+        set j = 0
+        loop
+            exitwhen j >= GSRI_POOL_SIZE
+            set GSRI_SegmentValid[j] = false
+            set j = j+1
+        endloop
+        set j = 0
+    endif
+    set GSRI_CachedId = id
+    set GSRI_CachedLevel = lv
+    set GSRI_CachedX = x
+    set GSRI_CachedY = y
+    set GSRI_CachedRadius = radius
+    set GSRI_CachedYaw = yaw
+    set GSRI_CacheAge = 0.0
+    if not GSRI_Visible then
+        set GSRI_ShowCount = GSRI_ShowCount+1
+        set GSRI_Visible = true
+    endif
+    if n > GSRI_RING_LIMIT then
+        set n = GSRI_RING_LIMIT
+    endif
+    set GSRI_LastRange = radius
+    set GSRI_DrawIndex = 0
+    if GSRI_RingDirty then
+    loop
+        exitwhen j >= n
+        set angle1 = 2.00*bj_PI*j/n
+        set angle2 = 2.00*bj_PI*(j+1)/n
+        call GSRI_Segment(x+radius*Cos(angle1),y+radius*Sin(angle1),x+radius*Cos(angle2),y+radius*Sin(angle2))
+        set j = j+1
+    endloop
+    call GSRI_Trim(GSRI_RingCount)
+    set GSRI_RingCount = GSRI_DrawIndex
+    endif
+    set GSRI_DrawIndex = GSRI_RING_LIMIT
+    if (profile == 2 or profile == 3 or profile == 5) and GSRI_MouseValid and dx*dx+dy*dy > 0.01 then
+        set GSRI_OriginX = x
+        set GSRI_OriginY = y
+        set GSRI_Cos = Cos(yaw)
+        set GSRI_Sin = Sin(yaw)
+        if profile == 2 then
+            call GSRI_PathLine(0,-120,1170,-120)
+            call GSRI_PathLine(0,120,1170,120)
+            call GSRI_PathLine(0,0,1170,0)
+            set j = 0
+            loop
+                exitwhen j >= 12
+                set angle1 = bj_PI*0.5+bj_PI*j/12
+                set angle2 = bj_PI*0.5+bj_PI*(j+1)/12
+                call GSRI_PathLine(120*Cos(angle1),120*Sin(angle1),120*Cos(angle2),120*Sin(angle2))
+                call GSRI_PathLine(1170-120*Cos(angle1),-120*Sin(angle1),1170-120*Cos(angle2),-120*Sin(angle2))
+                set j = j+1
+            endloop
+        else
+            set startWidth = LoadReal(GSRI_Data,id,20)
+            if GSRI_Item == null and offset != 0 then
+                set startWidth = LoadReal(GSRI_Cache,sid,offset+6)
+            endif
+            set reach = LoadReal(GSRI_Data,id,21)
+            set endWidth = LoadReal(GSRI_Data,id,22)
+            if GSRI_Item == null and offset != 0 then
+                set reach = LoadReal(GSRI_Cache,sid,offset+7)
+                set endWidth = LoadReal(GSRI_Cache,sid,offset+8)
+            endif
+            if profile == 5 then
+                if LoadInteger(GSRI_Data,id,5) == 1 then
+                    set lv = ModuloInteger(lv,4)
+                endif
+                set startWidth = LoadReal(GSRI_Data,id,200+lv*3)
+                set reach = LoadReal(GSRI_Data,id,201+lv*3)
+                set endWidth = LoadReal(GSRI_Data,id,202+lv*3)
+            endif
+            if reach > 0.0 and reach < 9999.0 and startWidth >= 0.0 and endWidth >= 0.0 then
+                call GSRI_PathLine(0,-startWidth,reach,-endWidth)
+                call GSRI_PathLine(0,startWidth,reach,endWidth)
+                call GSRI_PathLine(0,-startWidth,0,startWidth)
+                call GSRI_PathLine(reach,-endWidth,reach,endWidth)
+                call GSRI_PathLine(0,0,reach,0)
+            endif
+        endif
+    endif
+    if profile == 6 and GSRI_MouseValid then
+        set distance=SquareRoot(dx*dx+dy*dy)
+        set pointX=GSRI_MouseX
+        set pointY=GSRI_MouseY
+        if distance>radius and distance>0.0 then
+            set pointX=x+dx*radius/distance
+            set pointY=y+dy*radius/distance
+        endif
+        set startWidth=225.0
+        if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(u),'RD04',true)>0 then
+            set startWidth=300.0
+        endif
+        set j=0
+        loop
+            exitwhen j>=48
+            set angle1=2.0*bj_PI*I2R(j)/48.0
+            set angle2=2.0*bj_PI*I2R(j+1)/48.0
+            call GSRI_Segment(pointX+startWidth*Cos(angle1),pointY+startWidth*Sin(angle1),pointX+startWidth*Cos(angle2),pointY+startWidth*Sin(angle2))
+            set j=j+1
+        endloop
+    endif
+    call GSRI_Trim(GSRI_PathCount)
+    set GSRI_PathCount = GSRI_DrawIndex
+endfunction
+function RAIN_Spell takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local ability source=GetSpellAbility()
+    local unit v=GetSpellTargetUnit()
+    local integer aid=GetSpellAbilityId()
+    local integer lv=GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,aid)
+    local integer sid=GetHandleId(h)
+    local integer k
+    local integer i=1
+    local integer best=0
+    local unit aura=null
+    local unit candidate
+    local real amount
+    local real dx
+    local real dy
+    local real reach
+    local timer t
+    local boolean unitSpell=false
+    if GS181_Live(h) and not IsUnitType(h,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not IsUnitType(h,UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL) and GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,'Aloc')==0 and (IsUnitType(h,UNIT_TYPE_HERO) or not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(h)) then
+        set unitSpell=GS180_UnitSpell(h,aid,source)
+    endif
+    set source=null
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)=='URa1' then
+        if aid=='ARq1' and RAIN_Enemy(h,v) then
+            call RAIN_Mark(h,v,lv)
+        elseif aid=='ARw1' and RAIN_Enemy(h,v) then
+            set amount=RMinBJ(GetUnitState(v,UNIT_STATE_MANA),30.0+30.0*I2R(lv))
+            call SetUnitState(v,UNIT_STATE_MANA,GetUnitState(v,UNIT_STATE_MANA)-amount)
+            call SetUnitState(h,UNIT_STATE_MANA,GetUnitState(h,UNIT_STATE_MANA)+amount)
+            call RAIN_WStart(h,v,lv)
+        elseif aid=='ARr1' and RAIN_REnemy(h,v) then
+            call GSCT_Track(h)
+            call RAIN_RStop(h)
+            set t=CreateTimer()
+            set k=GetHandleId(t)
+            set amount=20.0+20.0*I2R(lv)
+            set i=1
+            if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RR03',true)>0 then
+                set amount=amount+5.0+5.0*I2R(lv)
+                set i=2
+            endif
+            call SaveTimerHandle(RAIN_Data,sid,10,t)
+            call SaveUnitHandle(RAIN_Data,k,0,h)
+            call SaveUnitHandle(RAIN_Data,k,1,v)
+            call SaveReal(RAIN_Data,k,2,amount)
+            call SaveInteger(RAIN_Data,k,3,0)
+            call SaveInteger(RAIN_Data,k,4,i)
+            call GSCT_SyncLine(RAIN_Data,k,5,"DRAM",false,h,v,80.0,false)
+            call TimerStart(t,0.01,false,function RAIN_RTick)
+            set t=null
+        endif
+    endif
+    if unitSpell and RAIN_Alive(h) then
+        set i=1
+        loop
+            exitwhen i>12
+            set candidate=udg_HeroPlayer[i]
+            set lv=GetUnitAbilityLevel(candidate,'ARe1')
+            if lv>best and GetUnitTypeId(candidate)=='URa1' and RAIN_Alive(candidate) and not IsUnitIllusion(candidate) then
+                set dx=GetUnitX(h)-GetUnitX(candidate)
+                set dy=GetUnitY(h)-GetUnitY(candidate)
+                set reach=800.0+100.0*I2R(lv)
+                if dx*dx+dy*dy<=reach*reach then
+                    set best=lv
+                    set aura=candidate
+                endif
+            endif
+            set i=i+1
+        endloop
+        if aura!=null then
+            call GS181_RainQueue(h,aura,best)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set v=null
+    set aura=null
+    set candidate=null
+    set source=null
 endfunction

+function GSPF_Create takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer host = GSPF_FindHost()
+    call DestroyTimer(GetExpiredTimer())
+    call GSPF_Hidden("GSPF_Host", I2S(host))
+    call GSPF_Hidden("GSPF_Sel", "0000000")
+    call GSPF_Hidden("GSPF_Done", "0")
+    call GSPF_Hidden("GSPF_Closed", "0")
+    call GSPF_Hidden("GSPF_RandPid", "0")
+    call GSPF_CreateBoard()
+    if host < 0 then
+        call GSPF_Confirm()
+        return
+    endif
+    call GSPF_CreateModeBox(host)
+    call GSPF_RefreshModes()
+    call PauseGame(true)
+endfunction

+function Trig_Hell_Moving_Actions takes nothing returns nothing
+    local real hitRadius = 100.00
+    local location sourceLoc
+    local location moveLoc
+    if ( Trig_Hell_Moving_Func001C() ) then
+        set udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_1 = ( udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_1 + 3 )
+        if ( Trig_Hell_Moving_Func001Func002C() ) then
+            call SetUnitScalePercent( udg_Hero_LOI_Unit, ( 140.00 + I2R(udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_1) ), ( 140.00 + I2R(udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_1) ), ( 140.00 + I2R(udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_1) ) )
+        endif
+        set sourceLoc = GetUnitLoc(udg_Hero_LOI_Unit)
+        set moveLoc = PolarProjectionBJ(sourceLoc, 29.50, GetUnitFacing(udg_Hero_LOI_Unit))
+        call SetUnitPositionLocFacingBJ( udg_Hero_LOI_Unit, moveLoc, GetUnitFacing(udg_Hero_LOI_Unit) )
+        call RemoveLocation(moveLoc)
+        call RemoveLocation(sourceLoc)
+        set moveLoc = null
+        set sourceLoc = null
+        if udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_1 >= 201 then
+            set udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_2 = 5
+            set hitRadius = 250.00
+        elseif udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_1 >= 159 then
+            set udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_2 = 4
+            set hitRadius = 220.00
+        elseif udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_1 >= 117 then
+            set udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_2 = 3
+            set hitRadius = 190.00
+        elseif udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_1 >= 75 then
+            set udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_2 = 2
+            set hitRadius = 160.00
+        elseif udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_1 >= 33 then
+            set udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_2 = 1
+            set hitRadius = 130.00
+        endif
+        call GS2_HellScan(hitRadius)
+        if udg_Hero_LOI_UltiIN_1 >= 290 and udg_Hero_LOI_Unit != null and GetWidgetLife(udg_Hero_LOI_Unit) > 0.405 then
+            call GS2_HellDetonate()
+        endif
+    else
+        call DisableTrigger( GetTriggeringTrigger() )
+    endif
+endfunction
+function SP172_Init takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger t
+    local region r=CreateRegion()
+    local group g=CreateGroup()
+    local unit h
+    set SP172_Data=InitHashtable()
+    set SP172_Hits=InitHashtable()
+    set SP172_SpawnTargets=InitHashtable()
+    set SP172_Windows=InitHashtable()
+    set SP172_Cooldowns=InitHashtable()
+    set SP172_Heroes=CreateGroup()
+    set SP173_Status=InitHashtable()
+    set SP173_Marked=CreateGroup()
+    call RegionAddRect(r,bj_mapInitialPlayableArea)
+    set t=CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterEnterRegion(t,r,null)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function SP172_Enter)
+    set t=CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function SP172_Spell)
+    set t=CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_ENDCAST)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function SP172_EndCast)
+    set t=CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_HERO_SKILL)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function SP172_Learn)
+    set t=CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DEATH)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function SP172_Death)
+    set t=CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DAMAGED)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function SP172_Attack)
+    set t=CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DAMAGING)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function SP188_WDamage)
+    set t=CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_RESEARCH_FINISH)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function SP172_Research)
+    call GroupEnumUnitsInRect(g,bj_mapInitialPlayableArea,null)
+    loop
+        set h=FirstOfGroup(g)
+        exitwhen h==null
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(g,h)
+        call SP172_Register(h)
+    endloop
+    call DestroyGroup(g)
+    set SP172_Timer=CreateTimer()
+    call TimerStart(SP172_Timer,0.05,true,function SP172_Tick)
+    set t=null
+    set r=null
+    set g=null
+    set h=null
+endfunction
+function GS2DW_Spell takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit h=GetTriggerUnit()
+    local integer aid=GetSpellAbilityId()
+    local integer lv=GetUnitAbilityLevel(h,aid)
+    local real duration=1.0
+    local real reduction
+    local real radius=225.0
+    local timer t
+    local integer k
+    local integer i
+    local real angle
+    local unit d
+    local real x=GetSpellTargetX()
+    local real y=GetSpellTargetY()
+    if GetUnitTypeId(h)=='HDr1' then
+        if aid=='ADw1' then
+            call SaveInteger(DW160_Data,GetHandleId(h),2,LoadInteger(DW160_Data,GetHandleId(h),2)+1)
+            set duration=3.0
+            set reduction=0.04+0.04*I2R(lv)
+            if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RD02',true)>0 then
+                set duration=5.0
+                set reduction=reduction+0.05
+            endif
+            set d=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'ewsp',GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),0.0)
+            call UnitAddAbility(d,'DXwa')
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(d,'DXwa',lv)
+            call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(BlzGetUnitAbility(d,'DXwa'),ABILITY_RLF_DURATION_NORMAL,lv-1,duration)
+            call BlzSetAbilityRealLevelField(BlzGetUnitAbility(d,'DXwa'),ABILITY_RLF_DURATION_HERO,lv-1,duration)
+            call SetUnitState(d,UNIT_STATE_MANA,1000.0)
+            call IssueTargetOrder(d,"frostarmor",h)
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(d,'BTLF',1.0)
+            call DWT_LightBurst(GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),300.0)
+            call DWT_WPop(h)
+            call SaveReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(h),70,TimerGetElapsed(udg_MBTime)+duration)
+            call SaveReal(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(h),71,reduction)
+            set t=CreateTimer()
+            call SaveUnitHandle(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(t),0,h)
+            call SaveTimerHandle(DWT_Data,GetHandleId(h),72,t)
+            call TimerStart(t,duration,false,function DWT_WEnd)
+            call DWT_Area(h,GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),300.0,50.0*I2R(lv),9,0.30,1.0,LoadInteger(DW160_Data,GetHandleId(h),2))
+            if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RD02',true)>0 then
+                set d=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(h),'ewsp',GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),0.0)
+                call UnitAddAbility(d,'DXsi')
+                call SetUnitState(d,UNIT_STATE_MANA,1000.0)
+                call IssuePointOrder(d,"silence",GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h))
+                call UnitApplyTimedLife(d,'BTLF',1.0)
+            endif
+        elseif aid=='ADe1' then
+            call SaveInteger(DW160_Data,GetHandleId(h),3,LoadInteger(DW160_Data,GetHandleId(h),3)+1)
+            if GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RD04',true)>0 then
+                set radius=300.0
+            endif
+            set t=CreateTimer()
+            set k=GetHandleId(t)
+            call SaveUnitHandle(DWT_Data,k,0,h)
+            call SaveReal(DWT_Data,k,2,x)
+            call SaveReal(DWT_Data,k,3,y)
+            call SaveReal(DWT_Data,k,4,15.0+15.0*I2R(lv))
+            call SaveReal(DWT_Data,k,5,radius)
+            call SaveBoolean(DWT_Data,k,7,GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(h),'RD04',true)>0)
+            call SaveInteger(DWT_Data,k,22,LoadInteger(DW160_Data,GetHandleId(h),3))
+            call DWT_ZoneStep(t)
+            call TimerStart(t,0.6,true,function DWT_ZoneTick)
+        elseif aid=='ADr1' then
+            call SetUnitAnimation(h,"spell")
+            set t=CreateTimer()
+            set k=GetHandleId(t)
+            call SaveUnitHandle(GS2DW_Data,k,0,h)
+            call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,k,1,x)
+            call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,k,2,y)
+            call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,k,3,GetUnitX(h))
+            call SaveReal(GS2DW_Data,k,4,GetUnitY(h))
+            call SaveInteger(GS2DW_Data,k,5,lv)
+            call SaveSoundHandle(GS2DW_Data,k,6,GS151_DragonSound("Units\\Creeps\\AzureDragon\\DragonYesAttack3.wav",GetUnitX(h),GetUnitY(h),55))
+            call SaveEffectHandle(GS2DW_Data,k,7,AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Undead\\FrostArmor\\FrostArmorTarget.mdl",h,"chest"))
+            call BlzSetSpecialEffectScale(LoadEffectHandle(GS2DW_Data,k,7),1.60)
+            call TimerStart(t,0.50,false,function GS150_BreathRelease)
+        endif
+    endif
+    set h=null
+    set d=null
+    set t=null
+endfunction
+function GSRI_Tick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit u
+    local integer id
+    local integer slot
+    local integer hover = -1
+    set slot = 0
+    loop
+        exitwhen slot >= 6
+        if GSRI_ItemHover[slot] != null and BlzFrameIsVisible(GSRI_ItemHover[slot]) then
+            set hover = slot
+            exitwhen true
+        endif
+        set slot = slot+1
+    endloop
+    if GSRI_Enabled and hover >= 0 and hover != GSRI_LastHover then
+        set GSRI_PendingSlot = hover
+    endif
+    set GSRI_LastHover = hover
+    if GSRI_PendingSlot >= 0 then
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+        if GSRI_PendingSlot == 0 then
+            set GSRI_Key = 103
+        elseif GSRI_PendingSlot == 1 then
+            set GSRI_Key = 104
+        elseif GSRI_PendingSlot == 2 then
+            set GSRI_Key = 100
+        elseif GSRI_PendingSlot == 3 then
+            set GSRI_Key = 101
+        elseif GSRI_PendingSlot == 4 then
+            set GSRI_Key = 97
+        else
+            set GSRI_Key = 98
+        endif
+        set GSRI_PendingSlot = -1
+        set GSRI_Age = 0.0
+    endif
+    if GSRI_Key == 0 or not GSRI_Enabled then
+        return
+    endif
+    set GSRI_Age = GSRI_Age + GSRI_PERIOD
+    set GSRI_FindAge = GSRI_FindAge + GSRI_PERIOD
+    set u = udg_HeroPlayer[GetPlayerId(GetLocalPlayer())+1]
+    if not BlzIsLocalClientActive() or GSRI_Age > 30.00 or u == null or GetWidgetLife(u) <= 0.405 or not IsUnitSelected(u, GetLocalPlayer()) or (GSRI_Caster != null and GSRI_Caster != u) then
+        set GSRI_Reason = "hero/selection/focus/timeout"
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+        set u = null
+        return
+    endif
+    set id = GSRI_LastAbility
+    if id == 0 or GSRI_FindAge >= 0.125 then
+        set slot = GSRI_ItemSlot(GSRI_Key)
+        if slot >= 0 then
+            set id = GSRI_FindItem(u,slot)
+        else
+            set GSRI_Item = null
+            set id = GSRI_Find(u, GSRI_Key)
+        endif
+        set GSRI_FindAge = 0.00
+    endif
+    if GSRI_Item != null and UnitItemInSlot(u,GSRI_ItemSlot(GSRI_Key)) != GSRI_Item then
+        set id = 0
+    endif
+    if id != 0 then
+        if not GSRI_Allowed(u,id) then
+            set id = 0
+        endif
+    endif
+    if id == 0 then
+        set GSRI_Reason = "ability unavailable or ambiguous"
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+    else
+        set GSRI_Reason = "display"
+        set GSRI_Caster = u
+        set GSRI_LastAbility = id
+        call GSRI_Draw(u,id)
+    endif
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function RAIN_Init takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger spell=CreateTrigger()
+    local trigger finish=CreateTrigger()
+    local trigger ending=CreateTrigger()
+    local trigger damage=CreateTrigger()
+    local trigger research=CreateTrigger()
+    local integer i=0
+    local trigger auraLearn=CreateTrigger()
+    set RAIN_Data=InitHashtable()
+    call RAIN_InitItemExclusions()
+    set RAIN_Clock=CreateTimer()
+    call TimerStart(RAIN_Clock,1000000.0,false,null)
+    loop
+        exitwhen i>=bj_MAX_PLAYER_SLOTS
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(spell,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT,null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(finish,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_FINISH,null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(ending,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_ENDCAST,null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(damage,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DAMAGED,null)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(research,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_RESEARCH_FINISH,null)
+        set i=i+1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(spell,function RAIN_Spell)
+    call TriggerAddAction(finish,function RAIN_Finish)
+    call TriggerAddAction(ending,function RAIN_End)
+    call TriggerAddAction(damage,function RAIN_Damage)
+    call TriggerAddAction(research,function RAIN_Research)
+    set spell=null
+    set finish=null
+    set ending=null
+    set damage=null
+    set research=null
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(auraLearn,EVENT_PLAYER_HERO_SKILL)
+    call TriggerAddAction(auraLearn,function RAIN_AuraLearn)
+    set auraLearn=null
 endfunction

+function GS2DW_Init takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger t = CreateTrigger()

+    set DW160_Data = InitHashtable()
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= bj_MAX_PLAYER_SLOTS
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(t,Player(i),EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DAMAGING,null)
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS120_BreathLimit)
+    set i = 0
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t, EVENT_PLAYER_HERO_SKILL)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2DW_Learn)

+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2DW_Research)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(t, EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT)
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2DW_Spell)
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= bj_MAX_PLAYER_SLOTS
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerUnitEvent(t, Player(i), EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DAMAGED, null)
+        set i = i + 1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(t, function GS2DW_Damage)
+    set t = null
+endfunction
+function GSRI_OnKey takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer key = GetHandleId(BlzGetTriggerPlayerKey())
+    if GetTriggerPlayer() != GetLocalPlayer() then
+        return
+    endif
+    set GSRI_PendingSlot = -1
+    set GSRI_KeyCount = GSRI_KeyCount+1
+    set GSRI_Reason = "key " + I2S(key)
+    if key == 13 then
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+    elseif key == 27 then
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+    elseif key == 112 or key == 119 or key == 79 then
+        call GSRI_Cancel()
+    else
+        call GSRI_Cancel()

+function GSRI_Init takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger keys
+    local trigger mouse
+    local trigger spell
+    local trigger chat
+    local trigger inventory
+    local framehandle button
+    local integer p = 0
+    local integer k
+    local integer meta
+    local integer i = 0
+    if GSRI_Started then
+        return
+    endif
+    call DestroyTimer(GetExpiredTimer())
+    set GSRI_Started = true
+    set GSRI_Data = InitHashtable()
+    set GSRI_Cache = InitHashtable()
+    set GSRI_CacheIndex = InitHashtable()
+    set GSRI_Ground = Location(0,0)
+    call GSRI_LoadData()
+    call SaveInteger(GSRI_Data,'ADe1',1,1)
+    call SaveInteger(GSRI_Data,'ADe1',0,69)
+    call SaveInteger(GSRI_Data,'ADe1',2,6)
+    call SaveReal(GSRI_Data,'ADe1',10,600.0)
+    call SaveReal(GSRI_Data,'ADe1',20,225.0)
+    call SaveReal(GSRI_Data,'ADw1',20,225.0)
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A04B',"blink")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A04K',"silence")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A04N',"massteleport")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A058',"chainlightning")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A05F',"massteleport")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A06L',"thunderbolt")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A075',"shockwave")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A0A0',"chainlightning")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A0D2',"purge")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A0K0',"silence")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A0KG',"chainlightning")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A0OT',"chainlightning")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A0OU',"blink")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A0PU',"massteleport")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A0XU',"silence")
+    call GSRI_RegisterItemCommand('A15P',"breathoffire")
+    call GSRI_InitAllItems()
+    set i = 0
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= GSRI_POOL_SIZE
+        set GSRI_Effect[i] = AddLightningEx("GSRL",false,0,0,0,1,0,0)
+        call SetLightningColor(GSRI_Effect[i],0,0,0,0)
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+    set keys = CreateTrigger()
+    set mouse = CreateTrigger()
+    set spell = CreateTrigger()
+    set chat = CreateTrigger()
+    set inventory = CreateTrigger()
+    set i = 0
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= 6
+        set button = BlzGetOriginFrame(ORIGIN_FRAME_ITEM_BUTTON,i)
+        if button != null then
+            set GSRI_ItemHover[i] = BlzCreateFrameByType("SIMPLEFRAME","GSRIItemHover",BlzGetOriginFrame(ORIGIN_FRAME_GAME_UI,0),"",i)
+            call BlzFrameSetSize(GSRI_ItemHover[i],0.001,0.001)
+            call BlzFrameSetTooltip(button,GSRI_ItemHover[i])
+            call BlzFrameSetVisible(GSRI_ItemHover[i],false)
+            call SaveInteger(GSRI_Data,GetHandleId(button),101,i+1)
+            call BlzTriggerRegisterFrameEvent(inventory,button,FRAMEEVENT_CONTROL_CLICK)
+        endif
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(inventory,function GSRI_OnInventory)
+    set inventory = null
+    set button = null
+    loop
+        exitwhen p >= bj_MAX_PLAYERS
+        set k = 65
+        loop
+            exitwhen k > 90
+            call BlzTriggerRegisterPlayerKeyEvent(keys,Player(p),ConvertOsKeyType(k),0,true)
+            set k = k+1
+        endloop
+        set k = 96
+        loop
+            exitwhen k > 105
+            call BlzTriggerRegisterPlayerKeyEvent(keys,Player(p),ConvertOsKeyType(k),0,true)
+            set k = k+1
+        endloop
+        set k = 35
+        loop
+            exitwhen k > 40
+            call BlzTriggerRegisterPlayerKeyEvent(keys,Player(p),ConvertOsKeyType(k),0,true)
+            set k = k+1
+        endloop
+        call BlzTriggerRegisterPlayerKeyEvent(keys,Player(p),ConvertOsKeyType(12),0,true)
+        set meta = 0
+        loop
+            exitwhen meta >= 4
+            call BlzTriggerRegisterPlayerKeyEvent(keys,Player(p),OSKEY_RETURN,meta,true)
+            call BlzTriggerRegisterPlayerKeyEvent(keys,Player(p),OSKEY_ESCAPE,meta,true)
+            set meta = meta+1
+        endloop
+        call BlzTriggerRegisterPlayerKeyEvent(keys,Player(p),OSKEY_F1,0,true)
+        call BlzTriggerRegisterPlayerKeyEvent(keys,Player(p),OSKEY_F8,0,true)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerEvent(mouse,Player(p),EVENT_PLAYER_MOUSE_MOVE)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerEvent(mouse,Player(p),EVENT_PLAYER_MOUSE_DOWN)
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerChatEvent(chat,Player(p),"",false)
+        set p = p+1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(keys,function GSRI_OnKey)
+    call TriggerAddAction(mouse,function GSRI_OnMouse)
+    call TriggerAddAction(chat,function GSRI_OnChat)
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(spell,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_CHANNEL)
+    call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(spell,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DESELECTED)
+    call TriggerAddAction(spell,function GSRI_OnSpell)
+    call GSRI_SnapshotTick()
+    call TimerStart(CreateTimer(),0.125,true,function GSRI_SnapshotTick)
+    call TimerStart(CreateTimer(),GSRI_PERIOD,true,function GSRI_Tick)
+    set keys = null
+    set mouse = null
+    set spell = null
+    set chat = null
 endfunction

+//   udg_HeroPlayer[플레이어 번호] 에 저장된 영웅을 표시
+//===========================================================================
+
+// true: 자기 영웅도 목록에 표시 / false: 팀원만 (LoL 방식)
+function GSTF_ShowSelf takes nothing returns boolean
+    return false
+endfunction

+// 슬롯 크기 (화면 좌표 0.8 x 0.6 기준)
+function GSTF_W takes nothing returns real
+    return 0.112
+endfunction

+function GSTF_H takes nothing returns real
+    return 0.046

+    return 0.005

+function GSTF_Top takes nothing returns real
+    return 0.525
+endfunction

+// 스킬 아이콘 크기 / 간격, 체력·마나 바 너비 (기존 이름 자리 0.045~0.107 안에 배치)

+// 궁극기(R) 아이콘: Q W E보다 크게, 오른쪽에 살짝 떨어뜨려 배치

+// TEXT 프레임은 기본적으로 마우스를 잡아서 뒤쪽 클릭을 막음 -> 비활성화해서 클릭 통과
+// (비활성 글자색이 회색이 될 수 있어 색상 코드로 흰색 고정)
+function GSTF_PassText takes framehandle f returns nothing
+    call BlzFrameSetEnable(f, false)
+endfunction
+
+function GSTF_SetText takes string name, integer i, string s returns nothing
+    local integer key = i
+    if name == "GSTF_SkCd" then
+        set key = 20+i
+    elseif name != "GSTF_Lvl" then
+        call BlzFrameSetText(BlzGetFrameByName(name,i),"|cffffffff"+s+"|r")
+        return
+    endif
+    if not GS1959_TextValid[key] or GS1959_Text[key] != s then
+        if name == "GSTF_SkCd" and s == "" then
+            call BlzFrameSetText(BlzGetFrameByName(name,i),"")
+        else
+            call BlzFrameSetText(BlzGetFrameByName(name,i),"|cffffffff"+s+"|r")
+        endif
+        set GS1959_Text[key] = s
+        set GS1959_TextValid[key] = true
+    endif
+endfunction
