+library GS19513FlameBurst initializer GS19513_FlameBurstInit
+globals
+    string array GS19513_FlameBurstStatus
+    boolean GS19513_FlameBurstStarted = false
+    boolean GS19513_FlameBurstInstalled = false
+endglobals
+function GS19513_Flag takes boolean flag returns string
+    if flag then
+        return "1"
+    endif
+    return "0"
+endfunction
+function GS19513_FlameBurstAction takes nothing returns nothing
+    local unit caster = GetTriggerUnit()
+    local player owner = GetOwningPlayer(caster)
+    local integer pid = GetPlayerId(owner)
+    local integer level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(caster,'A0CP')
+    local integer trait = GetPlayerTechCount(owner,'R048',true)
+    local integer rank = level
+    local integer actual = 0
+    local real x = GetUnitX(caster)
+    local real y = GetUnitY(caster)
+    local real damage = 0.0
+    local real radius = 0.0
+    local real slow = 0.0
+    local unit dummy = null
+    local ability payload = null
+    local boolean added = false
+    local boolean ordered = false
+    if level >= 1 and level <= 4 then
+        if trait > 0 then
+            set rank = level+4
+        endif
+        // Preserve the existing explosion visual, without asking its model to cast.
+        call GS2V84_CreateNUnitsAtLoc_3(1,'h00W',owner,Location(x,y),bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        call UnitApplyTimedLife(GetLastCreatedUnit(),'BTLF',3.00)
+        // 1.07/1.5005 used ewsp as the actual A0CV caster as well.
+        set dummy = CreateUnit(owner,'ewsp',x,y,bj_UNIT_FACING)
+        if dummy != null then
+            call UnitApplyTimedLife(dummy,'BTLF',3.00)
+            call UnitAddAbility(dummy,'Aloc')
+            call BlzSetUnitRealField(dummy,UNIT_RF_CAST_POINT,0.0)
+            call BlzSetUnitRealField(dummy,UNIT_RF_CAST_BACK_SWING,0.0)
+            call SetUnitState(dummy,UNIT_STATE_MANA,GetUnitState(dummy,UNIT_STATE_MAX_MANA))
+            set added = UnitAddAbility(dummy,'A0CV')
+            if added then
+                call SetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy,'A0CV',rank)
+                set actual = GetUnitAbilityLevel(dummy,'A0CV')
+                set payload = BlzGetUnitAbility(dummy,'A0CV')
+                if actual == rank and payload != null then
+                    set damage = BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(payload,ABILITY_RLF_AOE_DAMAGE,actual-1)
+                    set radius = BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(payload,ABILITY_RLF_AREA_OF_EFFECT,actual-1)
+                    set slow = BlzGetAbilityRealLevelField(payload,ABILITY_RLF_MOVEMENT_SPEED_REDUCTION_PERCENT_HTC3,actual-1)
+                    call BlzEndUnitAbilityCooldown(dummy,'A0CV')
+                    set ordered = IssueImmediateOrderById(dummy,852096)
+                endif
+            endif
+        endif
+        set GS19513_FlameBurstStatus[pid] = "[투마 W 진단] 스킬="+I2S(level)+" 특성="+I2S(trait)+" 내부="+I2S(actual)+"/"+I2S(rank)+" 부여="+GS19513_Flag(added)+" 명령접수="+GS19513_Flag(ordered)+" 피해설정="+R2S(damage)+" 범위="+R2S(radius)+" 감속설정="+R2S(slow)
+    else
+        set GS19513_FlameBurstStatus[pid] = "[투마 W 진단] 잘못된 시전자/스킬 레벨: "+I2S(level)
+    endif
+    set payload = null
+    set dummy = null
+    set caster = null
+    set owner = null
+endfunction
+
+function GS19513_FlameBurstChat takes nothing returns nothing
+    local player p = GetTriggerPlayer()
+    local string status = GS19513_FlameBurstStatus[GetPlayerId(p)]
+    if not GS19513_FlameBurstInstalled then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,20,"[투마 W 진단] 발동 처리 설치가 확인되지 않았습니다.")
+    elseif status == null or status == "" then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,15,"[투마 W 진단] 아직 시전 기록이 없습니다.")
+    else
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,20,status)
+    endif
+    set p = null
+endfunction
+function GS19513_FlameBurstInstall takes nothing returns nothing
+    call DestroyTimer(GetExpiredTimer())
+    if gg_trg_Flame_Burst != null then
+        call TriggerClearActions(gg_trg_Flame_Burst)
+        call TriggerAddAction(gg_trg_Flame_Burst,function GS19513_FlameBurstAction)
+        set GS19513_FlameBurstInstalled = true
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GS19513_FlameBurstInit takes nothing returns nothing
+    local trigger t
+    local integer i = 0
+    if GS19513_FlameBurstStarted then
+        return
+    endif
+    set GS19513_FlameBurstStarted = true
+    set t = CreateTrigger()
+    loop
+        exitwhen i >= 12
+        call TriggerRegisterPlayerChatEvent(t,Player(i),"-투마진단",true)
+        set i = i+1
+    endloop
+    call TriggerAddAction(t,function GS19513_FlameBurstChat)
+    call TimerStart(CreateTimer(),0.0,false,function GS19513_FlameBurstInstall)
+    set t = null
+endfunction

+library GS19514Burn initializer GS19514_BurnInit
+globals
+    group GS19514_BurnSources = null
+    group GS19514_BurnTargets = null
+    timer GS19514_BurnClock = null
+    boolean GS19514_BurnStarted = false
+    integer GS19514_BurnPulses = 0
+    string array GS19514_BurnStatus
+endglobals
+function GS19514_IsFlameBlader takes unit u returns boolean
+    return u != null and GetUnitTypeId(u) == 'Odrt' and not IsUnitIllusion(u)
+endfunction
+function GS19514_BurnSync takes unit u returns integer
+    local integer level = GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'ANic')
+    local integer resist = level
+    local boolean learned = GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(u),'R04B',true) > 0
+    if level < 1 or level > 4 then
+        call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A0UG')
+        call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A11Q')
+        return 0
+    endif
+    if learned then
+        set resist = level+1
+    endif
+    if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A11Q') == 0 then
+        call UnitAddAbility(u,'A11Q')
+    endif
+    if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A11Q') != resist then
+        call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A11Q',resist)
+    endif
+    if learned then
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0UG') == 0 then
+            call UnitAddAbility(u,'A0UG')
+        endif
+        if GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0UG') != level then
+            call SetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0UG',level)
+        endif
+        return level
+    endif
+    call UnitRemoveAbility(u,'A0UG')
+    return 0
+endfunction
+function GS19514_BurnTrack takes unit u returns nothing
+    if GS19514_BurnSources != null and GS19514_IsFlameBlader(u) then
+        call GroupAddUnit(GS19514_BurnSources,u)
+        call GS19514_BurnSync(u)
+    endif
+endfunction
+function GS19514_BurnEnter takes nothing returns nothing
+    call GS19514_BurnTrack(GetEnteringUnit())
+endfunction
+function GS19514_BurnHeroEvent takes nothing returns nothing
+    call GS19514_BurnTrack(GetTriggerUnit())
+endfunction
+function GS19514_BurnSold takes nothing returns nothing
+    call GS19514_BurnTrack(GetSoldUnit())
+endfunction
+function GS19514_BurnResearch takes nothing returns nothing
+    local group scan = CreateGroup()
+    local player owner = GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit())
+    local unit u
+    call GroupEnumUnitsOfPlayer(scan,owner,null)
+    set u = FirstOfGroup(scan)
+    loop
+        exitwhen u == null
+        call GroupRemoveUnit(scan,u)
+        call GS19514_BurnTrack(u)
+        set u = FirstOfGroup(scan)
+    endloop
+    call DestroyGroup(scan)
+    set scan = null
+    set owner = null
+    set u = null
+endfunction
+function GS19514_BurnTick takes nothing returns nothing
+    local integer i = BlzGroupGetSize(GS19514_BurnSources)-1
+    local integer level
+    local integer pid
+    local integer hits
+    local unit source
+    local unit target
+    local real before
+    local real remaining
+    local real drained
+    set GS19514_BurnPulses = GS19514_BurnPulses+1
+    loop
+        exitwhen i < 0
+        set source = BlzGroupUnitAt(GS19514_BurnSources,i)
+        if not GS19514_IsFlameBlader(source) then
+            call GroupRemoveUnit(GS19514_BurnSources,source)
+        elseif GetWidgetLife(source) > 0.405 and not IsUnitType(source,UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) then
+            set level = GS19514_BurnSync(source)
+            set pid = GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(source))
+            set hits = 0
+            set drained = 0.0
+            if level >= 1 and level <= 4 then
+                call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(GS19514_BurnTargets,GetUnitX(source),GetUnitY(source),250.0,null)
+                set target = FirstOfGroup(GS19514_BurnTargets)
+                loop
+                    exitwhen target == null
+                    call GroupRemoveUnit(GS19514_BurnTargets,target)
+                    if IsUnitEnemy(target,GetOwningPlayer(source)) and GetWidgetLife(target) > 0.405 and not IsUnitType(target,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE) and not IsUnitType(target,UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL) and not IsUnitType(target,UNIT_TYPE_MAGIC_IMMUNE) and not BlzIsUnitInvulnerable(target) then
+                        set before = GetUnitState(target,UNIT_STATE_MANA)
+                        set remaining = RMaxBJ(0.0,before-(2.0+2.0*I2R(level)))
+                        call SetUnitState(target,UNIT_STATE_MANA,remaining)
+                        set drained = drained+before-remaining
+                        set hits = hits+1
+                    endif
+                    set target = FirstOfGroup(GS19514_BurnTargets)
+                endloop
+            endif
+            set GS19514_BurnStatus[pid] = "[업화 진단] 주기="+I2S(GS19514_BurnPulses)+" E="+I2S(GetUnitAbilityLevel(source,'ANic'))+" 특성="+I2S(GetPlayerTechCount(GetOwningPlayer(source),'R04B',true))+" 활성="+I2S(level)+" 주변대상="+I2S(hits)+" 최근차감합="+R2S(drained)
+        endif
+        set i = i-1
+    endloop
+    set source = null
+    set target = null
+endfunction
+function GS19514_BurnChat takes nothing returns nothing
+    local player p = GetTriggerPlayer()
+    local string status = GS19514_BurnStatus[GetPlayerId(p)]
+    if status == null or status == "" then
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,20,"[업화 진단] 주기="+I2S(GS19514_BurnPulses)+" 추적투마="+I2S(BlzGroupGetSize(GS19514_BurnSources))+" 본인 기록 없음")
+    else
+        call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p,0,0,20,"현재주기="+I2S(GS19514_BurnPulses)+" "+status)
+    endif
+    set p = null
+endfunction

+    call TimerStart(GS19514_BurnClock,1.0,true,function GS19514_BurnTick)
+    call TimerStart(CreateTimer(),0.0,false,function GS19514_BurnBootstrap)
+    set enter = null
+    set hero = null
+    set sold = null
+    set chat = null
+    set area = null
+endfunction
